Looking past the girl to the sky, Fang Yuan spoke in a distant, reminiscent daze: "Little lady, have you ever heard of soul seizure?"

Fang Yuan gently explained: "It seems you have. Near death with no one to rescue me, I had no choice but to escape with my soul. Teleporting back with my Gu worm, I ran into you coincidentally."

"Hehe, if I meant you harm, I would have killed you long ago, rather than letting you accompany me or teaching you how to battle, right?"

"If I wanted to guard against you, I wouldn't have let you witness this. As a northern plains native and the great Chang Shan Yin, I would never harm a girl like you. Why did I wait twenty years to seize a body? Because I refused to slaughter a fellow northern plains native for selfish reasons. Little lady, will you attack me over an outsider?" Fang Yuan smiled brightly, his tone overflowing with righteousness.

# Chapter 433: Snow Wash Gu

Ge Yao lowered her guard slightly: "That makes sense. If you truly are Chang Shan Yin, you are our northern plains' great hero! I wouldn't oppose you over an outsider, but how can you prove your identity?"

Fang Yuan chuckled, donning the proud demeanor of a senior expert: "I, Chang Shan Yin, stand by my name. Why should I prove myself? Little girl, if you wish to leave, I will not stop you."

Pressing his advantage, Fang Yuan continued: "Little girl, being cautious is fine, but consider how many chances I had to kill you along the way—especially while we were flying. Had I released my grip, you would have fallen into the earth spike rats to certain death. Our meeting was fated; if you had the courage to flee your marriage, why lack the courage to face me?"

"Come with me," Fang Yuan added. "It isn't safe to wander deep in poison grassland alone. Weren't you searching for the snow spirea? You wanted to find a snow wash Gu to earn clan merit and cancel your marriage, right? Frankly, that is unrealistic; one or two snow wash Gu won't change your situation."

"I also happen to need a snow wash Gu. I'll take you to find the snow spirea, catch a few, and then return you to your tribe to persuade your father personally. What do you think?"

"Really?" Ge Yao's eyes lit up. "Father idolizes you as a great hero—he will definitely listen to you! But why do you still need a snow wash Gu? Your mother has already passed away..."

Fang Yuan sighed with a bitter smile. "My mother died of poison twenty years ago because I failed to return with a snow wash Gu in time. Ever since, snow wash Gu has become my obsession. I must capture one and kneel before my mother's tomb to repent."

Moved by Fang Yuan's tears and completely fooled by his lies, the girl consoled him: "Senior Chang Shan Yin, this isn't your fault. It was all because of that damned Ha Tu Gu!"

"Don't speak anymore, let's go." Fang Yuan waved his hand and walked forward.

As they ventured deeper into poison grassland, the purple fog thickened, and even poison-resistant beasts like poison beard wolves rarely appeared.

"Senior Chang Shan Yin, we should return or head in another direction for the snow spirea. If we go deeper, I'm afraid..." Ge Yao's face was purplish; she had reached her limit.

Fang Yuan shook his head, rejecting her suggestion and pressing forward.

The girl did not understand, but Fang Yuan knew snow spirea thrived in intensely poisonous environments.

Sure enough, after walking a few hundred more steps, Fang Yuan spotted a snow spirea.

Standing twenty feet tall, the snow spirea's pure-white drooping branches contrasted with its pitch-black trunk and lush leaves, appearing sacred and noble amidst the purple fog.

Snow wash Gu was an invaluable rank four Gu whose extraordinary detoxification power was widely acknowledged across northern plains.

The two searched for a long while and found three snow wash Gu.

Fang Yuan took only one and gave the other two to Ge Yao, filling her with gratitude.

With the snow wash Gu acquired, Fang Yuan retrieved a dark pearl.

Sealed inside was the Immortal Gu Fixed Immortal Travel, faintly leaking immortal aura that could easily attract the attention of Gu Immortals.

He channeled primeval essence into a Gu, transforming it into a red iron cabinet that firmly sealed the dark pearl.

After traveling two to three hundred *li,* Fang Yuan stopped, placed the iron cabinet into the stamen of an earth treasury flower king Gu, and planted it deep underground.

Fang Yuan carefully erased all surface traces, completely concealing Fixed Immortal Travel for future retrieval.

The two continued moving through the grassland and returned to that battlefield.

About a hundred poison beard wolves pounced upon Fang Yuan and Ge Yao.

Fang Yuan laughed in delight rather than shock, flying into the air and pointing downward.

The hundred beast wolf king resisted fiercely, but failed utterly against Fang Yuan's hundred man soul.

Under its command, the wolf pack halted, becoming Fang Yuan's minions.

With his pack grown to a thousand wolves and four hundred beast wolf kings, poison grassland was no longer scary.

Now secure, Fang Yuan began dealing with his southern border Gu worms.

Northern plains natives were xenophobic; his original appearance would invite suspicion and ostracism, while his southern border Gu worms risked exposing his identity.

# Chapter 434: Chang Shan Yin, be my husband!

A pot of meat soup simmered over the fire, emitting a fragrant aroma.

Seeing Ge Yao staring eagerly at the pot, Fang Yuan said plainly, "No rush. The dried meat just entered the pot and needs to boil. Once it becomes soft and juicy, it'll be delicious,", taking out moving perspective cup Gu.

Moving perspective cup Gu was a rank five Gu suppressed to rank four in northern plains, with high feeding and essence costs. It also consumed massive primeval essence, yet Fang Yuan had expended great effort and resources to refine it.

Fang Yuan took out the golden dragon Gu from his aperture.

The rank four golden dragon Gu, suppressed to rank three, flew out into the moving perspective cup Gu.

The moving perspective cup Gu moved forward, vanishing piece by piece until it disappeared completely in midair.

Meanwhile, far away in Central Continent's Hu Immortal blessed land—

Moving perspective cup Gu existed as a pair; by activating his cup, it swapped positions through space with the paired cup left in Hu Immortal blessed land.

Fang Yuan took out a letter from this moving perspective cup Gu.

Written by Little Hu Immortal, it detailed the current situation in the blessed land.

Though Fang Yuan had spent only five or six days in poison grassland, a full month had passed in Hu Immortal blessed land.

Aside from Dang Hun mountain, all was well. Immortal Crane Sect had proposed another transaction, which Little Hu Immortal rejected per Fang Yuan's instructions.

After reading the letter, Fang Yuan sent a reply.

Along with the letter, Fang Yuan enclosed three rank four Gu: golden coat Gu, charging crash Gu, and bone wings Gu.

After confirming the test run succeeded, Fang Yuan began sending all his southern border Gu into the blessed land for Little Hu Immortal to tend.

He held a primeval stone to replenish his primeval essence.

Fang Yuan's new northern plains appearance from human skin Gu aligned even more with Ge Yao's sense of beauty.

The shock of their first meeting, his warm smile, insightful pointers, bravery in battle, and eerie calm while flaying his own skin—

As Fang Yuan completed the exchange and began recovering primeval essence with a primeval stone, Ge Yao made the most important decision of her life.

She stood up abruptly, shouting, "Chang Shan Yin! Be my husband!"

"What did you say?" Fang Yuan frowned; even with five hundred years of experience, he had not anticipated this sudden confession.

Recovering, he smiled: "Stop fooling around, little girl. I am over twenty years your senior; my son would be a good match for you."

"No, Chang Shan Yin, I want you!"

# Chapter 435: Don’t block my road to success!

Fang Yuan's expression turned dark: "Alright, don't make a scene."

Ge Yao stamped her foot: "I am not making a scene! Chang Shan Yin, I have fallen deeply in love with you along the way. I want to give you my everything—please accept me!"

"Little girl, I already have a wife," Fang Yuan sighed with a complex expression.

Fang Yuan refused firmly: "I will not marry again. My heart is still, just like this poison grassland. You are too young to understand. Reflecting on my past and witnessing life and death, past suffering and joy no longer touch my heart. I have been reborn as a new Chang Shan Yin, and I will not return to Chang tribe."

"Then, come to my Ge tribe." Ge Yao's eyes shone.

She pleaded with utmost sincerity, but Fang Yuan refused, remaining completely unmoved.

"Chang Shan Yin! Is your heart made of iron? Do you want me to cut out my heart like a rockman to prove it?" Ge Yao muttered, tears welling in her reddened eyes.

Attracted by the fire, a large pack of poison beard wolves rapidly approached them.

"A thousand beast pack!" Ge Yao's attention turned to the wolves, her expression becoming grave.

Previously they would have fled from such a pack, but Fang Yuan smiled coldly: "No matter, circumstances have changed; we have our own wolf pack now. Ge Yao, stall the thousand beast wolf king! My primeval essence is exhausted; I'll assist once I replenish it!"

Softening his stance, Fang Yuan said gently, "Alright, I will consider it."

"But I want the answer now!" Ge Yao immediately said.

A dark glint flashed in Fang Yuan's eyes, but he sighed and proposed: "If you kill this thousand beast king alone, I will take you as my wife."

Ge Yao's eyes lit up: "Fine, just wait!"

Filled with battle intent, the girl charged forward to engage the thousand beast wolf king.

Watching her depart, Fang Yuan's smile vanished into cold indifference.

He had not expected Ge Yao to become so enamored, love having taken deep root within her. Yet love was inherently irrational and defied common sense. Long ago, Desolate Ancient Moon climbed Cheng Bai mountain and was pursued by a rockman.

Unable to enter the Door of Life and Death to rescue Ren Zu, Desolate Ancient Moon sought guidance from cognition Gu.

Given life by love Gu, a stone became a rockman.

Tall and mighty, the rockman's body gleamed dazzlingly with gold, silver, copper, and iron.

Upon birth, the rockman saw Desolate Ancient Moon, and her stunning beauty instantly captured his heart.

Unable to hold back, he blocked Desolate Ancient Moon, shouting: "Beautiful lady, your dazzling appearance and noble grace subdued me the instant I saw you. Please accept my love!"

Desolate Ancient Moon frowned slightly, sizing up the rockman before asking coldly: "Love? What is that? You want me to accept your love, but where is it?"

The rockman immediately stripped the iron pieces from his body and offered them to Desolate Ancient Moon: "Beautiful lady, this is my firmness. I give it all to you; this is my love."

Dazed, the rockman extracted the copper pieces from his body and piled them atop the iron: "Beautiful lady, this is my obstinance. I give it all to you, for this is my love."

Desolate Ancient Moon said impatiently: "Please move away. I have no interest in love; I must rescue my father."

Seeing his goddess unmoved, the panicked rockman knelt down resolved, taking all the silver pieces from his body and piling them over the copper: "Beautiful lady, this is my dignity. I give it all to you. This will prove my love, right?"

Growing more anxious, the rockman removed all his gold pieces and placed them atop the silver: "Beautiful lady, this is my self-confidence. I give it all to you; they represent my love for you."

Desolate Ancient Moon sighed deeply: "Rockman, you gave up your firmness, obstinance, dignity, and self-confidence, yet all I see is an ugly rockman. I cannot accept your love; I have more important things to do."

Weeping, the rockman begged Desolate Ancient Moon: "Then how can I obtain your love?"

Anxious as the rockman remained kneeling, Desolate Ancient Moon had an idea and smiled: "Rockman, since you love me, take out your real heart for me to see."

Without hesitation, the rockman opened his chest and offered his scarlet heart to Desolate Ancient Moon.

Desolate Ancient Moon took the heart and immediately kept it.

The rockman asked: "Now can I obtain your love?"

Desolate Ancient Moon shook her head: "Even offering your heart cannot exchange for my love."

"Chang Shan Yin, look at this!" Bloodied, wounded, and breathing heavily, Ge Yao walked toward Fang Yuan carrying the thousand wolf king's head.

Losing their wolf king, the invading wolf pack collapsed and fled.

Fang Yuan slowly stood up and nodded: "You killed the thousand wolf king."

Ge Yao had fought valiantly but was gravely wounded, her face bloodstained and primeval essence depleted. Looking at Fang Yuan with glittering eyes, she asked: "Chang Shan Yin, you are a hero—you won't go back on your words, right?"

"Of course not. Your love has moved me. From today on, you are my wife." Fang Yuan gazed deeply at Ge Yao, stepping forward to embrace her.

*Chi.*

Her face stiffening, the girl pushed out of Fang Yuan's embrace with all her strength and looked down at her chest.

There, a sharp dagger had pierced into it.

"Wh... why?" Ge Yao stared at Fang Yuan in disbelief, trembling with anger, hatred, shock, and doubt.

Fang Yuan looked at the girl and said, expressionlessly.

"The rockman panicked seeing Desolate Ancient Moon store his heart away, crying: 'Heartless woman, your cold-heartedness brings me despair. If I cannot have your love, please return my heart. Without it, I will die.'"

"Yet Desolate Ancient Moon refused to return it, watching him slowly die."

"'Why? I love you so much, why are you killing me!" The rockman shouted before his death.""

"Desolate Ancient Moon looked at him with pity, her voice tranquil: 'Rockman, I did not want to kill you. But you blocked my path to success.'"

"Path to success?" Hearing this, Ge Yao could no longer stand and collapsed to the ground.

Looking at Fang Yuan with the same deep love, she said: "Chang Shan Yin! I don't know how I blocked your path to success, but even if you kill me, I do not hate you. Perhaps you are seeking revenge? I leave all my Gu worms to you. I hope they aid your path to success."

"*Cough, cough*..." Coughing blood, the girl smiled sorrowfully and pleaded, "I am dying, but I have one small favor. Please hold me... I want to feel your warm embrace..."

Yet Fang Yuan remained motionless, gazing down at her coldly.

Finally, the flower-like girl became an ice-cold corpse.

Fang Yuan fell into a prolonged silence, looking at Ge Yao's face.

# Chapter 436: No regret even if I die along the way

Even by day, poison grassland remained gloomy and dark, shrouded beneath thick clouds that blocked the sunlight.

After hunting down prey across the dark grassland, a hump wolf headed home. Upon returning to its den, the hump wolf found only bloodstains and cold corpses.

Dropping the rabbit, it howled furiously toward the sky, neck fur bristling as intense hatred reddened its eyes.

A pack of poison beard wolves surrounded it from all directions.

From a distant mound, Fang Yuan observed the battlefield with crossed arms.

"Hehehe, the male wolf returned as expected." He chuckled lightly, feeling his luck had finally turned.

Hump wolves were excellent northern plains mounts; riding one saved significant primeval essence compared to using wolf sprint Gu.

Stumbling upon the den earlier, Fang Yuan had killed the female and cubs, obtaining a rank two wolf enslavement Gu.

Rather than leaving in a hurry, he ambushed with his poison beard wolves to await the male's return.

Under Fang Yuan's control, the cunning poison beard wolves avoided head-on clashes, taking turns in teamwork to exhaust the hump wolf.

An hour later, the gasping hump wolf had lost all its earlier ferocity.

Around it lay sixty dead poison beard wolves; capturing it alive had cost twice the casualties of killing it outright.

"It's about time." Seeing the hump wolf's trembling limbs in the wind, Fang Yuan walked down toward it.

Two hundred steps away, Fang Yuan pointed a finger, sending out a rank two wolf enslavement Gu.

The wolf enslavement Gu burst into light smoke, blanketing the hump wolf.

Covered in bleeding wounds, the hump wolf lay weakly on the ground, its red eyes showing submission rather than hatred.

"The hundred man soul is truly useful," Fang Yuan mused, activating wolf smoke Gu in his aperture.

Wolf smoke Gu emerged as dense smoke, engulfing the hump wolf and the injured poison beard wolves.

When the smoke dispersed, the hump wolf was fully healed with new fur grown, and the wounded poison beard wolves had regained their vitality.

At Fang Yuan's command, the wolves fed on the carcasses, while the hump wolf devoured its dead mate and cubs.

Standing in place, Fang Yuan took out his rations and ate.

Three days had passed since he killed Ge Yao.

Ge Yao had to die, the moment she saw fixed immortal travel Gu, her death was guaranteed.

She had seen him enter northern plains naked, bury the Immortal Gu, and use moving perspective cup Gu.

Given her ordinary soul foundation, an enemy using mind reading Gu or recollection Gu on her would expose his plans and secrets to the world.

Her affection toward him also made his Chang Shan Yin disguise feel like a dagger at his throat, a great danger.

Returning with Ge Yao would draw heavy scrutiny from both tribes. Why court hostility for such a burden?

Fang Yuan did not fear hostility, but he was racing against time in northern plains. Dang Hun Mountain was dying, Spring Autumn Cicada was slowly recovering, and his cultivation was only rank four peak stage.

Thus, near the border of poison grassland, Fang Yuan seized a secluded moment to end her life.

After killing Ge Yao, Fang Yuan fed her corpse to the wolves and captured her soul with burial soul toad, sending it to the blessed land to be crushed on Dang Hun Mountain.

"Without eternal life, even the greatest beauty is merely a moon's reflection in water." Without immortality, all worldly glory was worthless.

"Reputation and legacy are merely superficial comforts for cowards, and spiritual immortality is just a tool for descendants. Must human existence be validated through others? Perhaps on Earth, but in this world, if there is even a slight possibility, I want to pursue it!"

"Even if I die on the road pursuing my goals, dying a million times worse than Ge Yao, I have absolutely no regrets..."

---

# Chapter 437: Wind Wolf King

Once the wolves finished eating, Fang Yuan mounted the hump wolf and resumed his journey.

"Following Ge Yao's directions these past days, I am nearing the edge of poison grassland. A bit further and I will reach human settlements."

Fang Yuan sat between the two humps, inspecting his aperture while moving forward.

Only about ten Gu worms remained in his aperture; aside from Spring Autumn Cicada and moving perspective cup Gu, all were northern plains Gu.

His Southern Border and Central Continent Gu had been sent to Hu Immortal blessed land, and he had not kept a single primeval stone.

Foreign primeval stones differed slightly from local ones; while naive Ge Yao had not noticed, experienced Gu Masters would spot the discrepancy immediately.

"I will soon encounter northern plains Gu Masters. I cannot be careless; ideally, I should subdue a thousand wolf king during this time and expand the pack to over two thousand."

"Currently, I only have one rank three and one rank two wolf enslavement Gu, so I must use them carefully. Enslaving wolves is my top priority under Chang Shan Yin's identity, but lacking recipes for rank three and four wolf enslavement Gu is a major obstacle."

Two days later, he finally reached the edge of poison grassland.

"I am finally out," Fang Yuan thought with emotion. Riding the hump wolf amidst the poison beard wolves, he stepped into the sunlight.

Just as Fang Yuan was mumbling, his body suddenly relaxed.

Ever since entering northern plains, a formless restriction had uncomfortably weighed upon him.

Now, as this restriction loosened, Fang Yuan felt much closer to this vast land.

Subsequently, his aura rose from rank three peak stage to rank four initial stage.

A surge of joy welled up, making Fang Yuan laugh heartily.

As his body adapted to northern plains and his cultivation slowly recovered, his future plans would be greatly aided.

"Northern plains, I have arrived!" Fang Yuan shouted, urging the hump wolf forward with his legs as he led the poison beard wolves into the distance.

"Kill!"

Battle cries echoed over a hill as dozens of Gu Masters fought intensely against over a thousand wind wolves.

"Damned wind wolves!" cursed the leader Ge Guang fiercely, swinging his sabre to decapitate a wind wolf.

"Damn it, I don't have enough primeval essence!"

"There are at least three thousand wolves—it's too many!"

"Young tribe leader, we are completely surrounded! Fighting to the death is hopeless; we should break out to the east where their line is weakest!"

The surrounding Gu Masters shouted one after another.

Ge Guang's fierce eyes shone, and after a moment's thought, he resolutely refused: "No, there are puddles in the east. It looks weak, but it's a trap prepared by the wind wolf king. Going there will send us right into its snare!"

"Then what should we do?"The surrounding people asked.

Gritting his teeth, Ge Guang made up his mind: "Turn around, we break through to the west."

"But we haven't found Lady Ge Yao. If we return like this, what will we tell the lord tribe leader?"

Ge Guang snorted: "Ge Yao selfishly fled regardless of our tribe's plight. Sacrificing warriors for one woman is not worth it! Let the slaves hold the line while we break out west."

"Understood!" The surrounding people immediately transmitted the order.

Soon, Gu Masters divided into two groups.

The slaves were left on the mound to hold the enemy with their lives, while Ge Guang led the rest to break through the west.

Suddenly, a large three-leaf wind blade flew towards them.

"Master!" warned a loyal Gu Master, reacting first.

Without a trace of primeval essence left, he charged forward on his hump wolf to block the wind blade with his body.

The wind blade cut him in two, ending his life instantly.

Weakened to two leaves, the wind blade still flew toward Ge Guang.

Ge Guang reacted, immediately lifting his sabre to block it.

As blade met wind, the sabre shattered; coughing up a mouthful of blood, Ge Guang tumbled from his hump wolf.

"Young tribe leader!" His men rushed to protect him, but their breakout failed as endless wind wolves encircled them once more.

The wind wolves parted as a vigorous young wind wolf king slowly stepped into view.

By now, the slave Gu Masters holding the hill were dead, and swarms of wind wolves rushed over.

With their primeval essence exhausted, the Gu Masters grew anxious at the wind wolf king's appearance.

Someone pulled Ge Guang back, but he shook them off and stood up with difficulty, shouting: "What are you afraid of? Even without primeval essence, I still have limbs and teeth! Warriors, do not let these beasts look down on us! We will use our blood to prove that we are brave warriors of Ge tribe!"

Rallied by his words, their morale surged with a resolve to fight to the death.

Pacing leisurely, the wind wolf king suddenly turned its head toward the eastern battlefield.

A large group of dark purplish poison beard wolves were rapidly closing in!

---

# Chapter 438: Benefactor Chang Shan Yin

Without pausing, the poison beard wolves charged toward the wind wolves.

"Strange, don't poison beard wolves stay in poison grassland? Why are they out here?" several Gu Masters wondered.

"A Gu Master must be controlling them!" Ge Guang clenched his fists, hope reigniting in his despairing eyes as he saw the approaching wolves.

"Young master is wise—look, there's a person!" Moments later, a Gu Master pointed into the distance.

Looking closely, they saw Fang Yuan appear atop a hump wolf.

This eased their worries, but just as hope sparked, Fang Yuan directed the poison beard wolf pack to scatter like spilled water.

Ge Guang paled. Who would want to die if there was a chance to live? Fang Yuan had given them hope only to destroy it single-handedly!

The wind wolf king howled, ordering the entire pack to attack.

Just as the two packs were about to clash, Fang Yuan let out a loud howl.

The howl carried eight hundred steps; hearing it, the poison beard wolves within range turned frenzied, doubling their battle strength!

"The rank four wolf howl Gu! It temporarily boosts a pack's battle strength—a precious Gu. This person is a rank four Gu Master!"

Though originally weaker than the wind wolves, the poison beard wolves' surged battle strength quickly overwhelmed them.

After a brief clash, the wind wolves retreated, leaving behind heaps of corpses at a trade of over a dozen wind wolves per poison beard wolf.

Fang Yuan's strength drew the wind wolves' attention to his pack. Merely surrounded rather than attacked, the Ge tribe Gu Masters gained a moment to catch their breath.

"The wind wolf king is here!" Ge Guang said, as everyone became nervous again.

With higher intelligence, the wind wolf king howled to gather its pack's elites.

Led by the wind wolf king, the elites charged like an arrow straight through the formation toward Fang Yuan.

Yet Fang Yuan smiled faintly in delight rather than fear: "It couldn't resist."

Though cunning, the wolf king was still a beast, easily baited by Fang Yuan's scattered formation into charging directly at him.

Sprinting forward, the wind wolf king opened its jaws and fired three large wind blades.

The wind blades sliced through the pack, carving a path straight toward Fang Yuan.

Unmoving, Fang Yuan waited until the last moment before steering his hump wolf aside, narrowly dodging as the teal wind blades whistled past.

At his command, several prepared poison beard wolf kings surged into formation, intercepting the wind wolf king.

Fast, tough, and fiercely offensive, the wind wolf king surpassed each poison beard wolf king, yet it still failed to break the barrier.

Fang Yuan's precise control overcame the stronger foe, restraining the wind wolf king to howl in futile rage.

With full control of the battle, Fang Yuan saw the wind wolf king preparing to flee, its fighting spirit broken.

"Rank three wolf enslavement Gu, go!"

At his command, his only rank three wolf enslavement Gu flew forth as light smoke, engulfing the wind wolf king.

The wind wolf king howled and struggled, refusing to submit to Fang Yuan's authority.

"Hmph." Fang Yuan's eyes gleamed; backed by a hundred man soul, he had no fear of soul competition.

Before long, the wind wolf king could resist no more and submitted to Fang Yuan.

With the wolf enslavement Gu planted, Fang Yuan secured his first thousand wolf king.

The wind wolf king howled, halting the pack and silencing the noisy battlefield.

Following their king, the remaining thousand wind wolves joined Fang Yuan.

Fang Yuan's pack thus doubled in size, reaching two thousand four hundred wolves.

"Without those Gu Masters pinning them down, subduing this wolf king would have cost far more," Fang Yuan mused, riding toward the mound.

Ge Guang's group held their breath—their lives hung entirely on this man's whim.

Ge Guang stepped forward and bowed deeply: "Esteemed expert, your prowess commands our deepest reverence. Our lives are in your hands; we will obey without complaint."

"Hehehe, young warrior, I saw your fight. You are as bold as a stallion—it reminds me of my younger days." Fang Yuan laughed from his wolf's back, looking upon them warmly: "You are the first people I've met since leaving poison grassland. I am glad to return to these lands. Rest assured, I, Chang Shan Yin, am no wicked villain."

"Benefactor Chang Shan Yin, I am Ge tribe's young leader. You saved my life—allow me to repay you. Please come as our guest; I will ensure your stay is comfortable," Ge Guang invited earnestly.

"Ge tribe?" Fang Yuan pondered briefly. "Very well. I have exhausted my primeval stones and need to replenish my Gu. A moment to rest and regroup is welcome."

Taking the hint to heart, the young leader's eyes brightened as he laughed heartily: "Benefactor Chang Shan Yin, thank you for accepting! Let me lead the way."

---

# Chapter 439: Ge Tribe Camp

Fang Yuan followed Ge Guang and the others towards the west.

While Fang Yuan deliberately drew close with ulterior motives, Ge Guang eagerly sought to build ties with an expert he genuinely revered.

Within two days, Fang Yuan grew close to Ge Guang.

Fang Yuan planned to use Ge tribe as a stepping stone to integrate into Northern Plains, since Chang Shan Yin's sudden return after twenty years would otherwise raise suspicion.

Five days later, the gang returned to Ge tribe's camp base.

The camp gates opened, and many Gu Masters came out to welcome them.

Watching Ge Guang draw loud cheers from the welcoming tribesmen, Fang Yuan noted the young man's high standing.

During their journey, Fang Yuan had measured Ge Guang: forthright, fiercely loyal, and valuing tribal glory above his own life. Possessing both wits and strength, he held deeply ingrained patriarchal beliefs and felt utter disgust toward his sister for fleeing her wedding.

The group followed the main path toward the camp's center.

All around them were mortal tents resembling Mongolian yurts from Earth.

Hearing the commotion, mortals lifted their window flaps, their expressions shifting at Fang Yuan's wolf pack before they pressed right hands to their chests to loudly greet Ge Guang.

Past the mortal tents, the group entered the Gu Master domain.

Grassland Gu Masters did not live in tents, but in Gu houses.

Passing the lizard houses, Fang Yuan's group arrived at the mushroom forest houses.

Formed by planting mushroom Gu, each giant mushroom dwelling could withstand storm lightning, rain, and strong winds.

Tribe elders and wealthy Gu Masters resided in the mushroom forest.

"Benefactor Chang Shan Yin, ahead lies our Ge tribe's king tent," Ge Guang said.

An amicable old man led a group of Gu Masters to welcome them.

Guessing he was the Ge tribe leader, Fang Yuan politely dismounted his hump wolf.

The old leader approached Fang Yuan, pressing a hand to his chest and bowing deeply: "Esteemed expert, you saved my son and our tribe's future. Please come in; high-quality kumis and roast beef and lamb are ready, and I will have your wolf pack fed."

"Alright." Fang Yuan nodded, following Ge tribe leader into this largest mushroom forest.

Inside the largest mushroom Gu, everyone sat in order of status.

The old leader served personally, presenting the finest cuts of roasted meat to Fang Yuan on a golden platter.

"Benefactor, please." The old leader raised his wine cup before Fang Yuan in a toast.

When Fang Yuan drained his bowl of kumis, cheers erupted and the atmosphere livened.

As the elders followed with toasts, Fang Yuan downed every cup in one gulp, winning everyone's goodwill.

"Benefactor Chang Shan Yin, your name sounds familiar—are you from Chang tribe? I have friends there, and my second daughter married into the clan; we might even be relatives," the old leader said, setting down his cup with bright, flushed eyes.

"I hail from Chang tribe's Yuan Feng branch, a Shan-generation only son. My father was Chang Sheng Dun, and my mother was Chang Cui," Fang Yuan replied with a solemn sigh.

The old leader's eyes widened in shock: "You... you are truly the hero Chang Shan Yin?!"

---

# Chapter 440: Ten Year Interval of Wind and Snow

Receiving Fang Yuan's confirmation now deeply moved him.

"Chang Shan Yin?" Ge Guang echoed from the side, puzzled.

"You are young, so it is natural you wouldn't know," the leader sighed. "Son, toast Chang Shan Yin. He is not only your benefactor, but a hero of Northern Plains!"

"Old tribe leader," Fang Yuan said with a bitter smile. "I am merely a vagabond, not a hero. By Longevity Heaven's grace, I barely survived. Yet I slept for twenty years, waking to a changed world. An unfilial son, I have no face to return to my tribe..."

Ge tribe leader consoled him: "Benefactor Chang Shan Yin, you are truly our northern plains' hero! Ha Tu Gu's savage bandits looted countless tribes and wiped out the weak."

"By slaying them, you eliminated a grave menace. Your righteousness is renowned across Northern Plains, and your return is a blessing for the righteous path!"

Ge Guang's eyes shone as he learned of Fang Yuan's legendary past, deepening his respect even further.

"Let the past be past. Our meeting is fated—let us drink." Fang Yuan brushed it aside, knowing it was best to avoid probing into Chang Shan Yin's history.

The next day, the Ge tribe leader hosted another feast.

"Benefactor Chang Shan Yin, please accept this token of gratitude for saving my son!" Before the feast began, the old leader presented Fang Yuan with a million primeval stones.

Fang Yuan was surprised, having not expected such a generous gift.

Ge tribe was only a small-to-mid-sized tribe in tight financial straits, making this a massive gesture.

The primeval stones resolved Fang Yuan's immediate needs. Accepting them, he said, "Leader Ge, I am truly short on stones. I accept without ceremony and will repay your kindness in the future."

He explained that injuries had caused his cultivation to drop from rank four peak stage to initial stage.

On the third day, Ge tribe held yet another lively banquet.

An unfamiliar elder appeared at this feast—the intelligence elder, who had been dispatched with a search party for Ge Yao just as Fang Yuan arrived.

"It is all my fault for spoiling that willful girl—she actually fled her wedding!" the Ge tribe leader sighed.

Every ten years, a catastrophic blizzard swept across the entire Northern Plains.

Lasting for months under bleak skies, razor-sharp winds and relentless snow would bury the world, turning the vast plains into a frozen realm of ice.

The leader sighed: "Brother Shan Yin, I am old and lack my youthful ambition. Seeking refuge with a Huang Jin tribe would only drag us into a vortex of conflict. Success is grand, but failure is devastating. Our clan cannot bear such catastrophic losses."

# Chapter 441: “Fortune Rivalling Heaven” Ma Hong Yun

Fang Yuan walked shoulder-to-shoulder through the crowd, surrounded by an intense festive atmosphere.

Large wooden cages packed with people lined the square.

"Inside the cages, there were children who were thin and wore no clothes, there were also kneeling men who lowered their heads while locked by a steel chain. Of course, there were women too."

Thrown into battle as a slave, he fled after defeat and miraculously saved his young clan leader, earning the surname Ma and his freedom for the feat.

The shop had plenty of rank two ghost fire Gu, but no rank one bone bamboo Gu.

# Chapter 442: Jun Strength Gu

# Chapter 443: Man Tribe’s Challenge

# Chapter 444: Man Tribe’s Invitation

"For the tribe and the big picture, even if Chang Shan Yin were the killer, we couldn't suspect him! Did you think I forgot the hints and clues Gu? Yet you mentioned it. If he were the killer, what would we have done?" the old leader said meaningfully.

After a long silence, Ge Guang asked: "So Father gave the precious hints and clues Gu to Chang Shan Yin to mend our ties and secure his support?"

Ge tribe leader shook his head: "Time waits for no man, I am already old, Ge tribe is counting on you. Sigh... after this matter, I have understood Man Tu. He is a greedy jackal, no matter how much his wealth is, he would never be satisfied."

"With your sister gone, we cannot use Hong Yan valley, nor will we surrender to Man tribe. I refuse to let Ge tribe perish and become our greatest sinner! We cannot stay and be devoured by Man tribe. In a few days, we will depart for the heroes assembly."

"Father, will they let us leave so easily?" Ge Guang asked worriedly.

"They won't want to, but we are traveling with Chang Shan Yin. Wary of him, Man Tu won't strike," Ge tribe leader snickered.

"Fool! Why wouldn't we use him? A skilled hunter uses his surroundings. When strength is lacking, wisdom supplements it. This is for the clan's survival!"

Pausing, Ge tribe leader's expression softened: "Yet Chang Shan Yin is truly a hero. He likely saw through the situation, yet still sided with us. Righteous and willing to aid the weak, he is a true model of the righteous path. Rejoice, son—Ge tribe is fortunate to meet him!"

Time passed quickly, a few days went by.

Inside his room, Fang Yuan watched ghost fire consume the final bone bamboo Gu.

After his treatment, the battle bone wheel's eight worst wounds healed; though still covered in cracks, it was out of danger.

Returning the battle bone wheel to his aperture, Fang Yuan inspected his internal sea.

His aperture walls were crystal, and his primeval sea was ninety percent full of true gold primeval essence.

However, newly arrived in Northern Plains and unadapted, his true gold essence was suppressed to rank four initial stage light gold.

With only light gold primeval essence, he could not break through the crystal walls to reach rank five.

"To speed adaptation, one could use third watch Gu to accelerate personal time, but that burns lifespan proportionally."

Accelerating his time threefold with third watch Gu would also triple Spring Autumn Cicada's recovery speed.

Fang Yuan cleared his mind: "Power underlies every scheme. Man tribe didn't attack Ge tribe directly because they are only a large tribe, not a super tribe, with limited strength. Ge tribe survived not just through me, but their foundation as a former large tribe. Had old Ge tribe leader been rank five, he might have used hints and clues Gu long ago."

"In any world, strength is fundamental. The astute Ge tribe leader likely plans migration; to survive the ten-year blizzard, he must seek the Imperial Court's protection."

# Chapter 450: Measuring the stature of great men by the yardstick of small men

A day later, Ge tribe leader visited Fang Yuan, having decided to migrate the tribe to join the heroes assembly and compete for entry into the Imperial Court.

Fang Yuan agreed at once; traveling the grasslands alone was troublesome, whereas accompanying Ge tribe lowered risks and offered protection.

"Brother Ge is wise, but we must leave immediately. Man tribe will notice the moment we move," Fang Yuan warned.

Fang Yuan added: "I had promised to visit Man tribe, but since we are relocating, I will decline for safety. Just say my cultivation is returning and I entered closed cultivation. I will write a letter now; please have someone deliver it for me."

"It is easy to be misled when embroiled in conflict," Fang Yuan consoled the old leader as he wrote and handed over the letter. "Once we leave this region, Ge tribe will be free!"

Returning to their study, the old leader immediately opened Fang Yuan's letter.

Old Ge snickered: "Chang Shan Yin sent a normal letter so we could read it, signaling his intent to cooperate."

"He sent a normal letter so we could read it. Since Ge tribe is migrating together with him, this letter shows his intent to cooperate along the journey. Come, let's read it together." Old Ge tribe leader unsealed it.

The letter simply explained that Fang Yuan entered closed cultivation to recover his strength, expressing deep regret for missing his visit and promising to make amends in the future.

He also offered to buy bone bamboo Gu at 120% market price, along with various refinement materials and Gu like third watch Gu, hoping to conduct a transaction.

The leader realized: while Ge tribe used Chang Shan Yin, he was using them too. Chang Shan Yin appeared caught between two tribes, dragged into political strife and unnecessary trouble, but neither tribe dared offend him, allowing him to profit from both sides!

"We won't need to prepare these. Man tribe will send them—perhaps even for free," Ge tribe leader sighed, trying to expel the chill in his heart.

A sudden thought struck Ge tribe leader: "Perhaps Chang Shan Yin helps us not out of righteousness, but because siding with us yields the greatest profit."

He quickly dismissed it: "If such a hero were so scheming, what righteousness remains in this world? I am merely judging a great man by petty standards."

Three days later.

Man Tu and his son stood on the mound, watching Ge tribe march south.

Man Duo said indignantly: "Why give Ge tribe fifteen hundred tons of provisions when our prey is escaping?"

Watching the departing tribe, Man Tu said solemnly: "Man Hao, explain."

Elder Man Hao chuckled: "Do not worry, Third Young Master. The clan leader planned this long ago. Ge tribe won't leave easily; the provisions are packed with wolf lure Gu, and three myriad wolf packs wait in ambush ahead."

"I see!" Man Duo understood at once. "When Ge tribe falters against the wolves, we will 'save' and assimilate them. Those fifteen hundred tons of provisions will prove Father's magnanimity and silence any suspicion. But..."

Man Duo shook his head with concern: "Ge tribe has Chang Shan Yin, the Wolf King. Can these wolves stop him?"

"Don't worry, Third Young Master. Chang Shan Yin's fame was twenty years ago. He is now only rank four initial stage, and our banquet probe showed his soul dropped from thousand man soul to hundred man soul," Man Hao scoffed.

"He is merely a crippled old Wolf King. What forces does he have? Just a thousand wind wolves, a thousand poison beard wolves, and a thousand water wolves. Against three myriad wolf packs, what can his wolves do? His reputation will be ruined, and Ge tribe will be ours."

# Chapter 451: Turtleback Wolf Group

"Urgent report! A turtleback wolf pack has appeared three thousand *li* ahead, estimated at ten thousand strong!" an investigative Gu Master reported to Ge tribe leader.

Ge tribe halted in a circular formation as Gu Masters anxiously used Gu worms to erect high walls, watchtowers, and layered defenses.

"Invite Lord Chang Shan Yin." Facing a battle for the tribe's survival, Ge tribe leader needed all available strength.

Fang Yuan nodded, walking directly toward him with slight urgency: "I know about the wolf group's invasion. How is the situation?"

"The wolf group will arrive in about eight minutes. Since our relocation, Father assigned light cavalry to scout six hundred *li* to prevent Man tribe's tricks!" Ge Guang followed Fang Yuan, reporting from the side.

"Hehehe, my fate with Ge tribe is not shallow. Friends should help each other when walking the same path! How is the situation?" Fang Yuan asked.

"Please look." Ge tribe leader led Fang Yuan to a sheepskin map on a table, pointing as he explained the surrounding terrain, Ge tribe's defensive lines, and the wolf group's movements.

"Sir's arrangements are sound." Fang Yuan praised first, then pointed to a mark on the map.

Everyone followed his finger to a river beside the camp.

"With such a natural barrier, why not use it for defense?" Fang Yuan proposed.

"Brother might not know, but we considered that. Most troops move slowly; it would be too late to reach the river, relocate camp, and establish new defensive lines." Ge tribe leader smiled bitterly.

Fang Yuan smiled brightly: "Brother, as a fellow northern plainsman, I know this. We cannot reach the river, but we can bring the river to us."

Ge tribe leader promptly commanded: "Ge Cui, Ge Xiang, and Ge Mi shall lead the first, seventh, and eighteenth troops to stop their tasks immediately and dig a canal by the river. The third, fifth, and sixteenth troops shall take over their unfinished tasks."

Over thirty-eight thousand!

When the wolf group was five hundred *li* away, the canal was completed and the river diverted.

At three hundred *li*, three defensive lines were established and combat troops deployed. The construction and logistics Gu Masters retreated in succession, rapidly restoring their primeval essence with primeval stones.

The turtleback wolves mainly advanced from the north, with large numbers also pressing in from the northeast and southeast.

Broad-bodied and dark-green with dark-blue eyes, the turtleback wolves bore turtle-like shells on their backs.

Tens of thousands of charging wolves made the ground tremble.

The northern defensive line met the initial assault.

As the wolves drew closer, the Gu Masters switched from wind blades to more potent fire and lightning Gu.

The wolves pressed forward like relentless rain, charging into the outer earth walls.

Countless turtleback wolves battered themselves against the walls, bruised and dying on impact.

Yet the wolves advanced wave upon wave, leaping over corpses or clawing through the earth walls.

"Look, a myriad wolf king!" someone shouted, pointing into the distance.

This enormous turtleback myriad wolf king was over ten times the size of an ordinary wolf. Exuding a tyrannical aura, it crouched and howled, commanding the pack to split.

Surrounded on all sides, Ge tribe was embroiled in battle everywhere.

Housing rank two Gu, the powerful hundred beast kings drastically increased the pressure on Ge tribe's frontlines. Casualties surged as two to three hundred wolf kings smashed through the earth walls, breaching the defense.

"Hmm?" Man Hong's smile froze as his investigative Gu showed a wolf enslavement Gu entering a hundred wolf king.

It immediately shifted allegiance and howled, throwing nearby wolves into chaos.

Following their king toward the camp, the wolves soon gathered around a single Gu Master.

Man Hong narrowed his eyes at the Gu Master: "Could this be Wolf King Chang Shan Yin?"

Man Hong sneered: "Father called him the greatest variable. Let me see his capability!"

# Chapter 452: Intense Battle (1/3)

Subduing a hundred wolf king and adding several hundred wolves to his ranks, Fang Yuan turned this section of the battlefield into a safe zone.

To others, these wolves were a threat; to Fang Yuan, they were delivered gifts.

*"Traveling alone, I would have to flee such a massive beast group. But now, conditions are perfect! How could I not seize this godsent opportunity?"*

Fang Yuan laughed heartily, his battle intent surging as he called out: "Everyone, follow me!"

To the northwest, three hundred wolf kings had breached the earth walls, ravaging the defense line.

Fang Yuan arrived quickly: "I am Wolf King Chang Shan Yin. All Gu Masters, follow my commands."

"What Gu worms do these three wolf kings have?" Fang Yuan asked.

"Group one, lure the left hundred wolf king toward the second defensive line," Fang Yuan ordered.

"Group two, pin down the right wolf king and destroy its defensive Gu."

"Group three, follow me." Fang Yuan waved and charged into battle.

After a brief clash, he unleashed a wolf enslavement Gu.

Just as the smoke descended, the wolf king blasted a flame that incinerated it.

Fang Yuan's expression chilled, pained by losing a rank two wolf enslavement Gu.

"Ge Guang, deal with this firelight Gu; I will return shortly." Fang Yuan shifted his target to another wolf king, deploying a wolf enslavement Gu.

With its defensive Gu already destroyed by the Gu Masters, Fang Yuan captured it without incident.

Turning back, he saw Ge Guang had grown trees and bound the wolf king's maw with vines, preventing further flames.

"Good job," Fang Yuan praised, deploying a wolf enslavement Gu.

The smoke entered the wolf king's body; after slight resistance, it yielded to his hundred man soul and became his pet.

In short order, Fang Yuan divided and captured all three hundred wolf kings, resolving the crisis.

Fang Yuan sat on the ground, holding two primeval stones to restore his primeval essence.

Wolf enslavement Gu consumed little primeval essence, but placed a heavy burden on the soul.

Subduing wolf kings one after another with his hundred man soul took a toll; the clash of souls left Fang Yuan feeling increasingly agitated and impatient.

Fang Yuan meditated with closed eyes, soothing his mind and soul.

After a brief rest, his hundred man soul stabilized and the negative emotions dissipated.

"Continue following me," Fang Yuan said, mounting his hump wolf as Ge Guang and the others followed.

Sweeping across the battlefield, Fang Yuan subdued another three hundred wolf kings and eight hundred ordinary turtleback wolves.

*Howl!*

Fang Yuan's actions angered a thousand wolf king.

Seeing its subordinates surrender, the thousand wolf king howled and led its pack to attack Fang Yuan fiercely.

"Young tribe leader, we are here to help!" Three Ge tribe elders arrived just then.

The thousand wolf king rampaged furiously with fangs, claws, and even a wolf strength phantom, striking mercilessly across the battlefield.

With two elders lightly injured, Fang Yuan seized an opening and deployed a rank three wolf enslavement Gu.

The rank three wolf enslavement Gu transformed into dense smoke—far thicker than rank two—and descended onto the thousand wolf king.

Fang Yuan suppressed it with his hundred man soul; within a dozen breaths, the smoke fused completely into the thousand wolf king's soul.

With the thousand wolf king's surrender, its two hundred wolf kings and several thousand turtleback wolves also shifted allegiance.

Sensing something amiss, the myriad wolf king howled and hurled a massive spinning four-leaf windblade toward Fang Yuan.

"Three claw water dragon Gu!" an elder shouted, thrusting his hands as a light-blue water dragon struck the windblade, bursting into light drizzle.

"Lightning web Gu!" The third elder cast a large lightning web over the windblade.

Though weakened by the lightning web, the windblade spun furiously and cut free, only to dissipate midair at the end of its momentum.

# Chapter 453: Intense Battle (2/3)

Bypassing wolves with enslavement counters, sure enough, roaming the battlefield brought great rewards. In two hours, he subdued seventeen hundred wolf kings and two thousand wolf kings.

In all, Fang Yuan held four thousand wolf kings, over thirty hundred wolf kings, and over eight thousand ordinary wolves—nearing a myriad wolf group.

His efforts equalized both sides. Between Fang Yuan's recruitment and heavy casualties, the enemy wolf group was reduced from over thirty thousand to around twenty thousand.

Just then, the myriad wolf king let out a long howl, driving every wolf on the battlefield into a frenzy.

Over twenty thousand turtleback wolves charged recklessly at the camp, catching Ge tribe off-guard and routing them.

"Order the frontline to retreat to the second defensive line immediately!" Ge tribe leader commanded.

"The wolves are launching an all-out attack!" Ge Guang paled from the frontlines.

"Help the Gu Masters retreat. I will return to the ranch to reorganize; await my support." Fang Yuan's expression darkened.

Fang Yuan returned to the ranch alone, surrounded by wolves.

Crowding nearly ten thousand wolves together, the temporary ranch instantly felt cramped.

At Fang Yuan's thought, a robust water wolf stepped forward from the pack.

To others it was a water wolf, but to Fang Yuan, it was a white-eyes wolf.

"Go." At Fang Yuan's command, the white-eyes wolf—faster than a wind wolf—dashed out toward the high ground.

Covering his right eye, Fang Yuan watched the white-eyes wolf through his left while channeling primeval essence into Chang Shan Yin's investigative Gu.

Instantly, his left eye's vision shifted, overlooking the battlefield from high ground.

His left eye surveyed the battlefield while his right watched the wolves packed in the ranch.

Fang Yuan summoned the wolf kings to inspect their Gu worms.

Sure enough, Fang Yuan obtained one rank three and five rank two wolf enslavement Gu from them.

Fang Yuan activated this rank four healing Gu specialized for wolves, blanketing the ranch in billowing smoke.

With his primeval sea depleted, Fang Yuan drew primeval stones to rapidly restore his essence.

After two more healing rounds, Fang Yuan saw Ge tribe leader and the elders rush to the frontlines, where intense explosions soon erupted.

Through his left eye, Fang Yuan saw the myriad wolf king join battle as Ge tribe leader and the elders fought it all-out.

Ge tribe's second defensive line fell as well.

Fortunately, the canal allowed most Ge tribe Gu Masters to retreat to the third line, though dread gripped the battlefield.

"No time for another round." Having recovered ninety percent of his primeval essence, Fang Yuan surveyed his surroundings.

After three healing rounds, severe injuries had become minor and minor wounds had completely healed.

Fang Yuan howled toward the sky like an enraged wolf king.

Empowered by the Gu, the wolves grew slightly larger, their aura swelling as their battle strength multiplied.

Fang Yuan laughed aloud and mounted his hump wolf; with a thought, the entire pack joined in a unified howl.

Mounted on his hump wolf, Fang Yuan directed nearly ten thousand wolves past the ranch fences to strike south.

Like a bursting dam, the wolf army poured out of the camp, spearheaded by twelve hundred wolf kings that ruthlessly pierced into the battlefield.

Exhausted from prolonged fighting, the enemy wolves collapsed against this fresh force, suffering immense casualties in moments.

In a single assault, Fang Yuan crushed the turtleback wolves' offensive on the southern front.

Shielded by his wolves, Fang Yuan triggered three wolf enslavement Gu in rapid succession, their smoke swiftly subduing three hundred wolf kings.

"Charge left!" At his command, the wolf army veered smoothly toward the southeastern battle.

This thousand wolf king could only muster a few hundred wolves, easily overwhelmed by Fang Yuan's army.

Seizing the opportunity, Fang Yuan sent faint smoke into the paralyzed thousand wolf king, quickly bringing it under his control.

At its call, the wolves battling the Gu Masters ceased fighting and joined Fang Yuan's ranks.

# Chapter 454: Intense Battle (3/3)

Deliberately avoiding the myriad wolf king, Fang Yuan circled the camp and captured three more thousand wolf kings, bringing his total to eight.

His hundred wolf kings nearly doubled, reaching fifty-nine.

Repeatedly subduing wolf kings caused soul backlash, leaving Fang Yuan jittery and nauseous.

With the situation settled, he dismounted from the hump wolf and rested his spirit with closed eyes.

Periodically, he checked the battlefield through the white-eyes wolf's vision, ensuring Ge tribe's leaders survived so Man tribe would not intervene.

After resting, though not fully recovered, Fang Yuan was fit to command his wolves and re-entered the fray.

He mobilized only the eight thousand wolf kings, as ordinary wolves posed little threat to the myriad wolf king.

"Everyone, step back and rest, let me handle this!" Reaching the battlefield, Fang Yuan directed his eight thousand wolf kings to encircle the myriad wolf king.

The myriad wolf king sought to retreat, but could not break through the encirclement no matter which way it charged.

Fang Yuan ultimately exhausted the myriad wolf king to death, though its final counterattack took the life of a thousand wolf king.

On the battlefield, Ge tribe leader brought the elders towards Fang Yuan.

"The hero's might remains! Today's battle leaves me in awe. On behalf of the entire Ge tribe, I express our deepest gratitude!" The Ge tribe leader bowed deeply to Fang Yuan.

"Brother Ge overpraises me. Let's clean up the battlefield quickly," Fang Yuan smiled.

The myriad wolf king lay dead on the ground, but Fang Yuan refrained from touching it to avoid suspicion.

"If I had a rank four wolf enslavement Gu, I could have taken this turtleback myriad wolf king. What a pity," Fang Yuan regretted.

"Lord, we found a rank four wolf enslavement Gu!" shouted a Gu Master searching the myriad wolf king's corpse.

"What?" The Ge tribe leader's eyes flashed, and he laughed, "Haha, a precious Gu suits a hero—this belongs to Brother Chang."

Fang Yuan accepted the Gu worm and took his leave, excusing himself from the celebratory banquet to refine the rank four Gu.

Nightfall.

Sitting cross-legged with a calm mind, Fang Yuan inspected his aperture.

Fang Yuan shook off the iron pieces and grasped his fists, feeling an increased strength: "The strength increase has reached a bottleneck. Next, I need to enhance my skeleton, skin, tendons and so on, to cause the water bucket - my body - to become deeper, larger and firmer, so it can hold even more strength."

Fang Yuan's eyes flashed as he retrieved a wolf soul Gu.

Pouring in primeval essence, the wolf soul Gu burst into a grey wolf soul that slammed into his body.

Having subdued many wolf kings today, merging the hundred man soul with the wolf soul proved far more arduous than before.

Brows furrowed and sweating profusely, Fang Yuan gritted his teeth until the hundred man soul and wolf soul finally merged.

Hundred man soul had thoroughly changed into the wolfman soul.

The wolfman soul resembled a grey silhouette of Fang Yuan with sharp wolf ears, waist-length hair, and a wolf tail.

With the wolfman soul formed, Fang Yuan felt unburdened and greatly relaxed.

"The hundred man soul was near its limit, but with the wolfman soul, I can control three times more wolf kings!"

# Chapter 455: Night Assault

Two hump wolves moved through the night, carrying an old and a young Ge tribe investigative Gu Master.

After ambushing and executing the Ge tribe scouts, several figures emerged from the dark, led by Man tribe's external elder Shi Wu. Gazing at the corpses, he scoffed: "Killing these ants is as easy as turning my palm."

Shi Wu looked toward Ge tribe's troops: "Hmph, Ge tribe won earlier only because their scouts allowed them to prepare in advance. This time, our leader dispatched almost all the elders—Ge tribe cannot escape! I look forward to their terror when ten thousand night wolves strike!"

Three days after the turtleback wolf attack, Man tribe Gu Masters guided a night wolf pack for a second assault while their elders hunted down Ge tribe's investigative scouts.

When the myriad wolf group was discovered, they were merely a hundred li from camp.

"Wake up, an attack! Ten thousand night wolves!" Sleeping Ge tribesmen were startled awake.

In the main tent, the Ge tribe leader paled at the news.

"The night wolves are already so close to the camp, there is no time to construct defensive lines! What do we do?"

Unable to devise a countermeasure, the Ge tribe leader ordered: "Summon all Ge tribe Gu Masters to the main tent!"

The swift night wolves had already breached the camp perimeter.

Surging like a torrent, the night wolves smashed through the crude palisades and began their slaughter.

Meanwhile, Ge tribe's Gu Masters were still converging on the central main tent.

The inner camp fell into chaos as panicked mortals fled, trampling one another.

Only the elders and a few elite Gu Masters managed to reach the main tent.

"Ge tribe is not finished yet—there is one way to turn this around!" Fang Yuan announced, striding into the main tent.

Fang Yuan stated resolutely: "With the camp in chaos, defense is impossible. Only by using offense as defense do we have a chance at survival."

Fang Yuan smiled faintly: "Brother Ge, did you forget I possess a rank four wolf enslavement Gu?"

Observing their expressions, he continued: "We must unite our elites to charge through the wolf tide and subdue the myriad wolf king!"

Yet because Chang Shan Yin proposed it, the room fell into silence.

Accustomed to luxurious lives as high-ranking figures, these rank three Gu Masters deeply cherished their own lives.

# Chapter 456: A Hero’s Call

The Ge tribe leader hesitated; at his age and with stagnant cultivation, he no longer feared death.

Fang Yuan's plan carried immense risk—if they failed, the higher-ups would perish, leaving the mortals like sheep to the slaughter.

"Father, uncles, Uncle Chang is right—this is our only hope!" Ge Guang urged, chilled by the elders' hesitation.

Subduing this myriad beast king would dramatically boost his strength, potentially doubling it.

He seized this rare opportunity, though enslaving the myriad wolf king required Ge tribe's cooperation.

As a rank four Gu Master with rank three eagle wings Gu, he could easily fly away if things went awry.

Rather than letting Ge tribe simply collapse, he would maximize their utility.

"Everyone!" Fang Yuan shouted, attracting everyone's gazes.

His voice boomed like thunder: "What are you waiting for? Are all Ge tribesmen cowards afraid of death?!"

"Listen to our people's cries! These night wolves are slaughtering your families! If Ge tribe falls tonight, you will be homeless!"

"Can you watch your kin die before your eyes? I cannot! Though an outsider, I have felt the warmth and devotion among Ge tribesmen during my stay. For your people and for righteousness, I will charge forward to fight for our survival!"

"Men of Ge tribe, where are your sabres? Your ancestors watch you—does cowardice flow in your veins?!"

*Swoosh!* Ge Guang activated his sabre Gu, raising the blade high.

The young leader roared: "Ge tribe's warriors and sabres remain! Our ancestors watch over us! Wolf King, others may fear death, but I will follow you to hell and back!"

"Wolf King, young leader, count Ge De among the vanguard!"

Even reluctant elders shouted their willingness to join, terrified of being branded cowards and despised across the northern plains.

The situation had spiraled far beyond the hesitant Ge tribe leader's control.

Seeing the elders' bloodshot eyes, the old leader realized fight was now unavoidable.

With morale unified, the old leader bowed deeply to Fang Yuan: "Wolf King, you are a true hero! Ge tribe's future rests with you. We shall charge alongside your wolves to fell the myriad wolf king."

Everyone accepted the orders.

"Everyone, charge with me!" Fang Yuan shouted, leading the Gu Masters out of the main tent.

Several hundred wolf kings and thousand wolf kings gathered.

"Brother Chang, why are there so few wolves? Where is your wolf army?" the old leader asked, his heart sinking.

Fang Yuan snorted inwardly; why should he sacrifice his wolf kings to protect Ge tribesmen?

Previously, having few wolves, Fang Yuan needed Ge tribe to travel safely.

Now possessing a myriad wolf pack, Ge tribe's utility had plummeted.

He commanded total dominion over his wolves, but Ge tribesmen could never be controlled so absolutely.

*"You expect me to sacrifice my loyal beasts for outsiders? Do you take me for a fool like your hot-blooded clansmen?"* Despite his inward disdain, Fang Yuan smiled warmly: "Do not worry, Brother Ge. The pens were breached and the pack scattered. I have ordered the wolf kings to assemble; reinforcements will arrive shortly."

Cutting off further questions, Fang Yuan shouted: "Ge tribe's survival hangs in the balance—charge with me!"

He spurred his hump wolf forward into the fray.

The crowd roared in frenzy as Ge Guang followed right behind Fang Yuan.

Two rank four, seventeen rank three, and a great number of rank two elites, it was a great strength, like a sabre that stabbed into the battlefield.

At the myriad wolf king's howl, twelve thousand-wolf kings and dozens of hundred-wolf kings converged from all directions.

Slipping into the formation's center, Fang Yuan yelled frenziedly: "Charge faster, or we are dead! Enslave the myriad wolf king and victory is ours!"

"My primeval essence is dry—I will use the self-detonate Gu! For the tribe!" an elder roared, breaking formation to charge into the pack.

The elder sneered as he detonated, killing a thousand wolf king on the spot!

Watching this, the old leader's heart bled.

# Chapter 457: Wolf King, where are your reinforcements?!

Growing increasingly dissatisfied, the old tribe leader shouted: "Wolf King, where are your promised reinforcements?!"

"Do not worry, Brother Ge, they will arrive soon! Avenge the elder with me!" Fang Yuan roared, surging to the front.

The old tribe leader dragged the eager Ge Guang back: "Stay behind me!"

"This old fox..." Fang Yuan sneered inwardly. Only he and the old leader remained clear-headed in the entire force.

"Push forward, I will pin down these beasts!" the battle hall elder roared.

His body swelled into a giant rockman; though a rank three peak stage Gu Master, his aura surged to match rank four!

"Battle hall elder!" The tribe leader's heart ached to see their second strongest expert sacrificing his life.

"Do not let his sacrifice be in vain—we will turn the tide!" Fang Yuan shouted.

With his cover, the force finally reached the myriad wolf king.

"Kill!" Resigned to the fight, the Ge tribe leader charged without hesitation.

"That is a golden bell shield Gu—destroy it so I can use the wolf enslavement Gu!" Fang Yuan shouted.

The night wolf king moved faster than a cheetah; its furless black hide gleamed like tough armor.

Gu Masters fell as wounds mounted on the night wolf king, yet the golden bell shield Gu held firm.

Shortly into the assault, a pack of wolf kings charged them from behind.

"Wolf King, where are your reinforcements?!" the Ge tribe leader shouted in growing panic.

"Soon, hold on!" Fang Yuan shouted back. "Ge Guang, take a detachment and intercept those wolf kings!"

"Understood! While I draw breath, none shall disturb you! Follow me!" Ge Guang roared, charging valiantly toward the flanking wolf kings.

Fang Yuan urged: "Brother Ge, break the golden bell shield Gu! Once I enslave the wolf king, the entire tribe is saved!"

Battered by the old leader, the wolf king opened its jaws and spewed bursts of eerie blue ghost fire.

The surging, bone-chilling ghost blaze forced the Gu Masters back, loosening the encirclement.

Gaining a moment to breathe, the night wolf king prepared to retreat.

"Don't even think about it!" Ge tribe leader shouted, violently inhaling all the ghost fire into his stomach.

After swallowing the ghost fire, Ge tribe leader's stomach swelled abnormally to three times its size.

At the same time, his skin turned dark-blue and blood flowed from his eyes, nose, mouth, and ears.

His left hand swelled fivefold into a wooden root, its fingers transforming into thick purple vines that lashed at the night wolf king like whips.

Ge tribe leader paled; though he cultivated strength path as a secondary path, he could not match the night wolf king's power.

The purple vines tore apart. Ge tribe leader screamed as his left hand reverted, all five fingers broken.

"Wolf King..." The old tribe leader snarled.

Knowing he was about to ask for reinforcements, Fang Yuan stepped forward and called out: "Brother Ge, careful!"

Right then, the night wolf king's tail whipped over.

Fang Yuan activated azure wolf skin Gu and moved into its path, appearing to shield Ge tribe leader.

"Quick, save Lord Wolf King!" the academy elder shouted furiously, rushing toward Fang Yuan.

Sensing Ge tribe leader posed the greatest threat, the night wolf king charged and directed most of its attacks at him.

*"Dragon Head Drill!"* Dodging and attacking, the old tribe leader activated three Gu simultaneously, unleashing his killer move!

A four-clawed wood dragon soared with a roar, its head turning into a spiraling pike that slammed into the night wolf king.

The golden bell shield Gu protecting the night wolf king flickered and finally shattered.

Before the Gu Masters could rejoice, the night wolf king's eyes turned crimson; its battle intent surged and it counterattacked frenziedly, oblivious to pain.

Instead of falling, its strength surged to nearly double its original level.

"Rank four brave fight Gu, damn it! Chang Shan Yin, where is Chang Shan Yin!" the old tribe leader shouted.

"Lord Wolf King fainted, we're healing him!" The academy elder and others shielded the 'fainted' Wolf King from the pack.

"Of all times, he chose this moment to faint!" The old tribe leader nearly coughed blood, shouting: "Kill this myriad wolf king—once it falls, the pack will collapse!"

The Gu Masters fell into disarray, leaving only the old tribe leader holding the line.

The old tribe leader darted about rescuing clan members, his voice hoarse from shouting as his speed slowed and concentration slipped.

Turning his head, the old tribe leader saw the night wolf king pouncing at him from midair with murderous intent.

The next moment, the night wolf king pounced and ruthlessly smashed him to the ground.

Ge tribe leader frantically poured primeval essence into his defensive Gu, forming a thick wooden shield.

The night wolf king battered the shield, shattering it within a few breaths before its massive claws struck Ge tribe leader.

Fixated on Ge tribe leader, the night wolf king ignored all other attacks, determined to vent its rage by killing him.

# Chapter 458: Death of the Old Tribe Leader

"Father!" Ge Guang howled wildly at the sight, his eyes nearly splitting open.

As brave fight Gu's effect ended, the night wolf king lost its fervor and was driven off Ge tribe leader by their combined attacks.

*"This is the moment!"* Fang Yuan's heart stirred, and he 'awoke'.

Rank four — wolf enslavement Gu!

Wolf enslavement Gu transformed into a thick cloud of smoke, enveloping the night wolf king's head.

The night wolf king resisted intensely, but sensed a kindred aura from Fang Yuan's wolfman soul.

Its resistance faded rapidly under Fang Yuan's soul pressure, and the smoke soon merged into its body.

"Success!" Fang Yuan's eyes shone brightly.

Wolf smoke Gu!

Hurrying onto the battlefield, he exhaled vast plumes of wolf smoke over the night wolf king.

It let out a long howl, throwing the pack into chaos and prompting a swift retreat.

Ge tribe's crisis was resolved!

# Chapter 459: Lang Ya Blessed Land

Soon after, Ge tribe's convoy trudged along like an aged beast.

# Chapter 460: Number One Refinement Path Immortal of All Times

# Chapter 461: Prophecy of Three Venerables

Several days later.
