# Chapter 485: Plotting against the Land Spirit

Fang Yuan sat atop the white-eyes wolf, ready to move out.

Beside him, Ge Guang reported: "Over these eight days, most tribes set off for the heroes assembly. Only several large tribes remain at crescent lake. Bei Cao Chuan, Pei Yan Fei, and the others departed first."

Fang Yuan adjusted his posture: "Mm, our initiative in challenging the three tribes alarmed many. With the heroes assembly nearing, it is normal that they left. However, large tribes have many enterprises to settle, so they usually attend the second half of the heroes assembly."

Fang Yuan chuckled: "Crescent lake's aquatic plants are lush; we will stay for now and digest our battle gains rather than travel."

"Those water wolves, are they still there?" Fang Yuan asked.

"Yes, scouts checked on them repeatedly. There are about five thousand water wolves, and they retreat into their water den at night. Lord, do you really not need guards?"

Fang Yuan snorted arrogantly: "Where wolves roam, Chang Shan Yin reigns. Why would I need guards?"

"Mm, remain vigilant regarding tribal affairs. In my absence, keep a close eye on the surrendered Gu Masters."

Leaving the wind wolf king behind, Fang Yuan took the weakened turtleback myriad wolf king and eighteen thousand wolves out from camp to hunt.

Fang Yuan intervened from the rear several times, firmly seizing control of the battle.

Over a thousand water wolves lay dead, and Fang Yuan subdued over two thousand with wolf enslavement Gu, while the remaining thousand fled into crescent lake's depths.

After clearing several dens, by nightfall Fang Yuan had subdued six thousand water wolves, two thousand turtleback wolves, and a thousand night wolves.

Yet this hunt was merely a cover. In a secluded spot, Fang Yuan activated moving perspective cup Gu to contact Little Hu Immortal.

Upon receiving the message, Little Hu Immortal summoned starlight firefly Gu, using starlight and green grape immortal essence to activate stargate Gu.

Fang Yuan did not rush through the stargate, first sending in the heavily injured turtleback myriad wolf king and numerous wounded wolves.

In the blessed land, the injured wolves would heal, breed, and bear healthy cubs. With Hu Immortal blessed land's faster time flow, they would grow rapidly into a fresh supply of wolves.

Having dispatched the wolves into Hu Immortal blessed land, Fang Yuan stepped through.

"Master, I obediently checked connecting heaven Gu daily as you ordered. That Lang Ya Old Immortal truly reappeared and bought lots of materials in treasure yellow heaven." Delighted to see Fang Yuan, Little Hu Immortal hugged his leg, rubbing her face against it while recounting events during his absence.

Browsing through the list, Fang Yuan found the Gu worms and materials familiar—they were meant for refining second aperture Gu.

Lang Ya Old Immortal was the Lang Ya land spirit. Preparing for the refinement meant he had survived the second attack wave and was determined to forge second aperture Gu.

Meanwhile, divine travel Gu was undoubtedly in his possession.

"Lang Ya land spirit was ambushed by Old Man Yan Shi and should be defending the blessed land now. Though intelligent, land spirits are rigid and incapable of scheming. What am I waiting for?"

He immediately left Hu Immortal blessed land, returning to northern plains' crescent lake.

Leading the wolves, he rushed tirelessly to the stone forest and reentered Lang Ya blessed land through Thieving Heaven Demon Venerable's entrance.

Lang Ya blessed land had changed drastically; the twelve cloud buildings had been assaulted, leaving rubble, collapsed structures, and scars from fire, lightning, and frost.

Outside the buildings, the pristine white cloud soil was stained with blood, and a mountain-sized, deer-like desolate beast lay dead upon it.

"Why are you here?" Lang Ya land spirit welcomed Fang Yuan grumpily.

"What happened?" Instead of answering, Fang Yuan expressed his shock.

"Hmph, a bunch of audacious scoundrels laid their claws on this blessed land, but I killed them all!" the land spirit snarled, killing intent surging.

Fang Yuan looked at him curiously: "Isn't Lang Ya blessed land extremely secretive? How did they enter, unless you opened the doors yourself..."

"Get lost! Am I so stupid?" the land spirit howled. "Those scoundrels tampered with my purchases. I bought divine travel Gu to refine second aperture Gu, but during the refinement, a passage opened and those rats invaded!"

Fang Yuan laughed: "Just as I thought, you are Lang Ya Old Immortal, buying divine travel Gu in treasure yellow heaven. It seems you managed to protect it."

Suddenly, his expression shifted, and he glared at Fang Yuan with suspicion: "Why are you here, lad?"

Fang Yuan bowed to the land spirit, replying matter-of-factly: "What else? I am obviously here to ask you to refine second aperture Gu for me."

"What?!" the land spirit roared, glaring at Fang Yuan with blazing fury.

Back then, Long Hair Ancestor had failed to refine an important Immortal Gu for Thieving Heaven Demon Venerable, promising in return to refine nine Gu worms—mortal or Immortal—free of cost.

Thieving Heaven Demon Venerable claimed six Immortal Gu with his chances, leaving the remaining three in his inheritances for a fated person.

Earlier, he had used one chance to have the land spirit refine stargate Gu; now he returned to use the second on second aperture Gu.

Formed from Long Hair Ancestor's obsession, the Lang Ya land spirit could not refuse.

Fuming with rage, the Lang Ya land spirit glared and asked grimly: "Don't tell me you masterminded the attack on my blessed land?"

Fang Yuan said innocently: "Could a mortal mobilize Gu Immortals? I deduced you had the recipe after you bought divine travel Gu and materials."

The land spirit ground his teeth, pointing at Fang Yuan: "You humans are all cunning schemers! I killed those Gu Immortals, only to be swindled by a little brat like you!"

Fang Yuan laughed heartily: "This is no scam, but your ancient promise to Thieving Heaven Demon Venerable. So, will you refine second aperture Gu for me now?"

Though furious enough to hack Fang Yuan to pieces, the land spirit had no choice but to refine the Gu for him.

---

# Chapter 486: Two Immortal Gu obtained!

"I want to watch you refine the Gu in person," Fang Yuan said, testing the land spirit.

A Gu Master's refinement process was private, as observation could leak recipes or expose unique methods.

"Of course, that was part of the agreement," the land spirit agreed readily, defying Fang Yuan's expectations.

Formed from Long Hair Ancestor, the land spirit retained most of his refinement talent despite losing many memories.

Lang Ya land spirit waved his hand and teleported him to a huge hall.

The ten-li-wide hall was packed with green copper cauldrons, red steel furnaces, and rainbow water tanks.

"This is my *Earth-grade Room C* refinement hall," the land spirit introduced, causing Fang Yuan's expression to shift.

At this moment, the land spirit waved.

Instantly, several thousand hairy men materialized in the hall.

Though initially dazed from the teleportation, the hairy men quickly knelt, shouting: "Greetings to Lang Ya Old Immortal!"

With an affectionate expression, the Lang Ya land spirit said: "Children, you may rise."

He waved his hand, distributing refinement materials among them: "Today, we refine an Immortal Gu; follow the recipe I provided."

They promptly calmed down, studying the recipe in their hands before initiating the refinement.

During the refinement, several elderly hairy men even offered suggestions to adjust the recipe!

Most hairy men were refinement masters, while the recipe-adjusting elders were refinement grandmasters!

Right now, Fang Yuan was still barely a refinement master.

The hairy men completed the semi-finished products, passing them to the elders for inspection before presenting them to the land spirit.

The land spirit inspected the semi-finished products, destroying flawed pieces and having the hairy men refine them again.

After several iterations, the land spirit was satisfied and took over, effortlessly creating the semi-finished second aperture Gu.

Eventually, Lang Ya land spirit took out divine travel Gu.

The divine travel Gu was heavily scarred and damaged, making Fang Yuan's heart leap at the sight.

"Lad, it is not too late to change your mind," the land spirit paused to urge him.

Fang Yuan frowned, then chuckled: "No, please continue."

"Scheming brat, nothing gets past you!" the land spirit cursed, grudgingly teleporting supplementary materials over.

Fang Yuan recognized two rare materials capable of radiating eighteen meters of treasure light in treasure yellow heaven!

Though captivated, Fang Yuan bit his lip, forcing himself back to reality to execute his plan.

Sitting down cross-legged, he retrieved two previously prepared Gu.

One was clear mind Gu, the other awaken cloud Gu.

Clear mind Gu became a breeze entering his mind, while cotton-like awaken cloud Gu drifted above his head as a small white cloud.

Watching the ball of light in the land spirit's hands, Fang Yuan brought out four premium wines.

Through connecting heaven Gu, he had prepared at least fourteen varieties of premium wine.

Sensing Fang Yuan's actions, the land spirit snorted in displeasure but did not intervene.

At last, divine travel Gu dissolved into liquid, merging with the other materials.

Fang Yuan quickly seized the jars, gulping down the liquor.

Simultaneously, an intense wave of drunkenness assaulted him.

Fang Yuan rapidly activated clear mind Gu and awaken cloud Gu to maintain mental clarity.

Though clear-headed after four wines, Fang Yuan noticed no change had occurred.

"Divine travel Gu hasn't disappeared yet; since Immortal Gu are unique, I must keep drinking." Fang Yuan unsealed another jar and gulped it down.

The light ball shrank as the land spirit gripped it with an increasingly solemn expression.

After downing the eighth wine, Fang Yuan's vision began to blur.

In the land spirit's hands, the pulsing ball of light settled, transforming into second aperture Gu!

As second aperture Gu formed, the drunkenness in Fang Yuan's body condensed to a single point.

Dao marks materialized from a divine opportunity, bursting that point into a Gu—divine travel Gu!

Two Immortal Gu obtained at the same time!

Instantly sober, Fang Yuan stood up and laughed heartily in excitement.

"What a profound scheme!" The land spirit stared at Fang Yuan exhausted, his ethereal body turning faint and weak.

Ignoring the hairy men, Fang Yuan curbed his laughter and bowed to the land spirit: "It was merely a petty trick, far from graceful. Today was truly eye-opening and deeply beneficial; though ashamed of my trickery, I respect your mastery and wish to become your disciple."

---

# Chapter 487: Immortal Gu Transaction

"Taking you as a disciple would anger me to death! Get lost, I don't want to see you!" The land spirit flatly refused.

Fang Yuan chuckled, not minding the land spirit's refusal.

"What a pity; I had intended to offer divine travel Gu as my apprenticeship gift."

"I despise crafty people like you—hairy men are far better! I have already taken eighteen hairy men as disciples and will only ever accept them!"

"Alright, give me second aperture Gu," Fang Yuan said, extending his hand.

However, bound by the ancient agreement integrated into his will, the land spirit could not refuse.

"Brat, I'll remember you!" the land spirit growled, shoving second aperture Gu into Fang Yuan's hand.

"I risked everything at San Cha mountain for this Gu," Fang Yuan mused, storing it in his pouch.

The second aperture Gu now belonged to Fang Yuan, though without immortal essence, he could not yet activate it.

"You have your Immortal Gu. Unless you plan to use your final chance, leave!" the land spirit urged, wanting him gone.

Fang Yuan smiled, brandishing divine travel Gu before the land spirit: "Do you not want this Immortal Gu?"

Lang Ya land spirit's brows raised: "What, you want to sell it?"

Instead of answering, Fang Yuan asked: "Tell me, if I use another second aperture Gu, could I open a third aperture?"

"Hmph, keep dreaming," the land spirit scoffed. "This is second aperture Gu, not third aperture Gu. If you want a third aperture, create the recipe yourself!"

The land spirit would not lie merely to obtain divine travel Gu, and having studied the recipe, Fang Yuan had already deduced as much.

With this, the divine travel Gu and the semi-finished second aperture Gu with Fang Yuan had lost their use.

"Land spirit, take a look at what this is." Fang Yuan thought for a while before directly taking out the semi-finished second aperture Gu that he had personally refined.

The land spirit's eyes brightened: "To think you reached this stage! Only the final, most difficult step remains."

This temptation proved irresistible to the land spirit. "Speak, what do you want?" he asked, turning his burning gaze toward Fang Yuan.

Glancing at divine travel Gu in his right hand, Fang Yuan replied: "Immortal Gu are priceless, so naturally I want another Immortal Gu in exchange. That is standard rule for trading Immortal Gu."

Lang Ya land spirit scowled. "Divine travel Gu is impractical, usable only as a desperate escape. What use is second aperture Gu to a land spirit like me?"

"Land spirit, you're too stingy. Lang Ya blessed land has many Immortal Gu. Divine travel Gu is rank six; I'm not greedy, I only want to exchange it for another rank six Immortal Gu."

Seeing the time was right, Fang Yuan said, "Let's compromise. I'll take an expendable rank six Immortal Gu. Once I use it up, you can refine it again, right?"

He snorted and raised his head arrogantly. "Fine, we'll do it like that."

He spread his hands, conjuring five Immortal Gu from thin air.

"Lang Ya blessed land's foundation is really strong." Fang Yuan sighed inwardly - he was suddenly stupefied when he looked at them.

"I want this Immortal Gu." With a strange expression, Fang Yuan pointed to one of them.

It was Gruel Mud Immortal Gu—the culprit causing Dang Hun mountain's slow death.

They quickly completed the trade. Having obtained Gruel Mud Immortal Gu, Fang Yuan stored it in his pouch rather than his aperture for now.

"I poured all my effort into this semi-finished product, saving you immense expense. Since we're acquainted, I'll give you a discount: just one thousand hairy men. I won't be picky—the old hairy men who just refined Gu will do."

"Bullshit! These hairy men are all my children, I won't sell a single one!" Lang Ya land spirit roared in anger.

"All things have a price. We can still discuss!"

"Not for sale means not for sale! Mention this again and you can take your semi-finished product—I won't buy it."

Fang Yuan was surprised by the land spirit's stubborn refusal; he truly was deeply attached to the hairy men.

Regretting being unable to buy the hairy men, Fang Yuan changed his request: "In that case, I want to exchange for wolf enslavement Gu recipes."

"Take them. These are recipes for rank one to rank five wolf enslavement Gu." Lang Ya land spirit handed him a thick stack.

"The deal is finished, you can leave." Lang Ya land spirit waved impatiently.

Fang Yuan smiled. "No rush, I have another transaction that will definitely interest you."

"Hmph, don't talk big, young man. Few things in this world interest this old man," Lang Ya land spirit said proudly, stroking his beard.

"This time, I'm trading information—specifically, when I will use the second aperture Gu."

The land spirit stared in deep disdain: "How can you be so shameless?! Is there no limit to your degradation?!"

"Hahaha," Fang Yuan laughed. "Are you telling me you aren't interested in this information?"

Second aperture Gu was an Immortal Gu, and Immortal Gu were unique. If Fang Yuan never used it, the land spirit could never refine another.

"What's your price?" Swallowing his anger and suppressing the urge to beat Fang Yuan, the land spirit asked.

Fang Yuan narrowed his eyes with a sharp glint. "Information for information. I want all the information regarding Eighty-Eight True Yang Building in Imperial Court blessed land."

"Eighty-Eight True Yang Building? You actually know that Immortal Gu House is related to me?!" The land spirit was shocked.

---

# Chapter 488: Ma Ying Jie

Soon, a group of Gu Masters riding terror claw horses came to the swamp.

"Lord elders, they passed through here in that direction," an investigative Gu Master reported, his eyes glowing red as he scanned the surroundings.

A young Gu Master frowned anxiously: "Uncle, Rocks Pool leads out of Warm Pond Valley!"

"Relax. Fei Qing is heavily poisoned and burdened by his child. He won't get far. Keep chasing!"

The elders laughed and waved their hand, continuing the chase.

After they rode into the sparse woods, the swamp churned, and a yellowish silkworm emerged.

The silkworm split from within, and a middle-aged Gu Master and a child stepped out.

"We finally deceived them." Fei Qing's face was purple; the poison had spread deep.

"Despicable Fei Chang! Poisoning your own cousin just for the clan leader position! You bastard..."

Rage and desperation overwhelmed Fei Qing, making him cough up a mouthful of green blood.

"Father, father! Hold on!" Seeing the blood, the weeping child threw himself onto Fei Qing's chest.

"Son..." Fei Qing's despairing eyes showed a trace of hope and resolution.

Caressing his son's head, he said, "Little Cai, Father can't go on. Fei Chang will soon realize and turn back. Flee quickly while I hold them off. Take that secret path, and you might survive."

"No, Father, let's run together... please..." his son, Fei Cai, wept in grief.

Anxious, Fei Qing gripped Fei Cai's shoulders firmly. "Don't cry, Little Cai. Northern Plains men shed blood, not tears. You carry Giant Sun Immortal Venerable's bloodline of rare purity, qualifying you to enter Eighty-Eight True Yang Building."

"Cough..." Green blood seeped from Fei Qing's mouth. "If you ever enter Imperial Court blessed land, claim Ancestor Giant Sun's legacy and avenge me!"

Wiping away fresh tears, Fei Cai gritted his teeth, turned, and ran.

Watching his son run, Fei Qing hoped he could escape evil clutches—until his eyes suddenly widened.

"Fool, stop!" Fei Qing pushed himself up, shouting.

"Fa... Father?" Fei Cai stopped after a few steps and looked back in confusion.

Veins bulging on his forehead, Fei Qing roared, "Idiot, I said northwest! Why are you running southeast? Seeking death back at the tribe camp?!"

Fei Qing sighed helplessly. His son possessed a thick bloodline, but was foolish and had zero sense of direction. Could he truly survive to see another day?

Soon, as expected, a grim-faced Fei Chang returned with three Gu Masters on terror claw horses.

"Hmph, you were hiding here after all!" Fei Chang's voice was raspy and chilling, his knife-sharp gaze radiating dense killing intent.

"To think I'd fall to scum like you," Fei Qing scoffed disdainfully, his paralyzed body unable to move.

"Seize him." At Fei Chang's command, the Gu Masters bound Fei Qing tightly and dragged him with hemp rope.

"Taste the mud, Fei Qing! Pursue that brat—kill him!" Fei Chang laughed loudly in triumph.

At Rocks Pool, Fei Chang found no trace of the boy.

"He didn't run this way? Speak, where did he go?!" Fei Chang demanded coldly.

An eerie light shone from Fei Chang's eyes onto Fei Qing, making him shudder as his soul was severely injured.

"So there's a hidden path nearby." Fei Chang smirked, satisfied with the extracted memories.

Turning his horse, he immediately headed for the hidden path.

Yet upon arriving, they found no trace of anyone.

"How can this be? That mortal kid hasn't even opened his aperture; he can't hide from my investigative Gu. Did I only plunder partial memories?" Scanning the bushy path once more, Fei Chang's expression darkened.

*Wooo Woooo....*

Just then, a deep bugle horn blared from outside Warm Pond Valley.

Fei Chang and the rest immediately paled.

"Lord elders, return immediately! Ma tribe has launched a surprise invasion with a massive army! The tribe is in critical danger!" a messenger reported, flying in on a bird.

"What?!" Fei Chang was shocked. Ma tribe's invasion right amidst their internal turmoil was too coincidental!

Putting Fei Cai out of his mind, Fei Chang rushed back to the tribe camp.

Fei tribe, a large Huang Jin clan occupying Warm Pond Valley, was annihilated!

From atop a slope, Ma tribe's leaders watched the ruined Fei camp from horseback.

An elder cupped his fists toward the young man: "Congratulations, Young Master! Your scheme sparked Fei tribe's civil strife, capturing Warm Pond Valley!"

This youth was Ma tribe's young leader, Ma Ying Jie.

Spirited and sharp-browed, this rank four enslavement path expert was known as Little Ma Zun.

---

# Chapter 489: The debate about Chang Shan Yin

Ma Ying Jie remarked, "Warm Pond Valley is easily defensible. With the blizzard looming, it serves as a natural haven. Securing it gives our tribe a base to attack or defend as needed."

"Capturing over two hundred thousand terror claw horses will expand Uncle's herds for the heroes assembly!"

His uncle was none other than Ma Zun, one of the three great enslavement masters.

"Uncle told me before we marched: our Ma tribe required centuries of effort, accumulation, and rare fortune to become a large-scale tribe. Yet defending our foundation grows harder as we expand. Taking Warm Pond Valley only preserves our spark; the true way to secure our tribe is to advance further into Imperial Court!"

Ma Ying Jie added, "Imperial Court blessed land holds Giant Sun Immortal Venerable's true inheritance in Eighty-Eight True Yang Building! Uncle said my bloodline qualifies to enter Eighty-Eight True Yang Building. If I claim the Venerable's inheritance and become a Gu Immortal, Ma tribe will become Northern Plains' newest super tribe!"

In truth, Ma Zun had said no such thing; it was entirely Ma Ying Jie's fabrication.

Borrowing Ma Zun's prestige ensured no one would dare oppose him within the tribe.

Ma Ying Jie continued, "Though Uncle Ma Zun placed his hopes on me, obtaining the Venerable's inheritance in Eighty-Eight True Yang Building still depends on destiny. Yet beyond True Yang Building, countless other inheritances scatter Imperial Court blessed land. Every tribe that ever entered grew immensely stronger. I can't help feeling excited just thinking about it."

"Annihilating Fei tribe gives us a huge advantage in Tian Chuan's heroes assembly. Once we subdue Cheng tribe, Ma tribe will take a commanding lead!"

"Winning the heroes assembly lets us recruit experts and absorb lesser tribes for the great battle."

"To reach Imperial Court, we must also monitor the heroes assemblies in Yu Tian, Meng Qiu, and Cao Fu."

Amidst their fervent discussion, a messenger Gu Master hurried in and handed fresh intelligence to Ma Ying Jie.

"Dong Fang tribe already subdued Zhao tribe, becoming the undisputed ruler of Cao Fu's heroes assembly."

"In Meng Qiu, Nu Er tribe dispatched Nu Er Tu with terrifying momentum; Lui tribe likely can't hold them off."

"Yu Tian's assembly is in an uproar too—the former Wolf King, Chang Shan Yin, has resurfaced!"

"Chang Shan Yin is formidable; leading Ge tribe, he challenged three tribes and even defeated Pei Yan Fei!"

"Hei Lou Lan and Liu Wen Wu were the top contenders in Yu Tian. With the Wolf King's return, the outcome of Yu Tian's assembly is anyone's guess."

Soon, everyone's discussion focused on Fang Yuan.

Chang Shan Yin's legend had circulated across Northern Plains for years; his sudden return was stirring massive waves.

"Young Leader, if Wolf King Chang Shan Yin fought Lord Ma Zun, who would win?"

Chang Shan Yin was an enslavement path expert capable of fighting ten thousand alone.

"An enslavement master relies on beast packs. Having recently returned, Chang Shan Yin controls ordinary wolves with merely three myriad beast kings. One has died and another is heavily injured, how can he compare to my uncle Ma Zun?"

Ma Ying Jie snorted. "Uncle Ma Zun's herd will now reach five hundred thousand horses! Furthermore, he has a horse emperor, nine myriad beast kings, and five mutated horses. Can the Wolf King even compare?"

The surrounding Gu Masters gasped in pleasant shock.

Ma Ying Jie shifted tone. "Yet Wolf King Chang Shan Yin cannot be underestimated. To master Imperial Court, we will inevitably clash with him. More crucially, if he aligns with a Huang Jin tribe at the assembly, their Gu Masters will help him capture wolf packs and fuel his rise."

Sighing, the young leader concluded, "Absorbing Fei tribe is only the first step. Stronger foes await. Only by uniting can we overcome them and enter Imperial Court."

"Father, you died such a miserable death..." A tragic cry rose from the foot of the hill.

This sound attracted the Ma tribesmen's gaze.

Ma Ying Jie looked over the corpse-strewn battlefield; a child had thrown himself onto a scarred corpse, crying bitterly.

"Brat, get lost. You are already my Ma tribe's slave!" A nearby man beat the child and dragged him away.

The boy struggled fiercely and bit the man's wrist.

The adult man screamed, loosening his hand.

Scampering back, the kid threw himself onto the corpse again, weeping bitterly.

Ma Ying Jie sighed, "In these troubled times, human power is insignificant; if you don't die, I die. I will do everything to protect our tribe so our children never suffer such a fate."

Ma Ying Jie pointed down: "This kid is loyal and filial, yet suffers because of me. Someone bring him here; he will be my personal servant from now on."

"Kid, get up!" A Ma tribe higher-up stopped the man and grabbed the boy by his neck.

The kid struggled fiercely: "No, I want to be with my father."

"Your father is dead. Our young tribe leader is taking you in as his personal servant," the higher-up said.

The boy didn't listen, crying repeatedly: "Father, father!"

Suddenly, he stopped and looked sluggishly at his father's corpse.

"Ah! You aren't my father—his skin is darker and he has white hair!" The kid kicked the corpse, crying, "Father, where are you?"

Dark lines appeared all over every Ma tribesmen's forehead.

---

# Chapter 490: Second Aperture!

As turmoil gathered across Northern Plains, the transaction in Lang Ya blessed land concluded.

"You want information on Eighty-Eight True Yang Building? Hmm... not impossible," Lang Ya land spirit muttered, eyeing Fang Yuan sharply.

"Only Giant Sun Immortal Venerable was present during the refinement. How could you know such a secret?"

"Possessing Thieving Heaven's inheritance and clues regarding Giant Sun, I deduced this through calculations," Fang Yuan answered arrogantly.

Lang Ya land spirit studied his expression and suddenly realized: "Are you...?"

"Yes, junior has some wisdom path attainments," Fang Yuan lied with an earnest expression.

"To deduce this far, you must have grasped the essence of wisdom path." Learning Fang Yuan was a wisdom path Gu Master, the land spirit's tone softened.

He summoned a rank four east window Gu and held it.

Lang Ya land spirit infused his thoughts and released it.

East window Gu opened its window-like carapace, circled the air, and flew toward Fang Yuan.

Fang Yuan sent out his thoughts and checked it; his face immediately revealed joy.

"This is the information you wanted. Now, it is your turn." Lang Ya land spirit reminded.

Fang Yuan chuckled: "Now that second aperture Gu is formed, I am eager to use it. I'll notify you beforehand."

"Hold on!" the land spirit snapped. "You wisdom path Gu Masters are top schemers—are you trying to cheat me? We haven't finalized this east window Gu yet. With a single thought, I can make it self-destruct in your hand!"

"Then what do you propose we do?" Fang Yuan asked impatiently.

"Use second aperture Gu right before me now. Only then can I be at ease." Lang Ya land spirit stroked his grizzled beard, pleased with his idea.

Fang Yuan grinned: "Without immortal essence, how can I activate it? Let me leave so grandpa can help."

"Your grandfather can help, but I can't? Stop talking nonsense—hand over second aperture Gu and I'll activate it personally!"

"This..." Fang Yuan tried to make an excuse.

Seeing his hesitation, the land spirit grew convinced Fang Yuan wanted to trick him, making his stance firmer.

Looking helpless, Fang Yuan reluctantly allowed Lang Ya land spirit to assist.

Lang Ya land spirit took second aperture Gu, infused immortal essence into it, and tossed it to Fang Yuan.

Second aperture Gu turned into a bean-sized green light and flew into Fang Yuan's body.

The green light burst, forming a new aperture that appeared both real and ethereal.

Second aperture!

"This is the second aperture?" Fang Yuan touched his chest, muttering dazedly.

"Nonsense, what else? A second aperture grants huge advantages now and as an immortal. But a third aperture Gu is impossible. You would have to deduce an entirely new recipe for third aperture Gu."

Fang Yuan recovered and gave the land spirit a profound look. Raising this deliberately meant he wanted to cooperate in deducing the recipe.

Lang Ya land spirit flushed under Fang Yuan's knowing gaze.

Fang Yuan chuckled and bade farewell: "We'll discuss this later. I shall take my leave."

"Get lost, get lost!" Lang Ya land spirit repeatedly waved his hand.

Leaving Lang Ya blessed land, Fang Yuan returned to Hu Immortal blessed land via stargate Gu.

"Although the starlight fireflies are multiplying, the starlight firefly Gu are decreasing. My frequent use of stargate Gu has consumed them far faster than they can be produced."

# Chapter 491: Expansion of the wolf group

"Without major changes, Eastern Sea's air bubble sea will be poisoned by year's end during a battle between Gu Immortals, causing air bubble fish prices in treasure yellow heaven to skyrocket. Yet I lack enough air bubble fish for myself, let alone selling them anytime soon," Fang Yuan mused.

However, Dang Hun mountain was still in a worsening condition.

Standing on Dang Hun Mountain, Fang Yuan sensed an aura of death, making his mood turn somber.

Dang Hun Mountain was the blessed land's greatest treasure; neither starlight firefly Gu nor air bubble fish could compare.

Fang Yuan returned to Dang Hun Palace, summoning Little Hu Immortal and connecting to treasure yellow heaven.

Just as they connected, several divine sense were transmitted.

Fang Yuan had listed vast amounts of gruel mud for Immortal Gu Gruel Mud's recipe, drawing immense attention.

"Though Gruel Mud is necessary to refine the Immortal Gu, the recipe is far more valuable. The remnant recipes offered in exchange have reached peak value."

One glance told Fang Yuan the time to trade was ripe.

The offers were all capped with little difference between them, but Fang Yuan took interest in one specific bidder.

The seller, Immortal Mudfeet, offered an Immortal Gruel Mud remnant recipe boasting a sixty-five-foot treasure light.

Though slightly lower than rival bids, his message offered to include hairy men to make up the difference.

Now, he required a large number of wolf enslavement Gu.

Having obtained rank one to five wolf enslavement Gu recipes from Lang Ya land spirit, he only lacked hairy men to refine them.

Immediately, Little Hu Immortal conveyed the divine sense.

Immortal Mudfeet was present and replied immediately: "I will add ten thousand hairy men!"

Fang Yuan inspected the goods and replied: "These are all young hairy men, useless for Gu refinement. I need old hairy men."

"Old hairy men? Then the quantity must drop," Immortal Mudfeet replied, keen to clear his blessed land's surplus population.

After bargaining, Immortal Mudfeet agreed to sell over three thousand old hairy men and seven thousand young hairy men.

In exchange, Fang Yuan added half an immortal essence stone.

With the deal concluded, Fang Yuan inspected the Immortal Gu Gruel Mud remnant recipe.

Only sixty percent intact, the recipe had been tampered with, requiring Fang Yuan to filter out falsifications.

"With this remnant recipe, deducing the complete formula for Immortal Gu Gruel Mud will be far easier. More importantly, Immortal Gu Gruel Mud is already in my hands. So long as I don't use it, no one else can refine it, and I can keep profiting from gruel mud."

Fang Yuan continued listing gruel mud while inspecting the wolf groups.

"After heavy losses against the three tribes, I must replenish myriad beast kings. Eh, someone is selling a wolf emperor?"

Fang Yuan was pleasantly surprised.

Exchanging divine senses, Fang Yuan spent two immortal essence stones to buy the old night wolf emperor and over eighteen thousand night wolves.

He then bought thirty thousand turtleback wolves and ten thousand wind wolves, including two turtleback myriad wolf kings and one wind wolf myriad wolf king.

Combined with his existing pack, Fang Yuan's wolves reached one hundred thousand.

"Standing on Gu Immortals' shoulders, I can trade beast groups freely and replenish numbers without logistical worries. Yet one hundred thousand is still too few. Masters like Ma Zun, Yang Po Ying, and Jiang Bao Ya command at least four hundred thousand beasts—Jiang Bao Ya wielded over six hundred and fifty thousand in his prime!"

He bought ten thousand water wolves, including one myriad beast king and six thousand-wolf kings.

After careful consideration, he chose vermillion flame wolves.

He bought eighty thousand vermillion flame wolves from different Gu Immortals.

Aiming for a pack of one hundred thousand vermilion flame wolves, Fang Yuan tasked Little Hu Immortal with procuring the remaining twenty thousand.

"Six vermillion flame myriad wolf kings, one water wolf myriad beast king, three turtleback myriad wolf kings, two wind wolf myriad beast kings, one mutated beast white eye wolf and one night wolf beast emperor."

Fang Yuan estimated his wolf group's overall battle strength had increased tenfold.

---

# Chapter 492: Getting another mutated wolf

"My wolf group has reached two hundred thousand, but that's still not enough," Fang Yuan mused. "Right now, I must prioritize top-tier battle strength."

Although beast emperors occasionally appeared in treasure yellow heaven, Gu Immortals snapped them up almost immediately.

Knowing buying more wolf emperors was unrealistic, Fang Yuan turned his attention to mutated beasts.

Each mature mutated beast possessed battle strength rivaling a myriad beast king.

Fang Yuan bought out all listings: one blood forest wolf, three shark fin wolves, two frenzy wolves, and five white-eyes wolves.

Far away in Southern Border's Shadow Sect blessed land, Old Man Yan Shi squinted at the floating connecting heaven Gu.

Fang Yuan's bulk purchases of wolf packs, emperors, and mutated beasts drew the attention of this wisdom path Gu Immortal.

"What is Fang Yuan trying to achieve by suddenly buying so many wolves?"

The shadowy rank seven wisdom path Gu Immortal frowned.

He tried using his Gu to make a deduction.

The deduction indicated Fang Yuan merely intended to rear wolves for commerce.

This result did not satisfy him.

Instinct told Old Man Yan Shi that Fang Yuan's actions carried deeper meaning.

Old Man Yan Shi had deduced Fang Yuan's arrival at Hu Immortal blessed land via Fixed Immortal Travel, but never suspected he was in Northern Plains.

Repeated attempts yielded the same result.

"Must I use my vital Gu for this?" Traces of cloudy smoke drifted from Old Man Yan Shi's pores.

This was Old Man Yan Shi's vital Gu — Heavenly Secret!

Heavenly secret Immortal Gu!

It could expose heavenly secrets, leading a Gu Immortal directly to the truth even without clues or evidence.

Old Man Yan Shi had previously used Heavenly Secret Gu to deduce Fang Yuan's eventual return to Southern Border.

He had thus laid a trap, waiting for Fang Yuan's return.

Now, Old Man Yan Shi hesitated over whether to activate Heavenly Secret Gu.

"My current body has around eighty years of lifespan left. Even the most severe backlash will only take seventy years of my life, I will still have ten years left, it is enough to execute my heaven defying plan! A minor matter like this would likely cost only thirteen or fourteen years. But..."

"Is it worth using Heavenly Secret Gu here? Defying heaven will alert enemies at crucial moments later, when I will need it to divine the future."

"Yet seizing Fixed Immortal Travel would immensely aid my plans. If I had it during the attack on Lang Ya blessed land, I could have advanced or retreated at will. What could Lang Ya land spirit have done to me? I wouldn't have suffered such heavy losses."

Weighing his options, Old Man Yan Shi decided against it.

Heavenly Secret Gu was a double-edged sword—its low success rate and severe penalties made risking his lifespan unworthy.

One day, Fang Yuan would return to Southern Border and join the battle of Yi Tian Mountain.

For this Fixed Immortal Travel Gu, Old Man Yan Shi spent a hundred and fifty years of his life.

"No matter. Since I already have the result, I shall wait here. His wolf rearing is trivial—how could a mere mortal escape a scheme personally laid by a wisdom path Gu Immortal? Hehe."

Old Man Yan Shi snickered as he opened his eyes.

Like a white-eyes wolf, his eyes held no pupils, only pure white.

Staring at connecting heaven Gu, his smirk deepened: "A mere mortal cost me a hundred and fifty years of life. Dying to my plot will be your greatest honor. But for now, don't expect an easy time!"

Following Old Man Yan Shi's maneuvers, Fang Yuan soon noticed something amiss inside Hu Immortal blessed land.

"Someone is buying up wolf enslavement Gu refinement materials in bulk!"

Fang Yuan wanted to buy these materials, but Old Man Yan Shi was a step ahead of him.

Several Gu Immortals deliberately inflated prices, forcing Fang Yuan to overspend for a smaller quantity of materials.

Fang Yuan's gaze sharpened: "Someone is deliberately sabotaging me. Lang Ya land spirit lacks such influence. Aside from Immortal Crane Sect, it can only be that mysterious Old Man Yan Shi!"

Previously he would have been helpless, but circumstances had changed.

He possessed numerous wolf enslavement Gu recipes from rank one to five, with multiple variations for each rank.

The targeted ingredients belonged only to standard recipes; Lang Ya land spirit's formulas relied on unconventional materials beyond their comprehension.

---

# Chapter 493: Surge in Battle Strength

A moment later.

"Hmph..." Fang Yuan memorized these Gu Immortals' names with a cold gaze.

Diao Sou, Great Immortal Ju Shi, Dian Huang Tianmu...

"Old Man Yan Shi, so it was you." Fang Yuan realized who was behind the trouble—most of these Gu Immortals had participated in attacking Lang Ya blessed land in his past life.

"These Gu Immortals hail from Northern Plains, Southern Border, Eastern Sea, Western Desert, and Central Continent. Including Old Man Yan Shi, this shadowy organization is truly immense!"

Their clash had been restrained with perfect control to avoid drawing suspicion.

Fang Yuan knew Lang Ya land spirit's recipes had enabled his escape, but primarily, the enemy had held back to avoid drawing suspicion or exposing themselves.

"Old Man Yan Shi likely noticed me because of Fixed Immortal Travel Gu," Fang Yuan thought.

"By now, the news has surely spread. Immortal Crane Sect is definitely investigating thoroughly, but that is a good thing."

"The deeper they investigate, the more they learn about me: a thirty-year-old vagabond from a destroyed small-to-mid clan, a lone cultivator—a demonic Gu Master!"

"How could someone with low aptitude and few resources know Hu Immortal blessed land's landscape and refine an Immortal Gu? It is like an ant growing into a giant and swallowing an elephant, or a winged pig outflying eagles."

"They will definitely deduce a mysterious, powerful Gu Immortal expert is backing me, and I am merely their pawn."

"Of course, this is only temporary. Paper cannot contain fire—once they learn the truth or lose patience, trouble will come."

If Immortal Crane Sect attacked Hu Immortal blessed land, Fang Yuan's best option would be to self-detonate it, ensuring mutual destruction so no one obtained Dang Hun Mountain.

Without the blessed land's protection, he would be hunted by everyone.

Thus, he maintained the Chang Shan Yin identity as a backup escape route.

Immortal essence stones were running out!

Selling Immortal Gu recipes had yielded twenty-eight immortal essence stones, but recent bulk purchases had drained his funds.

Fang Yuan had only four immortal essence stones left, yet too many areas required investment.

Helpless, he had to stop investing in the wolf groups.

Fang Yuan originally planned to dual cultivate strength and enslavement paths; with his second aperture, the plan was taking shape.

"With this purchase, my wolf group ranks second-rate in northern plains' mortal realm. The three first-rate enslavement masters remain Ma Zun, Jiang Bao Ya, and Yang Po Ying."

"However, my enslavement Gu worms from Chang Shan Yin are only rank four; I must advance them to rank five for the coming northern plains war."

"Thankfully, dying Dang Hun Mountain still produces guts Gu, greatly reducing costs, but I still need numerous wolf soul Gu to develop my wolfman soul."

Given his cultivation needs, Fang Yuan's immortal essence stones fell short. Bulk buying wolves satisfied only one of the three aspects of enslavement cultivation.

Next, he bought more Gu recipes, refinement materials, and eighteen urgently needed rank five wolf soul Gu.

Spending another immortal essence stone left him with only three.

Fang Yuan placed his sights on relic Gu next.

With his immortal essence stones nearly depleted, Fang Yuan could only buy green copper, red steel, white silver, and yellow gold relic Gu.

Next, he chose the body modification Gu worm.

After these purchases, only two immortal essence stones remained.

These two stones were kept to deal with emergency situations.

For the next two days, Fang Yuan remained in Hu Immortal blessed land, cultivating on Dang Hun Mountain.

"Dang Hun Mountain's vitality and intact guts Gu are decreasing... but after these days of intensive use, my soul has reached thousand-man soul."

Opening his eyes, Fang Yuan summoned Little Hu Immortal to teleport him into Dang Hun Palace.

Sitting on his cushion, he retrieved a white silver relic Gu.

Having verified the relic Gu earlier, Fang Yuan injected primeval essence into it.

A moment later, he opened his eyes and inspected his second aperture, nodding in satisfaction.

"Second aperture has reached rank three peak stage too."

Now, Fang Yuan's first aperture was rank five peak stage with crystal purple essence, while his second aperture reached rank three peak stage with snow silver essence.

"Using the yellow gold relic Gu will push it to rank four peak stage. Best of all, the second aperture allows me to select another vital Gu, granting me two vital Gu in total."

---

# Chapter 494: All of you, get lost!

After rebirth, Fang Yuan's vital Gu was Spring Autumn Cicada, hibernating motionlessly at the center of his first aperture.

Now, his second aperture granted him the chance to choose a second vital Gu.

Though he had deduced this from the recipe, Fang Yuan was still delighted to confirm the opportunity.

'Which Gu should I choose as my second vital Gu?'

Without much hesitation, Fang Yuan made his decision.

It was rank three all-out effort Gu!

Cultivating both strength and enslavement paths, All-Out Effort Gu was an essential, ideal core for the strength path.

Making All-Out Effort Gu his vital Gu ensured he would never lose this precious worm to refinement failure.

Two days passed in an instant.

Fang Yuan returned to the northern plains through stargate Gu.

With Hu Immortal blessed land's faster time flow, two days inside was only one night in northern plains.

It was crack of dawn.

Dawn light illuminated Fang Yuan's face as he smiled and looked aside.

The depleted wolf pack was replenished with numerous white wolves.

Over ten thousand water wolves stood assembled, led by a myriad beast king and six thousand-beast kings.

Fang Yuan left behind the vermillion flame wolves, night wolves, and mutated beasts.

"I must continue absorbing wild water wolf packs." Astride his hump wolf, Fang Yuan directed the massive wolf group toward their next destination.

Three days later, beside Crescent Lake.

Gu Masters from two tribes glared furiously at each other.

"Zhong Fei You, your Zhong tribe bullies too much! These five black skin fat beetles are our tribe's goods, yet you dare seize them openly!" Chai tribe leader Chai Zhang shouted.

"Nonsense! We agreed this water wolf nest marks the boundary. Since these five black skin fat beetles entered Zhong territory, they belong to us!" Zhong tribe leader Zhong Fei You sneered.

Zhong Fei You shrugged unconcernedly, laughing coldly: "If Chai tribe refuses to accept it, we can fight."

Chai Zhang considered retreating, but three of the beetles carried his tribe's most precious cargo.

These meticulously gathered goods were Chai tribe's tribute to join Liu Wen Wu; giving them up was unacceptable.

In the end, should he fight or retreat?

As the stalemate dragged on and Chai Zhang hesitated, distant wolf howls echoed.

Members of both tribes turned toward the sound, bracing as if facing a great enemy.

Soon, a majestic wolf army surged through the sparse forest like a river.

The pack contained sturdy night wolves, defensive turtleback wolves, agile wind wolves, and a majority of white-furred water wolves.

Unlike wild packs, they moved in disciplined unison like an army—indicating only one possibility.

Chai Zhang's heart thumped as a name sprang to mind: Chang Shan Yin!

Zhong Fei You's expression became extremely unsightly.

Zhong tribe also intended to join Lord Liu Wen Wu and coveted Chai tribe's tribute, never expecting an interloper to disrupt them at the crucial moment.

As the wolf army drew near, both tribes' Gu Masters grew restless.

The immense wolf pack fanned out into a crescent formation, encircling both tribes.

Trapped against Crescent Lake, the surrounded Gu Masters found themselves in a dire predicament.

"Didn't Chang Shan Yin suffer heavy losses against the three tribes? Why does he have so many wolves?!" Chai Zhang paled as wolves hemmed them in.

A hump wolf carrying Fang Yuan strolled leisurely out from the forest.

"Chang Shan Yin!" Zhong Fei You and Chai Zhang exclaimed together.

Fang Yuan sat expressionless and upright on the hump wolf, mimicking Chang Shan Yin's posture.

"Lord Chang Shan Yin, I, Zhong Fei You, have long admired your great renown..." Zhong Fei You gritted his teeth and bowed deeply.

No one found the tribe leader's deference inappropriate—their opponent was Chang Shan Yin!

Before he could finish, Fang Yuan waved dismissively: "All of you get lost. Don't block my way."

Zhong Fei You's eyes widened in undisguised humiliation.

Swallowing his anger, he bowed again to Fang Yuan and ordered his clansmen: "Retreat."

Reading the situation, Chai Zhang immediately shouted: "We retreat too."

Soon, only Fang Yuan and his wolf pack remained by the lakeside.

Alongside them were the three slow-moving black skin fat beetles.

Fang Yuan glanced indifferently at the beetles; the goods the tribes fought over held little appeal to him.

With a wave of his hand, the water wolves plunged into the water to assault the local wolf den.

---

# Chapter 495: Grey-white Stone Slab

The local den contained four thousand water wolves, forming a thousand-beast pack.

Fang Yuan activated wolf howl Gu, dispatching three waves of reinforcements.

The wild water wolves held out briefly before collapsing under the pressure, thoroughly routed.

"Hmph, do you think Zhong tribe hasn't thought of that? Even if Chang Shan Yin ignores them, we could never retrieve those resources! With Chang Shan Yin here, we cannot stay at Crescent Lake; we must leave immediately." Chai Zhang waved dismissively, his tone a mix of helplessness, anger, and weakness.

After nine days, Fang Yuan returned to Ge tribe camp with his vastly expanded wolf pack.

Ge Guang and the tribal higher-ups came out to welcome Fang Yuan.

"Lord Supreme Elder, your cultivation recovered?!" Sensing Fang Yuan's rank four peak stage aura, Ge Guang was shocked and delighted.

Fang Yuan nodded plainly: "It did; it was about time."

His apparent rank four peak stage aura was merely produced by breath concealment Gu.

His second aperture, having originated in northern plains, suffered no suppression and remained at rank three peak stage.

Concealing it and gradually revealing his aura would preserve a trump card while letting others accept his progression naturally.

Fang Yuan followed the Ge tribe higher-ups back to camp.

"The biggest problem now is the lack of slavery Gu. If we had large numbers of slavery Gu, we could send these slave Gu Masters into battle. This will greatly increase our battle strength!" Ge Guang exclaimed.

"I will continue cultivating in seclusion. You will oversee feeding the wolf pack," Fang Yuan instructed.

"Yes," Ge Guang replied quickly, though inwardly dismayed.

Expanding Ge tribe already lacked manpower; feeding such a colossal wolf pack would demand immense labor.

But Fang Yuan's next sentence made this young Ge tribe leader joyous —

"I brought back ample resources gathered while hunting wolves. Use them freely, but safeguard the goods on those three black skin fat beetles—they are mine."

"Yes, Lord Supreme Elder!"

Over the next few days, Fang Yuan remained in Ge tribe camp, cultivating in seclusion.

His second aperture needed advancement, and despite reaching a thousand-man soul, he still needed wolf soul Gu to transform it into a thousand-man wolfman soul.

Meanwhile, his strength path required further refinement using jun strength Gu.

To relax, he inspected the items retrieved from the three black skin fat beetles.

These treasures Chai tribe painstakingly gathered were peculiar grey-white stone slabs.

Their surfaces were covered in black ink lines overlapping to resemble words and landscape sketches.

If authentic, they traced back to the immemorial era and Ren Zu's ninth child, Carefree Wisdom Heart.

Fang Yuan harbored no ambitions of restoring Book Mountain.

In his past life, he had developed a sharp eye, having even crafted and sold counterfeit slabs himself.

Appraising the slabs and weeding out fakes served as a pleasant diversion.

Unexpectedly, while examining one particular slab, an anomaly occurred.

When he infused primeval essence into this slab he had deemed fake, the ink lines began to shift mystically.

---

# Chapter 496: Di Qiu Inheritance

The shifting ink lines gradually coalesced into a terrain map.

At the center rose a gentle, cliff-less elevation featuring a tunnel-like opening.

On this place, two words were indicated — Di Qiu.

Swamps and forests surrounded Di Qiu, with a river in the southwest.

At the bottom ran four lines: *"light in the soil, shine up to a hundred thousand feet high, swimming in the sky for a hundred li, praising plum fragrant snow."*

Fang Yuan was certain these riddle-like verses were deliberate clues.

Remarkably, after lingering briefly, the map faded from the slab.

Yet closing his eyes, Fang Yuan recalled every detail with vivid clarity.

"Painting idea Gu was used here, etching the map indelibly into my memory."

Fang Yuan smiled, having unexpectedly obtained clues to a Gu Master's inheritance.

"I am too busy to abandon my plans for such a vague inheritance. Besides, with just this map, where would I even find 'Di Qiu'?"

Getting Di Qiu inheritance map was only a tiny accident, Fang Yuan quickly forgot about it.

In the following days, he continued cultivating while refining Gu.

Drawing materials from Ge tribe's warehouse, he refined rank three eagle wings into rank four eagle rise Gu.

A few days after refining eagle rise Gu, Ge Guang visited Fang Yuan personally with the latest intelligence.

"Ma tribe completely absorbed Fei tribe, dominating the Tian Chuan heroes assembly..."

"Cao Fu's Zhao tribe? Mm, Zhao Lian Yun—Ma Hong Yun's future wife and an eventual wisdom path Gu Immortal—is only an innocent young girl now."

"Regardless, Ma tribe drawing so much attention means they are plotting to contest the Lord of the Imperial Court's throne, just as in my previous life. But will Ma Hong Yun appear?"

Ge Guang reported: "Lord Supreme Elder, at our Yu Tian assembly, many experts are locked in fierce competition. Among them, Liu Wen Wu and Hei Lou Lan lead the two strongest factions; other forces cannot compete with them."

"Right now, only our tribe remains at crescent lake while even large tribes have left for Yu Tian. Having digested our battle spoils and stabilized our situation, we might not make it in time if we do not set off now."

Fang Yuan nodded.

Fang Yuan told Ge Guang: "The tribe has stabilized only on the surface; in real battle, we could not unleash a mid-sized tribe's true strength."

Ge Guang lowered his head, listening to Fang Yuan's teachings patiently.

Fang Yuan continued: "The contest at Yu Tian heroes assembly has only just entered its climax. We need not rush. For now, we head to onion valley."

"Onion valley?" Ge Guang showed some confusion.

Fang Yuan soon explained: "Long ago, I bred wolves in onion valley. Over these years, they should have matured and multiplied."

"So that's it!" Ge Guang's eyes shone.

"After so many years, the wolf king remains, though I do not know how many wolves are left. When attending the heroes assembly, a larger wolf pack will give us greater authority and voice."

Ge Guang nodded in agreement: "Lord Supreme Elder is right. When do we set off?"

"Today." Fang Yuan said.

# Chapter 497: Mo Shi Kuang

Yu Tian, renowned as one of Northern Plains' richest pasturelands, was now crowded with gathering factions beneath fluttering banners.

One side was Liu tribe's Liu Wen Wu, the other Hei tribe's Hei Lou Lan.

A spacious battle stage stood in the center of the gathering.

On the stage, two rank four Northern Plains Gu Masters were locked in fierce combat.

"Water Demon, hand over your life!" the middle-aged Gu Master shouted, stamping his foot and leaping into the air.

In midair, he inhaled deeply and breathed out a basket-sized dark flame toward his opponent.

Water Demon Hao Ji Liu's heart gave warning signs.

Blue light flashing in his eyes, he poured yellow gold primeval essence furiously into water wall Gu.

The dark flame landed upon the water wall and was immediately extinguished.

"Huh?" The spectators were stunned. Just as they prepared to mock Water Demon for overreacting, the faint spark violently exploded!

As the mist dispersed, Chai Ming stood gasping on the stage, glaring at the body under his foot: "Water Demon, did you ever expect this day when you killed my father?!"

Water Demon Hao Ji Liu coughed up blood, grimacing in pain under Chai Ming's foot.

"Brother Lou Lan, thank you for conceding." Liu Wen Wu stood and cupped his fists toward Hei Lou Lan with an elegant smile.

Hei Lou Lan snorted coldly at the unexpected result. Just as he was about to exchange polite pleasantries...

With a soft sound, Chai Ming looked down at his chest in shock.

A sharp water blade protruded out of his heart.

Turning slowly, he saw Hao Ji Liu smiling malevolently, his face covered in blisters from the fire.

Just then, the 'Hao Ji Liu' under his feet dissolved into a pool of water.

"Despicable..." With this final word, he died in bitter indignation.

"Hahaha..." Hei Lou Lan threw back his head in unreserved laughter, giving Water Demon a thumbs-up. "Hao Ji Liu, well done! Come, drink this wine!"

"Many thanks for Lord's reward." Grimacing from burns, Water Demon took the cup and drank it in one gulp.

Hei Lou Lan waved his hand, his voice coarse and boorish: "Keep the cup as a reward too. Yan Cui Er, bring a new cup and pour the best wine!"

She was Yan tribe's eldest daughter and Liu Wen Wu's fiancée, abducted by Hao Ji Liu and presented to Hei Lou Lan as a greeting gift.

"Young Master Liu, you cannot beat me. Why not admit defeat, and I will return your fiancée?" Hei Lou Lan downed the wine and boorishly wiped his beard.

"Hehehe, why worry about a wife? She cannot replace my ambition. Brother Lou Lan, haven't you heard that women are like clothes, while brothers are like hands and feet? Since Brother Lou Lan likes her, feel free to keep her." Liu Wen Wu chuckled without the slightest hint of anger.

Hei Lou Lan snorted furiously: "Your Liu tribe has always been glib. But so what? Come, send your fighters to the stage for another match!"

Having won only three of the previous nine matches, he had lost numerous experts, most recently the rank four Fire Prodigal Chai Ming.

As Liu Wen Wu's subordinates hesitated, a loud voice boomed from a distance: "Big brother, no need to worry, send me!"

Tall and muscular, he had ink-dark skin, fierce features, and lush snow-white hair and beard that blended like a lion's mane.

The striking contrast of white hair and black skin stunned the crowd until someone cried out, "This person—is an inkman!"

"Not late at all, you came at just the right time." Liu Wen Wu patted his shoulder and introduced him: "Everyone, this is Mo Shi Kuang, my sworn brother from years ago."

"Mo Shi Kuang... Young Master Liu has fine taste, mingling with an insignificant variant human. Very well, let my Viper Prince exchange moves with your brother."

Provoked by this, Mo Shi Kuang leapt onto the stage in fury: "Die!"

"What? Qi path?! Rank four peak stage! Shit—" Viper Prince could not even finish speaking before he was crushed into minced meat that splattered everywhere.

# Chapter 498: Wolf Howl

Hei Lou Lan looked at Mo Shi Kuang with a gloomy face.

"Hey, black-skinned fatty over there, are you the one opposing my big brother? Come, send your experts so I can slap your lackeys flat!" Mo Shi Kuang patted his chest and shouted boorishly.

"Black-skinned fatty..." Hei Lou Lan's eyelids twitched and was extremely angry, "Although I am fat, am I as black as you? This black boor is really hateful!"

"Hei Xiu Yi," Hei Lou Lan called softly, his calm voice masking burning rage.

His gaze icy and indifferent, black light blossomed over his body as he walked, condensing into firm armor that covered him completely.

Next, a dim green halo flew over his head.

Fifty-six flying bone shields hovered around him, providing complete protection.

Similarly, nine greyish-blue ghost faces whimpered and hovered around him.

"Ahahaha!" Mo Shi Kuang rejoiced. "A guy asking for a beating—come, eat my punch!"

The moment he finished speaking, his right fist punched fiercely at Hei Xiu Yi.

His fist strength instantly condensed into thick fist qi, slamming fiercely at Hei Xiu Yi dozens of steps away.

But Hei Xiu Yi took the punch head-on; though his upper body shook, his lower body did not move in the slightest.

"Good!" Mo Shi Kuang rejoiced. Unlike ordinary inkmen, he was addicted to fighting. Thrilled, he shouted, "Again!"

Rising into the air with his snow-white hair swaying, he pulled some distance from Hei Xiu Yi and punched rapidly.

A torrential rain of fist shadows descended as translucent fist qi shot toward Hei Xiu Yi.

The fist qi exploded against Hei Xiu Yi's armor with sounds like crackling thunder.

When Mo Shi Kuang's assault ceased, the halo above Hei Xiu Yi shone dim green light onto the flying bone shields, completely repairing their cracks.

"Let me return this to you." Hei Xiu Yi sneered; the nine ghost faces opened their mouths together and spurted out dozens of fist qi.

Shockingly, Mo Shi Kuang's attack was returned back to him in full.

Dazed by the returning fist qi, Mo Shi Kuang took the successive explosions and crashed to the ground.

"Don't worry." Liu Wen Wu smiled. "My third brother is addicted to fighting; the stronger the opponent, the more excited he becomes. Just watch the show."

"Hahaha... refreshing, so refreshing!" Mo Shi Kuang laughed crazily and leapt up from the ground.

His eyes turned fiery red as he fixed a burning gaze on Hei Xiu Yi.

"You are somewhat interesting, worthy of half my strength," Mo Shi Kuang said earnestly.

"HAAAAAAH!" Mo Shi Kuang's body shook as an intense, beastly aura of lions and bears erupted from him, oppressing everyone's hearts.

Rushing into the sky with the overwhelming might of a demon god, he lifted his right leg.

"Here it comes!" he shouted excitedly, kicking his right leg toward Hei Xiu Yi.

Wind whirled violently as boundless air condensed into an enormous foot.

Nearly transparent and as large as a small hill, the foot crashed down with violent momentum.

As the enormous foot stamped down, Hei Xiu Yi gritted his teeth and sent all fifty-six flying bone shields to block it.

An irresistible force bore down on Hei Xiu Yi's spine; powerless to resist, he was flattened against the ground within breaths.

As the dust dispersed, Hei Xiu Yi lay motionless on the ground like a dead dog, at his last breath.

Hei Lou Lan's face paled. Hei Xiu Yi was a black banner commander; losing him would reduce the troop's battle strength by twenty percent.

Unable to lose Hei Xiu Yi, Hei Lou Lan immediately ordered: "Bring back Hei Xiu Yi!"

Immediately, two rank three Gu Masters rushed forward.

"A group of scoundrels!" Mo Shi Kuang shouted in fury, thrusting his right fist forward.

Under everyone's dumbstruck gaze, an enormous qi arm—fifty feet long and ten feet wide—rapidly formed.

The two rank three Gu Masters sent to rescue Hei Xiu Yi were swept flying like flies by the colossal qi arm.

Having avoided the attack's brunt, Hei Lou Lan and his experts struck together and shattered the qi arm.

"Hahaha, more!" Facing so many Gu Masters, Mo Shi Kuang showed no fear; instead, his joy and battle intent surged higher.

"Not good, third brother has gone berserk again." Unable to remain calm, Liu Wen Wu waved his hand: "Everyone, follow me to reinforce Third Brother!"

With Liu tribe joining the fray, the heroes assembly descended into an unprecedented, chaotic brawl.

Mo Shi Kuang rampaged across the battlefield as Hei Lou Lan's group grabbed Hei Xiu Yi and retreated, while Chai tribe's Gu Masters hunted down the heavily injured Hao Ji Liu, forcing him to flee desperately...

Right at this moment, an intensely desolate wolf howl echoed from afar, manifesting the presence of a beast emperor.

Countless wolf howls followed, merging into a majestic chorus that resounded across heaven and earth!

# Chapter 499: Turtle Jade Wolf Skin Gu

A grand wolf army approached from all directions as all sorts of Northern Plains wolves gathered and charged together.

Nimble black night wolves, elegant wind wolves, sturdy turtleback wolves, snow-pure water wolves, and blazing vermillion flame wolves...

Each wolf pack numbered in the tens of thousands. As the grand army filled everyone's vision, a suffocating chill seized their hearts.

A grand blue flag bearing the character 'Ge' was carried aloft, marking the main tent's location.

"That means, this is Chang Shan Yin's wolf army?"

"According to our intel, the Wolf King commands night, wind, and turtleback wolves. Where did he get all these water wolves and vermillion flame wolves?" Liu Wen Wu's face was grim.

"Forget the vermillion flame wolves—look at that largest night wolf, is it a wolf emperor?!" Zhong Fei You shouted, pointing.

"It truly is... a night wolf emperor." Recognising its absolute authority, Bei Cao Chuan confirmed dryly.

This was equivalent to the strength of a rank five Gu Master!!

Chang Shan Yin was only a rank four Gu Master—how could he control a wolf emperor?

The chaotic battle ceased as everyone gathered around Liu Wen Wu and Hei Lou Lan, assuming their formations.

Soon after, under everyone's gaze, Fang Yuan rode his white-eyes wolf alongside Ge Guang and the rest toward Hei Lou Lan.
