Since Chang tribe had already submitted to Liu Wen Wu, if Chang Shan Yin wanted revenge, he would first have to deal with Liu Wen Wu.

Fang Yuan looked toward Hei Lou Lan and spoke calmly, his voice echoing in everyone's ears: "I returned to exact revenge. With the Imperial Court competition underway, I can meet Northern Plains' heroes. Brother Lou Lan, why don't we team up?"

Hei Lou Lan's pupils shrank. He stood up eagerly, gripped Fang Yuan's shoulders, and laughed: "Gaining Wolf King's help is my greatest honor!"

The Hei tribe camp erupted into thunderous cheers.

"Your defeated opponent, Hao Ji Liu, pays respects to Lord Wolf King." Water Demon bowed to Fang Yuan in trepidation.

Hei Lou Lan frowned and turned. Though Hao Ji Liu had merits, if he offended Chang Shan Yin, Hei Lou Lan would execute him to show goodwill.

But Fang Yuan nodded at Hao Ji Liu: "No matter, just do your best from now on."

"Hahaha, Wolf King's magnanimity leaves me in awe!" Hei Lou Lan laughed louder. Hao Ji Liu was a rank four upper stage expert; getting the best of both worlds overjoyed him.

Several undecided large tribes immediately chose to side with Hei Lou Lan.

Thus, all tribes at the Yu Tian heroes assembly chose sides: most joined Hei Lou Lan, while the rest went to Liu Wen Wu.

"Hahaha, Liu lad, we'll meet on the battlefield next time!"

"Brother Lou Lan, till we meet again."

With several powerful forces still outside Yu Tian, it was not time to fight. Both groups vigilantly retreated toward their main camps.

"Brother, don't worry. No matter how many wolves he has, I can charge in and kill Chang Shan Yin," Mo Shi Kuang consoled fearlessly.

"Big brother, remember second brother. Once he finishes secluded cultivation and the three of us join forces, what is there to fear in all of Northern Plains?" Mo Shi Kuang laughed.

"Second brother?" Liu Wen Wu's eyes shone, relief easing his heart. "Right, together, Chang Shan Yin is no match for us. But for now, we shouldn't provoke Hei tribe. We must conquer the western area first to gather strength."

Meanwhile, Hei Lou Lan laughed heartily: "Hahaha, once news of the Yu Tian heroes assembly spreads, surrounding forces will panic. Brother Shan Yin, your wolf army will terrify them."

Recognizing Hei Lou Lan's veiled probe, Fang Yuan laughed flatly: "Honestly, I never expected such gains either. Back then, I left wolves behind in Onion Valley; who knew they would multiply to this extent over the years?"

In truth, after entering Onion Valley alone, Fang Yuan had opened the Stargate to Hu Immortal blessed land, retrieving most of the wolves within.

Leading the pack back to Ge tribe left everyone speechless, turning the entire tribe into his witnesses.

Fang Yuan smiled mildly, then laughed arrogantly: "Beyond revenge, I want to spar with Ma Zun, Yang Po Ying, and Jiang Bao Ya, and use Imperial Court blessed land to advance my cultivation."

"Good, true ambition!" Hei Lou Lan handed over a Gu: "Fine Gu belongs to heroes. Please accept this rank five Gu as a meeting gift."

Fang Yuan looked; it was a highly defensive turtle jade wolf skin Gu. In his previous life, he learned this rank five Gu was refined from a living turtleback wolf emperor.

Though rank five Gu were sold in treasure yellow heaven, procuring one that suited enslavement path would cost immense time and precious immortal essence stones.

"Alright, I happily accept." Fang Yuan unhesitatingly took the Gu.

# Chapter 500: Trapped inside and outside, slashing thorns and vines

Twelve days later.

In the secret room, Fang Yuan sat cross-legged with eyes closed, his mind calm yet body tense, focusing entirely on the turtle jade wolf skin Gu inside his aperture.

"After days of continuous seclusion, my body is finally refined with turtle jade wolf skin."

His skin looked normal, but when he ruthlessly slashed his arm with a dagger, the turtle jade wolf skin Gu activated instantly.

Upon contact, his skin turned jade-green while faint turtle shell patterns pulsated outward.

Fang Yuan nodded in satisfaction: "Turtle jade wolf skin Gu activates passively upon being attacked, requiring no primeval essence—truly practical defense."

"Modification complete. Next is increasing strength." Seizing every minute, Fang Yuan remained on his cushion to diligently cultivate strength path.

By now, Fang Yuan had accumulated sixty jun of strength deep within his body.

"With turtle jade wolf skin, my body can hold about a hundred jun. A hundred jun or more enters the rank five realm."

Yet jun strength Gu could not resolve strength path's fundamental limitation.

Though possessing sixty jun of strength, Fang Yuan could only exert a fraction of it in practice.

To solve this problem, he had to rely on all-out effort Gu.

All-out effort Gu allowed a Gu Master to freely unleash their full bodily strength—truly the core Gu of strength path.

Therefore, Fang Yuan made it his second aperture's vital Gu.

But this all-out effort Gu was only rank three, suppressed to rank two in a foreign region.

Fang Yuan possessed the rank four all-out effort Gu recipe; refining it within Northern Plains would eliminate regional suppression.

"Still, continuing accumulation is tricky. Turtle jade wolf skin supports physical strength, but does not aid enslavement path. Though I have two apertures, I share one body."

Spring Autumn Cicada was steadily recovering, renewing the lethal pressure upon him.

Frequently entering and leaving Hu Immortal blessed land rapidly depleted his starlight firefly Gu.

Immortal Crane Sect coveting Hu Immortal blessed land, the mysterious force drawn by Fixed Immortal Travel, retrieving Fixed Immortal Travel and Gruel Mud, the blessed land's earthly calamity, Dang Hun Mountain's dying state, and the strain of flawlessly impersonating Chang Shan Yin...

"Yet facing such crises, I look forward to hacking through the thorns and breaking free of all worries."

Fang Yuan gave a cold laugh, composed himself, and left the secret room.

"Greetings, Lord Wolf King," the two Gu Masters saluted upon seeing him. "Lord Hei Lou Lan has invited the leaders to a banquet for important matters."

"Important matters?" Fang Yuan paused, setting aside his usual distaste for banquets: "Let us go."

Arriving at the banquet, he found it was indeed about the blood oath.

The alliance agreement was settled, with tribal leaders finalizing their interests. Finding no issues, Fang Yuan joined everyone in using poison vow Gu.

But Fang Yuan was the exception.

He possessed eating one's words Gu, which he had used in Shang Clan City to break his vow with Bai Ning Bing.

Now connected to treasure yellow heaven, dispelling this poison vow merely required refining another eating one's words Gu.

Hei Lou Lan held the central seat, with Fang Yuan seated first to his left and Ge Guang standing behind.

"Hahaha, we are family now! Tradition dictates a grand feast after forming an alliance, but that's total bullshit! I have a better idea: instead of annexing weak powers, we will gather wild wolves," Hei Lou Lan announced.

Fang Yuan remained expressionless, scanning the room while knowing his involvement had already altered history.

He recalled from his previous life that Hei Lou Lan had attacked eastward immediately after allying, sparking a bloody war with Dong Fang tribe.

"Although Hei Lou Lan previously suffered heavy losses fighting Dong Fang tribe, he is now prioritizing my night wolf emperor to incorporate myriad beast groups into his army. Expanding the wolf pack was hugely beneficial to him."

Fang Yuan pondered briefly, then nodded: "In that case, I will do my part."

Following the discussion, the entire Hei tribe alliance mobilized, with Gu Masters from all tribes working to expand Fang Yuan's wolf pack.

# Chapter 501: Five hundred thousand wolves start a war

Hunting across the nocturnal grasslands with Hei tribe's assistance, over several days, his night wolf pack swelled from thirty thousand to three hundred and twenty thousand!

The night wolves instantly became the largest force under Fang Yuan's command.

Counting vermillion flame wolves, wind wolves, water wolves, and other breeds, Fang Yuan's wolf army reached a staggering five hundred and thirty thousand!

"Incorporating these night wolves so easily was entirely thanks to the night wolf emperor." After settling the pack, an exhausted Fang Yuan returned to his secret room.

With the night wolf pack's expansion, the number of myriad wolf kings under his control multiplied several times.

Controlling so many myriad beast kings burdened his soul, creating an increasingly heavy weight in its depths.

After sleeping for hours, Fang Yuan sat cross-legged on his cushion to resume cultivation.

He used the wolf soul Gu, slowly converting his thousand man soul into wolfman soul.

The wolf soul Gu's effect was minimal; over two hours only slightly lengthened the wolf ears on his soul.

Yet to Fang Yuan, the burden weighing on his soul eased considerably.

A wolfman soul made controlling packs much easier, as wolves instinctively recognized the Gu Master as one of their own.

"Unfortunately, lacking a rank five wolf soul Gu, I can only use rank four; its effects were prominent on a hundred-man soul, but weaken drastically on a thousand-man soul."

However, rank five Gu were never easy to obtain.

With only two immortal essence stones left and a mysterious enemy lurking, buying one in treasure yellow heaven was too risky.

"Though I cannot buy it in treasure yellow heaven, I requested it from Hei Lou Lan. Hei tribe is a Huang Jin lineage backed by Gu Immortals, boasting deep foundations. Two or three days have passed—I should ask him now."

Fang Yuan exited the secret room to meet Hei Lou Lan, who claimed his hands were tied.

"Brother Shan Yin, truth be told, I have already written a letter to request it from the supreme elders. But they thought it would be better to give a live wolf emperor instead of rank five wolf soul Gu. And the wolf emperor cannot be given casually as well, their intention is to use battle merits to exchange for it. After all, I need to convince the masses as well."

Hei Lou Lan was crafty; once Fang Yuan took the poison vow, his cordiality cooled noticeably.

Having expended substantial manpower and resources to help Fang Yuan capture the night wolves, he felt he had done more than enough.

Meanwhile, Fang Yuan's pack had grown past five hundred thousand, secretly terrifying Hei Lou Lan despite the poison vow.

Fang Yuan nodded and expressed his understanding.

Fang Yuan discerned that Hei Lou Lan was itching for war and already preparing his campaign.

"Brother Lou Lan, which faction do you plan to attack first?" Fang Yuan asked.

Hei Lou Lan laughed heartily and patted Fang Yuan's shoulder: "Little brother is really sharp. I won't hide it from brother, I want to attack Cao Fu and eradicate Dong Fang tribe. Dong Fang tribe has lot of beauties, especially that Dong Fang Qing Yu who is a famous beauty in northern plains. I want to kill all their men and capture all their women! Hahaha..."

Fang Yuan was slightly startled; history had looped back to targeting Dong Fang tribe despite the detour.

"With five hundred thousand wolves, things will differ from my previous life. Dong Fang tribe... hehe," Fang Yuan sneered inwardly.

*So long as profit awaits, let the heavens collapse or deluge drown the world! Who cares if infamy lasts ten thousand years!*

The next day, Hei tribe dismantled camp and commenced a grand expedition toward Cao Fu.

Dong Fang tribe dominated Cao Fu's assembly, suppressing rivals and absorbing many tribes. Only Zhao tribe resisted, unwilling to accept Dong Fang tribe's harsh alliance conditions.

News of Hei tribe's expedition drew Dong Fang tribe's attention, giving Zhao tribe breathing room to shift toward the periphery.

Dong Fang tribe's current leader was rank five wisdom path Gu Master Dong Fang Yu Liang.

After a sleepless night of deductions, he softened his stance and made the alliance terms extremely generous.

Dong Fang Yu Liang personally travelled to invite Zhao tribe to join the alliance!

# Chapter 502: Zhao Lian Yun

In the study room, Zhao tribe leader placed down the document wearily.

Hei tribe's expedition and Dong Fang Yu Liang's personal invitation had split Zhao tribe into two factions.

They argued endlessly: one faction wanted to resolve old grudges by allying with Dong Fang tribe, while the other favored the mightier Hei tribe.

As Zhao tribe leader grew frantic, weeping suddenly came from outside the window.

The guard outside reported: "Lord tribe leader, the young miss slipped on the stairs and knocked her head while running here."

Zhao tribe leader's sons had all been schemed against and killed by Dong Fang Yu Liang, leaving him only a daughter.

Leaning against his chest, she acted spoiled: "Father, Yunyun's head hurts..."

"Father, Yunyun was worried. I heard the elders arguing with you, and that you were upset in the study."

In truth, she shouted in her mind: *'If I hadn't come, my life would be in danger! Convenient dad, you're too indecisive—why haven't you fled yet? What are you dilly-dallying for?!'*

Waving her delicate hands with a nonchalant look, she said: "Father, Yunyun thinks the people arguing with you are idiots. Our Zheng tribe is like a sheep, Dong Fang tribe is a wolf while the tiger from Yu Tian is coming over. The wolf can't beat the tiger, so it seeks the sheep's help. But whichever side the sheep aids, neither beast will spare it in the end."

Observing the tribe leader's expression, she timed her addition: "Father, I heard Ma tribe is very strong and treats its people well. Sheep and horses eat grass, while tigers and wolves eat meat—it's much better to ally with Ma tribe!"

Helplessly, the girl urged: "Father, we should leave immediately. With the tiger and wolf confronting each other, they have no spare strength to care about us."

"Good girl, you're right. Our Zhao tribe cannot meddle in this clash or enter this whirlpool. We shall leave!" Zhao tribe leader decided.

"But Yunyun, did you think of this yourself, or did someone tell you? Tell father." Zhao tribe leader finally sensed something amiss, gazing at his daughter.

Her heart thumped. Blinking innocently with wide eyes, she said: "No one taught me; Yunyun thought of it. Father works so hard, and Yunyun didn't want you exhausted, so I wanted to help."

*'Sigh, that's transmigration for you. Friends can be chosen, but parents are predestined. Since you treated me well, I'll naturally return the favor...'*

# Chapter 503: Dong Fang Yu Liang

"Zhao tribe tore down camp and left?" Hei Lou Lan glanced at the report before casually tossing it on the table.

Sitting beside him, Fang Yuan glanced over the report on the table.

Zhao Lian Yun.

He remembered the name: Ma Hong Yun's future wife and wisdom path Gu Immortal. Currently, she was merely a little girl.

"Looks like the famous persuasion of tiger, wolf and sheep has already utilized..."

In the five regions chaotic war, Ma Hong Yun, Sheng Ling Er, and Zhao Lian Yun would become Gu Immortals and Northern Plains' cornerstones against Heavenly Court's invasion.

"The priority right now is dealing with Dong Fang tribe." Fang Yuan refocused on the discussion.

Like Hei tribe, Dong Fang tribe was a deep-rooted super tribe and Cao Fu's preeminent power.

Dong Fang tribe's young, promising leader Dong Fang Yu Liang used his wisdom path cultivation to manage affairs flawlessly, steering the tribe toward greater prosperity.

Though Hei tribe held military superiority, an opponent adept in wisdom path planning and deduction could not be underestimated.

"He may be young, but he is knowledgeable and accomplished in the four arts, astronomy, and geology. Understanding human nature and unable to protect his vast inheritance, he surrendered most of the assets to an authoritative elder, keeping only a small share."

Meanwhile, the focus of their discussion, Dong Fang Yu Liang, was in his study planning for the crucial battle.

The door opened, and a gentle, graceful beauty in a light yellow dress entered.

After a brief silence, Dong Fang Qing Yu asked cautiously, "Big brother, has Zhao tribe moved?"

"Don't worry, I anticipated this." Dong Fang Yu Liang smiled, gently holding his sister's hand.

Relieved, Dong Fang Qing Yu said, "Nothing escapes your deductions, big brother. But our opponents are formidable—not just Hei Lou Lan, but also Wolf King Chang Shan Yin. You must be careful."

"Hehehe, little sister, do you still not believe your big brother? But..." Dong Fang Yu Liang comforted her: "When Hei Lou Lan harbored ill intentions toward you, I taught him a lesson. Yet he still hasn't learned. This time, I will teach him an unforgettable lesson. As for Chang Shan Yin, I have a plan for him as well. Everything is under control, so focus on resting. You've been frail since youth; worrying and falling ill will only distract me."

Watching his sister leave, Dong Fang Yu Liang could no longer hide his concern, brows furrowing in worry.

"Hei Lou Lan is difficult enough, and now Chang Shan Yin joins him. Five hundred thousand wolves—as expected of an enslavement master, he alone widens Hei tribe's advantage significantly."

"I cannot lose! I barely convinced Old Ancestor to cure my sister's illness if I finish this secret mission. For her sake, I must conquer the Imperial Court and enter Eighty-Eight True Yang Building!"

"Anyone who blocks my path must die. So, Wolf King Chang Shan Yin, why don't you die in this pre-battle rain?"

# Chapter 504: Assassination (Long Chapter)

As Fang Yuan adapted to Northern Plains, his first aperture recovered to rank five middle stage, though he used breath concealment Gu to suppress his aura to rank four peak stage.

Deciding to advance his second aperture, Fang Yuan sat cross-legged and channeled primeval essence to break through.

By dawn, Fang Yuan had successfully broken through to rank five initial stage.

"In half a month, the second aperture's suppression will fade, while the first will fully assimilate in three months—just as the Imperial Court contest peaks..."

A Gu Master reported: "Lord Wolf King, we captured a wild shark fin wolf and caged it. The tribe leader asked me to inform you to tame it at the supply camp when you finish cultivating."

A shark fin wolf was a mutated beast matching a rank four Gu Master. Though Fang Yuan had bought mutated wolves in treasure yellow heaven, he hadn't brought them out without a plausible excuse.

After a while, Fang Yuan entered the supply camp.

"Tu Bo greets Lord Wolf King." A rank three Gu Master hurried over to welcome Fang Yuan.

Led by Tu Bo, Fang Yuan and the others soon reached the caged shark fin wolf.

Eyeing the beast with narrowed eyes, Fang Yuan smiled and asked casually, "How many were lost capturing this mutated wolf?"

Tu Bo answered promptly: "Four rank three and over two hundred rank two Gu Masters died. Without timely reinforcements from leaders Wang and Fang, it would have escaped."

Fang Yuan narrowed his eyes to slits: "It's covered in wounds, but some look preexisting?"

"Fortunate..." Fang Yuan muttered, his unease growing stronger.

Under the onlookers' expectant gazes, Fang Yuan produced a rank four wolf enslavement Gu.

"Take it and subdue the wolf." Unexpectedly, Fang Yuan handed the wolf enslavement Gu to Tu Bo instead of acting himself.

"Lord wants me to use it?" Tu Bo gasped. "I'm only rank three..."

"Cut the nonsense and use it," Fang Yuan snapped, thrusting the Gu into Tu Bo's hands.

Baffled by the Wolf King's eccentricities yet cowed by his prestige, Tu Bo reluctantly poured primeval essence into the wolf enslavement Gu.

The wolf enslavement Gu turned into shimmering light, settling onto the shark fin wolf.

A woman's regretful sigh suddenly echoed in everyone's ears.

Alarm bells blared in Fang Yuan's mind, and he retreated instantly without hesitation!

Almost simultaneously, Tu Bo screamed and collapsed dead on the spot!

"Soul explosion..." Fang Yuan blurted out as realization struck.

"Lord Wolf King has keen insight," a woman's voice whispered as shadows surged.

Overlapping sword-like shadows unfurled like a peacock's tail, sharply binding Fang Yuan.

Rank four — multiple sword shadow Gu!

Rank five — turtle jade wolf skin Gu!

"Wretch!" The remaining rank three Gu Master roared, rushing to Fang Yuan's aid.

At the same time, she spat out a thin snake.

Like a black thread, the snake bypassed the sword shadows and darted toward Fang Yuan's ear.

Cold and expressionless, Fang Yuan grabbed the rank three guard rushing to assist him.

Instantly, the rank three Gu Master groaned, convulsing with rolled-back eyes and foaming at the mouth!

The thread-like snake took this chance to slitter into Fang Yuan's ear.

Sensing the immense force in his punches, the woman chuckled, recalled her multiple sword shadow Gu, and dissolved into shadow, retreating twenty paces.

She was exquisite, dressed in black with a veil revealing only narrow phoenix eyes.

"Shadowless Sword Bian Si Xuan greets Lord Wolf King." Surrounded by enemies in hostile territory, she bowed calmly and at ease.

Fang Yuan snorted and questioned: "What Gu did you assault me with?"

Bian Si Xuan smiled: "I discovered a strange Gu in ancient ruins. When activated, it bores into the ear and enters the brain. If one's thoughts accelerate even slightly, it expands rapidly until the brain bursts. I call it brain explosion Gu."

Bowing again in sincere admiration, she said: "Senior perceived Lord Dong Fang's lethal trap and avoided the soul explosion's brunt—truly admirable. Taking your life will be my greatest honor. Farewell."

She then melted into a black shadow, flitting away through the camp's structures.

"What could happen to me? Incompetent trash, none of you noticed an infiltrator! Get lost!" Fang Yuan raged outward, though secretly pleased.

He never expected this assassination attempt to deliver a clue to Thieving Heaven Demon Venerable's inheritance!

In Fang Yuan's past-life memories, shadow sword expert Bian Si Xuan was a prominent figure.

She would become one of Ma Hong Yun's wives and a rank six Gu Immortal. Her 'brain explosion Gu' was precisely how Ma Hong Yun had obtained Thieving Heaven's inheritance.

He only knew how to properly activate this 'brain explosion Gu'.

# Chapter 505: Star Thought Gu

"We failed after all..." Dong Fang Yu Liang sighed, looking out at the rain with hands behind his back.

"His reputation matches his skill—worthy of the Wolf King." Hearing Bian Si Xuan's report, Dong Fang Yu Liang raised his appraisal of Fang Yuan.

"Alliance Leader Dong Fang needn't worry. Though Chang Shan Yin used a meat shield, I still hindered him within the soul explosion's blast radius. Moreover, he is infected by my brain explosion Gu; even if he survives, his strength is crippled. The Wolf King is effectively incapacitated."

"What if she failed, and Chang Shan Yin cures the brain explosion Gu? Choosing to block the soul explosion while letting the worm enter his ear suggests he has a countermeasure..."

Dong Fang Yu Liang's eyes narrowed: "Yet Wolf King was struck by the soul explosion... With new variables, I must recalculate."

Focusing inward, he channeled rank five primeval essence into his star thought Gu.

"If Wolf King manages to deal with brain explosion, how do I deal with him?"

Emitting blue starlight, this visible thought flew out from his head to hover above him.

Dong Fang Yu Liang quickly thought: "To deal with an enslavement path Gu Master, there are three ways."

"First is the supreme method: pitting enslavement master against enslavement master." A second starlight thought flew out, joining the first.

"Second is the domination method: decapitating the leader by charging through defenses to slay him." A third star thought emerged to circle the first.

"The third is the unconventional method: assassinating Chang Shan Yin, using bribes, or exploiting kinship against him." The fourth star thought flew out, intertwining and colliding with the others, yet the four thoughts remained unchanged.

Dong Fang Yu Liang factored in military forces, expert Gu Masters on both sides, weather forecasts, battlefield terrain, and potential third-party interventions.

In an instant, thousands of star thoughts formed, gushing from his brain.

After four hours, only eight of the myriad star thoughts remained.

He had successfully deduced several clear, structured methods with concrete steps to deal with the Wolf King.

Yet deep in his soul lingered an inescapable, heavy fatigue.

Wisdom path deductions consumed not only primeval essence to activate Gu, but also soul energy. The more numerous or grand the thoughts, the longer the deduction took and the heavier the soul's burden.

Rank four, refine essence spirit Gu!

Dong Fang Yu Liang immediately grew gaunt as refine essence spirit Gu converted his bodily vitality into soul nourishment.

Rubbing his belly, Dong Fang Yu Liang chuckled bitterly: "Refine essence spirit Gu, my tribe's secret inheritance, heals the soul well but fails to treat the root cause. Soul path and wisdom path are closely linked; if I could obtain the legendary guts Gu, I could deduce at will and easily heal any soul damage. What a pity guts Gu is only found on Dang Hun Mountain..."

# Chapter 506: Three Hearts Combination Soul

The Hei alliance army flowed like a current toward Cao Fu.

Manipulated by an enslavement path Gu Master, the giant rank four strength beast, the twin-headed steel rhino, exuded an imposing aura. Hei tribe's main tent stood high upon its back; seated at the center, Hei Lou Lan enjoyed an expansive field of vision.

"Hahaha, with my army's formation, there is no reason to fear that Dong Fang Yu Liang lad." He looked around with burning ambition, his laughter brimming with brutality and violence.

Only the person seated right beside the main seat rested with eyes closed, expressionless and detached from the chatter.

Hei Lou Lan filled his cup and toasted him: "Brother Shan Yin, let's drink!"

Fang Yuan opened his eyes, raised his cup, and shared a drink with Hei Lou Lan.

"Brother Shan Yin, still thinking about that assassination? Hahaha, that Shadow Sword Expert is indeed a beauty, and I've already sent men after her. That Dong Fang lad is shameless to attempt assassination, but we cannot show weakness! Once we win and capture her, she will be yours to handle!" Hei Lou Lan urged in a rough voice.

Soon, a sinister voice spoke: "This Lord Wolf King... I understand now why Chang tribe could not tolerate him."

"Oh, it is Cunning Gentleman Sun Shi Han." Hei Lou Lan glanced over and pointed at Fang Yuan's seat: "Come, since Chang Shan Yin has left, sit here."

Rising, Sun Shi Han bowed to Hei Lou Lan: "Thank you, Alliance Leader, but reward requires merit. I have pondered this battle for seven days and seven nights and have twenty-three suggestions to offer."

Sun Shi Han chuckled: "Alliance Leader, I just conceived a new strategy: feigning weakness to the enemy. Dong Fang Yu Liang tried to assassinate Chang Shan Yin with soul explosion Gu, but failed. He will surely devise further countermeasures against Lord Wolf King. Why not order the Wolf King to hold back? Once we dismantle Dong Fang Yu Liang's countermeasures in battle, we can deploy the Wolf King to finish them off. What do you think, Alliance Leader?"

Hei Lou Lan's eyes glinted. After a moment's thought, he said solemnly: "Sun Shi Han's plan is decent. We shall see."

"E Xuan Ming, Jiang Wan Shang, and Wei Xin pays respect to Dong Fang alliance leader."

Though the Dong Fang alliance lacked an enslavement master like Fang Yuan, it had numerous tribal enslavement Gu Masters, with these three being the most outstanding.

Dong Fang Yu Liang nodded slightly to them and got straight to the point: "I called you three here today to discuss how to deal with Wolf King Chang Shan Yin."

Knowing fear was useless, the three replied in unison: "We await Alliance Leader Dong Fang's instructions."

"Alliance Leader knows my background. I wasn't originally an enslavement path master, but switched after finding Blood Sea Ancestor's minor inheritance and obtaining a group of bladewing blood bats. Over the years, I've gathered relevant enslavement path Gu, but progress has been slow," Jiang Wan Shan sighed.

Dong Fang Yu Liang's expression turned solemn: "Do you know of my tribe's three-person combination killer move, three hearts combination soul?"

Their pupils contracted. Who had not heard of Dong Fang tribe's renowned triple combination killer move?

# Chapter 507: Surprising Thieving Heaven Inheritance

Red, green, and black intertwined violently in midair.

Flickering light reflected in Fang Yuan's eyes as he focused intently on the semi-finished product before him, striving to stabilize it.

The three colors vanished, and the semi-finished product burst into traces of blue blood, splattering the surrounding walls.

"Failed again..." Fang Yuan sighed lightly.

Lately, he had been refining nauseous crying baby Gu, specifically to counter three hearts combination soul.

Only several hundred li apart, both camps bristled with tribal banners, enveloped in the heavy tension of imminent battle.

Fang Yuan had purchased the rank five space thought Gu from treasure yellow heaven through Hu Immortal blessed land.

Under the Gu's effect, translucent, bubble-like thoughts drifted toward the brain explosion Gu within his skull.

The brain explosion Gu was only rank four, subdued back then by Spring Autumn Cicada's aura.

Having absorbed his brain matter while being corroded by space thought Gu, the brain explosion Gu finally underwent a qualitative change.

The brain explosion Gu instantly dispersed into black light, white smoke, and a fist-sized space thought.

"The reverse refinement succeeded." Fang Yuan exhaled in relief, filled with joy.

Fang Yuan absorbed the space thought into his mind and read its contents.

Soon, his body shuddered and his eyes widened, an unconcealable joy washing over his face.

"This Thieving Heaven Demon Venerable inheritance leads to Luo Po Valley?!"

# Chapter 508: Challenging Wolf King

The progenitor of soul path, the legendary rank nine Spectral Soul Demon Venerable, once said:

"In this vast world, the best place to strengthen the soul is Dang Hun Mountain, and to refine the soul, Luo Po Valley. With both mountain and valley, one can achieve grand success in soul path and sweep away all obstacles!"

Thus, Dang Hun Mountain and Luo Po Valley became known as soul cultivation's sacred lands.

With Dang Hun Mountain, Fang Yuan had raised his soul foundation at meteoric speed. But beyond strengthening, soul cultivation also required tempering and purification.

Yet even without rank five wolf soul Gu, another method remained.

He could use second watch Gu or third watch Gu to accelerate his body's time flow, or enter a blessed land to hasten his cultivation.

Others could use these methods, but Fang Yuan could not.

His first vital Gu, Spring Autumn Cicada, was steadily recovering. Until he became a Gu Immortal, it hung over his neck like an executioner's blade.

"My thousand-man soul came from Dang Hun Mountain. Luo Po Valley is on par with it; if I could obtain it..."

"The space thought indicates Luo Po Valley is far away. Saving Dang Hun Mountain takes priority, and with battle looming, I cannot abandon my current strength and enslavement foundations."

In Hu Immortal blessed land, Dang Hun Mountain continued shrinking daily. Little Hu Immortal cleared away massive amounts of Gruel Mud each day to prolong the mountain's vitality as long as possible.

After three more days of standoff, Dong Fang Yu Liang penned a challenge and sent it to Hei Lou Lan.

Surprised, Hei Lou Lan asked his subordinates: "Has Dong Fang tribe's rear army already arrived?"

Cunning Gentleman Sun Shi Han answered: "Their rear army is still five thousand li away, building the fifth defensive line."

"He wants battle, but I won't oblige. When will our rear army arrive?" Hei Lou Lan asked.

"Approximated three days." Wang tribe leader answered from the side.

"Good! I shall write back and postpone the battle to four days later!" Hei Lou Lan laughed heartily.

Dong Fang Yu Liang received and skimmed the letter.

As the crowd clamored for war, Dong Fang Yu Liang smiled calmly: "Do not be impatient. This reply was expected. After extensive deductions, I have a plan. Listen closely..."

Four days were gone in an instant.

The hill-sized twin-headed rhino carried the main tent, bearing Hei Lou Lan, Fang Yuan, Hao Ji Liu, and the leaders of Wang, Fang, and Ye tribes alongside other experts.

Winds whipped the banners wildly. From his seat, Fang Yuan gazed at Dong Fang tribe's disciplined formation, their main tent floating aloft upon a white cloud.

Hei Lou Lan's booming laughter rang out: "Hahaha, this battle marks our Hei tribe's first step toward claiming the Imperial Court and ruling the northern plains! Who will step forward for the opening challenge?"

Instantly, several Gu Masters rose, clamoring and volunteering to be sent into battle.

Hei Lou Lan's gaze swept over the crowd and settled on one man: "Pan Ping, you go."

Pan Ping was tall and muscular with reddish-yellow hair, wearing a gold-edged, silver-hilted scimitar at his waist. He laughed heartily, but before he could accept, a shout rang from the enemy: "Junior Tang Miao Ming has long revered the grand Wolf King's fame and comes seeking guidance!"

All eyes turned to Fang Yuan, awaiting the Wolf King's response.

---

# Chapter 509: A wave of his hand

Leisurely sipping his wine, Fang Yuan set his cup down and looked at Hei Lou Lan: "Alliance Leader, should I accept the challenge?"

Hei Lou Lan laughed heartily, pleased that Fang Yuan consulted him: "Let them witness Brother Shan Yin's might and tremble!"

Fang Yuan rose slowly, amplifying his voice with Gu: "Little girl, your bravery is commendable, but you are no match for me. Besides... it is getting late."

At the front of the formation, Tang Miao Ming clenched her sweat-soaked hands, shuddering as her mind raced: 'The Wolf King replied! Arrogant, just as Alliance Leader Dong Fang predicted. Now I must follow the plan, goading him to duel using only a hundred-beast wolf pack against my fox group. But... what did he mean by his last sentence?'

Dong Fang Yu Liang was excited but doubtful: "It is getting late? What is he talking about?"

The order rippled down. The massive army began to advance, hundreds of thousands following the wolves to charge the enemy.

Tang Miao Ming commanded her fox group, shifting formations repeatedly to protect herself.

The Hei tribe army accelerated under the wolves' cover, unleashing earth-shattering momentum and violent power.

In her momentary panic, Tang Miao Ming's circular fox formation instantly collapsed.

The twin-headed rhino thundered forward; gazing down from atop it, Hei Lou Lan felt a slight jolt at Tang Miao Ming's beauty.

"Who will capture this woman for me?" Pan Ping immediately shot forward.

Leaping forward with agility, Pan Ping rapidly closed in and swiftly captured Tang Miao Ming.

Hei Lou Lan nodded in satisfaction and turned his gaze forward.

"Dong Fang lad..." He smiled malevolently, eyes burning with vengeance.

Soon, the two armies clashed fully, plunging into a massive chaotic melee.

With Fang Yuan's single move, this newly begun battle had entered its climax.

---

# Chapter 510: Great Battle

Across the chaotic battlefield, experts clashed in fierce combat. As time passed, other rank four Gu Master experts found their opponents as well.

Fang Yuan took this chance to assemble his wolf group.

The two armies faced off against each other, creating a deadlock.

Breaking this deadlock would grant initiative, accumulating into an advantage that would ultimately seal victory.

Thus, their gaze landed on their elite troop.

Hei Lou Lan's side possessed five elite divisions, while Dong Fang Yu Liang had six.

Dong Fang Yu Liang first deployed hundred blossoms elite troop.

Watching from the main tent, Hei Lou Lan snorted and ordered the blue butterfly elite troop to attack the hundred blossoms troop.

Dong Fang Yu Liang had anticipated this, ambushing them with three elite troops.

Unwilling to see the blue butterfly elite troop destroyed, Hei Lou Lan immediately dispatched reinforcements.

Elite troops from both sides converged into several rings of encirclement, deadlocking the battle once more.

"Lord leader, let me crush them!" Unable to restrain himself, Dong Fang She requested to join the battle.

Dong Fang Yu Liang slowly shook his head, refusing permission.

Dong Fang Yu Liang placated him: "Be patient, Elder She. Everything remains within my expectations."

Smiling calmly, he turned to the three enslavement path Gu Masters: "It is time to show your strength."

These three were E Xuan Ming, Wei Xin, and Jiang Wan Shan.

---

# Chapter 511: Dark Vortex and Cloud Whirlpool

At Dong Fang Yu Liang's words, E Xuan Ming, Jiang Wan Shan, and Wan Xin exchanged glances, nodded, and activated their Gu.

Killer move — Three Hearts Combination Soul!

*BOOM...*

A silent explosion burst out as their three souls flew from their bodies, merging into a single entity midair.

Within a two-hundred-li radius, all Gu Masters with at least a five-hundred-man soul felt heavy pressure weighing down upon their souls.

"This pressure... it is already at the level of a one-thousand-four-hundred-man soul! As expected of three hearts combination soul!" Fang Yuan reacted instantly, looking toward Dong Fang tribe's main tent.

Having only a nine-hundred-man soul after past injuries, Fang Yuan could not match their one-thousand-four-hundred-man soul.

Fang Yuan inwardly sighed while mobilizing the wolf group.

Countless night, water, wind, and turtleback wolves formed an enormous force, charging the enemy like a raging river.

"Wolf King, let us experience your brilliance today!" Wan Xin, E Xuan Ming, and Jiang Wan Shan spoke in unison, their movements perfectly synchronized through their merged souls.

Under their command, swarms of various crabs gathered into a firm defensive line within breaths.

The wolf group fiercely smashed into this defensive line, like a flood striking the dam.

Standing atop the twin-headed rhino, Fang Yuan controlled the wolf pack into rolling waves of offense, quickly pushing the crab defensive line to the brink of collapse.

"The nine layered wave charge! Reinforce me, my crab group cannot hold much longer!" Wan Xin's thought immediately transmitted to the other two.

"No need to worry, my crocodiles are coming." E Xuan Ming remained composed, battle intent blazing in his focused eyes.

Swarms of various crocodiles rushed to the frontline under his control.

With these reinforcements, the crumbling defensive line stabilized, becoming virtually impregnable.

"Both crabs and crocodiles excel at defense. Merged under three hearts combination soul, their beast-controlling attainment has reached master level."

Suddenly, he halted the fierce assault and prudently slowed his offense.

Rather than devoting all his focus to the beasts, he reserved half his attention to observe the battlefield.

His true threat was not these three, but another potential assassination attempt by Shadow Sword Expert Bian Si Xuan.

Right then, a large swarm of blood-colored bats appeared above the wolf group.

These four-winged bats possessed blade-sharp wings, quickly inflicting heavy casualties among the wolves.

"Jiang Wan Shan's bladewing blood bats." Fang Yuan's eyes flashed, not the least bit surprised.

The bladewing blood bats' fierce assault instantly shifted the momentum of this front.

"Brother Shan Yin." Pressured by the mixed beast group's fierce charge, Hei Lou Lan's expression darkened.

Fang Yuan said in a low voice: "They have bladewing blood bats with sharp offensive power, while my wolves lack aerial attacks. More importantly, their three hearts combination soul grants them a thousand-man soul to lead this mixed group as one. Break that killer move, and the mixed group will disperse without a fight."

Hei Lou Lan frowned deeply, a ruthless glint flashing in his eyes as he made his decision.

"Brother Shan Yin, concentrate on the battle, I will resolve this quickly!"

Extending his arm, rank five aura erupted as primeval essence poured into four Gu.

"Dong Fang tribe has three hearts combination soul, but my Hei tribe has dark vortex!" Hei Lou Lan smiled sinisterly, killing intent raging in his heart.

As dark streams poured into it, the speck of light swelled into a fist-sized dark sphere.

"Dong Fang lad! Take this!!" Hei Lou Lan roared and vanished from his spot.

The next moment, he appeared above the enemy main tent.

"Die!" Laughing crazily, Hei Lou Lan flipped his wrist and pushed the dark sphere toward Dong Fang Yu Liang with immense effort, as if bearing a thousand jun.

Following his movement, the dark sphere expanded madly, swelling to the size of a small hill within breaths.

"Damn it, it is Hei tribe's killer move dark vortex!"

Gu Masters cried out in terror, while the three enslavement masters looked on in despair, unable to disengage quickly.

The corners of Dong Fang Yu Liang's lips, however, curled up.

Watching the dark sphere loom larger, Dong Fang Yu Liang remained calm: "Just as expected, Hei Lou Lan. I have waited long for your move."

He lifted his right foot and lightly tapped the white cloud beneath him.

The tranquil cloud roiled like boiling water, erupting into an enormous mist whirlpool in the blink of an eye.

The whirlpool rose like a giant maw and swallowed the dark sphere.

"This is?!" Hei Lou Lan was shocked and furious, realizing he had fallen into Dong Fang Yu Liang's trap.

"This is cloud whirlpool, a killer move I spent three years devising specifically against your dark vortex. You lose, Hei Lou Lan, just like years ago," Dong Fang Yu Liang proclaimed.

"Damn it..." Sweating profusely, Hei Lou Lan gritted his teeth and tried to pull back, but the cloud whirlpool held his dark vortex fast.

Dong Fang Yu Liang's smile broadened as he called: "Dong Po Kong, Bian Si Xuan."

At his command, Shadow Sword Expert emerged from hiding, gliding through ground shadows to appear before the twin-headed rhino in the blink of an eye.

Simultaneously, a flash of lightning streaked across the battlefield, arriving directly before the twin-headed rhino.

The lightning dispersed into a valiant man who pounced toward Fang Yuan.

Flying Lightning Dong Po Kong, Shadow Sword Expert Bian Si Xuan!

In an instant, both Hei Lou Lan and Fang Yuan had fallen into danger!

---

# Chapter 512: Reliable Alliance Mate

Seizing this chance, Shadow Sword Expert Bian Si Xuan charged the main tent to assassinate Fang Yuan once again.

Dong Po Kuang, known as 'Flying Lightning', was one of Northern Plains' few flying masters—a rank four upper stage lightning path expert. He had held back during the earlier chaos, waiting until now to strike!

Pincer-attacked from above and below, Fang Yuan paled, retreating in frantic panic as he yelled: "Quick, someone protect me!"

"Wolf King, do not worry, Hei Xiu Yi will guard you." Clad in black with an unshaken expression, he stepped forward to shield Fang Yuan.

"Courting death!" Dong Po Kuang roared, condensing his crackling lightning into a spear and thrusting it at Hei Xiu Yi.

Bian Si Xuan snorted and flicked her wrist, unleashing a torrent of shadow swords.

Unfazed by the two experts' combined assault, Hei Xiu Yi pressed his palms together and channeled primeval essence.

Dong Po Kuang's lightning spear pierced through seven flying shields and the dark-brown oil wind, but stopped against the black armor.

Bian Si Xuan's shadow swords shattered eighteen shields before sinking into the oil wind like a swamp, their momentum drained completely.

Hei Xiu Yi's expression turned heavier.

His primeval essence was rapidly depleting from the intense battle, nearly bottoming out, while the two enemies consumed theirs at half his rate.

He gradually reduced his defense, no longer actively meeting their attacks. Dong Po Kuang and Bian Si Xuan immediately sensed the shift, launching several risky strikes and nearing success.

"If Lord Hei Lou Lan were behind me, I would risk my life to protect him. But Chang Shan Yin is just an arrogant outsider who looks down on me—why should I die for him? Even if Wolf King dies, we still have the black banner army and can match the enemy. I must save myself to continue serving the tribe."

"Now is the time, overlapping shadow Gu!" Spotting a gap in the defense, Bian Si Xuan seized the chance with sharp eyes, activating the Gu Dong Fang Yu Liang had lent her.

Under overlapping shadow Gu, Bian Si Xuan's numerous shadow swords overlaid one another until only a single blade remained.

Bian Si Xuan thrust the sword forward, slicing through Hei Xiu Yi's defense like a knife through tofu toward Wolf King.

Hei Xiu Yi had already resolved to flee. With Shadow Sword Expert charging toward Chang Shan Yin, he seized the opportunity to retreat, quickly leaping off the twin-headed rhino's back.

Looking back, he saw Bian Si Xuan's shadow sword had already pierced Chang Shan Yin's chest.

"Wolf King, remember, the one who killed you is Shadow Sword Expert Bian Si Xuan!" Her eyes reddened with excitement.

"Wolf King is dead, giving my army the upper hand and victory within grasp." Observing from afar with a detective Gu, Dong Fang Yu Liang excitedly clenched his fists.

Looking up, he smiled calmly at Hei Lou Lan, who was battling the cloud whirlpool: "Hei Lou Lan, Chang Shan Yin has been beheaded. Surrender, and I will make you a general with a chance to enter the Imperial Court."

To his surprise, Hei Lou Lan did not rage, but instead smiled malevolently: "Dong Fang Yu Liang, look carefully with your dog eyes!"

At that moment, shocked cries arose from Bian Si Xuan and Dong Po Kuang atop the twin-headed rhino.

'Chang Shan Yin' had collapsed into a puddle of water. Several Gu flew out, leaving only a water image Gu nearly sliced in two by the shadow sword, held together by mere skin.

Before the battle, Fang Yuan had planned this with Hei Lou Lan, keeping the arrangement secret between just the three of them.

Fang Yuan's true body was hidden elsewhere on the battlefield, commanding the wolves via wolf care Gu while staging illusions in the tent with Gu worms.

# Chapter 513: Seven Star Light

Searching in vain, Bian Si Xuan and Dong Po Kong's expressions darkened considerably.

Quickly accepting the failure, Dong Fang Yu Liang smiled brightly: "Interesting, but still within my expectations. As long as Wolf King commands his wolves, his soul fluctuations will expose his position sooner or later. Hei Lou Lan, your defeat is merely delayed."

"Hahaha!" Hei Lou Lan threw his head back in disdainful laughter. "Dong Fang child, you really think you restrained me?"

With that, his skin turned night-black while endless dark smoke poured from his pores.

The next instant, Hei Lou Lan dissolved into black smoke and entered the dark vortex.

The hill-sized dark sphere, which was being slowly swallowed by the cloud whirlpool, suddenly contracted rapidly.

The cloud whirlpool held for merely three breaths before bursting under the dark vortex, which expanded and swallowed humans and beasts like a prehistoric monster.

When the dark vortex vanished, ten *li* of the battlefield was cleared, leaving only Hei Lou Lan in midair and Dong Fang Yu Liang in a deep crater.

Exhausted and gasping for breath, Hei Lou Lan looked down at Dong Fang Yu Liang, his body soaked in dark red blood.

"Hahaha, Dong Fang Yu Liang, if you can devise a cloud whirlpool killer move to counter dark vortex, I can improve mine as well! How does my meticulously prepared banquet taste? This is a trump card I concealed even from my own kin."

Laughing wildly, Hei Lou Lan suddenly coughed up several mouthfuls of dark blood.

In a single move, Hei Lou Lan escaped the trap, pressured Dong Fang Yu Liang, and killed Wei Xin, Jiang Wan Shan, and E Xuan Ming in their three hearts combination soul state.

With those three dead and unguided, the mixed beast group turned on each other and crumbled, just as Fang Yuan had predicted.

Dong Fang Yu Liang rose slowly, looking solemn.

"Dong Fang Yu Liang, it is not too late to admit defeat. If you surrender, I will let bygones be bygones and appoint you as my chief military advisor." Hei Lou Lan demanded his surrender before everyone.

"Hei Lou Lan, you are too optimistic. Even with the upper hand, you are far from victory. Come, let us fight. Seven Star Light!"

Empowered by the varied effects of these seven lights—his signature killer move—Dong Fang Yu Liang activated star thought Gu.

Countless thoughts gushed out bright as starlight, their radiance impossible for even sunlight to obscure.

Extremely fast, star thoughts directly assaulted the enemy's mind from every angle, making them difficult to defend against.

"So many star thoughts—Dong Fang Yu Liang truly intends to risk his life! Creating so many star thoughts recklessly goes far beyond injuring soul or body; regardless of the outcome, he will lose at least two years of lifespan. My current state is poor; I should evade for now."

He disappeared from the spot, appearing thousand steps away.

The massive cloud of star thoughts pursued Hei Lou Lan, devastating everything in its path.

Now, Hei Lou Lan fled like a rabbit while Chang Shan Yin hid, suppressing his soul and using only a fraction to command the wolves. Flushing him out amid this chaotic battlefield was nearly impossible.

"Then I shall destroy your elite troops and see how long you can endure!" A cold glint in his eyes, Dong Fang Yu Liang redirected the star cloud toward the elite troops' battle rings.

Despite their numerical advantage, Hei tribe's blue butterfly elite troop was no match for Dong Fang Yu Liang, collapsing under the star cloud with severe casualties.

Despite the boost from seven star lights, Dong Fang Yu Liang felt intensely weak as white strands surfaced in his bluish-black hair.

"Kill then, let us see how long you can maintain this killer move." Hidden in a corner, Fang Yuan watched through wolf care Gu with a cold smile.

To him, more casualties simply meant more souls to collect after the battle.

# Chapter 514: Wolf King’s ruthlessness

Attacking with full strength to slaughter three elite troops in succession, Dong Fang Yu Liang seized the upper hand for Dong Fang tribe.

Yet Dong Fang Yu Liang, the architect of this momentum, remained uneasy.

"Though victory seems close, we have revealed our trump cards. Seven star lights cannot last long, and if I cannot flush out Hei Lou Lan and Chang Shan Yin, then..."

His sharp gaze shifted to Hei tribe's mid-army, where the formidable black banner elite troop was stationed. Far surpassing the others, this elite force had held its position without moving.

There, Ge Guang and the blood-soaked Ge tribe Gu Masters fought valiantly.

Dong Fang Yu Liang expressionlessly split the star cloud, sending one half toward the black banner elite troop and the other toward Ge tribe.

Battle thought Gu, like star thought and space thought Gu, was a wisdom path Gu worm. The black banner commanders coordinated to activate rank three and four Gu.

As the star cloud pounced, red thoughts emerged over the black banner elite troop.

Though few in number, these battle thoughts shielded the black banner elite troop, allowing them to withstand the star cloud's impact.

"Hei tribe is truly worthy of a super tribe; their elite troops far surpass those of other tribes," Fang Yuan praised inwardly at the sight.

On the Ge tribe's side, miserable screams rang out as the majestic star thoughts slaughtered them.

Fang Yuan watched indifferently, his proficient use of wolf care Gu letting him view Ge tribe's plight clearly.

Ge tribe was merely a pawn to disguise his identity—why would the chess player risk himself for a chess piece?

"Still not coming out?..." Dong Fang Yu Liang waited patiently, scanning with detection Gu to pinpoint Fang Yuan's location via soul fluctuations if he moved to save Ge tribe.

Wolf King's cold, heartless detachment sent a chill down Dong Fang Yu Liang's spine.

Conversely, seeing his black banner elite troop on the verge of collapsing, Hei Lou Lan quickly moved to intervene.

"Dong Fang Yu Liang, die!" he roared with immense vigor, appearing fully recovered from the backlash.

Snorting, Dong Fang Yu Liang summoned a fresh wave of star thoughts above his head to attack Hei Lou Lan.

The two clashed in midair, exchanging numerous moves with neither side gaining the upper hand.

Deprived of support by Hei Lou Lan's interference, the star cloud harassing the black banner elite troop soon dissipated after wreaking havoc.

Meanwhile, inside Ni Yu blessed land, two Gu Immortals sipped tea while observing a smoke image on their table.

The female Gu Immortal Tan Bi Ya smiled at Dong Fang Chang Fan: "It seems this clash between Dong Fang Yu Liang and Hei Lou Lan will decide the battle. Whichever side wins will gain the upper hand. Young Dong Fang Yu Liang is quite impressive, forcing a stalemate despite having weaker forces than Hei tribe—Brother Chang Fan's guidance was truly effective."

Dong Fang Chang Fan had an ancient, noble bearing, his eyes flashing with multicolored light. The sole wisdom path Gu Immortal of Dong Fang tribe shook his head indifferently:

"I actually only said two or three sentences to Dong Fang Yu Liang. But the lad is talented and hardworking—he boldly proclaimed this to rise using my prestige. I promised that if he becomes Lord of the Imperial Court, I will heal his sister and groom him as my successor."

"Lord of the Imperial Court?" Tan Bi Ya was taken aback, then smiled. "Forgive my bluntness, but Dong Fang tribe's chances in this contest are slim. Among this year's top contenders, Ye Lui Sang is widely favored, especially since Supreme Elder Ye Lui Lai secretly entrusted him with an Immortal Gu. This is already an open secret in the circle."

Tan Bi Ya's eyes flashed with interest: "What is it? Did Brother Chang Fan also give Dong Fang Yu Liang an Immortal Gu, or arrange something to ensure he becomes Lord of the Imperial Court?"

Dong Fang Chang Fan dismissed her theory: "No. Ma tribe has immense momentum in this contest, already with one foot on the throne. Why would I waste effort on pointless work?"

Dong Fang Chang Fan was already old, with little time left.

Merely owning wisdom path Gu did not make one a true master. Dong Fang Chang Fan was pleased—and slightly wary—of Dong Fang Yu Liang's talent, and even more pleased by the young man's sickly, non-cultivating younger sister.

This was Dong Fang Yu Liang's weakness; by grasping this leverage, he had no need to worry about Yu Liang's loyalty.

Tan Bi Ya was surprised: "Brother Chang Fan, you favor Ma tribe? Though a large tribe with formidable military strength, they lack a Gu Immortal supreme elder."

Anticipating this, Dong Fang Chang Fan replied leisurely: "Sister Bi Ya, Snowy Mountain blessed land has already secretly allied to support Ma tribe."

"Snowy Mountain blessed land, those demonic path Gu Immortals?" Tan Bi Ya's expression darkened at the shocking revelation.

She stared at Dong Fang Chang Fan: "Brother Chang Fan, how do you know this?"

Dong Fang Chang Fan smiled proudly: "I deduced it myself; you are the first to know."

As Liu tribe's external supreme elder, she secretly backed Liu Wen Wu; his taking the Imperial Court throne would greatly elevate her status in the tribe.

Ma tribe severely threatened her plans. Standing up, she said: "Brother Chang Fan, this is of grave importance. Demonic path Gu Immortals are jackals and wolves, and the others are in the dark. Forgive me, but I must take my leave to inform them."

"Go on." Dong Fang Chang Fan nodded slowly, opening the blessed land's entrance.

Once Tan Bi Ya departed the blessed land, Dong Fang Chang Fan's tranquil, well-like face revealed a faint smile.

After prolonged fighting, Dong Fang Yu Liang could no longer hold out and began to pull back. With their chief commander retreating, army morale plunged and the troops followed his order to withdraw.

Though rattled, the army retreated in an orderly fashion, showing rigorous training.

Right then, the wolf group howled and regrouped into a wolf tide, launching a death charge toward the Dong Fang army.

"Damn it!" Dong Fang Yu Liang's heart tore as he watched. Under the wolf group's charge, the Dong Fang alliance army suffered heavy casualties, and panic spread as their lines began to crumble.

Fang Yuan utilized eighty percent of his master-level enslavement attainment. Onlookers were dazzled as relentless waves of assault broke the Dong Fang army apart like mud washed by a flood.

The strong soul fluctuations revealed Fang Yuan's position.

Yet Fang Yuan stood openly atop the calm twin-headed rhino, surrounded by Gu Master experts.

"Wolf King Chang Shan Yin..." Dong Fang Yu Liang gnashed his teeth, his eyes seemingly breathing fire.

Fang Yuan's second strike hit the Dong Fang army at its weakest, kicking them while they were down. Having risked their lives for so long, the Gu Masters had almost no primeval essence left. Though they still fought, they were perishing alongside the wolves.

Fang Yuan's wolf group suffered severe losses too, but he still profited greatly. Northern Plains had plenty of wolves to replenish his ranks, while the enemy sacrificed precious Gu Masters!

# Chapter 515: Dong Fang Yu Liang’s backup plan

Suffering huge losses in a short time, the Dong Fang army abandoned heaps of corpses as they retreated.

Dong Fang Yu Liang made a move again, but was pinned down by Hei Lou Lan.

Seeing his allies pursuing the enemy and mounting a cruel massacre, Fang Yuan stopped and summoned the wolf group to his side.

This move immediately won the favor of the black banner elite troop's commander beside him.

Fang Yuan knew the commander was expressing goodwill. Hei Xiu Yi had been appointed as his bodyguard but deserted him in danger; without water image Gu, Fang Yuan would have died.

At disastrous cost, the Dong Fang army finally fled to their first defense line.

Hei tribe's Gu Masters charged three times but were repelled by the feather arrow elite troop. Hei Lou Lan sent rank four Gu Masters forward, but Dong Fang Yu Liang's traps ensnared them, costing three experts.

"Lord alliance leader, the enemy holds the geographical advantage. Our side has fought hard and lacks sufficient primeval essence to continue; it would be better to retreat for now and make new plans."

Fang Yuan frowned; his past-life memories reminded him that Dong Fang Yu Liang excelled at turning chaotic situations around and defeating stronger foes. The longer they delayed, the more intel he would gather, putting Hei tribe at a growing disadvantage.

Hei Lou Lan silently weighed Sun Shi Han's suggestion. Having clashed with Dong Fang Yu Liang before, he knew his methods well. Reluctant to let this chance slip, his gaze shifted toward Fang Yuan.

Fang Yuan smiled proudly and said to Hei Lou Lan, "Hei tribe leader does not need to worry, I guarantee I will break this defense line in just a quarter of an hour."

The wolf group gathered once more, launching a relentless charge at Dong Fang tribe's first line of defense.

This intense battle cost the pack dearly; two hundred and eighty thousand wolves died in a short period!

"Wolf King Chang Shan Yin, such a ruthless heart you have, do you intend to spare no one?!" Dong Fang Yu Liang's expression was grim. The wolf pack's heavy casualties had drastically consumed the Dong Fang army's primeval essence.

"Retreat!" Helplessly, Dong Fang Yu Liang could only send down the command to retreat.

Just as Fang Yuan proclaimed, Dong Fang tribe's first line of defense fell in a quarter of an hour. Leaving crippled Gu Masters to cover their retreat, Dong Fang Yu Liang swiftly led the survivors toward the second defense line.

"My wolf group is exhausted and unfit to pursue them." Fang Yuan withdrew his wolves, clearing the way for the Hei tribe army to advance.

"I sustained some injuries in battle; you guys pursue and kill them all. But be careful, that Dong Fang lad definitely made preparations." Staying in the main tent, Hei Lou Lan dispatched Hao Ji Liu, Pan Ping, the Wang tribe leader, and others to pursue.

Yet the moment the troops crossed the defense line, an intense explosion suddenly erupted.

*BOOM!* Like a crack of thunder, dozens of Gu Masters were instantly fried, leaving behind scorched flesh and broken limbs.

"It is charred thunder potato Gu! Dong Fang Yu Liang buried large numbers of them under the defense line!" the investigative Gu Masters reported in the main tent.

"I can see that!" With an exceedingly dark expression, Hei Lou Lan waved his hand for the scouts to leave.

Before the battle, Dong Fang Yu Liang had deliberately sent a war challenge. Listening to Sun Shi Han, Hei Lou Lan delayed for several days until his rear army assembled, giving Dong Fang Yu Liang the opportunity to execute this plan.

"We gained a massive victory today; that Dong Fang lad is merely delaying his death. I will enjoy killing him later!" Pacifying himself, Hei Lou Lan began managing postwar affairs.

Unwilling to waste precious time, Fang Yuan casually excused himself from the main tent and returned to his large lizard house Gu to cultivate.

"The Wolf King wasn't injured in the blast...?" Listening to the investigative Gu Master's report, Dong Fang Yu Liang felt deeply regretful.

After this battle, he regarded Fang Yuan as his primary threat, rating him even above Hei Lou Lan.

Watching the battle conclude from Ni Yu blessed land, Dong Fang Chang Fan withdrew his gaze and gathered the table's smoke into his sleeves.

Even without deducing, he could see Dong Fang Yu Liang was at an absolute disadvantage; unless Hei Lou Lan made a major blunder, Dong Fang Yu Liang's hopes of reaching the Imperial Court were slim.

# Chapter 516: Battle Merit Board

The red cloud surged overhead, radiating burning heat toward Fang Yuan.

Sitting cross-legged on a mat with eyes closed, Fang Yuan mentally held the fire cloud together.

"It is time." Calculating the moment, he opened his eyes and took out a wine vat.

The wine vat was filled with dark blue liquid that shimmered like moonlight on the sea.

"Descend," Fang Yuan spoke softly, and the fire cloud descended completely into the wine vat.

The merging of fire and water instantly produced thick black smoke.

Fang Yuan repeatedly flicked his finger, throwing Gu worm after Gu worm into the wine vat. The wine vat kept on shaking for two-three minutes before finally calming down.

Gazing into the vat, Fang Yuan saw only black mud; the Gu worms had fully merged into a semi-finished product hidden at its center.

"Rise." Fang Yuan cautiously poured his primeval essence.

The surface of the black mud split open as a glossy green sprout emerged, rapidly growing into a small sapling.

"Open," Fang Yuan shouted softly, pouring large amounts of primeval essence into the tree.

The green fist slowly opened, revealing a Gu worm in its palm.

This Gu possessed an oval dark brown carapace and a majestic horn on its head, giving it a thick, powerful appearance.

A trace of joy flashed in Fang Yuan's eyes.

This was the all-out effort Gu; after three failed attempts, he had finally succeeded on his fourth try.

Rank four all-out effort Gu had four pairs of legs and was larger in size, over two times bigger than its rank three counterpart. And because it was refined in Northern Plains, it became a Northern Plains Gu and did not suffer from suppression, thus letting out a genuine rank four aura.

"With this rank four Gu, most of my strength path battle strength is restored. I must now prepare its rank five recipe. With access to treasure yellow heaven and Lang Ya blessed land, obtaining the rank five recipe of all-out effort Gu is well within reach."

Storing the Gu into his aperture, Fang Yuan stepped out of the lizard house Gu.

Countless Gu Masters bustled between tents, exchanging Gu worms at supply camps or constructing defenses.

Eight days had passed since the great battle with Dong Fang alliance army.

"Subordinate greets Lord Wolf King, please come this way." When Fang Yuan arrived at the supply camp, a smiling female Gu Master led him into a Gu house.

"Lord Wolf King is mighty, you rank first on the battle merit list!" The young, beautiful female Gu Master handed Fang Yuan a scroll with reverent worship.

Unrolling the scroll, Fang Yuan saw Chang Shan Yin at the top with over a hundred thousand battle merits.

Opening the scroll further, Hei Lou Lan was listed beneath him with over eighty thousand battle merits.

Fang Yuan set the scroll aside. Observing his reaction, the female Gu Master handed him a Gu worm.

This was rank four east window Gu, an information path Gu, used to store information.

East window Gu glimmered, pouring an enormous amount of information into Fang Yuan's mind.

The inventory held vast goods: Gu worms of every path, beasts, vegetation, primeval stones, variant humans, and Gu recipes.

Though Fang Yuan could connect to treasure yellow heaven, trades there required immortal essence stones—unsuitable for his current needs.

Moreover, purchasing Northern Plains Gu worms in treasure yellow heaven risked exposing clues to Old Man Yan Shi.

"Among my strength path Gu worms, all-out effort Gu has been raised to rank four and adapted to Northern Plains. Yet the rest of my strength path Gu are from Southern Border and suppressed in Northern Plains."

"To remove the regional suppression, I must advance them in Northern Plains, but that requires too much investment."

# Chapter 517: Lurking Soul Coat Gu

Advancing bitter strength Gu, expend strength Gu, and charging crash Gu to rank five was a massive project requiring immense materials and Gu worms.

"My enslavement path Gu originated from Chang Shan Yin; almost all are rank four, making advancement to rank five in a short time extremely difficult. I need to focus on gathering recipes just in case."

"As for my strength path Gu, those originate from Southern Border; rather than refining them, it might be better to make direct purchases. After all, these Gu are not my vital Gu, so if the refinement fails, they will perish. And if I want to refine again, I will have to accumulate them again."

Though only one rank five Gu was listed, rank four Gu were plentiful, including bitter strength Gu, tusita flower, and primeval elder Gu.

Fang Yuan opted for the next best choice, taking two pairs of rank three horizontal charge Gu and vertical crash Gu to fuse himself.

Self-reliance Gu was a rare, ideal match for strength path Gu Masters. Hei tribe's vast list of goods had one, but it was only rank two—lower than Fang Yuan's.

"Without strength qi Gu, I lack ranged strength attacks. Yet with two apertures, my dual cultivation of enslavement and strength paths allows them to complement each other."

"For now, I can only try to gather rank four and five recipes for strength qi Gu. Qi path is extinct; though available in treasure yellow heaven, their prices are high. My best hope lies in Lang Ya blessed land. Yet the Lang Ya land spirit is difficult to deal with; obtaining the recipe will cost a steep price."

"Enslavement Gu Masters fear leader-beheading tactics, which strength path defends against. Conversely, enslavement path covers strength path's weaknesses. There is no need for strength qi Gu."

Following this, Fang Yuan spent battle merits to exchange for numerous space path Gu and large amounts of refinement materials.

Thieving Heaven Demon Venerable had sealed Luo Po Valley; entering required a rank five open door Gu rather than ordinary methods.

Fang Yuan soon saw his battle merits drop by more than half, falling from first place on the merit board.

"Lord Wolf King, your exchanged goods will be delivered gradually today and completed by dawn," the female Gu Master softly informed.

Fang Yuan nodded and was about to leave when she whispered: "Lord Wolf King, wait a moment. The tribe leader specifically instructed me to reserve a Gu recipe perfectly suited for you."

Fang Yuan realized this was Hei Lou Lan reciprocating for his restraint regarding Hei Xiu Yi's earlier desertion.

With lurking soul coat Gu concealing his soul fluctuations, he could mobilize his wolf pack at full strength while hiding.

Fang Yuan used all his remaining battle merits and barely obtained it.

Skimming the recipe, he saw the refinement difficulty was not high, but the steps were monumental and costly, especially one procedure requiring large quantities of fresh beast skins.

"The tribe leader said if merits are insufficient to hire refinement masters, you may borrow five hundred thousand," she added.

Fang Yuan nodded and borrowed five hundred thousand battle merits on the spot.

Soon after, several assignments from the Wolf King stirred the quieted camp back into a clamor.

Several days later, Fang Yuan's strength path broke through hundred jun, and he had received ten thousand rank one lurking soul coat Gu.

# Chapter 518: Famous

# Chapter 519: Just a game

Following female Gu Immortal Tan Bi Ya, a new guest arrived in the blessed land.

# Chapter 520: Stealing Shoes (1/2)

Seated on his cushion, Ma tribe's young leader Ma Ying Jie bowed his head, assisting his father with the alliance army's administrative affairs.

"Report!" an investigative Gu Master called from outside the tent.

Ma Ying Jie set aside his documents: "Come in."

Apologizing profusely, the scout changed shoes and entered, dropping to one knee: "Subordinate greets Young Tribe Leader. I have brought important information regarding Yu Tian."

After Fei tribe's destruction, the bewildered Fei Cai had been chosen as Ma Ying Jie's personal servant, escaping his tribesmen's grim fate.

Fei Cai held the investigative Gu Master's worn shoes, hesitating before stuffing the other pair into his shirt.

Squatting by the pond, he washed the worn shoes so intently that he failed to notice someone behind him.

"Hey, big dummy, why are you washing shoes so seriously?" A small hand roughly patted Fei Cai's shoulder.

Startled, Fei Cai turned to see the jade-like young girl, Zhao Lian Yun.

Zhao Lian Yun shoved his head away, muttering unhappily, "Hey blockhead, don't get so close. Haven't you heard of propriety between sexes?"

Nearly shoved into the water, Fei Cai paid it no mind, secretly pulling open his shirt to reveal the hidden shoes. "Look, what's this?" he asked, seeking praise.

Fei Cai said, "Lady Xiao Yun, didn't you say you lacked primeval stones? These exquisite shoes can be sold on the black market for primeval stones."

Zhao Lian Yun raised her brows, seeing him in a new light. "Oh wow, blockhead, you actually thought to embezzle public property? Impressive! But how much could these shoes even sell for? My daily allowance is ten times that. I appreciate the thought, but sell them yourself and replace your filthy rags."

A group of old servants shouted arrogantly, pouring out of the entrance to search for Fei Cai.

Fei Cai paled in panic, but Zhao Lian Yun snapped: "Fool, you've been framed! Follow me!"

She pulled him into the alleys, but the exits were blocked.

Zhao Lian Yun stomped her feet, fuming inwardly: *"Was it easy finding an insider for information?! Where else could I find a dummy like Fei Cai nowadays? Wherever there are humans, there's conflict and scheming. No way! I won't take this lying down—you're courting death trying to harm my informant!"*

"Big dummy, you're in luck—I just bought silk from the market," Zhao Lian Yun said, pulling high-grade silk from her pocket.

Overjoyed, they encircled him, only for Fei Cai to clench his fists and thrash them like a madman.

# Chapter 521: Stealing Shoes (2/2)

Fei Cai glared furiously and kicked the old slave before him. "Filthy bastard, I'm going to see the young tribe leader—out of my way!"

Flanked by the old slaves, Fei Cai marched toward the young tribe leader's tent.

Ma Ying Jie stood at his tent's entrance, displeased after discovering his shoes missing.

Remembering Zhao Lian Yun's instructions, Fei Cai strode forward with head held high.

"This subordinate greets young tribe leader," Fei Cai said clearly, kneeling on the ground.

Ma Ying Jie snapped displeasedly, "Did you steal my shoes?"

"I wouldn't dare steal Lord's shoes even with a hundred guts," Fei Cai denied flatly.

"He's lying! His clothes are bulging—check him and see!" the old slaves shouted from behind.

Fei Cai opened his shirt, revealing the shoes wrapped inside.

Recognizing his shoes, Ma Ying Jie smiled coldly. "Great, the proof is here. Such a confident thief is truly rare."

"I implore young tribe leader to investigate thoroughly." Fei Cai placed the shoes down respectfully and pressed his forehead to the ground.

Killing a slave was trivial, but Ma Ying Jie cultivated a 'wise and benevolent' reputation to become a sage ruler.

"I have always been fair," Ma Ying Jie said. "Fei Cai, explain yourself."

Fei Cai exhaled in relief, bolstered by Zhao Lian Yun's accurate prediction.

"My father died in our tribe's internal strife, so young tribe leader wiping out Fei tribe avenged me. Young tribe leader is so wise and benevolent—how could I repay benevolence with enmity?"

Pleased by the praise, Ma Ying Jie asked gently, "Then did you have another reason?"

Fei Cai shook his head. "I only wanted to repay you. As a mortal, I cannot fight for young tribe leader. I am foolish and can only clean and arrange shoes. Left outside in the cold, your shoes would freeze your feet. So I used my savings to buy silk, wrapping them against my chest so your feet wouldn't feel cold."

"Eh? So that was it!" Ma Ying Jie was astonished.

*'Fei Cai is truly a devoted servant.'* Ma Ying Jie's gaze softened.

Fei Cai suddenly kowtowed. "Young tribe leader, I have sinned!"

"Eh? What sin have you committed?" Ma Ying Jie asked, smiling openly.

Fei Cai replied, "I forgot it would inconvenience you when leaving. Please punish me!"

Ma Ying Jie sighed. "Fortunately, I didn't wrongfully blame a loyal servant."

"Young tribe leader, please investigate thoroughly," Fei Cai added. "These old slaves have stolen shoes repeatedly. Because I refused their incitement, they resent me. I request young tribe leader to investigate and grant me justice!"

He immediately summoned an investigative Gu Master, ordering a full inquiry into the matter.

The investigative Gu Master worked swiftly, uncovering the truth within moments.

Exposed, the old slaves fell to their knees, begging for mercy.

Ma Ying Jie snorted. "Flattering superiors and bullying subordinates—you slaves dared deceive me! You deserve death, but considering your long service since my childhood, I will spare your worthless lives. You are banished to the supply camp to serve the army. Clean the faeces and latrine!"

"As for you..." Ma Ying Jie smiled at Fei Cai. "As punishment for taking my shoes, you are appointed head of the slaves!"

Fei Cai was stunned before realizing Ma Ying Jie's 'punishment' was actually a promotion!

Ma Ying Jie waved his hand. "Now get out and serve me properly!"

"What? You became the head of the slaves?" Zhao Lian Yun's eyes widened in shock upon hearing the news.

# Chapter 522: Rank Five Amplify Effect Gu

Kicking his leg, Zhao Lian Yun barked, "Idiot, your situation is even more precarious now! Countless people will target you—even Gu Masters!"

Fei Cai was shocked: "Then what should I do?"

"Idiot," Zhao Lian Yun snorted. "With the old servants gone, you must recruit new subordinates to manage."

# Chapter 523: Tai Bai Yun Sheng

Mirror lake.

# Chapter 524: Number one in prestige and merit

As Hei Lou Lan's camp strategized, Liu Wen Wu and his group also plotted how to battle Hei tribe.

"In Hei tribe's army, Wolf King Chang Shan Yin is our greatest threat. He inflicted disastrous losses on us today, with at least thirty thousand Gu Masters dying in the wolves' jaws. Xiao Hun blessed land.

Hei Cheng muttered: "I have the Gu, but mutated wolves must be bought from treasure yellow heaven. I must trouble you, Brother."

Hei Bai nodded: "I rely on our nephew to retrieve Immortal Gu Wooden Chicken from Eighty-Eight True Yang Building."

# Chapter 529: Diligence despite transmigration

# Chapter 530: Adjusting his appearance for him

Liu tribe defense line, inside the camp tent.

Hei Lou Lan roared: "Stop! Wolf King, what are you doing?!"

# Chapter 531: Huge Battle (1/4)

# Chapter 535: Meeting of ‘Father and Son’

# Chapter 536: Major Battles
