# Chapter 547: Search for Success

Flipping through The Legends of Ren Zu, Fang Yuan read:

When Ren Zu was trapped in Luo Po valley with no way out, facing certain death—

To save her father, Desolate Ancient Moon climbed Cheng Bai mountain to obtain the sole success Gu at its peak.

Reaching the foot of the mountain, Desolate Ancient Moon was obstructed by the rockman.

Love Gu appeared before her, laughing: "You interrupted my sweet dream. Now I will topple Cheng Bai mountain—find that success Gu among billions of rocks!"

Troubled and left with no choice, Desolate Ancient Moon returned to cognition Gu for advice.

"Now that Cheng Bai mountain has collapsed, you can only check these rocks one by one to find the real success Gu. There is no other way."

Cognition Gu continued: "Be careful, for Cheng Bai mountain holds two Gu: success Gu at the peak, and failure Gu at the bottom. Failure is the mother of success. Those rocks are its siblings; picking them will cause terrible disasters. Here is a secret: as long as you firmly believe in 'me' in your heart, these disastrous situations will gradually disappear."

Her heart sinking, Desolate Ancient Moon asked: "Then how do I differentiate the rocks? What do success Gu and failure Gu look like?"

Cognition Gu sighed: "They look almost identical, but differentiating them is simple. Just hold them, and you will learn their identities."

"In your search for success Gu, failure Gu will be your greatest threat. You must not hold it, or you will become completely lost and your life endangered."

Desolate Ancient Moon breathed in deeply, picking up the first rock.

The rock seemed ordinary, but shook slightly when Desolate Ancient Moon held it.

A light wound appeared on Desolate Ancient Moon's hand.

She chanted in her heart: "Me, me, me, me..."

As she chanted, the wound miraculously healed, leaving only a faint scar.

Yet as days passed, she found only failure Gu's children.

Some rocks injured her, others brought dejection, despair, or fear, and some made her grow a pig head or rat's tail.

Though Desolate Ancient Moon chanted 'me' continuously, scars accumulated and gradually turned her into a monster.

She grew six heads, three arms, five tails, and sixteen legs bearing fur, snake scales, sharp claws, and tough hooves.

In the search for success, people often transform completely.

Yet Desolate Ancient Moon grew far stronger because of this.

Through her immense effort, fewer and fewer unpicked rocks remained.

When only two rocks remained, Desolate Ancient Moon faced a difficult choice.

Obtaining success Gu would be best, but picking failure Gu would make her lose herself completely, endangering her life.

"If fear of failure keeps me from taking the next step, I will never succeed! I am a step from success. Even if I take failure Gu, chanting 'me' will let me endure it." Mustering courage, she picked one.

Unfortunately, she picked failure Gu.

An unforseen feeling of lost, self-doubt assaulted her.

"Me, me, me..."

Desolate Ancient Moon chanted 'me', but her voice softened until her expression turned blank.

Falling into endless perplexity, she completely lost herself.

Man's greatest tragedy is losing one's sense of self.

"Sigh..." Fang Yuan sighed as he closed the book.

Several days later.

# Chapter 554: Plotting is difficult, Living is tough

Hall of affairs.

# Chapter 557: Three grades of evaluation, clearing with high grade?

Fang Yuan felt his body stiffen as intense pressure assaulted him upon entering the building.

"Oh? This is..."

Aside from rotting corpses, only Fang Yuan and Tai Bai Yun Sheng remained in the hall.

Closing the hall door, Fang Yuan half-squatted and gripped Tai Bai Yun Sheng's skull with his right palm.

The whites of his eyes glowed faintly as countless images flashed through Fang Yuan's mind.

Fang Yuan extracted Tai Bai Yun Sheng's memories, tracing backward from old age.

A massive torrent of Tai Bai Yun Sheng's memories battered Fang Yuan's mind with intense pain.

After reviewing the old man's life, Fang Yuan halted his Gu worms to rest.

"I didn't find it!" he sighed with regret.

"What couldn't you find?" Mo Yao's will asked inquisitively in his mind.

Fang Yuan did not answer. Tied to his grand schemes, Landscape As Before could never be revealed to Mo Yao.

Landscape As Before was an Immortal Gu Tai Bai Yun Sheng obtained only after ascending to immortality.

Rumors claimed the Gu condensed spontaneously through the resonance of heaven and earth when Tai Bai Yun Sheng became an immortal.

Yet another possibility existed: Tai Bai Yun Sheng had possessed the Immortal Gu recipe for Landscape As Before all along.

With the recipe, Fang Yuan could have Lang Ya land spirit refine the Immortal Gu directly, avoiding immense risk.

Yet this soul search yielded a disappointing result.

Failing to find a recipe confirmed that Landscape As Before condensed purely from heaven and earth's resonance during ascension.

To obtain it, Fang Yuan would have to forcibly snatch it from an already-ascended Tai Bai Yun Sheng.

Having invested so much effort, Fang Yuan had no choice but to prepare for the dangerous gamble.

When Tai Bai Yun Sheng opened his eyes, he found himself bedridden and weak.

"Lord elder, your injuries are treated, though your advanced age has taken a toll. You must recuperate carefully over the next few months; your body is weak and needs slow recovery," the head healing Gu Master gently urged.

To assemble a raid team, Tai Bai Yun Sheng had agreed to become a Hei tribe external elder.

Tai Bai Yun Sheng's gaze was unfocused, but hearing this brought him back to his senses. "Where is this place?" he asked.

"This is Lord Hei Lou Lan's residence. When you returned half-dead, the tribe leader personally brought you here for treatment. The servants have reported your awakening, and the tribe leader will be here shortly," the Gu Master leader replied.

Tai Bai Yun Sheng threw his head back in bitter laughter: "Haha, I failed after all! All that sacrifice for nothing!"

"Gao Yang, Zhu Zai, they gave their lives for me!" Tears streamed from his eyes in agony.

At the critical juncture, Tai Bai Yun Sheng withheld his primeval essence to activate defensive Gu instead of saving his comrades.

For his own selfish desires, he had ignored his comrades' sacrifices.

He had deliberately sacrificed his comrades solely to claim the lifespan Gu and extend his life.

The decision alienated him from himself, filling him with profound shame and self-loathing.

The room knelt as a smiling Hei Lou Lan approached Tai Bai Yun Sheng.

Noticing his pained look, Hei Lou Lan smoothed his expression: "Elder Tai Bai, I am glad you awoke. I have heard what happened. You, Gao Yang, and Zhu Zai displayed true Northern Plains bravery; though you failed, it was an admirable attempt! Learn from this, and I am certain you will conquer this round in the future."

Tai Bai Yun Sheng kept his eyes closed, remaining silent with a pained expression.

His memories flashed in his mind one by one once more.

From youth, he had always believed in the power of love.

When Tai Bai tribe annexed other tribes, he married a captive childhood friend to spare her and her people from slavery.

On their wedding night, she betrayed him; the captives colluded with enemies, slaughtering his parents.

His ensuing life as a slave was wretched, plagued by intense guilt and regret.

Years later, he gave an old beggar water; in return, the beggar offered three immortal inheritances.

The first allowed him to tread fire and bathe in flames, transcending mortality.

The second allowed him to control wind and fly, roaming the world freely.

The third allowed him to surpass life and death, gaining the ability to help the world's people.

Tai Bai Yun Sheng chose the third inheritance.

From then on, his heart found light in the darkness, and he was completely reborn without regret.

Surpassing life and death to help people had become his life's goal.

And indeed, he truly achieved this in his later life.

He failed not from losing the lifespan Gu, but because he betrayed his lifelong principles.

Most ironically, all this had been done by his own subconscious.

He spent a lifetime building his ideals, only to destroy them in a single selfish moment.

He had seen the other side of himself, his own selfish nature.

The shadow was extremely dark...

# Chapter 595: Green vines blocking the round, Fang Yuan’s backstab

Hei Lou Lan watched the troops making slow progress through the dense jungle.

To pass this round, Gu Masters had to cross the jungle to reach a stone palace on the opposite side.

Though devoid of beasts, the jungle was filled with green vines.

Even severed segments continued attacking, while green dragon vines tore free from their roots to lash out suicidally.

The army shattered into isolated pockets, retreating step by step as numerous Gu Masters lost their lives.

He paid special attention to experts like Hei Lou Lan, Ye Lui Sang, and Tai Bai Yun Sheng, mobilizing mutated beast-level green dragon vines to obstruct them.

Hei Lou Lan gnashed his teeth, his expression warring fiercely before he forced out: "Retreat!"

# Chapter 596: Preparations from long ago, Mo Yao’s shock and suspicion

# Chapter 597: True Inheritance Secluded Domain, Unexpected Event

Reckless Savage Demon Venerable praised: "Good beast!"

Possessing human-like intelligence, the enraged primordial ash owl unleashed heavenly lightning from its beak; a blue thunderbolt pierced ten thousand li, instantly reaching Reckless Savage Demon Venerable.

Reckless Savage Demon Venerable stood completely still, letting the frenzied lightning strike him directly.

Amid the electricity, his bronze, muscular body remained unscathed, glowing brightly as beast totems prowled across his skin like living creatures.

With a single punch, apocalyptic gales scattered the clouds, stripping the heavens bare as radiant sunlight banished all darkness!

The immemorial beast's bones shattered instantly; rainbow feathers drifted as it collapsed, golden pupils filled with terror.

# Chapter 598: Three Olds, Three True Inheritances, Using Will

Old Immortal Kong Jue researched apertures, authoring Immortal Aperture Strategy and enabling ten extreme physiques to achieve immortal ascension. Rumors even claimed he could refine lifespan Gu, prompting Giant Sun to attack Lang Ya blessed land, though fruitlessly."

# Chapter 602: Frost Jade Peacock

Frost Jade Peacock sneered arrogantly, "I am one with the blessed land; everything that transpired here is clear to me. If you want to be my new owner, you will need to fulfill one condition."

"What condition?"

Protected by an Immortal Venerable's arrangements, Imperial Court blessed land resisted wisdom path deductions. Once Fang Yuan patched its loopholes over time, it would be far safer than Hu Immortal blessed land.

The tribe leaders exchanged glances, weighed their options, and ultimately accepted the condition.

The following day, Hei Lou Lan dispatched the Black Banner Elite to collect the Gu worms promptly, sending Tai Bai Yun Sheng to oversee the process and manage logistics.

When Tai Bai Yun Sheng reported back, Hei Lou Lan invited him to a banquet.

At the banquet, Hei Lou Lan raised his cup: "Old sir, drink! It is our tribe's blessing to have you; your healing has saved countless lives and minimized our casualties. You have achieved tremendous merit."

"I am unworthy of such praise. Success lies with fate; with Longevity Heaven watching over us, we can only do our utmost."

"With Longevity Heaven watching, we can only do our best..." Hei Lou Lan drained his cup, muttering with a sigh: "Old sir speaks with profound truth. Longevity Heaven watches as we tread an uncertain future; mortals can only strive our hardest. Elder Tai Bai has done his utmost, and I, Hei Lou Lan, must do no less!"

Sensing a deeper implication behind the words, Tai Bai Yun Sheng asked: "Lord Tribe Leader, what do you mean?"

Hei Lou Lan laughed heartily and was about to answer when Hei Shu entered with a report.

Covered in blood, he cautiously approached Hei Lou Lan with a respectful expression: "Reporting to lord tribe leader, the black banner army has met your expectations and settled it appropriately."

Sensing the killing aura with growing dread, Tai Bai Yun Sheng quickly asked: "What do you mean by settled appropriately? Hei Shu! What did you settle?"

"Hahaha, Elder Tai Bai! Just as you said — we can only do our best! You are doing yours, and I am doing mine! Who would be left to challenge the rounds with me?" Hei Lou Lan said resolutely, his eyes glinting ruthlessly.

"Hei Lou Lan, you!" Tai Bai Yun Sheng stood up in a flash.

"Elder Tai Bai, remember your current status." Putting away his ruthlessness, Hei Lou Lan indifferently poured another cup of wine.

Unmoved, Hei Lou Lan pointed at the dishes and laughed: "Elder Tai Bai, this banquet celebrates your success. Without your support, why would they trust us enough to lend their Gu? Without their Gu worms, my black banner army easily swooped in and obliterated them. I have you to thank for this."

"Hei Lou Lan, you are really an unscrupulous scoundrel!"

"Unscrupulous? To think you would say something so naive. Elder Tai Bai, you were once a young tribe leader—after living so many years, have you not seen the reality of this world? Politics has always been dirty."

Snorting coldly, he turned and walked out of the hall without looking back once.

Hei Lou Lan raised his wine cup calmly. Glancing at Tai Bai Yun Sheng's retreating figure, he sneered: "Tai Bai Yun Sheng is merely a healing Gu Master, what is there to fear? His reputation? Hehe, after this, who will dare believe in him? Good deeds go unnoticed, while bad deeds travel a thousand li..."

Tai Bai Yun Sheng hurried toward the scene.

The sacred palace was bloodstained, corpses littering the ground.

Corpses were severed of limbs or bisected in gruesome slaughter, their twisted expressions frozen in agony.

"It was all my fault. If not for my mediation... I failed to see his vile intentions! They all died because they trusted me!"

He collapsed weakly to his knees, propping himself up as blood stained his hands, knees, and pants bright red.

"Sorry, I am sorry..."

"He is a good person... though darkness lingers in his heart, there is great terror between life and death. Facing death, who wouldn't lose themselves?" From a hidden corner far away, Fang Yuan observed silently.

It turned out the black coffin luck represented a severe, life-threatening disaster, proven by these tribes' extermination.

Meanwhile, his own death energy was dozens or even a hundred times thicker than that of these tribesmen!

"Hehe, interesting. Luck, huh..." Fang Yuan curled his lips into a cold, arrogant smile, eager to see if this bad luck could halt his steps.

"In this life, no person, reason, or obstacle can shake my resolve to press forward!" His icy gaze fixed upon Tai Bai Yun Sheng.

"Who said kind people are rewarded?" A sarcastic trace entered Fang Yuan's cold expression. "Let me lend you a hand."

He secretly activated his Gu worms, sending an untraceable, illusory voice whispering into Tai Bai Yun Sheng's ears.

He heard voices that sounded just like Gao Yang and Zhu Zai.

"I believe in you! You will definitely save us, isn't that right?"

"Old sir, you are our benefactor. Grateful to you, we are willing to risk our lives to help you!"

The puddle of blood rippled as his nightmare resurfaced: Gao Yang and Zhu Zai dying in the sea of blood beasts!

Tai Bai Yun Sheng shuddered, frozen like a statue, before throwing his head back and screaming with all his might.

"Hehehe, hihihi, hahaha!"

When his screams ceased, Tai Bai Yun Sheng began laughing maniacally.

His laughter held madness, sorrow, and fury, along with mockery toward both himself and the mortal world.

Meanwhile, Fang Yuan smiled faintly; as a reborn transmigrator, his rich life experience allowed him to grasp human psychology with precise mastery.

Tai Bai Yun Sheng was a very good person.

But his subconscious action in the blood hall was akin to betrayal.

It sparked intense self-doubt, suspicion, and denial of his core values.

When a person denies and doubts himself, he inevitably plunges into an abyss of agony.

Tai Bai Yun Sheng was clearly in agony and wracked with guilt, tormented nightly by the same nightmare.

He found it impossible to accept that he could possess such a despicable and lowly nature. His entire life was devoted to justice and benevolence. Having walked this path for so long, he yearned to return, but deep in his heart, this act formed an impassable barrier.

Trapped in an abyss of agony, he sank deeper the more he struggled.

The tribe leaders' plea had offered him a chance at salvation and redemption for his mistake.

Had he succeeded, it would have been the finest medicine to atone for his sins and find self-forgiveness.

Instead, Hei Lou Lan ordered a massacre without sparing women or children, making Tai Bai Yun Sheng the greatest accomplice to the slaughter.

His cure became a piercing poison whose potency shattered his composure, pushing his psyche to the brink of collapse.

At this juncture, Fang Yuan's gentle nudge shattered Tai Bai Yun Sheng's heart, triggering a total breakdown.

"If you deny even yourself, what is left?" Fang Yuan murmured, his gaze dark as night.

"Challenge the blood hall again? No, your mind would be haunted by Gao Yang and Zhu Zai. Seek help? Who could help you now? Hei Lou Lan? You've surely fallen out with him. Besides, even if you obtained the lifespan Gu, could you use it with peace of mind?"

"Hehe, what options do you have left? Denying yourself, wallowing in self-pity, and drowning in grief—as someone undergoing a trial of conscience, what choices remain?"

"So make your choice—don't let me down!" In the shadows, Fang Yuan's eyes shone as he watched the deranged Tai Bai Yun Sheng.

Pitiful person.

Since some time ago, a mild wind had started blowing.

The wind gradually grew stronger as clouds gathered in the sky.

"You did not disappoint me after all..." Thrilled, Fang Yuan turned and vanished without a trace.

Soon, the wind and clouds went wild, as heaven and earth changed!

Thick, looming black clouds looked ready to collapse at any moment and crush the sacred palace.

"Investigate, find out who it is!" Hei Lou Lan roared furiously inside the hall.

"Lord, it's Tai Bai Yun Sheng!" Drenched in sweat, Hei Shu stumbled into the hall to report.

Breaths later, he snapped back and shouted with a twisted expression: "Retreat! Evacuate everyone from the sacred palace. Anyone wishing to die can stay!"

# Chapter 606: Awakening

Depleting this small world's heaven and earth qi directly weakened the blessed land, draining the very source of the land spirit's strength.

Imprisoned for countless years, it had finally seen hope for freedom.

Fearing Giant Sun's will, the land spirit had planned to wait until Gruel Mud corroded its shackles before breaking free in one decisive strike.

Now that Tai Bai Yun Sheng was ascending, he was not only draining the land spirit's strength, but would inevitably awaken Giant Sun's will, dashing its hopes entirely.

With no choice left, it made a swift decision to strike while Giant Sun's will still hibernated, giving the will no time to prepare!

"Huh?"

Starting as a faint glimmer, it blazed brightly enough to pierce the underworld, sweeping across every corner of True Yang Building.

Fang Yuan's will in the guest halt stele was instantly wiped out without defense, while the glass owner token in his grip grew scalding hot!

# Chapter 650: Return to Hu Immortal Blessed Land

After returning to Hu Immortal blessed land, he made some arrangements and fell into deep sleep.

"My body is filled with death energy and completely turned into a zombie, knowing no fatigue. But my soul is still my original soul—it has limits and suffers injuries too."

Fang Yuan stood quietly inside, stepping out of the wisdom light halo only after his mind's wills were fully depleted.

After a few rounds, their offense will intensify as they take us seriously. We must ally with another ancient sect to resolve this."

"The situation has changed, my friend," Hei Lou Lan said gravely, revealing a trace of worry.

Realizing her slip, Hei Lou Lan concealed her emotions with a cold smile: "Naturally, arriving early also catches you off guard. In case you set traps in your headquarters, I've disrupted your plans!"

Fang Yuan chuckled unperturbed: "After northern plains, we are tied together for better or worse. But for full cooperation, your previous conditions remain insufficient!"

# Chapter 659: The dirtiness of humans

Hearing him say "insufficient", Hei Lou Lan snorted displeasedly: "Fang Yuan, let me enlighten you on the situation in northern plains. Recently, northern plains' number one wisdom path Gu Immortal, Dong Fang Chang Fan, invited all super tribes and made deductions for them. His condition was that they ally with Dong Fang tribe and refrain from targeting or suppressing them for fifty years after his death."

"Reportedly, Dong Fang Chang Fan gave each tribe one deduction regarding Gu recipes, Immortal Gu sightings, or killing desolate beasts. He has deduced much about you, though I lack the deeper details. Now everyone knows you aren't a northern plains Gu Master, and that a local Gu Master colluded with you."

Tai Bai Yun Sheng's pupils shrank, saying with some fear: "He deduced so much? As expected of Dong Fang Chang Fan..."

Hei Lou Lan snickered: "Fang Yuan, our lives are tied together! If I die, I might expose you and Tai Bai Yun Sheng. Besides, is wisdom Gu in your hands?"

You know full well that hiding in central continent isn't safe. I made arrangements beforehand: if I do not return in three days, all of northern plains will know you two toppled True Yang Building, and the entire world will know wisdom Gu is with you!"

Fang Yuan's eerie words stopped her laughter: "Hei Lou Lan, I know you aren't afraid of death, but have you forgotten your hatred?"

Hei Lou Lan's expression changed, her aura diminishing as her lightning-like gaze fixed on Fang Yuan: "State your conditions."

Seeing her sincerity, Fang Yuan smiled faintly: "Lastly, I need the full story, and why you must kill your father personally."

Hei Lou Lan was silent briefly before agreeing: "You are overly suspicious, but I can satisfy all three conditions. There is nothing I can't speak of anyway."

Next, in their conversation, Fang Yuan finally understood the secret behind Hei Lou Lan's thirst for revenge.

The root of all this was actually Eighty-Eight True Yang Building.

In True Yang Building, there was a true inheritance called the "yin-yang life extension method", taken by Hei Cheng long ago.

Giant Sun Immortal Venerable created this true inheritance while researching Ren Zu for life extension methods.

Using this method required a male and female Gu Immortal to copulate, extending the lifespan of one of them.

Once, while Su tribe's leader attended Hei Cheng, Su Xian Er poured wine and fell in love with him at first sight.

Learning of a plot, Su Xian Er fled her campsite at midnight to save Hei Cheng.

He had asked Su Xian Er: "Your tribe leader plotted against me; as a Su tribesman, why save your tribe's enemy?"

Su Xian Er answered: "Lord possesses a noble spirit, and this humble girl fell in love at first sight. Our short-sighted leader plotted against Lord under petty influence, ignoring the consequences of offending Hei tribe. It is proper for Lord to take revenge, but I hope Lord will be merciful and leave behind a trace of Su tribe's bloodline."

Overwhelmed, Hei Cheng grasped Su Xian Er's hand and swore: "Your love is deep as the sea, and I am not cruel; how could I not repay you? From today on, you will be my only wife! I will care for no other beauties, no matter how fair. In this life, I will never betray you!"

Yet few knew that Su tribe faced extermination soon after.

Hei Cheng had many wives and children, Su Xian Er was neither the first, nor the last.

Hei Cheng and Su Xian Er had a daughter, taking her father's surname and given the name Lou Lan. Years later, Su Xian Er died. A deeply aggrieved Hei Cheng announced that childbirth had ruined her health and strength, causing her to perish in her blessed land's earthly calamity.

"He secretly obtained the yin-yang life extension method in the true inheritance secluded domain. For his selfish desires, he maliciously deceived my mother, who trusted him, mercilessly taking almost all her lifespan."

"Before dying, mother saw his true colors and warned me. A flaw in his cultivation rapidly consumed that stolen lifespan; facing another lifespan crisis, his target is now me."

"With my Great Strength True Martial Physique, my foundation will be extremely firm upon becoming a Gu Immortal. Using the yin-yang life extension method on me will waste less lifespan and grant him far more!"

Hei Lou Lan spilled these dark secrets, her calm tone brimming with utter hatred.

Tai Bai Yun Sheng shook his head: "To think Lord Hei Cheng is such a person, how disappointing..."

"Hmph, such is the righteous path—countless dirty deeds beneath a glorious surface. In contrast, the demonic path is far more straightforward!" Hei Lou Lan scoffed.

"No wonder you ignored Hei Cheng's call when the wind veil of assimilation opened." Fang Yuan nodded, looking at Hei Lou Lan with new perspective.

This was likely what forged her formidable personality.

Legend says when Ren Zu started walking the road of life, his vision plunged into pure darkness.

He took the first step.

PIop.

At the next moment, he stepped into the mud.

He raised his foot and wiped it; it was caked in foul-smelling, mushy mud.

He was hesitant to move forward.

Self Gu spoke: "Do not hesitate, human. To walk your own road, rely on your own legs. When stepping forward, do not fear dirtiness."

# Chapter 710: Crossing the Regional Wall

# Chapter 711: Giving Up on Possession

Hu Immortal blessed land, in an underground cave.

"What do we do now?" Hei Lou Lan frowned. "Under their watchful eyes, we cannot possibly seize the walking meat tree."

"How is this possible? My weak icy drill stardust should have only temporarily shattered his image... Wait, could it be?!"

Soon, an immortal zombie resembling an ordinary human stepped forth in fury, locking his gaze onto Star Lord Wan Xiang, Hei Lou Lan, and Fang Yuan.

"Seven Star Child didn't die, but became an immortal zombie! No wonder the heavenly spirit didn't appear. Hei Lou Lan, I can only help you this much." Gritting his teeth, Fang Yuan fired icy drill stardust at Hei Lou Lan before leaving.

"Worms, you court death!" Seven Star Child first went to Star Lord Wan Xiang.

With a loud boom that blasted a hole in the eighth star hall, he nearly shattered Star Lord Wan Xiang's chest, sending his body plummeting like a shooting star into the forest.

Struck by the icy drill stardust, Hei Lou Lan narrowly awoke from Star Constellation Immortal Venerable's dream realm under intense cold and pain.

Seven Star Child immortal zombie snickered sinisterly. Closing to fifty or sixty paces from Hei Lou Lan, he thrust out his left arm.

Instantly, a massive starlight pillar silently shot from Seven Star Child immortal zombie's hand.

As star billow pillar was a straight-line attack, Hei Lou Lan narrowly dodged its path and rapidly retreated.

Reaching Fang Yuan's side, Hei Lou Lan could hardly believe she had survived and escaped!

Fang Yuan grabbed her arm and ran deeper into the forest: "Quickly go! Seven Star Child immortal zombie was trapped in that dream realm too long—his condition is abnormal, his thoughts sparse, and his cognition too slow to think normally."

Hei Lou Lan suddenly stopped. Seeing the icy drill stardust marks on herself, she angrily shouted: "Fang Yuan! You actually attacked me?"

"Shut up! I was saving you. Without that icy drill stardust, could you have escaped Star Constellation Immortal Venerable's dream realm? If you hadn't reacted in time, Seven Star Child immortal zombie's killer move would have killed you!" Fang Yuan replied displeased, without looking back.

Pausing briefly, Hei Lou Lan followed Fang Yuan: "I will remember this lifesaving favor and compensate you handsomely! But what was that dream realm? We have Fixed Immortal Travel."

Running along, they looked up to see Seven Star Child immortal zombie fly out of the eighth star hall, his attention fixed on the rolling rock battlefield in the air.

After brief consideration, Seven Star Child immortal zombie extended his left arm, unleashing another star billow pillar.

# Chapter 726: Retreat

Next, a massive hand of grand starlight formed and slammed forcefully against the rolling rock battlefield.

After two immortal killer moves, the rolling rock battlefield cracked open, revealing the interior through a wide rift, though it still held together.

Exhaling a misty breath, Hei Lou Lan felt mostly relieved: "Good, Seven Star Child immortal zombie is fighting Shi Lei—the best possible situation. Fang Yuan, why are you still running?!"

"Saving someone," Fang Yuan replied curtly.

Rounding a mountain wall onto a cliff, Fang Yuan pointed: "Him."

Reaching Star Lord Wan Xiang, they saw a gaping hole in his chest. Completely pierced through, nearly his entire chest was gone, held together only by flesh at the sides.

"This is the power of Seven Star Child immortal zombie's stomp." Fang Yuan crouched, his eight arms searching Star Lord Wan Xiang's body in turn.

Fang Yuan soon sighed inwardly in disappointment: "His physical injuries could be healed at great cost, but his soul was sucked into the dream realm. Unless Star Constellation Immortal Venerable's dream is broken, this Gu Immortal's soul can only wander inside it or transform into another dream realm."

"What a pity," Fang Yuan muttered, hands still working. "Alive, he could have provided vital intelligence. We could even have enslaved him with your Immortal Gu to do our bidding. We could even have plotted against Shi Lei to kill him risk-free and without suspicion, reaping maximum benefits!"

"If you have time for that, help me seal his immortal aperture." Fang Yuan's words drew all of Hei Lou Lan's attention.

"He died leaving behind his obsession, so the blessed land now has a land spirit." Fang Yuan's eight arms worked continuously, planting various Gu worms into Star Lord Wan Xiang's corpse.

Frowning in deep concentration, Fang Yuan said: "Sealing a blessed land is troublesome, and I lack Gu worms. Watch the battle above while communicating with treasure yellow heaven to buy these Gu worms. Remember, not a single one can be missing!"

Guarding Fang Yuan, she connected to treasure yellow heaven through her immortal aperture and used the moving perspective cup Gu he lent her to seek Fairy Li Shan's help.

Unable to endure the pressure, the rolling rock battlefield finally shattered.

Shi Lei, who broke it, was also in poor shape. Covered in wounds, a deep slash on his chest stretched from shoulder to waist, exposing bone.

"Intruder, die," Seven Star Child immortal zombie shouted, pointing expressionlessly at Shi Lei.

Both killer moves activated swiftly with immense power. Starlight erupted from Seven Star Child immortal zombie's fingertip, instantly tearing through space to pierce Shi Lei's chest.

Earth path, transformation path — dual immortal killer move — Rock Mountain Immortal Monkey King Transformation!

A burst of golden light repelled Seven Star Child, revealing a sixteen-meter-tall giant monkey.

The massive Immortal Monkey King faced off against the starry-cloaked immortal zombie; the two remained at a standstill, neither attacking yet.

Watching with a trembling heart, Hei Lou Lan knew their clash would be devastating. She urged Fang Yuan: "Quick, the situation is worsening."

"I know, but without Immortal Gu, this seal lasts only seven minutes before the immortal aperture must land and take root." Dizzied from the intense exertion, Fang Yuan finally halted his eight arms' complex movements.

Immortal Monkey King shifted his golden pupils, eyeing Fang Yuan and Hei Lou Lan with his peripheral vision.

Fang Yuan's pupils shrunk: "He found us. Quick, hide the corpse!"

Solemn-faced, Hei Lou Lan grabbed Star Lord Wan Xiang by the leg and tossed him into her immortal aperture.

Seven Star Child immortal zombie howled toward the sky.

Desolate beasts emerged from the pillars: diamond bear, flying sword rat, star desolate hound, golden pangolin...

Having regained his intellect, Seven Star Child immortal zombie used the grotto-heaven's advantage, unleashing desolate beasts from the seven spaces to establish overwhelming dominance!

Seeing this, Fang Yuan immediately activated Fixed Immortal Travel.

Hei Lou Lan entered Fang Yuan's immortal aperture, and within a few breaths, both vanished.

"Fixed Immortal Travel, immortal zombie... Fang Yuan!" These thoughts flashed through Immortal Monkey King's mind before Seven Star Child charged him again. Bold as he was, Shi Lei was not stupid enough to keep fighting.

Flying down to the walking meat tree, he stored its two segments into his immortal aperture.

Enduring Seven Star Child immortal zombie's attacks, he flew to the astral wind flying heavenly boar corpse and reached out, only to grab empty air!

"What?!" Shocked, Shi Lei noticed the broken mortal Gu on his arm and instantly flew into a rage—it had to be Fang Yuan!

The next moment, a star billow pillar struck Immortal Monkey King directly on the back, slamming him to the ground.

# Chapter 727: Escape

Growling angrily, he spat out dirt and scrambled to his feet.

Striding forward and uprooting trees in his path, he looked toward the star demon bat corpse and rejoiced to see it still intact.

Shi Lei shouted in fury: "Damn it, what method is this to look so real?! Right, there is still the flying bear!"

Nearing the flying bear corpse, Shi Lei found only five living flying bears surrounding the bloody ground.

Shi Lei's hope was completely dashed as rage overwhelmed him: "Every desolate beast I killed was stolen by that despicable thief Fang Yuan! Those were my spoils, the fruits of my victory! How long has it been since anyone dared steal from me, the Immortal Monkey King?!"

Though Star Lord Wan Xiang's death cost Shi Lei his exit from Starry Sky grotto-heaven, he knew the loophole's location; reaching it, he could blast a larger opening connecting to Central Continent.

Shi Lei veered away, only to find five flying bears charging ahead, three blazing divine stallions closing in on the left, a giant ghost face tortoise to the right, and seven star desolate hounds behind him.

The mountain-sized ghost face tortoise on his right was the least agile, offering the best route to break through.

Resolved, Shi Lei took a huge stride and charged toward the ghost face tortoise.

At last, Shi Lei reached the grotto-heaven's loophole opening.

Laughing heartily, he strode forward to force his way out.

Glancing around, Shi Lei saw five flying bears closing in from five directions.

"What is going on?" Looking up, he saw six enormous star shadows looming in the sky.

Seven Star Child immortal zombie laughed coldly: "Little monkey, did you think my seven star space was so simple? I should thank you—without you awakening me, I'd still be stuck in that dream realm. In return, I will bury your corpse beneath my favorite mountain peak."

Seven Star Child had fully regained his senses and could think normally again!

"This is bad." Shi Lei's heart sank.

"Scram!" Shi Lei was about to erupt when flickering starlight weighed him down and slowed his movements—Seven Star Child immortal zombie had attacked.

"I have no choice but to seek help from the sect! To think that I, the grand Immortal Monkey King, am forced to use seek help Gu! Where will my reputation go after this? Fang Yuan, this is all your fault—once saved, I will make you pay!!" Shi Lei raged internally, nearly vomiting blood in fury.

Immortal Monkey King raised his head, shouting at Seven Star Child immortal zombie: "Fight me for three hundred more rounds if you have the guts!"

The golden monkey growled as dazzling golden light erupted, forcing Seven Star Child immortal zombie to squint.

As the golden light faded, Shi Lei reverted to human form and sped into the forest.

"You dare trick me? I took you for a champion who would battle to the death! Run, go ahead—let's see where you can escape in my grotto-heaven!" Seven Star Child immortal zombie raged after a stunned moment.

# Chapter 728: Star Form Blessed Land

"We're here." Looking around, Fang Yuan nodded in satisfaction.

"Where is this?" Hei Lou Lan came out of Fang Yuan's immortal aperture.

"This place is Earth Abyss." Fang Yuan lightly replied.

"Earth Abyss?" Hei Lou Lan looked at Fang Yuan in astonishment.

Hei Lou Lan nodded, then pivoted: "But Ancient Soul Sect's headquarters is in Earth Abyss. As one of the ten great ancient sects, that colossus has dominated the far west for millennia. They claim Earth Abyss as their exclusive domain. Placing the blessed land here is like planting flowers in someone else's backyard—aren't you afraid of being found?"

Fang Yuan laughed: "Don't worry. Earth Abyss's depths are utterly secluded. Over thousands of years, Ancient Soul Sect has fully explored only eighteen layers, briefly reaching the twenty-seventh. From the twenty-eighth to thirty-sixth layers, their Gu Immortals only roam occasionally. As long as we place the blessed land below the fortieth layer, even a massive commotion won't be discovered."

In the thirty-fifth layer, an Ancient Soul Sect rank six Gu Immortal was being wretchedly pursued by an ancient desolate beast and four desolate beasts.

Guided by previous-life memories, Fang Yuan led the way to the key location.

After setting up six Gu formations, Fang Yuan pointed downward: "My attack power lacks punch; use your Immortal Gu to strike this muddy ground."

Following his directions, Hei Lou Lan morphed into a strength path phantom giant and pounded the muddy ground three times.

Under the continuous bombardment, the crater deepened thousands of feet until it broke through completely into an opening.

By the time they reached the fortieth layer, the seal on Star Lord Wan Xiang hit its time limit.

"Your estimate was spot on." Setting Star Lord Wan Xiang's corpse down, Hei Lou Lan gave Fang Yuan a deep look.

At Fang Yuan's thought, hundreds of mortal Gu buzzed out of Star Lord Wan Xiang's corpse like locusts and flew into his immortal aperture.

Freed from suppression, Star Lord Wan Xiang's body gradually radiated bright starlight.

The starlight absorbed surrounding earth qi and formed a hovering door inscribed with four words: Star Form Blessed Land.

Hei Lou Lan exhaled turbid air: "We finally succeeded; our luck held. Despite the huge commotion, the local wild beasts didn't attack."

"Let's go." Fang Yuan led the way, opening the starry entrance.

Hei Lou Lan followed closely behind. The two entered Star Form blessed land.

Like late night, the sky inside was pitch-black and studded with stars.

Star Form blessed land resembled a giant basin: elevated ground rose in the center, while continuous mountain ranges encircled the perimeter like a circular wall.

"So much star fragment grass!" Fang Yuan looked at the ground, which was covered entirely in star fragment grass.

"If not for Song Zi Xing severely injuring my body and soul, how could my grand main body, Star Lord Wan Xiang, perish in the eighth star hall?" A boy suddenly appeared before Fang Yuan and Hei Lou Lan.

# Chapter 729: Splitting Loot

"Star Lord Wan Xiang? It's him..." Hearing the land spirit introduce himself, Fang Yuan showed a flash of comprehension.

"Land spirit, do you remember me?" Fang Yuan smiled lightly. "I previously bought star fragment grass and the killer move spring star rain from your main body."

Star Form Child's gaze flickered. Reassessing Fang Yuan, his expression softened: "So it is you, I have some impression."

"A land spirit alone cannot manage the entire blessed land. Would you like to seek refuge with one of us?" Fang Yuan asked directly.

Star Form Child nodded his small head sadly: "To protect this foundation, I need help. But I have conditions."

Star Form Child frowned and pouted, saying angrily: "My main body died in the eighth star hall because of Song Zi Xing. He severely injured my main body, forcing me to expose my secret and explore the grotto-heaven with Immortal Monkey King Shi Lei. To become this blessed land's owner, bring me Song Zi Xing's head!"

"Song Zi Xing's head?" Hearing this condition, Hei Lou Lan laughed bitterly.

Song Zi Xing was a notorious rank seven demonic expert with formidable blood path methods, comparable in strength to Shi Lei.

"Alright, I will give it a try," Fang Yuan agreed calmly.

"Hurry and do your best! Star Form blessed land's earthly calamity is imminent. If it fails, the blessed land will be destroyed, making your efforts futile," Star Form Child urged.

Fang Yuan's eyes flashed: "In that case, I can help you resist the earthly calamity first."

Star Form Child shook his head like a rattle: "I won't let outside Gu Immortals stay in Star Form blessed land over seven minutes. People are unpredictable; only my master may help me pass tribulations. Soon, I will use treasure yellow heaven to spread this news and rally others against that accursed Song Zi Xing!"

Star Form Child laughed: "Don't worry, I won't expose our location. Only those meeting my condition may enter Star Form blessed land. Leave now, and keep this location secret."

With the land spirit seeing them off, Fang Yuan did not linger. Bidding farewell, he and Hei Lou Lan exited the blessed land back into Earth Abyss.

The moment they stepped into Earth Abyss, the door behind them vanished completely.

Silently erasing their traces, Fang Yuan and Hei Lou Lan used Fixed Immortal Travel to return to Hu Immortal blessed land.

Now safe, they immediately began splitting the loot.

"Our journey into Starry Sky grotto-heaven was safe and vastly profitable. Had I known, I wouldn't have agreed to a forty-sixty split," Hei Lou Lan sighed, retrieving the loot from her immortal aperture.

"Why so many desolate beast corpses? This boar looks ancient. Eh, this lion isn't dead yet!" Little Hu Immortal was immediately drawn to the beasts.

A blazing divine stallion, flying bear, star demon bat, chestnut yak—seven desolate beast corpses in total, plus a near-dead yellow jade lion.

"Seven desolate beast corpses are worth about two hundred and eighty immortal essence stones, the dying yellow jade lion around eighty, and the astral wind flying heavenly boar corpse four hundred. The diamond soil is worth about thirty immortal essence stones, and excluding the mysterious trees for now, our total profit is seven hundred and ninety immortal essence stones."

Facing nearly eight hundred immortal essence stones, even Fang Yuan sighed inwardly.

He had never experienced this before; across the five hundred years of his previous life, his peak savings had been merely sixty-odd immortal essence stones.

"We made such huge profits without fighting or expending immortal essence; we merely picked them up for free," Fang Yuan said calmly.

"That monkey is probably fuming. Will he attack Hu Immortal blessed land?" Hei Lou Lan asked, worried by the massive sum.

"No," Fang Yuan shook his head. "A rank seven Gu Immortal like Shi Lei possesses at least several thousand immortal essence stones!"

Fang Yuan analyzed: "Central Continent's ten great ancient sects have long histories compared to other regions' super forces. They value order, stability, and reputation. Shi Lei will seek revenge through righteous suppression rather than force, since we are now part of Immortal Crane Sect."

"How will we split Star Form blessed land?" Hei Lou Lan asked seriously, unwilling to yield such massive profit.

Fang Yuan pondered, then said: "Since it is hard to divide, let us compete fairly. Whoever fulfills the land spirit's condition first claims Star Form blessed land without compensating the other. If anyone else, even Fairy Li Shan or Tai Bai Yun Sheng, tries to contest it, we unite to stop them. What do you think?"

Hei Lou Lan nodded with flickering eyes: "That works best!"

# Chapter 730: Giving You Qingpu Tea

Central Continent, Bai Qing blessed land.

Reclining against a tall tree on the grassy ground, Feng Jin Huang inhaled deeply, savoring the breeze and fragrant grass.

Holding the exquisite book The Legends of Ren Zu, Feng Jin Huang had already reached its final pages.

At the book's end, Ren Zu's ten children had died one after another, and Ren Zu himself neared death from old age. Before dying, Ren Zu gathered his children's corpses and sacrificed himself, feeding them all to derivation Gu.

Drawn by the aroma, vast dream realms entered derivation Gu's mouth alongside them.

Derivation Gu's stomach burst, shining life's light across the lands to create the first mortals.

"Because dream realms were involved in derivation, mortals dreamed in their sleep. Like Northern Dark Ice Soul, humans often sink too deeply into dreams to escape." Feng Jin Huang closed The Legends of Ren Zu and stood up.

"Mother, send me back to the building. I am tired." She said softly.

"Okay," Fairy Bai Qing's gentle voice echoed beside her.

Feng Jin Huang vanished, reappearing in her room inside the building.

In the room, Fairy Bai Qing was already waiting.

Feng Jin Huang beamed: "Mother, why are you free today? Don't you need to assimilate earth qi?"

Fairy Bai Qing looked dotingly at her daughter: "Huang Er, this dream realm trained your mentality well. In the past, you would have complained and demanded my company. Yet this time, while I assimilated earth qi for three days and nights, you quietly read and refined Gu. You have matured greatly; mother is very pleased."

"Of course!" Feng Jin Huang smiled proudly, the bells on her phoenix coronet chiming. "I am my parents' daughter—how could I tarnish your reputations!"

Fairy Bai Qing smiled back: "Since mortals first appeared, nearly everyone has dreamed. Over the ages, countless geniuses and even Venerables have left behind dream realms. Together, these form an unprecedentedly vast hidden realm. Huang Er, your Dream Wings Immortal Gu lets you traverse dream realms freely without being influenced! This is a huge opportunity you must utilize well."

"I understand, mother. Lately, I discovered my refinement path attainment reached quasi-master level. Despite never practicing refinement path before, the dream realm's benefits are simply immense. My attainment rose so sharply after that dream realm that I've surpassed many in the sect," Feng Jin Huang sighed.

"You navigated Old Immortal Kong Jue's dream and absorbed some of his refinement path true meaning. Because he was a supreme grandmaster, you gained immensely. Dream realms are complex, and you might not be so fortunate next time to find someone of his caliber," Fairy Bai Qing analyzed.

Fairy Bai Qing turned solemn: "Huang Er, do not lower your guard. You emerged safe this time only because the dream realm happened to be harmless. If you ever enter a Venerable's dream, retreat immediately; their power exceeds all imagination."

Softening her expression, Fairy Bai Qing produced a letter Gu: "Your father breached the regional wall and found shelter in Northern Plains. He has not learned of your awakening yet. We can reply through this letter Gu to relieve his worries during his Northern Plains mission."

Fairy Bai Qing then produced another letter sending green bird Gu, a rank five mortal Gu.

"Here is another letter for you from Fang Yuan, sent long ago," Fairy Bai Qing said.

"Fang Yuan!" Feng Jin Huang gritted her teeth, her sharp brows knitting as her face flushed with indignation.

She snatched the letter Gu and checked it.

In the letter, Fang Yuan praised Spirit Affinity House, accepted Feng Jin Huang's challenge, and apologized for the delayed reply.

At the end, he wrote: I await Fairy Feng Jin Huang in Hu Immortal blessed land. I have heard that Spirit Affinity House's qingpu tea is renowned. If you spar with me, savoring this famous tea would be truly enjoyable.

"Hmph! He wants to enjoy qingpu tea? Evil scoundrel! Lecherous thief! I'll tear you to pieces and feed your bones to dogs!" Feng Jin Huang's eyes blazed, squeezing the letter sending green bird Gu until it chirped in distress.

Fairy Bai Qing swiftly rescued the Gu: "Huang Er, Fang Yuan has exceeded our expectations again. He is not who he was—if you spar now, you cannot win."

"What?" Feng Jin Huang stared at Fairy Bai Qing in shock.

Fairy Bai Qing explained that Fang Yuan was now an immortal zombie whose mysterious backers repelled Immortal Crane Sect's assault.

"An immortal zombie? He became an immortal zombie?" Feng Jin Huang muttered, finding it unbelievable had her mother not said so.

Fairy Bai Qing spoke solemnly: "Fang Yuan sent this right before Immortal Crane Sect attacked, intending to establish ties with Spirit Affinity House to introduce a third party. Holding Dang Hun Mountain and trading with the ten ancient sects, his name is known to almost every Gu Immortal in Central Continent."

"Will you ignore or reply to this letter? I'll let you decide," Fairy Bai Qing tested her.

Feng Jin Huang said immediately: "Of course we will reply! Since this challenge was set by me, and he has already responded. If I avoid battle because he is an immortal zombie, then I would be showing weakness."

"However..." Her eyes shifted. "He is strong while I am weak, so head-on confrontation is foolish. Soon, the Central Continent Refinement Path Convention begins. I'll defeat him publicly in refinement path! That will soothe my anger. Mother, what do you think?"

Fairy Bai Qing nodded in satisfaction: "This is a good idea."

Drafting her reply, Feng Jin Huang chuckled coldly: "You want qingpu tea? I'll send fifty jars! But any competition needs a wager—I will make you lose both reputation and substance!"

# Chapter 731: Four to You, Six to Me

Northern Plains, Lang Ya blessed land.

"Land spirit, I brought a living desolate beast; come look," Fang Yuan said, opening his immortal aperture and activating a dozen Gu to set the lion on the ground.

Pleased with the yellow jade lion, Lang Ya land spirit promptly handed Fang Yuan eighty-eight immortal essence stones along with the killer move unfamiliar face.

Fang Yuan examined the details before Lang Ya land spirit.

This killer move had extraordinary origins, created by Thieving Heaven Demon Venerable.

"As expected of Thieving Heaven Demon Venerable's ingenious creativity," Fang Yuan praised. "Only three hundred Gu worms are used, yet they span six paths including transformation, strength, and wisdom. Hmm.., several Gu are rare. Collecting them to assemble this killer move will take time. Lang Ya, do you have them?"

Lang Ya land spirit shook his head with a chuckle: "Why keep them? I can't use it. Unfamiliar face, vaguely familiar face, and familiar face form a trilogy. Yours is merely the mortal killer move, disguising you only as a stranger. The latter two are immortal killer moves that prevent exposure even when impersonating acquaintances. Thieving Heaven Demon Venerable left an inheritance behind; perhaps you might obtain the other two killer moves in your lifetime."

He recalled obtaining clues in Northern Plains regarding Thieving Heaven Demon Venerable's Luo Po Valley inheritance.

Clearing his mind, Fang Yuan handed over three completed Immortal Gu recipes: "Here is our current transaction."

Inspecting the recipes and finding no issues, Lang Ya land spirit praised: "Rascal, I rarely admire anyone, but your deduction talent truly impresses me."

"Land spirit, I wanted to discuss changing the terms of our Immortal Gu recipe transactions," Fang Yuan said.

"I've completed all your recipes with high completion rates. The remainder have only sixty to seventy percent, or even under fifty percent. I suggest that we change the details of our transaction..."

Fang Yuan laughed confidently: "My suggestion is this: from now on, you take charge of deducing the Immortal Gu recipes. Whenever you get stuck, I will help you deduce the next step over that hurdle, charging only two immortal essence stones each time."

Fang Yuan laughed: "Land spirit, this transaction benefits you too. Having gained so many Immortal Gu recipes and regained your freedom, you can refine Immortal Gu again. When refining Immortal Gu, the vast majority of attempts fail with an abysmal success rate, expending immense resources. I am helping you save immortal essence stones—shouldn't you thank me?"

"Hmph, I knew you would say that." Lang Ya land spirit rolled his eyes. "I can agree, but on one condition."

"It is a long story. Do you know about Qin Bai Sheng's auction?" Unable to leave the blessed land, Lang Ya land spirit was nonetheless well-informed about Northern Plains affairs.

"Of course I know." Fang Yuan nodded.

Lang Ya land spirit continued: "You know a mysterious force attacked my Lang Ya blessed land some time ago. They failed, and I captured several Gu Immortals. I intend to sell them all—or rather, sell their blessed lands."

"Selling blessed lands?" Fang Yuan looked at Lang Ya land spirit in shock; this was a massive move.

Fang Yuan's expression turned solemn: "That would be a thousand times more popular than my guts Gu business! Buying these blessed lands allows Gu Immortals to swallow them, raising their cultivation and skipping tribulations and calamities. Why didn't you keep them for yourself?"

Lang Ya land spirit shook his head: "To swallow a rank six blessed land requires master attainment in that path; a rank seven requires grandmaster, and a rank eight grotto-heaven demands great grandmaster. Although my refinement path attainment is high, I am not involved in many other paths. And the most important reason is, I do not want to devour them. My Lang Ya blessed land has already reached the limits of a blessed land, any progress would elevate it to a grotto-heaven. A grotto-heaven's tribulations are far more dangerous. Back then, I purposely weakened Lang Ya grotto-heaven until it became a blessed land, why would I raise it up again?"

Fang Yuan understood: "That is true. Wait, your condition is for me to sell these blessed lands at the auction in your stead?"

Lang Ya land spirit gave a thumbs-up, flattering him: "You are a smart lad!"

Fang Yuan stared with wide eyes: "Do you want to get me killed? Absolutely not! Selling these blessed lands will make me everyone's target! It attracts too much attention—how could I have the ability to capture all these Gu Immortals? If I appear like this, that mysterious force would know and associate me with Lang Ya blessed land. Next time when they attack you, they might even attack my blessed land! Isn't the Inkman King Mo Tan Sang your good friend, ask him to go."

"Don't make it sound so terrible. Don't you have the killer move unfamiliar face? With it, other Gu Immortals cannot identify your true form," Lang Ya land spirit said in a low tone.

Fang Yuan appraised the land spirit: "I wondered why you were so generous in giving me this precious killer move. You had a plan from the start."

Unable to take it anymore, Lang Ya land spirit glared furiously and shouted: "Rascal, do you think I don't know you?! You have ridiculous guts—since when have you been scared? You even destroyed Imperial Court blessed land and toppled Eighty-Eight True Yang Building, as long as the benefits are high enough, you are a desperado! Afraid of this matter? Just tell me, how much do you want?"

Fang Yuan snorted coldly: "We will split the profits from selling the blessed lands—at least a four to six ratio."

"Four to six ratio? You are too greedy, demanding forty percent?!" Lang Ya land spirit screamed.

Cold light flashed in Fang Yuan's grim eyes: "You are wrong, land spirit. My intention is: I take sixty percent, you take forty!"

He took a deep breath, staring at Fang Yuan: "You actually have the nerve to say that?"

"Why wouldn't I?" Fang Yuan's face was thick as a city wall. "I am taking a huge life-threatening risk; without enough profit, I will not do it. This is already my lowest friendly price as old friends."

"No deal then? Think it over. There is still time before the auction—I am leaving first." Fang Yuan opened a stargate.

"Get lost!"

# Chapter 732: Top Tier Mortal Killer Move

Hu Immortal blessed land, Dang Hun palace.

Fang Yuan sat cross-legged on a cushion, intently studying a pair of bat wings before him.

A pair of large bat wings hovered before him, covered in thin, pinkie-sized eerie blue scales that refracted light like starlight.

After returning from Lang Ya blessed land, Fang Yuan began repairing the star demon bat wings. After nine days and nights of effort, he reached the crucial moment.

The mortal Gu turned into a drop of jade-green liquid, shooting into the bat wings and casting a layer of green light.

Standing outside the door, Fang Yuan lightly stamped his foot, calling: "Land spirit."

"Master, master, you called for me!" Little Hu Immortal immediately appeared beside Fang Yuan, eyes shining with joy at seeing her master.

"How is the business in treasure yellow heaven going?" Fang Yuan asked as he walked.

Little Hu Immortal followed closely, replying: "Master put the desolate beast corpses up for sale in treasure yellow heaven, but only one has sold so far."

However, Fang Yuan did not want immortal essence stones this time.

He left a will informing other Gu Immortals that buying these beast corpses required exchanging specific goods.

First was a method or clues for immortal zombies to turn back into humans.

Second was the recipe, the Gu worm itself, or clues regarding white lotus giant silkworm Gu.

Third was the wings of bat desolate beasts.

Fourth was top-tier mortal killer moves—the more outstanding, the better.

Fifth was bone path Gu worms like Battle Bone Wheel that could form the killer move White Bone Chariot.

Last was wisdom path inheritances or related clues.

With such strict conditions, only one corpse sold after twelve days in Hu Immortal blessed land.

"Oh? What did that beast corpse exchange for?" Fang Yuan asked excitedly.

"One whole chestnut yak was exchanged for a pair of bat desolate beast wings and an investigative killer move called hundred li eye." Little Hu Immortal replied.

"Hundred li eye..." Fang Yuan nodded. "This mortal killer move is valued at six immortal essence stones, allowing a Gu Immortal to observe scenery within a hundred li as clearly as palm lines. Good, I was lacking this kind of investigative killer move. But of course, the greatest satisfaction in this transaction is that I obtained another pair of desolate beast bat wings."

Yet Fang Yuan dared not slacken. Ever since seeing the external manifestation of a dream realm in Starry Sky grotto-heaven, he felt urgency, sensing the waves of a new era approaching.

Over the next few days, Fang Yuan began processing the newly obtained bat wings.

Fang Yuan entered the secret room and stood before the green-haired bat wings.

By now, the green hair on the bat wings had grown extremely thick and lush.

"Success or failure will be decided now." Fang Yuan activated a mortal Gu, snapping a spark flying outward.

The spark reached the wings and ignited the hair in a flash of green fire.

The fire appeared quickly and disappeared just as quickly.

The green hair burned away, revealing charred black bat wings covered in thick ash.

Fang Yuan showed a trace of disappointment: "Failure."

He softly exhaled; when the weak breath touched the bat wings, they collapsed to the ground like charcoal and shattered.

"Fortunately, I have another pair of bat wings." Quickly overcoming his disappointment, Fang Yuan was soon busy refining.

# Chapter 733: Recognizing one's own ordinariness

With previous refinement experience, Fang Yuan found this second attempt at refining desolate beast bat wings much easier.

After half a month, he transplanted the desolate beast bat wings onto his back, choosing to retain their sensation of pain.

# Chapter 740: Nine Heavens Fragment

Three rank seven Gu Immortals from Combat Immortal Sect gathered in this sky.

Blessed lands brought fortune, but heaven and earth maintained balance through periodic calamities and tribulations.

Rank six Gu Immortals faced an earthly calamity every ten years and a heavenly tribulation every hundred. Thus, heavenly tribulations served as the benchmark for cultivation; in his previous life, Fang Yuan had passed two heavenly tribulations.

Surviving three heavenly tribulations advanced a rank six Gu Immortal's blessed land, elevating them to rank seven.

Rank seven Gu Immortals face an earthly calamity every ten years, a heavenly tribulation every fifty years, and a grand tribulation every one hundred years. Qian Zhu Xian and Valley Lord Ming He were one grand tribulation Gu Immortals, while Divine Mother Jue Kong was a level higher than them, being at two grand tribulations cultivation level.

As for rank eight Gu Immortals, they no longer experienced any earthly calamities, but they faced a heavenly tribulation every ten years, a grand tribulation every fifty years, and a myriad tribulation every one hundred years.

Far more terrifying than heavenly tribulations, myriad tribulations were dubbed 'hopeless myriad tribulations' among Gu Immortals due to their extreme difficulty.

Thus, nine heavens fragments were much more precious.

The immemorial nine heavens belonged to the main world. Calamities and tribulations struck only immortal aperture worlds like blessed lands and grotto-heavens, never the five regions or nine heavens.

By devouring a nine heavens fragment, a grotto-heaven essentially became part of the main world, greatly weakening tribulations and surviving even if the Gu Immortal died. Starry Sky grotto-heaven, for instance, remained intact despite Seven Star Child turning into an immortal zombie.

"The benefits of absorbing a nine heavens fragment are immense, but so is the drawback: absorbing even a sliver takes in the greater world's aura. Once rooted into it, the grotto-heaven can never be retrieved into your body again," Divine Mother Jue Kong reminded them.

Qian Zhu Xian nodded: "The Gu Immortal loses their freedom, confined to their aperture, yet if a nine heavens fragment appeared before me, I would take it without hesitation!"

# Chapter 746: Joyful News, A Way To Escape The Zombie Body

Tai Bai Yun Sheng chuckled: "Your concern is valid, junior brother. But the good news is that neither Su Bai Man nor Shark Demon left a mark with Time Anchor beforehand."

"Back then, Su Bai Man repelled her enemies and obtained Time Anchor without knowing its usage. Heavily injured, she had no choice but to become an immortal zombie. Learning of this, Shark Demon chose to become an immortal zombie despite ample lifespan just to accompany his wife. Only years later did they discover Time Anchor's origin and usage."

Tai Bai Yun Sheng continued: "When they discovered its usage, they were full of regret, but it was already too late. I raised the same concern during the banquet, and Shark Demon mentioned an alternative method: Spring Autumn Cicada."

Without suspecting anything, Tai Bai Yun Sheng added: "Spring Autumn Cicada is unreliable, mentioned only as an example. Shark Demon meant that even if one missed the timing for Time Anchor, using an Immortal Gu like Spring Autumn Cicada could bring a Gu Immortal before the River of Time. One could then place a mark upstream with Time Anchor and successfully use Man as Before. I believe this method has a high chance of success."

"Besides Spring Autumn Cicada, other time path Immortal Gu like Looking Back and Vivid Recollection allow a Gu Immortal to stand in the present and observe the past, though with distinct differences. Refining the two together yields the rank eight Immortal Gu Extreme Past, allowing a Gu Immortal's will to traverse the River of Time and observe everything in the past."

Fang Yuan deduced inwardly: "If I had the time path investigative Immortal Gu Extreme Past, combining it with Time Anchor might allow me to create an immortal killer move that marks the past from the present. Then I could use Man as Before to revive into a living human without losing Wisdom Gu. Of course, Extreme Past is just an example; other time path Immortal Gu might be even more compatible with Time Anchor."

"Old Bai, thank you." He thanked Tai Bai Yun Sheng sincerely: "Although this method is innovative, it would demand tremendous time, effort, and resources—at least a hundred-year endeavor. But it is still a beacon of hope."

Understanding Fang Yuan's meaning, Tai Bai Yun Sheng sighed: "Indeed, it is hope at least. Though it will take time, you can use Zombie Alliance's black oil in the interim to slow your blessed land's destruction. # Chapter 786: One Against Two Rank Sevens

# Chapter 791: Unstoppable Life Chasing Fire

Immortal killer move — Life Chasing Fire!

Old Lord Can Yang looked solemn, opening his palm to reveal a faint flame.

# Chapter 807: People Who Refuse to be Ordinary

The Legends of Ren Zu, Chapter Three, Section Eighteen states:

Embarking on his road of life, Ren Zu left the door of life and death, only to end up in ordinary abyss.

Cognition Gu advised: "Human, following others' trails offers no hope if you wish to become extraordinary and leave ordinary abyss. Since you walk your own road of life, you must brave every hardship yourself, innovating and carving your own footprints."

Cognition Gu added: "You cannot become extraordinary while seeking comfort—walk through the thorns and blades."

Taking the hint, Ren Zu gritted his teeth and deliberately walked along paths covered in thorns and blades.

Whenever he lifted his foot and moved forward, a small stem of grass grew in his footprint.

The name of this grass was — accomplishment.

"This way, I won't lose my way." Ren Zu endured the pain, tenaciously trudging through thorns and blades.

Gradually, the grass growing from his footprints turned into accomplishment trees.

Even after the forest covered the entire ordinary abyss, Ren Zu found no way out.

He plucked a fruit and tasted it, but it no longer tasted sweet, only bitter and hard to swallow.

Perplexed, Ren Zu investigated and discovered that a second heart had quietly grown within his body.

This heart was called discontent.

His heart spoke in self Gu's voice: "Plant an accomplishment tree taller than ordinary abyss, and you can climb it to escape."

Self Gu said: "Foot blood produces only ordinary trees. Use heart blood to grow a great accomplishment tree. Blades lie buried under ordinary abyss—stab your heart with them, and use the flowing heart blood to water the trees."

The more blades he drove in, the more heart blood flowed, growing ever larger trees.

When a tree's crown finally reached the height of ordinary abyss, its trunk cracked open and a girl emerged.

This was Ren Zu's fourth child, called Boundless Forest Samsara.

Boundless Forest Samsara urged him: "Father, why exhaust yourself? We have fruit, shelter, and peace here until old age."

Ren Zu firmly shook his head, planting an even greater tree whose branches stretched completely beyond ordinary abyss.

Boundless Forest Samsara wept, clinging to him: "Father, don't abandon me. I cannot climb trees—I will starve alone."

Ren Zu said: "Why would I abandon you? You are my daughter, I will carry you and leave this place."

Cognition Gu warned: "This is your accomplishment tree; it cannot help others become extraordinary, not even your daughter."

Hope Gu urged: "Put her down! Your heart blood is exhausted—this is your last hope, and the tree is collapsing!"

Seeing Ren Zu's stubbornness and the other Gu worms' failure to persuade him, self Gu flew out.

"Ah, this is killing me!" Without consulting Ren Zu, self Gu bit down on Boundless Forest Samsara's hand.

Losing her grip, she tumbled off Ren Zu's back and crashed to the ground in agony.

"It's too late, the tree is going to fall!" Self Gu pushed Ren Zu, prompting him to step forward and escape ordinary abyss!

At the cliff's edge with no way back, Ren Zu cried helplessly: "Daughter, I will return to save you."

"It's useless," self Gu said. "A grand person is extraordinary—how could you re-enter ordinary abyss?"

Hu Immortal blessed land, Dang Hun palace.

Fang Yuan closed The Legends of Ren Zu, sighing with a complex expression.

Discontent with being ordinary was human nature; Dong Fang Chang Fan was like this, and so was Fang Yuan.

"In this aspect, you and I are the same type of people." Fang Yuan said plainly.

Restrained before him, Dong Fang Chang Fan's soul smiled coldly, transmitting his voice through the resonance of his soul.

He heard Northern Plains' number one wisdom path Gu Immortal say: "If you want to search my soul, go ahead! But obtaining my inheritance is harder than you think, hehe."

# Chapter 808: Unyielding Spirit, More Soul Searching

# Chapter 819: Returning To The Blessed Land, Putting Up A Show

Hu Immortal blessed land.

# Chapter 820: Insufficient Wealth To Refine Immortal Gu

The dao marks formed a resilient battlefield in space, turning entering Gu Immortals' thoughts into star thoughts that fueled the fireflies' attacks and converted enemy power into offensive force.

Instead of answering, Fang Yuan asked: "Old Bai, do you know the phrase, 'man is the spirit of all living beings, Gu are the essence of heaven and earth'?"

# Chapter 821: Strategy To Attack Blessed Land, Conversation About Dao

Tai Bai Yun Sheng was stunned before laughing: "Junior brother, you mock me! I've heard that phrase countless times since beginning cultivation; it has rung in my ears ever since. Even mortals know it."

Fang Yuan nodded: "This phrase originated from the first rank nine Gu Immortal, Primordial Origin Immortal Venerable. Yet in my opinion, it is not brilliant enough. I summarize it in a single word—Dao."

Tai Bai Yun Sheng sat up straight, eyes shining as he repeated: "Please enlighten me."

Fang Yuan said slowly: "Man is the spirit of all living beings—possessing the highest intelligence and comprehension, humans understand heaven and earth to experience the Great Dao. Gu are the essence of heaven and earth. Uniquely among living beings, mortal Gu contain meager traces of the Great Dao, while Immortal Gu harbor law fragments. Hence, they are the essence of heaven and earth."

"What is Dao? Water flowing downward, hunger, trees growing from rain—all are Dao. Gu Masters unleashing fire, lightning, or healing wounds with Gu worms are likewise Dao."

"By nurturing, using, and refining Gu, humans utilize Gu worms to display the might of heaven and earth, gradually grasping the laws of the world through life and procreation. Upon becoming a Gu Immortal, the aperture turns immortal, and dao marks are carved onto the body. One could say Gu Masters nurture Dao when nurturing Gu, use Dao when using Gu, and refine Dao when refining Gu. Gu Masters walk diverse paths—strength, fire, time, poison—each forged step-by-step into cultivation routes by predecessors exploring the unknown."

Fang Yuan paused before concluding: "In other words, Gu Master cultivation is fundamentally cultivating Dao."

"When Gu Masters cultivate, they are basically cultivating Dao..." Tai Bai Yun Sheng sat frowning as he pondered Fang Yuan's words.

Fang Yuan continued: "The immortal aperture—a blessed land or grotto-heaven—is a small world containing dao expressed solely through dao marks."

"For instance, my Hu Immortal blessed land possesses basic time path dao marks, allowing it to draw in a tributary of the River of Time so time can flow within. It also has substantial space path dao marks, keeping it vast and allowing Hu Immortal land spirit to teleport freely. It is richest in enslavement path dao marks. Because of these marks, Hu Immortal blessed land aids in raising foxes, enslaving fox-like beast groups, and promoting the growth of desolate beasts."

Tai Bai Yun Sheng nodded in agreement: "Exactly! My Tai Bai blessed land has mostly time path dao marks, making time resources abundant—one day outside equals thirty-three days within. Having the fewest earth path dao marks, it lacks mountains and has infertile soil. In terms of space path dao marks, it is only ordinary—the area isn't large, but the sky is very high."

"That is why I said a blessed land's offense and defense boil down entirely to its composition of dao marks," Fang Yuan continued.

"Blessed lands restrict enemies and suppress their Gu worms because their abundant dao marks act like a pond. Mortal Gu contain traces of Dao, like water droplets or sparks. Dropped into a pond, a droplet easily merges, while a spark is easily extinguished. Once the blessed land's dao marks activate, heavenly power is enforced and mortal Gu lose effect."

"Why are Immortal Gu unrestricted? Because they are unique law fragments, like rocks. Toss a rock into a pond, and no ripple can halt its entry. Yet while Immortal Gu cannot be sealed, their power is amplified or suppressed by the blessed land's dao marks."

"Invading Gu Immortals are similarly suppressed by a blessed land's dao marks. Yet Gu Immortals possess immortal bodies fundamentally different from mortals—simply put, bodies carved with dao marks! During an invasion, the more dao marks a blessed land has, the greater the suppression on the immortal; conversely, the more dao marks on the Gu Immortal's body, the less suppression they experience."

"Truly insightful!" Tai Bai Yun Sheng sighed in realization. "I understand now. Public blessed lands have weak defenses because they are pieced together from fragments sacrificed by numerous Gu Immortals. Their dao marks are chaotically mixed, canceling each other out without forming cohesive strength—like five fingers from different people, they act individually rather than forming a fist."

"Blessed land that have a sole origin also have dao marks that are pure. If there are land spirits, they can expend immortal essence and mobilize the dao marks to use the heavenly power. Immortal Gu are the law fragments, there are dao marks on the desolate beasts' bodies, Gu Immortals have been mentioned already, Immortal Gu Houses are formed by combining Immortal Gu, while immortal killer moves are the fusion of many types of dao marks, they are an effect or great power formed from varying sources."

"Thus, the purer a blessed land's dao marks, the harder it is to conquer; land spirits and immortal essence merely assist in mobilizing them. Looking at Imperial Court blessed land, if not for the land spirit and Eighty-Eight True Yang Building contesting against each other, if it was fully protected, how could it be destroyed?"

Saying this, Tai Bai Yun Sheng rose, straightened his posture, and bowed to Fang Yuan: "Hearing your words has truly enlightened me, answering my questions and teaching me much. From today onwards, I would not dare to call you junior brother, a skilled person is a teacher, on the road of cultivation, you have already surpassed me."

"Hehehe, Old Bai, this is just casual talk. No need to be humble; you already knew this deep down, just less clearly than me." Fang Yuan waved his hand, calm and composed.

Tai Bai Yun Sheng looked solemn: "No, simple as it is, this reasoning is profound. The concept of 'dao' far surpasses the adage 'man is the spirit of all living beings, Gu are the essence of heaven and earth." I was quite ignorant in the past, only now have I seen the essence of Gu Master cultivation. This reasoning, I am afraid ordinary Gu Immortals have not comprehended it yet.""

In truth, Fang Yuan understood this because of his advantage as a transmigrator.

The two spoke a while longer before Tai Bai Yun Sheng took his leave.

Though they had regularly communicated via Gu, this face-to-face talk erased any lingering distance between them.

Consuming green grape immortal essence, Time Luck Immortal Gu worked alongside the supporting mortal Gu to form a vast white-gold mist of light.

The radiant mist drifted through the grey sky for several li toward a group of captive Gu Masters.

As the mist enveloped them, the captives screamed: "What is this thing?"

The spiral spun briefly before erupting into a towering white-gold pillar of light.

Immortal killer move —Time Assist Luck!

Simultaneously, the white-gold spiral inside his aperture dispersed, leaving the Dong Fang tribe captives dead across the decaying ground.

"I won't give in!"

Moments later, Fang Yuan's soul made a full recovery, returning to peak condition.

Tempered like forged steel, his soul was now denser, firmer, and more refined than before.
