# Chapter 1003: Fang Yuan Defeats Bo Qing in One Move!

Since this formation had succeeded, Fang Yuan was no longer in a hurry to retreat.

Just as in his previous life, Fixed Immortal Travel was ineffective within this formation.

Even with the Immortal Gu House Graceful Chaotic Duel Stage, breaking through the ninety-percent-complete ten extreme immortal zombie lifeless formation would take time.

Emerging now would make him an open target: the Southern Border Gu Immortals would not let him go, and Shadow Sect would never watch him claim the Immortal Gu House.

"Suppress the Great Strength True Martial immortal zombie first, then find an opportunity to forcibly break through with the Immortal Gu House!" Fang Yuan concentrated on his target.

To Fang Yuan's shock, the immortal zombie still retained considerable strength.

Facing Fang Yuan's continuous offense, it activated Immortal Gu to mobilize battle will, resisting fiercely and decisively.

"This immortal zombie is an astute schemer! After failing to refine the Immortal Gu House with battle will, it fell into deep slumber from exhaustion. During sleep, it accumulated strength hoping to overturn the situation upon waking," Fang Yuan deduced, feeling involuntary admiration for such an opponent.

While Fang Yuan dealt with the Great Strength True Martial immortal zombie, the situation above Yi Tian Mountain shifted rapidly.

As in his previous life, increasingly terrifying waves of tribulations descended upon the Southern Border Gu Immortals, inflicting severe losses.

Just as before, they mistook Ying Wu Xie for the greatest flaw, only to be stopped in defeat by the immortal killer move lead soul into dream.

Under Graceful Chaotic Duel Stage, the Great Strength True Martial immortal zombie's resistance grew steadily weaker over time.

While Fang Yuan slowly saw hope, the Southern Border Gu Immortals had already lost theirs.

The two surviving rank eights were heavily injured, fleeing frantically between the tribulations and Shadow Sect's onslaught.

Meanwhile, high in the sky, a tall white tower hovered quietly.

Immortal Gu House Heaven Overseeing Tower!

"Tower Lord, the Southern Border Gu Immortals are almost all dead. Should we make a move now?" Bi Chen Tian asked.

Gripping his walking stick, Heaven Overseeing Tower Lord used Heaven Overseeing Tower to pierce all obstacles and view the battlefield below clearly.

"No wonder Shadow Sect tried every method to capture that Great Strength True Martial immortal zombie under the mountain," Lian Jiu Sheng realized.

Heaven Overseeing Tower Lord stroked his beard: "Capturing the Great Strength True Martial immortal zombie is not easy; they must bypass Graceful Chaotic Duel Stage. Let us wait. Bo Qing and the others have yet to appear."

"Heavenly Court is still not making a move?" Far away, Bo Qing gazed at the sky solemnly.

"Since he won't make a move, we will." Song Zi Xing's voice came through an information path Gu worm.

Bo Qing nodded: "Let me go first."

The next moment, dazzling light shot into the sky as a majestic Immortal Gu House appeared in everyone's vision.

The Immortal Gu House soared into the sky before crashing fiercely onto Yi Tian Mountain.

Fang Yuan's expression was ashen, his eyes shining with a cold brilliance.

"Immortal Gu House Sacred Feather City!" He gritted his teeth, never expecting the featherman Gu Immortals' former stronghold to appear at this crucial moment.

The Sacred Feather City directly smashed down, Fang Yuan had to activate Graceful Chaotic Duel Stage to resist it.

"Graceful Chaotic Duel Stage, rise!"

Fang Yuan commanded resolutely, shedding his concealment to reveal his true body.

Yi Tian Mountain instantly crumbled, while Graceful Chaotic Duel Stage shot towards the sky like a crimson meteor.

Its space path Gu worms released a powerful, formless force that instantly transported Fang Yuan inside.

Right now, Fang Yuan was officially controlling Graceful Chaotic Duel Stage!

"Merely Sacred Feather City..." Fang Yuan snorted inwardly, releasing rank nine yellow apricot immortal essence with a flourish of his hand.

Originally shrouded in a few meters of red light, Graceful Chaotic Duel Stage erupted like a volcano upon using yellow apricot immortal essence, expanding to fifteen or twenty meters!

"What?" Bo Qing, controlling Sacred Feather City, called out in shock.

An earth-shaking explosion erupted, Sacred Feather City was ruthlessly sent flying by Graceful Chaotic Duel Stage.

Countless walls, gates, and tiles flew everywhere, disintegrating into Gu worm corpses that scattered into the air.

Without a doubt, Fang Yuan had defeated Bo Qing in a single move!

# Chapter 1004: Deep Underlying Schemes, Great Danger

Using this opportunity, Fang Yuan maneuvered Graceful Chaotic Duel Stage, turning around in the sky and crashing towards Yi Tian Mountain again.

"Great Strength True Martial immortal zombie, you are mine! Hmm?" As Graceful Chaotic Duel Stage charged down, a second Immortal Gu House blocked his path.

This Immortal Gu House was pitch-black, giving off a metallic luster.

Eyes shining brightly, Fang Yuan gritted his teeth and charged down again.

With an ear-splitting roar, the two Immortal Gu Houses crashed into each other.

Despite Graceful Chaotic Duel Stage's mighty charge, the iron fortress-like Immortal Gu House managed to hold it off.

"Graceful Chaotic Duel Stage is rank seven, and this Immortal Gu House is likely a rank seven specialized in defense," Fang Yuan realized.

Fang Yuan's attempt failed, he immediately tried to retreat, leaving this troublesome place.

The third and fourth Immortal Gu Houses appeared consecutively.

Four Immortal Gu Houses trapped Graceful Chaotic Duel Stage under Fang Yuan's control.

Fang Yuan charged in all directions, but obstructed by the four Immortal Gu Houses, he could not gather enough momentum to break out of the ten extreme immortal zombie lifeless formation.

"Why haven't Heavenly Court's Gu Immortals attacked yet?" Fang Yuan wondered, intentionally dialing back Graceful Chaotic Duel Stage's power.

Inside Heaven Overseeing Tower, the white light glowing in Heaven Overseeing Tower Lord's eyes gradually faded.

He smiled coldly: "The person inside Graceful Chaotic Duel Stage is the otherworldly demon Gu Yue Fang Yuan, responsible for Imperial Court blessed land's destruction and Eighty-Eight True Yang Building's collapse! He seems connected to Red Lotus Demon Venerable and Spectral Soul Demon Venerable. Do not assume he is truly suppressed; he is merely baiting us to strike."

Heaven Overseeing Tower Lord waved his hand: "Their relationship is unimportant. Since he wants to lure us into attacking, we shall strike. The ten extreme immortal zombie lifeless formation is crucial to the enemy's plan. I have deduced they secured the final key immortal zombie. Everyone, activate Heaven Overseeing Tower to destroy the formation and ruin their scheme!"

A beam of light shot towards the ten extreme formation.

"I hoped to use Fang Yuan to stall Heavenly Court from attacking, but such a shallow scheme cannot deceive them. Attack!" Envoy Blue, Seven Star Child, commanded upon assessing Shadow Sect's situation.

"Good, Heavenly Court is attacking." Fang Yuan's nascent joy was cut short as three more Immortal Gu Houses emerged!

The three Immortal Gu Houses joined forces to resist Heaven Overseeing Tower's attack.

"Good, good, good. Sacred Feather City, Unbreakable Iron Fortress, Blood River Chariot, Nightmare Castle, Green Wave Pavilion, Weaving Cocoon Manor, Golden Altar... seven Immortal Gu Houses forced out by a single move," Heaven Overseeing Tower Lord's voice echoed from within Heaven Overseeing Tower.

Rank nine Immortal Gu House, Heaven Overseeing Tower, activated fully.

Even inside Graceful Chaotic Duel Stage, Fang Yuan could only see blinding white.

"This... what sort of attack..." When the white light faded, Fang Yuan regained his senses slowly.

In the sky, debris of these Immortal Gu Houses was falling down.

The three Immortal Gu Houses closest to Heaven Overseeing Tower—Green Wave Pavilion, Weaving Cocoon Manor, and Golden Altar—had shattered, while the rest suffered heavy damage.

"Hmph! Otherworldly demon..." Heaven Overseeing Tower Lord glanced at Graceful Chaotic Duel Stage before turning his attention to the ten extreme immortal zombie lifeless formation.

The move earlier had activated fate Immortal Gu, creating an incredibly strong attack.

Meanwhile, Ying Wu Xie flew out of the ten extreme immortal zombie lifeless formation, replaced by the rank eight Great Strength True Martial immortal zombie.

The fully completed ten extreme immortal zombie lifeless formation activated!

Countless immortal apertures were drawn out by the formation's mystical power, resembling starlight.

Fang Yuan finally understood: "This ten extreme immortal zombie lifeless formation is actually a refinement path Gu formation! What is Shadow Sect trying to refine that requires the Southern Border Gu Immortals' immortal apertures as refinement materials?!"

# Chapter 1005: Thousand Year Traitor, Stalling

Heaven Overseeing Tower Lord shouted, gathering the Heavenly Court immortals' strength to unleash Heaven Overseeing Tower's strongest attack again.

"Endure it!" Having anticipated this, the Shadow Sect immortals activated their Immortal Gu Houses and charged upward.

The world turned white.

The attack from fate could not be defended against.

Recovering his senses, Fang Yuan spat a mouthful of blood, his face flushed purple-gold.

Looking out, Fang Yuan saw Unbreakable Iron Fortress, Blood River Chariot, and Nightmare Castle shattered into fragments, raining down from the sky.

Even inside the ten extreme formation, Graceful Chaotic Duel Stage suffered severe damage: two Immortal Gu were crippled, and three of its seven edges broke apart.

Under Fang Yuan's expectant gaze, Heaven Overseeing Tower was surrounded in white light once again.

The gathering white light thickened; once fully charged, it would unleash fate's strongest attack and breach the ten extreme formation.

Boom!

Suddenly, Heaven Overseeing Tower shook immensely, the accumulated white light exploded and vanished.

Heaven Overseeing Tower was heavily damaged and covered in blemishes.

Inside the tower, the Heavenly Court Gu Immortals coughed blood from the backlash.

From Sacred Feather City, Seven Star Child's voice sounded: "Heaven Overseeing Tower Lord, you fell for our trap."

"There are traitors in Heavenly Court!" Heaven Overseeing Tower Lord said grimly, staring at Bi Chen Tian and Lian Jiu Sheng.

"Wait! How could I be a Shadow Sect traitor?!" Bi Chen Tian defended himself in shock and fury. "Joining Heavenly Court requires countless trials. In three million years, when has a traitor ever appeared? This must be Shadow Sect's scheme to sow dissension! Our urgent priority is destroying this refinement path formation!"

"Hahaha..." Lian Jiu Sheng laughed darkly, speaking eerily. "Precisely because it was created three million years ago, those trials are completely outdated. Infiltrating Heavenly Court is hardly difficult."

"Lian Jiu Sheng never existed in the first place. Stop me? Not even a rank nine Immortal Gu House can! Hehehe, survive this first."

Saying this, Lian Jiu Sheng died!

Inside the rank nine Heaven Overseeing Tower, Tower Lord and the others barely managed to quell the consuming winds of assimilation before they spread.

Heaven Overseeing Tower Lord shook his head. "Forty percent of the tower is destroyed. We cannot reuse that earlier attack without causing Heaven Overseeing Tower to break apart!"

Heaven Overseeing Tower was activated, crashing down like a meteor.

Shadow Sect did not block it, opening a gap in the formation to let Heaven Overseeing Tower enter.

Fang Yuan attempted to leave, but Sacred Feather City obstructed him.

Inside the formation, the three Immortal Gu Houses clashed in chaotic battle.

Seven Star Child added: "Indeed, we have Ying Wu Xie. The longer we stall, the higher his cultivation and the stronger his dream path killer move. Dream path surpasses this era; even Heaven Overseeing Tower has virtually no defense against it."

# Chapter 1006: Continuously Going In and Out

The ten extreme immortal zombie lifeless formation had transformed into dark clouds, completely concealing the ten extreme immortal zombies within and foiling Fang Yuan's plan to attack its cores.

"I've reached rank seven cultivation now," Ying Wu Xie said cheerfully inside Sacred Feather City.

"Good, we'll deal with Fang Yuan first and seize Graceful Chaotic Duel Stage!" Seven Star Child replied.

Shadow Sect had specially tailored the dream path killer move, lead soul into dream, for him, preparing Gu worm sets corresponding to every cultivation rank.

Rank seven dream path killer move — Lead Soul Into Dream!

Lead soul into dream's formless power struck toward Graceful Chaotic Duel Stage.

Caught unprepared, Fang Yuan was struck and fell into a dream realm.

In the lake pavilion, Star Constellation Immortal Venerable sang while playing her zither.

"Fallen songs and despondent heroes, difficulty in resisting the trials of fate."

"Bent swords sink in the sand, rising and falling from ancient times, the rumbling of an unceasing heavenly river."

"Alas..."

"Spectral night carries a soul into endless dreams, where can one rest in peace?"

"During spring and autumn body and mind shifts, only heaven's will remains vast and boundless."

Just like before, a new wave of information flowed into Fang Yuan's mind.

"Spectral night carries a soul into endless dreams, where can one rest in peace? Spectral night... endless dreams... so that is the truth behind Shadow Sect!" Fang Yuan shuddered in realization.

Yet just as Sacred Feather City was about to strike Graceful Chaotic Duel Stage, Ying Wu Xie's eyes widened. "Oh no, he escaped!"

Because among all the immortals here, Fang Yuan's dream path attainment was second to Ying Wu Xie's.

Armed with five hundred years of memories, he possessed the immortal killer move — Unravel Dream!

"Old Bai, at this crucial moment, I must rely on you." Fresh out of the dream realm, Fang Yuan patted Tai Bai Yun Sheng's shoulder.

Fang Yuan chuckled. "They have dream path methods that might target you. Bring out Fairy Li Shan and Hei Lou Lan!"

Hei Lou Lan and Fairy Li Shan promptly emerged.

Surveying their surroundings, Hei Lou Lan remarked with a hint of admiration: "Fang Yuan, you truly excel at landing yourself in danger."

Fang Yuan smiled grandly. "What is there to fear? With your help and this Immortal Gu House, they cannot harm us, and victory is within reach. You will be rewarded handsomely afterward."

Hei Lou Lan nodded silently, her eyes shining brightly as she assessed Graceful Chaotic Duel Stage.

# Chapter 1007: Everyone's Abilities Against the Grand Tribulation

"Fairy Li Shan, can you contact Blazing Heaven Demoness now?" Fang Yuan asked while observing the battlefield.

Knowing they had fallen into Fang Yuan's scheme, Fairy Li Shan rolled her eyes and attempted contact.

Soon, she paled and shook her head. "No! This ten extreme formation is formidable enough to restrict my information path methods."

Fang Yuan nodded silently, thinking: "It seems we can only contact this powerful ally after breaking out."

Suddenly, golden light shot out from the sky, shining brightly!

Tens of thousands of golden vajra pearls rained endlessly from the sky.

"Grand tribulation!" Shadow Sect's Gu Immortals were all taken aback.

"Hahaha, the relic vajra tribulation!" Inside Heaven Overseeing Tower, Heavenly Court's Gu Immortals laughed and stroked their beards, recognizing it immediately.

Yet this relic vajra tribulation surpassed a heavenly tribulation—it was a grand tribulation!

Vajra pearls crashed into the dark clouds with crackling sounds.

Under the grand tribulation's might, the ten extreme formation gradually destabilized.

The dark clouds parted, letting the vajra pearls plunge into the formation.

The vajra pearls struck all three Immortal Gu Houses within.

"Fate Gu resides within Heaven Overseeing Tower, refined using heaven's will as a core material! Since these tribulations stem from heaven's will, Heaven Overseeing Tower follows heaven and upholds its justice. Thus, Heaven Overseeing Tower suffers far less damage from tribulations than other Immortal Gu Houses," Heaven Overseeing Tower Lord stated.

"Sacrificing other Immortal Gu Houses to protect Sacred Feather City was all for this moment!"

It flew down and blocked the relic vajra tribulation, helping the ten extreme formation endure much of the pressure.

Fang Yuan laughed aloud. "Hahaha, I was waiting for this! Witness the true power of Graceful Chaotic Duel Stage! Absorb!"

He focused entirely on controlling Graceful Chaotic Duel Stage.

This Immortal Gu House could use time path methods to seal incoming attacks and deflect them back at enemies.

With his allies assisting him and Sacred Feather City occupied by the grand tribulation, Fang Yuan finally had the opportunity to unleash Graceful Chaotic Duel Stage's unique power!

# Chapter 1008: Respective Sacrifices

A mysterious force spread over the flames; every vajra pearl striking the Immortal Gu House was engulfed in red light and sealed within.

Giant Sun Immortal Venerable's rank nine immortal essence allowed Graceful Chaotic Duel Stage to unleash its full potential.

"After battling so long, that portion of Giant Sun's immortal essence wasn't even thirty percent depleted. Yet absorbing a hundred vajra pearls consumed all of it!"

After this wave, Sacred Feather City suffered the heaviest damage; despite expending countless wish power mortal Gu, it could not match Fang Yuan or Heavenly Court.

The relic vajra tribulation lasted eight minutes before halting abruptly.

Without giving the three sides a breather, the second tribulation wave descended.

Immemorial desolate beast — Destiny Light Deer!

This grand tribulation comprised immemorial desolate beasts, each matching a rank eight Gu Immortal—and twenty-two of these deer had appeared.

A gap widened in the ten extreme formation, allowing half the deer herd inside.

Fang Yuan maneuvered Graceful Chaotic Duel Stage toward the battlefield's perimeter.

Fortunately, Fang Yuan had captured numerous vajra pearls earlier and used them to repel the deer.

At this crucial moment, immortal zombie Bo Qing stepped forward.

He unleashed terrifying sword path killer moves like five finger fist heart sword with unstoppable power.

Immortal zombie Bo Qing persevered bitterly, finally carrying Shadow Sect through the second grand tribulation.

Yet the dark clouds had thinned drastically, leaving the ten extreme immortal zombies faintly visible.

"The formation is at its weakest—charge!" Fang Yuan commanded.

Spotting the opportunity, Heaven Overseeing Tower Lord mobilized the tower as well, striking Shadow Sect while they were down.

"We have no choice but to sacrifice Zombie Alliance!" Seven Star Child sighed and resolved.

Shocking numbers of rank six, seven, and eight immortal zombies emerged from all the Zombie Alliance branches.

"Big sister!" Fairy Li Shan howled in grief.

Among these immortal zombies, she saw Blazing Heaven Demoness' figure.

Before Fairy Li Shan and Hei Lou Lan's eyes, Blazing Heaven Demoness transformed into immortal material, merging into the massive formation.

Fueled by these dao-mark-rich bodies, immortal apertures, and countless Immortal Gu, the dark clouds expanded beyond their previous peak, blotting out the sky.

"Shadow Sect's mandatory formation-refinement tasks were all a plot against Zombie Alliance!" Tai Bai Yun Sheng realized, chilled by Shadow Sect's sinister cruelty.

"At such immense cost—slaughtering nearly all immortal zombies across five regions as materials for this formation—what are they refining? The legendary Gu of eternal life?!"

The third wave of grand tribulations had descended.

Grand tribulation — Absolute Piercing Rain.

Fang Yuan repeated his tactic, spending Giant Sun's immortal essence to absorb the piercing rain with Graceful Chaotic Duel Stage.

"At this rate, the Immortal Gu House will only last fifteen minutes," Hei Lou Lan warned Fang Yuan.

As the third wave ended, both Sacred Feather City and Graceful Chaotic Duel Stage shattered, their surviving Gu retrieved by their masters.

Heaven Overseeing Tower was heavily fractured, with one corner completely crumbled away.

"It is over! The final victor is Heavenly Court!" Heaven Overseeing Tower Lord laughed, activating the tower's strongest attack.

Before his eyes, Heaven Overseeing Tower's attack shattered the formation, slaughtering Shadow Sect's Gu Immortals and annihilating Fang Yuan's group!

# Chapter 1009: Huge Hand!

Moments later, he frowned in suspicion. "Wait, Heaven Overseeing Tower was too damaged to unleash Fate's strongest attack—how did it fire?"

"And laughing like that earlier was completely uncharacteristic of me. What is happening?"

Suddenly, his body shook, he realized the truth.

"Oh no! It's a trap—none of this is real, I'm inside a dream realm!"

"I know I'm dreaming, but how do I escape?" Tower Lord grew anxious; lacking Fang Yuan's unravel dream, he had no way out.

Surrounding their leader, Heavenly Court's Gu Immortals poured water, applied fire, and shouted hoarsely, but no method could rouse him.

After prolonged battle, Pure Dream Reality Seeker Ying Wu Xie had advanced to rank eight.

After two failed attempts, his third killer move succeeded, trapping Heaven Overseeing Tower Lord in a dream.

Seven Star Child asked: "How long will he be trapped?"

Ying Wu Xie replied: "As a rank eight who passed one myriad tribulation, the dream can only hold him for a few minutes. But even if he escapes, I can simply trap him again!"

At this time, Heaven Overseeing Tower began to move again.

Ying Wu Xie shook his head with certainty. "Heaven Overseeing Tower Lord is still asleep. The other Heavenly Court immortals must be piloting the tower!"

But soon, Heaven Overseeing Tower stopped moving again.

Fang Yuan's expression grew grim. "Shadow Sect used dream path methods on Heavenly Court just like they did on me. But why didn't they target them earlier?"

"What use is pondering that now? We lack an Immortal Gu House, Shadow Sect lost Sacred Feather City, and Heavenly Court's tower is paralyzed. We are in grave danger! Fang Yuan, can you use Fixed Immortal Travel again?" Tai Bai Yun Sheng asked worriedly.

"I can't." Fang Yuan shook his head, sighing deeply.

"Is this really the end?" Fang Yuan checked Spring Autumn Cicada, but too little time had passed for it to recover.

Just then, the sound of a zither resonated across the sky.

Though it was daytime, endless starlight illuminated the sky.

"Oh no! Even the ten extreme formation cannot block this zither music—it's the fourth grand tribulation, the zither mind tribulation!"

"And that brilliant daytime starlight is the fifth grand tribulation—the star flow tribulation!"

A vast blue tsunami of starlight gushed endlessly across the sky, crashing downward.

Resigned to death, Shadow Sect's immortals rallied and charged forward, leaving only Ying Wu Xie behind to handle Heaven Overseeing Tower.

Grounded and pale, Fang Yuan's group struggled desperately against the zither mind grand tribulation.

At that moment, an immensely powerful aura of supreme might erupted from the ruins of Yi Tian Mountain!

Feeling this aura, all of the Gu Immortals' hearts shook.

"Our main body... has appeared!"

Boom!

A colossal, monstrous ghostly hand emerged from the immortal aperture's entrance.

The rank nine aura grew immensely!

"This is...?!" Hei Lou Lan and Tai Bai Yun Sheng were left speechless.

"Spectral Soul Demon Venerable!" Inside Heaven Overseeing Tower, a newly awakened Tower Lord identified the ghostly hand under crushing mental pressure.

# Chapter 1010: Embroidered Tower Cannot Block the Demonic Might

Stretching from Life and Death blessed land, the ghostly hand was colossal as a hill.

A majestic, vast rank nine aura swept out in all directions.

Fang Yuan's side hurriedly retreated.

Reaching out from Life and Death blessed land, it grasped Yi Tian Mountain's ruins, pulverizing massive boulders into dust.

"Spectral Soul... Demon Venerable..." Looking at the colossal hand filling his vision, Fang Yuan's throat went dry.

Earlier, when struck by the immortal killer move lead soul into dream and entering the dream realm again, he had heard Star Constellation Immortal Venerable's melodious song.

"Spectral night carries a soul into endless dreams, where can one rest in peace?"

"Spectral night carries a soul into endless dreams, where can one rest in peace?" This revealed the ghostly hand's identity, showing Fang Yuan that Shadow Sect's mastermind was Spectral Soul Demon Venerable!

The Legends of Ren Zu clearly recorded: The road of life was filled with suffering Gu while the road of death had three obstacles: Dang Hun Mountain, Luo Po Valley and Reverse Flow River.

Fang Yuan did not know about Reverse Flow River's location, but he knew Dang Hun Mountain and Luo Po valley were in his hands!

"So these were really Spectral Soul Demon Venerable's arrangements. No wonder Shadow Sect is so mysterious and powerful, and their Gu Immortals fearless of death. Have they already grasped a method to revive souls? But what does Spectral Soul Demon Venerable want? Shadow Sect spared no sacrifice to protect the ten extreme immortal zombie lifeless formation—what are they trying to refine?"

"Spectral Soul Demon Venerable... you finally could not bear it anymore." Inside Heaven Overseeing Tower, Heaven Overseeing Tower Lord heaved a deep sigh.

"The ten extreme formation is Spectral Soul's weakness. Stop this huge hand first, then we can gather our strength to break the formation!" Bi Chen Tian shouted.

"That makes sense!" Heavenly Court's immortals nodded, and several flew out of Heaven Overseeing Tower.

Heaven Overseeing Tower started activating, releasing sparkling white light.

Immortal killer move — Lead Soul Into Dream!

"Damn it!" Heaven Overseeing Tower Lord stomped his foot furiously, but fell into the dream realm again, unable to extricate himself.

Rank eight Immortal Gu House — Embroidered Tower!

"Does Heavenly Court only have these broken antiques left?" Immortal zombie Bo Qing sneered, raising a fist.

The peerless sword path killer move, five finger fist heart sword, erupted with full power.

Embroidered Tower shook from the attack, then shot out seven embroidery needles condensed from faint light.

The seven embroidery needles flew like birds and instantly struck the huge ghostly hand, piercing through it and the ground countless times.

Spectral Soul's ghostly hand tried to rise, but could not even budge.

Yet in the next moment, the solid, malevolent ghostly hand softened and dissolved into a pool of black water.

A sea of black water surged from the door of life and death, instantly submerging the surrounding mountain ranges. This soul water covered everything, tyrannical and domineering.

Fang Yuan and the rest quickly flew into the sky.

The sea of black water soared into the sky, transforming into a monster thousands of meters tall!

"Spectral Soul!" Heavenly Court's Gu Immortals watched in terror as an unavoidable giant ghostly hand swept across the air, instantly smashing Embroidered Tower.

Another hand grabbed the large Heaven Overseeing Tower. As the ghostly hand tightened, cracks spread across the tower, threatening to crush it completely!

The two grand tribulations, zither mind tribulation and star flow tribulation, came smashing down.

Spectral Soul roared towards the sky, suppressing the zither sound.

He raised two other hands and ferociously tore at space.

The torn space shattered as the massive starlight tsunami rushed into the void.

# Chapter 1011: Spectral Soul? Spectral Soul!

"This, this is the might of a rank nine demon venerable?" Fang Yuan's heart shook.

Spectral Soul was already dead; this was merely his soul.

Thousands of meters tall, the dark clouds of the ten extreme formation barely reached his waist.

He had three heads.

He had a thousand ink-black arms, five hundred on each side, their bulging muscles oozing demonic aura.

Fang Yuan showed a moved expression full of anticipation.

"The soul turns solid, interacting with the material world like a physical body! A foundation far exceeding a hundred million man soul—compared to it, mine is like an ant before the moon."

"Yet even Spectral Soul Demon Venerable died and returned to the door of life and death. Now that he has broken out to defy heaven and fate, what is he trying to do?"

"When will I reach such heights? Yet even at this level, he could not avoid death. I pursue eternal life... does it truly exist?"

Like a climber beholding an immeasurably tall peak, even if it was not his final goal, he felt deeply motivated to ascend and surpass it!

Even if he died on the ascent, his corpse desecrated and his soul destroyed, so what?

This was the goal that he pursued!

Heaven Overseeing Tower erupted with grand light, shattering Spectral Soul's ghostly hand and regaining freedom.

With the immortals' firm determination, Heaven Overseeing Tower shone with unprecedented brilliance.

Moving with speed disproportionate to his size, Spectral Soul instantly seized Heaven Overseeing Tower with several hands.

Ghostly hands layered over one another, trapping Heaven Overseeing Tower in their center.

Having trapped it, Spectral Soul ignored Heaven Overseeing Tower as all three heads looked grimly toward the sky.

"This... is no longer a grand tribulation."

"This is a myriad tribulation! Apocalyptic myriad tribulation!"

Beyond grand tribulations, there were myriad tribulations.

Myriad tribulations were terrifying; passing all three elevated a rank eight Gu Immortal to a rank nine venerable!

Myriad tribulation — Wind Lightning Prison!

Countless lightning bolts rained down as tornadoes coiled around Spectral Soul's body like dragons and pythons.

A thousand arms moved in unison—ghostly hands tore tornadoes apart while hill-like fists smashed the descending lightning bolts.

These Shadow Sect Gu Immortals were actually Spectral Soul Demon Venerable's split souls.

This huge force was simply a one man show by Spectral Soul Demon Venerable!

Following Old Man Yan Shi's example, Shadow Sect's Gu Immortals, including Seven Star Child and Song Zi Xing, entered the formation and sacrificed themselves.

Only two people were left.

One was Ying Wu Xie, whose Pure Dream Reality Seeker Physique would reach rank nine in his life's final moments—Spectral Soul's ultimate trump card.

The other was immortal zombie Bo Qing, his body now inhabited by Mo Yao's remnant soul.

With no further worries, immortal zombie Bo Qing and Ying Wu Xie charged toward Fang Yuan's group.

Encircled by the formation with space path methods sealed, where could they run?

Bo Qing waved his hand and sword light flew out, decapitating Fairy Li Shan as blood sprayed from her neck.

Man as Before!

At the crucial moment, Tai Bai Yun Sheng activated man as before Immortal Gu.

Restored to her former state, Fairy Li Shan clutched her neck, eyes filled with fear.

With arms behind his back, immortal zombie Bo Qing laughed arrogantly: "Merely a rank six time path Immortal Gu, how can it stop me?"

As he spoke, Fairy Li Shan's eyes widened as sword qi erupted from within her, reducing her to mushy flesh.

"Little Aunt!" Hei Lou Lan cried in anguish, charging at Bo Qing with bloodshot eyes.

Ying Wu Xie blocked Fang Yuan.

He stared intently at Fang Yuan: "You actually escaped my dream realm, how interesting. Let's see if you can escape it again with my cultivation at rank eight!"

"You know my name?" Fang Yuan growled, feeling something amiss.

"As an otherworldly demon, you are still useful to Shadow Sect, so I will spare your life. Don't bother with Spring Autumn Cicada—Yan Shi deduced it cannot be activated now." Confident of victory, Ying Wu Xie approached with a smile.

"What?!" Fang Yuan's entire body shook.

# Chapter 1012: Murdering Kin, Slaughtering Everyone

A hundred thousand years ago.

Southern Border, Xuan Ci Mountain.

A battle had just ended, leaving only two people on the battlefield with the victor evident.

"Hahaha!" A young man laughed toward the sky, blood-red eyes brimming with bloodthirst as he strode toward the other Gu Master.

The old man shouted: "Why! I raised you and taught you everything! Why attack the clan's higher-ups and repay our kindness with enmity? Why?!"

Facing the old man's questions, the young Gu Master lowered his gaze and smiled faintly: "Why? I haven't really thought about it. Hmm... if I must give a reason, maybe I was just annoyed."

"Annoyed?!"

"That's right... Constantly preaching that we must endure in silence, respect elders, maintain integrity, and never talk back. Saying the clan relies on me to defend its reputation, that I must think of the clansmen to become a brilliant clan leader... it's truly annoying! I felt annoyed ever since I was young. I thought I could endure it, but eventually I couldn't." The young Gu Master bared his pale white teeth.

"Enough! Enough!" The young Gu Master scowled ruthlessly, irritated by the old Gu Master's weeping.

He raised his right hand, slashing down.

With a soft sound, the old Gu Master was cleaved in two, blood and intestines spilling out as he died in grievance.

Tears flowed in deep sorrow, yet a look of utter satisfaction spread across his face.

"Even though I feel sad... is this freedom? Had I known, I would have killed them long ago. From now on, I will kill whatever annoys me!"

A hundred thousand years later.

Now completely transformed, he was a thousands-of-meters-tall monster with three heads and a thousand arms.

"So noisy, non-stop rumbling, enough is enough!" Spectral Soul roared.

A thousand arms exerted immense force as surging demonic aura coiled around the tornadoes and tore them to shreds.

Clouds dispersed and sunlight returned—Spectral Soul had resolved the myriad tribulation, wind lightning prison!

"Did we succeed?" Bo Qing and Ying Wu Xie looked back, joy showing on their faces.

But immediately, the sky turned dark again, countless grey clouds gathered above Spectral Soul's head.

The second myriad tribulation was gathering strength!

Suddenly, he raised hundreds of arms, stabbing into the dark clouds at his waist.

Formed by the ten extreme formation, the dark clouds shook intensely under Spectral Soul's assistance.

Led by Heaven Overseeing Tower Lord, Heaven Overseeing Tower turned phantom and flew past the encirclement of ghostly hands.

Re-solidifying the next moment, Heaven Overseeing Tower surged forward with a loud crash, striking Spectral Soul's right head fiercely.

Spectral Soul's head caved in under the impact, his chin slammed up into his cheekbones.

As Heaven Overseeing Tower hovered above Spectral Soul in phantom form, a hundred of his muscular dark arms withered into long, thin tendrils.

With his aid, the ten extreme formation shifted as dark clouds gathered toward the center.

At the center of the dark clouds, a spinning sphere faintly appeared, glowing with fourteen different colored lights.

Seeing this, an anxious Heaven Overseeing Tower Lord ordered: "Chop off these arms!"

Like a rocket, Heaven Overseeing Tower traced a dazzling light rainbow through the sky, cleanly severing all of Spectral Soul's arms upon contact.

"Ying Wu Xie, go and deal with Heavenly Court's Gu Immortals!" Immortal zombie Bo Qing called out.

Ying Wu Xie gritted his teeth, unwilling to leave just yet: "Give me a moment to put Fang Yuan to sleep first."

Saying so, he activated the rank eight immortal killer move — Lead Soul Into Dream.

Unable to dodge, Fang Yuan was dragged into the dream realm.

In the pavilion at the center of the lake, zither music resonated.

Fang Yuan met Star Constellation Immortal Venerable again.

Unravel dream.

Fang Yuan hurriedly activated his dream path killer move, but the dream realm held firm, producing only faint ripples across his vision.

Unravel Dream was only rank six, powerless against Ying Wu Xie's rank eight killer move.

As zither music played, Star Constellation Immortal Venerable smiled gently at Fang Yuan and sang in a soft voice.

As Heaven Overseeing Tower prepared to strike again, one of Spectral Soul's heads opened its eyes and immobilized it with a stare.

Heaven Overseeing Tower could no longer exit its phantom form!

"Fang Yuan!" Hei Lou Lan and Tai Bai Yun Sheng shouted.

But Fang Yuan was fast asleep and could not be awakened.

Just as Bo Qing moved to slaughter Hei Lou Lan and Tai Bai Yun Sheng, immense suction surged from the ground.

Caught off guard, the immortals were dragged into the earth up to their legs, powerful forces restricting their movement.

Grand tribulation — Earth Collapse!

Bo Qing and Ying Wu Xie were stunned; they had not expected a grand tribulation to ambush them while the myriad tribulation engaged Spectral Soul.

"Why aren't they restricted?!" Both were soon shocked again.

Upon hitting the ground, Hei Lou Lan and Tai Bai Yun Sheng regained their freedom and could move unhindered.

The latter grabbed the sleeping Fang Yuan and retreated rapidly.

To their joy, once the ten extreme formation produced the mysterious sphere, the spatial restriction vanished—if Fang Yuan awoke, they could escape with Fixed Immortal Travel.

Immortal zombie Bo Qing's eyes flashed with killing intent, but as he prepared to activate sword path Immortal Gu, newly formed thoughts were instantly dragged into the ground.

Earth collapse targeted not only Gu Immortals' bodies, but their thoughts, wills, and emotions as well.

# Chapter 1013: Grey Memory

Not only were the Gu Immortals trapped in the ground, their thoughts were also interrupted.

"Damn it!!" Ying Wu Xie screamed, struggling futilely as he sank deeper and deeper.

"Stop struggling and stop thinking—it will only worsen our situation, and we cannot resolve this now," immortal zombie Bo Qing said calmly beside him.

"We can only hope our main body saves us," Ying Wu Xie sighed, looking at Spectral Soul.

Spectral Soul was sinking too, half his massive legs dragged beneath the earth.

Of his six eyes, two pinned down Heaven Overseeing Tower while the other four gazed into the sky.

Thickening grey clouds gathered high above and descended slowly.

The second myriad tribulation had started.

This myriad tribulation however, was very slow.

But Spectral Soul did not move.

Even as grey clouds completely shrouded him, Spectral Soul remained motionless, controlling Heaven Overseeing Tower firmly.

They had used phantom transformation to evade Spectral Soul's attacks, but his phantom path attainment far exceeded expectations—he was certainly a great grandmaster.

The grey cloud descended, but it caused no harm.

"What is happening? A harmless myriad tribulation?!" Seeing no damage, a bewildered Ying Wu Xie felt around his body and cried out in suspicion.

"Is this grey memory?" an observant Heavenly Court Gu Immortal cried out.

"What is grey memory?"

The Heavenly Court Gu Immortal recalled: "In my youth, I inherited the legacy of a rank eight Gu Immortal who perished against the myriad tribulation grey memory, leaving his inheritance in his final moments. This myriad tribulation is harmless to the body, but it draws out the person's deepest memories. These memories were either those which had caused huge pain to the Gu Immortal's mind, or were a trauma in their life."

Myriad tribulation — Grey Memory.

Recognizing this myriad tribulation, Spectral Soul made no move.

No attack could disperse this tribulation; he had to confront all his past shame, trauma, and rage to overcome it.

The grey clouds coiling around his body suddenly flared with light and emitted sounds.

A scene from Spectral Soul Demon Venerable's childhood unfolded before the immortals.

"Kill her! Kill her! Kill her!"

A band of Gu Masters surrounded a family of three, ruthlessly shouting with bloodshot eyes.

"Father! You cannot kill mother!!" A child protected his heavily injured mother, yelling with all his energy.

"Hmph, all demonic path members must be executed! We of the righteous path uphold justice and slay demons!! Why can't we kill her? We must kill her to purge our clan's humiliation!!" The old Gu Master leading the group spoke with righteous indignation; he was the boy's grandfather and the clan leader.

With a soft sound, fresh blood spewed out.

His father stood weeping with gritted teeth, dagger plunged deep into his beloved wife's heart.

From that day onwards, he became very quiet.

The grey fog moved, as another scene appeared.

Several years had passed.

Having grown slightly, the young boy stood respectfully before his grandfather.

His grandfather, the clan leader, sipped tea and asked casually: "I had you read our clan's history. What insights did you gain? Tell grandfather."

"From history, I realized there is only one universal law in this world — to kill," the boy said calmly.

"Kill?" The old man frowned, demanding grimly: "Explain it to me."

"Yes," the boy continued. "When hungry, we kill prey. When threatened, we kill our enemies. In times of peace, rulers kill meritorious subjects to secure authority and control..."

"Though 'kill' is just a word, it holds profound meaning. How does one kill—use Gu worms personally, or hire other Gu Masters? When killing openly invites trouble, we assassinate instead. There are many ways to assassinate, for example..."

"Enough!" the old man bellowed, angrily smashing his cup onto the ground.

The old man stood up, shouting angrily: "I had you study so you would learn our clan's glorious history! I wanted you to learn courtesy and integrity, and understand the righteous path's glory! Yet all you learned was killing? What kind of twisted logic is this? You—you are confined for a month! Stay inside and reflect upon your mistake!"

"Yes, grandfather," the boy replied softly, a stubborn light in his eyes.

The grey fog moved, as the scene changed again.

Years later, the boy had become a rank one Gu Master.

Having refined hidden aura Gu, the youth sneaked into the study to surprise his grandfather.

Not long after, he heard a commotion.

Two people walked into the study room.

"That traitorous son! He dares rebel? He wants to harm his own father?!" Enraged, the old clan leader slammed the table with immense force.

"Clan leader, the evidence is conclusive. News that you obtained an eighty year lifespan Gu has spread; it is confirmed the young clan leader intends to harm you."

"Hmph! That traitorous son wants to seize my authority? Impossible!" the clan leader shouted.

His grandfather said solemnly: "Suppressing my son openly would damage our righteous reputation. Hmm... ...strike first and assassinate him. Once he is dead, the other clan elders will yield."

Behind the secret door in the hidden tunnel, the youth covered his mouth, shivering intensely.

# Chapter 1014: Food Path Inheritance

Carrying Fang Yuan, Tai Bai Yun Sheng sprinted away in escape.

"Fang Yuan, wake up!" Hei Lou Lan slapped his face, but he remained sound asleep.

Without Fang Yuan's Fixed Immortal Travel, leaving Southern Border was impossible.

Meanwhile, on Yi Tian Mountain's battlefield, the grey fog continued spreading.

But it was a completely different story for Spectral Soul Demon Venerable!

Inside the grey fog, Spectral Soul stood motionless like a mountain, like a dormant volcano.

Around him, the grey fog churned with dazzling rainbow lights, displaying various scenes after Spectral Soul had become a Gu Immortal.

Inside Earth Abyss.

"Youngster, you want my inheritance?" In the darkness, two eyes shone like lanterns.

"Yes," the Gu Immortal replied concisely. Black-robed with messy shoulder-length hair, he looked cold, light flashing occasionally in his eyes.

"Then this is your inheritance test!" With a loud roar, a strange beast emerged from the darkness.

The dragon-horned, crocodile-headed beastman Gu Immortal opened his mouth and bit at Spectral Soul's soul.

But Gu Immortal Spectral Soul did not dodge or evade.

The beastman bit, tearing apart Spectral Soul's arm.

Spectral Soul did not retreat, allowing it to continue biting.

The beastman Gu Immortal quickly devoured his other arm and both legs.

Despite intense pain, Spectral Soul remained expressionless without even frowning.

"You are different from the others." The beastman Gu Immortal stopped and appraised Spectral Soul with praise: "You feel no fear at all. As the creator of food path, I have researched eating extensively. Many who sought my inheritance looked tough outside, but inside were filled with agony and fear."

"Then, is my flesh delicious?" Spectral Soul asked.

With a claw, the beastman tore open Spectral Soul's stomach and pulled out his intestines.

Though pale, Spectral Soul remained cold, as if those intestines were not his own.

"What can I not endure?" Spectral Soul smiled coldly. "In this environment, even if only my head remains, I will regenerate and claim your inheritance. Once you lose all value, you should worry about yourself."

The beastman Gu Immortal faltered at his gaze: "What are you thinking?"

"Eating is natural in this world, but its flip side is killing. To eat meat, we must hunt. To eat vegetables, we must uproot them; that too is killing. Even consuming only wind and water still means swallowing and digesting them. In essence, eating is killing. Yet killing encompasses far more than eating—thus, your food path is inferior to my killing path."

"I have eaten many things, but never been eaten. Devouring me now is killing me. Likewise, though I have killed countless beings, I have never been slowly killed myself. Experiencing being killed is its own enjoyment. Only by being killed can I fully grasp killing. Thank you for deepening my comprehension."

The beastman Gu Immortal's eyes widened, staring at Spectral Soul as if looking at a nightmarish monster!

Soon, Gu Immortal Spectral Soul had only his head left.

Even with only his head remaining, Gu Immortal Spectral Soul was completely calm and peaceful.

But at this moment, the beastman Gu Immortal laughed wildly.

"Hahaha, you were duped! But don't feel bad—you're the two hundred and seventieth fool! Hahaha!"

Spectral Soul's gaze flashed: "Is this inheritance fake?"

"Of course it is real! When I reached rank eight, Barbarian Jiu Lie trapped me to steal my food path. I could not defeat him, but I refused to let him have his way easily. I made an agreement to pass the food path inheritance to future humans instead of him, provided they endure my eating test."

"Since then, many humans came to take the test and obtain food path knowledge. But not even Barbarian Jiu Lie understood my true abilities. By devouring dao marks endlessly, after a thousand years, I finally broke our agreement!"

"I will eat your head to nourish my recovery. Don't worry, I'll remember you—the most unique among the fools I have devoured!"

"So that is it," Spectral Soul replied plainly, remaining utterly calm.

The beastman Gu Immortal's expression froze, he grabbed his throat, shouting anxiously: "What is going on? What is going on?!"

Spectral Soul sneered: "Did you think my flesh was easy to eat? Every piece contained a fragment of my soul. You are an expert in food path, but coincidentally, I have some attainment in soul path."

"Soul path? When did such a path appear?! Splitting your soul causes pain far beyond tearing flesh!"

"I am the founder of soul path. As for that pain... experiencing it only heightens the joy of killing, doesn't it?" Spectral Soul stated. The beastman's face turned ashen as he ceased moving.

He was dead.

# Chapter 1015: Scenes of Past Events

"Spectral Soul is completely mad! Filled with demonic thoughts, he believes anything can be killed, that killing is the greatest joy, and that the Dao of heaven and earth is essentially killing!"

"The myriad tribulation grey memory cannot stop him. Though no longer a Demon Venerable and physically invincible, he remains mentally invincible!"

Just then, the clear chirping of birds echoed from the sky.

Wherever the birds passed, deep lacerations opened like wounds from sharp blades.

The surrounding grey fog seemed to trap Spectral Soul deep within his memories.

However, Thieving Heaven true inheritances were left for otherworldly demons.

Not being an otherworldly demon, Gu Immortal Spectral Soul was unqualified to inherit it.

Despite exhausting every method, he only spat blood, returning empty-handed with a pale face.

"Okay." Spectral Soul Demon Venerable nodded.

Thieving Heaven's will continued: "You might already know, I am not from this world, I am what you would call an otherworldly demon."

"The world I came from is different from here in both its foundation and scenery. To me, I am only a traveler here, I want to go home, I have strived over my whole life for that goal."

"Mecha... you can think of it as a puppet or armor operated by a human inside to unleash immense battle strength," Thieving Heaven's will explained vaguely.

A moment later, another scene appeared.

Within Eighty-Eight True Yang Building.

Holding Giant Sun's true inheritance, Spectral Soul sighed: "Possessing bodies is merely a desperate measure—death remains inevitable. Lifespan Gu is still the best option. The path of a Gu Immortal is filled with tribulations—the body fails, the soul cannot exist independently, and maintaining longevity defies heaven... it is hard, hard, hard!"

"Giant Sun, oh Giant Sun, even if you created Eighty-Eight True Yang Building and attempted to plunder the lifespan Gu in Northern Plains. But heaven's will is vicious, fewer and fewer lifespan Gu are being produced, even if you obtain all of the lifespan Gu in the world, so what?"

"Heaven's will dictates lifespan Gu production. To live a long life, the crux lies with heaven's will."

At the river of time.

Spectral Soul Demon Venerable hovered mid-air, looking at a red lotus floating on the river's surface.

After exhausting all his efforts, he successfully left a ghost face on the red lotus.

"Red Lotus Demon Venerable, the most mysterious in history..." Spectral Soul Demon Venerable sighed with weary yet bright eyes. "Why did you deliberately stop and leave behind the heavily injured fate Immortal Gu?"

"Star Constellation Immortal Venerable truly made a deep scheme!"

"So only a complete otherworldly demon can thoroughly destroy fate."

"Even Thieving Heaven was only half an otherworldly demon—his soul came from another world while his body was native."

"To extend my lifespan, I must defy heaven's will. Sadly, heaven's will has no soul for me to kill. Perhaps with this Red Lotus true inheritance, I can become half an otherworldly demon..."

In a dark secret room.

Spectral Soul Demon Venerable sat on the ground before countless Gu formations.

Inside the formations lay countless corpses of men, women, young, old, and diverse variant humans.

With disheveled hair and a blood-covered body, Spectral Soul Demon Venerable was skeletal and exhausted, but his sunken eyes shone brilliantly.

He was staring at a book fixedly.

The Legends of Ren Zu.

"The Legends of Ren Zu... to think I only truly understood you today! You are an exposition of human path, the true inheritance Ren Zu left behind!"

"Using human path methods, I can create a new body and become half an otherworldly demon through soul replacement!"

"Maybe not just that, I can still..."

"What a pity—it is too late! I am fatally injured, and death approaches me."

Though invincible under heaven, Spectral Soul succumbed to injuries—perhaps inflicted while testing human path methods.

The myriad tribulation grand clear space was still continuing.

Over half of Spectral Soul's thousand arms had been severed by the jade birds. Covered in wounds, he offered no resistance.

# Chapter 1016: Over A Long Time

Inside the door of life and death.

In Obsession Death Domain.

Bodiless, Spectral Soul Demon Venerable manifested as a soul possessing three heads and a thousand arms.

Looking at his reflection in the lake, he muttered: "Very good. I created soul devouring based on food path, restoring my peak and letting me devour Gu Immortal souls for their lifelong memories and cultivation experience! Hehehe, a blessing in disguise..."

"Yet I found no souls of other Immortal or Demon Venerables. Star Constellation's absence is understandable, but Thieving Heaven is missing too—did he successfully return home?"

"It is time to return to the living world. Without Dang Hun Mountain and Luo Po Valley obstructing me, leaving the Door of Life and Death is far easier than it was for Ren Zu. Since my main body cannot depart yet, I should send split souls to pave the way."

In the following scene, seven mortals appeared instead of Spectral Soul.

"Due to Reverse Flow River's obstruction, only seven of our original ten made it out."

"Freeing our main body will take effort. If discovered, others will not sit idly by."

"To play it safe, we should separate and develop secretly across the five regions, communicating occasionally."

"In that case, why not create an organization to deceive the masses?"

"That's true. Let's call it Shadow Sect—unnoticed like shadows yet everywhere. One day, the entire world will be shrouded in our shadows!"

"Agreed. We seven are named Red, Orange, Yellow, Green, Azure, Blue, and Purple. Like the seven immemorial heavens, let us never grow complacent!"

"Sword Immortal Bo Qing is actually Spectral Soul Demon Venerable's split soul!" Heavenly Court's Gu Immortals cried out.

"Azure." Inside Bo Qing's immortal zombie body, Mo Yao's remnant soul felt deeply moved upon seeing the young, handsome Azure in the image.

Around her, grey fog rumbled, showing a scene from deep within her memories.

Ruins stretched all around, with countless mangled corpses lying on the bloody ground.

"Husband! Don't die—you cannot die! If you die, how will I live without you?" Mo Yao hugged Sword Immortal Bo Qing, weeping helplessly.

Bo Qing held Mo Yao's hand weakly: "I am a split soul of Spectral Soul Demon Venerable. Loving me will only bring pain. Leave quickly, or it will be too late."

Mo Yao shook her head firmly: "No! I don't care about your identity—only that we love each other. If I cannot live with you, I will die with you!"

Six members of Shadow Sect gathered together.

"My mistake!" Green said. "Had I not sent Azure to treasure yellow heaven, he wouldn't have fallen into love's trap, betrayed us, and exposed our main body!"

"Not your fault," Purple consoled. "These are obstacles from heaven's will! As our cultivation rises, nothing goes smoothly; unintended troubles arise everywhere."

"We must resolve Azure's situation quickly, or our main body's plan will be obstructed!"

"It is possible, but risky and costly," Purple said slowly. "Yet I have a plan. If it succeeds, we might even turn Fairy Mo Yao to our side."

Purple smiled: "Spirit Affinity House used rank nine Love Gu. With his sword path incomplete, Azure couldn't resist its unstoppable might. It isn't his fault."

"With my wisdom path attainment reaching great grandmaster, I understand Azure's sword path and deduced a solution: a recipe for wisdom sword Immortal Gu."

Purple nodded: "Wisdom sword severs love threads. It only needs to cut Azure's love dao marks. We can stage an encounter so he believes he created the recipe himself."

"Once used, his love threads will be severed, restoring his reason and loyalty. Furthermore, since Mo Yao still bears love threads, we can use them to turn her to our side!"

"What?!" Seeing this, immortal zombie Bo Qing frowned deeply from the ground.

Inside the body, Mo Yao's remnant soul had believed her lover created wisdom sword Immortal Gu himself!

"Then... did Azure deceive me, or did he still love me?" Mo Yao's remnant soul shook with doubt.

Just then, another scene appeared around Spectral Soul.

Shadow Sect's seven immortals gathered.

"Once I become a venerable, I will dominate the world unrivaled," Azure said arrogantly. "Even heaven's will cannot touch me, and lifespan Gu are plentiful in this era."

Purple looked at him: "After Azure's first failure, ample preparation should prevent further mishaps... How is Fairy Mo Yao?"

Azure laughed coldly: "That foolish woman went to Eighty-Eight True Yang Building to refine calamity beckoning Immortal Gu, intending to draw the myriad tribulation onto herself during my ascension."

Purple shook his head: "Mo Yao's luck path plan will fail. Still, give her change soul Immortal Gu and that killer move. If you fail the tribulation, an intact soul preserves your foundation, letting you restart quickly."

"Mm. Thorough preparation is best." Azure nodded expressionlessly.

This scene made immortal zombie Bo Qing's body shake intensely.

Five of the immortals from Shadow Sect were gathered again.

"Blue failed," Yellow said painedly. "He fused his immortal aperture with the immemorial blue heaven fragment to research heaven's will, but fell deep into a dream realm."

After a long pause, Purple said: "Blue can be saved, but we mustn't act hastily. This is heaven's will's trap to expose us."

"Azure's second rank nine ascension attempt proved it—the tribulation was over tenfold stronger than the first! Heaven's will refuses to let us become venerables and targets us relentlessly."

"I won't hide it, I've had a bad premonition. First Azure, then Blue—I fear I am next."

"After I am gone, Gu Immortal Da Li will take over. Heaven's will is stronger than estimated, but not impossible to deceive. From now on, Shadow Sect will lie low and build strength in secret. When executing our heaven-defying act, we must strike with all our might before heaven's will can react."

# Chapter 1017: Deep Scheme

# Chapter 1018: Narrow Victory

# Chapter 1049: Selling a Human Slave

Lang Ya blessed land, Black Hair Continent.

Lang Ya blessed land was arguably the world's greatest hairy man paradise.

The blessed land contained four continents: three sea-bound continents, and the smallest floating aloft—Cloud Cover Continent, a sacred realm hairy men longed to reach.

Steel Thread City's trading market, among the most renowned on Black Hair Continent, bustled with clamor.

Today, at the market's southeast corner, a burly, muscular hairy man stepped onto a stage.

Kang Ba was a well-known slave merchant who commanded a massive trade.

"Quiet, everyone." Kang Ba raised his hands to calm the crowd. "Without wasting time, I present the first slave. Bring him out!"

"Move it!" Behind the stage, a muscular black-haired hairy man yanked a chain.

At the chain's end was a slave covered in flesh-baring wounds.

It was Fang Zheng, who was interrogated earlier!

Standing up, he glared at the black-haired hairy man with stubborn defiance.

"Asking for a beating? Move!" Laughing, the hairy man reached out an arm thicker than Fang Zheng's leg and hoisted him by the neck.

Stepping onto the stage, the hairy man threw Fang Zheng down at the center.

Kang Ba pointed at Fang Zheng, announcing: "This slave is a rare breed, acquired with great difficulty!"

"He isn't weak—he has rank five cultivation!" someone gasped, noticing Fang Zheng's faint aura.

Kang Ba laughed: "You guess wrong—this slave is not a hairy man, but a purebred human!"

"He is a human?"

Hairy men dominated Lang Ya blessed land. Shock spread—most had only ever heard rumors of humans.

"Stand up properly." Kang Ba hooked his finger.

A formless force seized Fang Zheng's body, forcing him to stand on the stage.

Fang Zheng had never seen so vast a crowd of hairy men before.

Across the five regions, humans ruled and variant humans barely survived. Yet here, hairy men ruled and humans were suppressed!

Kang Ba feigned fury: "Who do you think I am? I trade with complete honesty. Look at him!"

Kang Ba stepped forward and clamped his fingers around Fang Zheng's chin and lips.

"Inspect him!" With a sharp rip, Kang Ba shredded Fang Zheng's shirt.

Fang Zheng shuddered, left stark naked before the crowd of hairy men.

Fang Zheng gritted his teeth, eyes blazing with fury and humiliation, wishing he could slaughter every hairy man present.

Kang Ba chuckled, prodding Fang Zheng's groin: "This still works! He can sire an endless supply of slaves."

Burning with humiliation, Fang Zheng would have bitten his tongue to commit suicide had Kang Ba not immobilized him.

"I will buy this slave," a distant voice called.

Turning toward the voice, the crowd saw a black-furred female hairy man gazing lustfully at Fang Zheng.

"Kang Ba, heal this slave, clean him up, and send him to my home tonight."

"As you command, beautiful, mighty city lord!" Kang Ba kowtowed in delight.

Fang Zheng shut his eyes, losing all hope in life.

Suddenly, thunder roared as the world trembled.

A five-colored light surged from Cloud Cover Continent, illuminating all of Lang Ya blessed land.

Drawn by the spectacle, the hairy men looked up in curiosity and awe, completely forgetting Fang Zheng.

The earthly calamity of sovereign immortal aperture won't be easy to pass. Heaven's will cannot affect Fang Yuan, but can still make arrangements to deal with him. Most likely, not only will there be calamities and tribulations, there could also be human disasters."

# Chapter 1053: Fang Yuan Undergoes Tribulation (1/5)

"To think I am back here again." Fang Yuan sighed inwardly, descending from the sky.

Upon destroying the earthly calamity, the ascendant would receive an infusion of true meaning, equivalent to Reckless Savage Demon Venerable's direct guidance.

Immortal Gu flew up one by one, shining with bright lights while floating in the sky.

A huge blue image formed, engulfing the immortal aperture and expanding outside to cover a vast area of the icy plain.

Immortal killer move — Immortal Tribulation Tempering Aperture!

Over ten thousand immortal essence beads were expended, yet this was just the start!

With mostly rank seven core Immortal Gu, Fang Yuan's green grape immortal essence drained rapidly.

Thankfully, he had obtained many immortal essence stones from Lang Ya land spirit and even borrowed Heavenly Essence Treasure Imperial Lotus.

Fifteen minutes later, the killer move finished, consuming sixty percent of Fang Yuan's immortal essence.

"This expenditure far exceeds Lang Ya land spirit's estimate. But as he mentioned, the cost varies with the immortal aperture itself."

An hour later, the calamity descended.

The immortal aperture shook as heaven and earth qi surged from every direction.

Within the aperture, the internal heaven and earth qi clashed, instantly forming a blizzard.

Wild snow and fierce winds instantly transformed the immortal aperture into an icy world.

Seeing this, Fang Yuan was overjoyed: "Did the immortal tribulation tempering aperture method work?"

As the blizzard rampaged through the aperture, snow monsters formed one after another.

"Snow monster calamity? Slash!" Fang Yuan thought, floating behind a barrier of Gu worms as he fired flying sword Immortal Gu.

Flying sword Gu pierced a snow monster's head and exited the back.

In an instant, it flew back to Fang Yuan.

The snow monster howled, its head wound healing instantly as it continued charging at Fang Yuan.

Like mud monsters and cloud beasts, snow monsters were troublesome opponents, hard to kill unless their core was destroyed.

# Chapter 1054: Fang Yuan Undergoes Tribulation (2/5)

# Chapter 1059: Dog Shit Splits Luck

Whoosh—!

Rank five sword sheath Gu!

Hong Yi was shocked, at once he was speechless.

# Chapter 1061: Blood Torrent

Northern Plains.

Inside the sovereign immortal aperture's first layer of heaven.

# Chapter 1064: I am a transformation path Gu Immortal

Why did Fang Yuan choose transformation path?

After the battle of Yi Tian Mountain granted him a living body, Fang Yuan had pondered the critical question of which path to pursue.

Between Ying Wu Xie, Shadow Sect's remnants, Heavenly Court, Central Continent's ten ancient sects, and Northern Plains' Huang Jin tribes, Fang Yuan had countless enemies.

After Yi Tian Mountain, his secrets were laid bare—Spring Autumn Cicada, his otherworldly demon identity, and the destruction of Imperial Court blessed land were almost completely exposed.

Right now, Fang Yuan needed high battle strength.

Yet blood path was taboo, strength path was declining, and wisdom and star paths lacked direct battle strength—plus, despite having inheritances, he had lost his accumulated Immortal Gu.

Only as he grasped the profoundness of this body did his confusion clear, revealing fresh hope.

He realized his body bore over a thousand dao marks across all paths.

Most importantly—his dao marks did not interfere with each other, nor did they weaken one another!

This was Sovereign Immortal Fetus Gu—a rank nine Immortal Gu and the culmination of tens of thousands of years of preparation by Spectral Soul Demon Venerable and Shadow Sect.

With just this point, he could cultivate every path!!

Fang Yuan quickly calmed down.

Yet cultivating every path was a fantasy requiring vast time, resources, and absolute safety.

Lacking the foundation to create his own path, Fang Yuan could only pursue an existing path, cultivating at most a second one alongside it.

That was — transformation path!

Known as the 'path that projected every path', transformation path allowed Gu Immortals to transform into forms of metal, light, sword, and all other paths.

Yet transformation path had a persistent flaw: when Gu Immortals transformed into other beings, they had to cleanse those dao marks to prevent them from conflicting.

For Fang Yuan, Sovereign Immortal Fetus Gu let his dao marks coexist harmoniously, granting him unrestrained transformation without conflicting marks.

Better still, once he cultivated transformation path, his secret of having non-conflicting dao marks would be completely concealed.

After transforming, he would gain amplification effects for those paths: turning into a sword path beast would provide sword path dao marks to heavily empower sword path Immortal Gu.

Though his transformation path attainment was modest, he had Reckless Savage's true meaning!

Facing danger in the future, he could transform into other beings to deceive enemies; if his identity was exposed, he could conceal himself and roam the world safely.

"From now on, I am a transformation path Gu Immortal!"

"Fang Yuan, you may be busy cultivating with your own plans, but this affects Lang Ya Sect's development—and you are a member of the sect. At a crucial moment, how can you not defend the sect's interests? You are an outsider after all, not a hairy man Gu Immortal!"

The sect's alliance agreement did not allow forcing members into missions unless facing a life-and-death crisis.

Lang Ya land spirit sighed: "Must I follow Fang Yuan's suggestion and use this falling star hound as a grindstone to develop our hairy man Gu Immortals' battle strength?"

He was cold and impassive on the inside.

"My plan is to use Lang Ya Sect as chess pieces for my cultivation. If I accepted that mission, wouldn't I become a pawn risking my life for them?"

"Hmph! Heaven's will is focused on Tai Qiu. It has likely laid a trap, biding its time only because of the immemorial corpse..."

Cultivating transformation path required refining Immortal Gu and hunting desolate beasts for materials, but he did not need to do so personally.

In this world, what is most important is myself.

"I will not waste time for Lang Ya Sect, but I must manage my relationship with the land spirit well."

"Frequent friction will worsen our relationship; eventually, the land spirit might lose control and expel or even kill me."

"For now, I still need Lang Ya Sect's power—at least to borrow their water path Immortal Gu for the second earthly calamity."

"Even if calamities and tribulations are heaven's will's best chance to eliminate me, I must face them fearlessly! Each passed tribulation brings me closer to breaking free from heaven's will, growing stronger until I can confront it head-on. When I become an invincible Demon Venerable, what can heaven's will do to me?"

Returning to his cloud city, Fang Yuan received a wooden box. Opening the wooden box revealed the rank six beast enslavement Immortal Gu inside!

Days earlier, feeling the time was ripe, Fang Yuan had offered sect contribution points to borrow Twelfth Hair's beast enslavement Immortal Gu.

Though Twelfth Hair agreed, he declined the contribution points, making another request instead.

Twelfth Hair had recently taken in an apt descendant whose grandmother he was close with; since the boy cultivated enslavement path, Twelfth Hair wanted Fang Yuan to guide him.

Inside the immortal aperture, the ice and snow stopped spreading.

Controlling the immortal zombie, Fang Yuan cautiously approached a desolate beast snow monster.

Beast enslavement Immortal Gu!

At Fang Yuan's will, he injected green grape immortal essence into this Immortal Gu.

The desolate beast snow monster shuddered, as if struck by an invisible force.

Growling, it quickly discovered the hidden strength path immortal zombie and attacked.

Normally, his soul foundation could easily suppress this desolate beast snow monster, but reality proved otherwise.

"Just as Shadow Sect said, creatures filled with heaven's will cannot be enslaved. Keeping them is a major threat!"

"Enslaving them to resist tribulations or sell in treasure yellow heaven would be ideal, but now I can only kill them."

Fang Yuan had an idea: "Could I use self will Gu to purge heaven's will before using beast enslavement Immortal Gu?"

# Chapter 1096: Wind Flowers, Snow Moon

Fang Yuan squinted, he muttered under his breath: "Snow moon!"

With a heavy heart, Fang Yuan thought: "This is not a wind flower tribulation, but a wind flower snow moon tribulation! The former is an earthly calamity, while the latter is a heavenly tribulation. This second earthly calamity is absurdly strong!"

# Chapter 1180: Heaven and Human Path, Grandmaster Discusses Dao

Created in Giant Sun Immortal Venerable's later years, heaven and earth luck was profound, deciphering the mysteries of the world. Unable to break through alone, Five Elements Grandmaster had snuck into Longevity Heaven to steal the heaven and earth luck inheritance.

"Tribulations originate from heavenly principles. Heaven takes surpluses to replenish deficits, emphasizing balance; whatever disrupts this equilibrium faces calamities and tribulations."

"Endowed with great intelligence, humans pose a greater threat; Gu Immortals managing their own small worlds draw heaven's direct suppression."

"What is calamity? What is luck?" Heaven Extremity suddenly asked.

Enlightened, Five Elements Grandmaster spoke immediately: "I understand. Heaven takes surpluses to replenish deficits—calamity takes away surpluses, while luck replenishes deficits."

Heaven Extremity raised his eyebrows: "Correct, that is exactly so! Ancestor Giant Sun was immensely talented, creating luck path targeting heavenly principles. Self luck true inheritance replenishes oneself. All living being's luck takes others' surpluses to replenish oneself, while heaven and earth luck takes heaven and earth's surpluses to replenish oneself."

"So that's it." Five Elements Grandmaster sighed deeply: "No wonder Giant Sun Immortal Venerable never joined Heavenly Court."

"If heaven cannot use tribulations to destroy Longevity Heaven, it will use human calamities," Heaven Extremity continued. "And you, Five Elements Grandmaster, were subconsciously influenced by heaven's will to become the human calamity sent to destroy Longevity Heaven! What a pity that a great rank eight like you was influenced by heaven's will unknowingly."

"Hahaha, I have learned much!" Five Elements Grandmaster laughed grandly. "Even if heaven's will influences me, so what? This is also my own intention! Man will triumph over heaven—heaven's will can never match the will of humans. "No." Chu Du smiled bitterly. "You know Northern Plains' situation—Chu Sect allied with Bai Zu tribe, and the righteous path is gathering forces to deal with us."

Not Immortal sighed: "These are worldly affairs. Fame and reputation—will they remain after death? In The Legends of Ren Zu, when Verdant Great Sun entered the door of life and death, reputation Gu abandoned him at pacifying soul lake. Only eternal life is worthy of our pursuit."

Chu Du looked resolute: "I promised someone I would make strength path flourish. If I cannot achieve it, I will not live in peace!"

"Brother Liu, you have great potential, why not stay here?"

Fang Yuan smiled: "I came to sign the Crazed Demon Agreement. Now that it is done, I have other matters to settle."

"The third last layer is no problem, though I cannot assess the deeper layers. Derivation Gu is at the bottom, but guarded by the Three Crazed Demon Eccentrics, I cannot act alone." Fang Yuan felt it was a pity.

Fang Yuan and Chu Du said goodbye to Not Immortal, before flying towards the sky.

Chu Du admitted with a bitter smile: "I feel great pressure too. Even allied with Bai Zu tribe, our enemies outmatch us dozens or hundreds of times over! Yet they are divided, bound to their territories, and constrained by righteous rules and reputation... we still have a chance."

"When are they coming?" Fang Yuan asked the crucial question.

Chu Du looked at him: "Pardon my presumption, Brother Liu, but has your transformation path reached great grandmaster attainment level?"

"What? Not yet." Fang Yuan replied.

"If not great grandmaster, you are at least quasi-great grandmaster," Chu Du said with great confidence.

Chu Du chuckled: "Higher attainment eases exploration here. Not Immortal was shocked by my progress because my strength path attainment recently saw a qualitative leap."

Fang Yuan knew that he was trying to ask about the killer move immortal tribulation tempering aperture.

Knowing what Chu Du meant, Fang Yuan feigned ignorance: "Oh, I see."

Disappointment flashed deep in Chu Du's eyes.

Chu Du swallowed his disappointment rationally. In this situation, he had to deepen cooperation with Fang Yuan, not strain their relationship.

Halfway through the journey, he parted with Chu Du.

Flying southwest for several days, Fang Yuan landed on an ordinary-looking mound.

"According to Xue Song Zi's memories, this is the place." Fang Yuan surveyed the area, confirming his location.

Pinpointing the blessed land, he summoned the upper extreme heavenly eagle. "Found it!" Fang Yuan's eyes shined, he summoned the upper extreme heavenly eagle.

Circling briefly, the upper extreme heavenly eagle pierced through space, carrying Fang Yuan into the new blessed land.

Because its former owner had cultivated earth path, the blessed land was covered in rotten black mud.

From time to time, desolate giant mud monsters surged from the soil like black tidal waves.

A small mudman with a strand of green grass on its head floated toward Fang Yuan.

Looking down at the mud, Fang Yuan muttered: "To claim the blessed land, I must defeat five desolate mud monsters at once? Heh, easy."

After annexing this earth path blessed land, his Mini Western Desert gained a huge swamp.

For the next month, Fang Yuan traveled everywhere, locating and annexing blessed lands.

The upper extreme heavenly eagle displayed immense value, Fang Yuan easily got into blessed lands to explore them.

His targets came from searching captive souls like Dong Fang Chang Fan, Xue Song Zi, and Hei Cheng.

Fang Yuan's cultivation soared as he repeatedly skipped calamities and tribulations, steadily expanding the space and resources within the sovereign immortal aperture.

By the time he returned to Lang Ya blessed land, he had already passed two heavenly tribulations, standing as a rank six Gu Immortal a mere three earthly calamities away from his third!

# Chapter 1190: Blood Plain Martial Competition

Northern Plains, Feng Xian grotto-heaven.

The collapse of Eighty-Eight True Yang Building, Bai Zu tribe's rise, and Chu Sect have constantly crossed Longevity Heaven's bottom line. They will never seek my aid—Yao Huang is their only choice!"

"I should go talk to Heavenly Lord Bai Zu first." Yao Huang sighed, storing his immortal aperture and flying into Northern Plains' white heaven.

Receiving Yao Huang's invitation, Heavenly Lord Bai Zu hesitated briefly before agreeing to meet and discuss the matter.

"Friend, what do you think?" Yao Huang smiled and asked.

"Sigh, to tell the truth, I never expected it to reach this point." Heavenly Lord Bai Zu waved his hand, feeling gloomy over the situation.

Yet Chu Du's strength and cunning exceeded Bai Zu's expectations, worsening the situation until Bai Zu could no longer back out.

Yao Huang smiled: "Old friend, do you understand now? Leading a righteous path force isn't easy; even as rank eight Gu Immortals, we cannot act freely."
