Yao Huang fell silent before replying: "I don't want to interfere either, but I cannot help it—Longevity Heaven's token is already in my hands."

Heavenly Lord Bai Zu sighed deeply: "Then we can only fight now."

Yao Huang waved his hand: "That is inevitable, but there is no rush. Though I lead this effort, Longevity Heaven oversees everything. They are watching patiently; fighting now resolves nothing. We should let the juniors clash first."

Heavenly Lord Bai Zu pondered and nodded: "Then in that case, let's decide a date for a martial competition."

"Alright." Yao Huang thought: "Blood Plain is a good choice of location, how about there?"

"That is good." Heavenly Lord Bai Zu agreed instantly.

After finalizing the Blood Plain martial competition, the two Gu Immortals left white heaven and returned to their tribes.

News of the Blood Plain martial competition soon spread across Northern Plains and beyond.

Both sides gathered strength: the righteous path Huang Jin tribes selected only elites, while Bai Zu tribe and Chu Sect recruited outside experts in extensive preparation.

An extremely stunning sword light flashed!

Victory and defeat, life and death, were decided in that instant.

While dark souls still hovered, Granny Yin fell, sliced in two by the sword light.

"That is sword heart clarity, countering wisdom path methods!" Nian Er Yi Fang laughed heartily, seizing the chance to boost his tribe's prestige.

"No, Granny Yin was simply overconfident in her bewitching soul art," Chu Du assessed inwardly. "And Nian Er Ping Zhi is no mere brute—he feigned being struck to deceive her. His lethal move was terrifyingly fast and powerful, almost impossible to guard against. It must be one sword life, the killer move Sword Saint Nian Er used in his youth!"

"Come back quickly," Nian Er Yi Fang urged anxiously through voice transmission despite his high spirits.

Nian Er Ping Zhi had killed Granny Yin, but he had also suffered heavy injuries.

He retreated swiftly, taking both halves of Granny Yin's corpse with him.

Though Xue Wu Hen had won three battles, he had only slain the rank six Liu Hui. Nian Er Ping Zhi had won just one, but had claimed the life of a rank seven demonic immortal.

Soon, the result of this battle reached Fang Yuan.

Fang Yuan was still in Lang Ya blessed land, cultivating.

"Nian Er Ping Zhi killed Granny Yin?" Fang Yuan was only slightly surprised before he accepted this fact.

What made Fang Yuan more interested was instead Xue Wu Hen.

More precisely, he was interested in Xue Wu Hen's spoils—Liu Hui's blessed land.

"Liu Hui's earth path blessed land is suitable for me to annex and push my cultivation to rank seven."

Thinking this, Fang Yuan immediately drafted a reply.

He asked Chu Du to purchase the immortal aperture from Xue Wu Hen.

As for Chu Du's invitation to fight, Fang Yuan tactfully declined under the pretext of secluded cultivation.

"I must reach rank seven first; it won't be too late to join the martial competition then."

Shaking his head, Fang Yuan put news of the martial competition out of his mind.

Chu Du received Fang Yuan's reply.

"If only Elder Liu Guan Yi came, I would not be in such a bind," Chu Du sighed.

Standing beside him, Xue Wu Hen asked curiously: "From your tone, Brother Chu, you seem to hold this Elder Liu Guan Yi in high regard."

Chu Du chuckled: "He mentioned you in his letter, wanting to buy Liu Hui's immortal aperture from you."

Xue Wu Hen shook his head: "The aperture's resources are my spoils. Without knowing their value, I cannot sell them."

His intention of refusal was extremely obvious.

# Chapter 1197: Sword Dragon Transformation

Chu Du smiled.

Knowing Liu Guan Yi had entrusted him with this, Chu Du transmitted: "Brother Xue, collaborating with Elder Liu Guan Yi is likely your best way to extract the resources from Liu Hui's aperture."

"Upper extreme heavenly eagle?! I've heard of this immemorial beast, but never expected Elder Liu Guan Yi to have such a rare bird."

Pausing briefly, Xue Wu Hen transmitted: "I am willing to transact with Elder Liu!"

Right as Fang Yuan's plan was about to succeed, a change happened.

A Gu Immortal walked out of Golden Dawn Hall.

Liu Zhuan Shen called out: "Lord Domination Immortal, my side is willing to exchange Granny Yin's corpse for Elder Liu Hui's corpse and soul."

Liu Zhuan Shen had negotiated with Nian Er tribe and surrendered many benefits to obtain Granny Yin's corpse.

The immortal aperture inside Granny Yin's corpse remained unharmed for now.

Hearing this, Chu Du's side stirred immediately, whispering among themselves.

"Agreeing to Liu Zhuan Shen's request will stabilize these Gu Immortals' minds and ease their worries. Otherwise, falling morale could severely impact future battles."

Chu Du hesitated briefly, mentally apologizing to Liu Guan Yi before agreeing to the transaction.

Liu Zhuan Shen was joyous, both sides exchanged the corpses.

Though losing a rank six earth path aperture and soul, Xue Wu Hen gained a rank seven soul path aperture, with Chu Du secretly compensating him with snow path killer moves.

So, he was quite happy with this result.

Following this event, both sides added a rule to the blood battle martial competition regarding the exchange of corpses and soul captives.

Due to this setback, Fang Yuan's plan fell through.

Soon after, Fang Yuan received a letter from Chu Du explaining the situation and apologizing.

Fang Yuan understood Chu Du's difficulty.

Standing in a Gu refinement secret room, he muttered: "A soul path aperture is useless to me. It seems I must act personally to seize the aperture I want and advance to rank seven."

With so many forces present at the competition, Familiar Face alone was not enough; Fang Yuan needed new offensive methods.

After all, he had publicly claimed to be a transformation path Gu Immortal.

"I have Flying Bear Strength Immortal Gu, but the flying bear transformation's power is quite poor."

"Fortunately, I considered this beforehand and have multiple solutions ready!"

Fang Yuan's gaze fell upon the dragon corpse before him.

Its silvery body bore a spear-sharp horn, pure white eyes, fearsome fangs, and gleaming metallic scales.

This two-clawed silver dragon was an authentic sword path desolate beast—a sword dragon.

This was the transformation Fang Yuan had prepared to cultivate ——Sword Dragon Transformation!

"Sword dragon transformation requires dragon scale Gu, dragon horn Gu, dragon claw Gu, dragon eyes Gu, and others. If any one is an Immortal Gu, it becomes an immortal killer move."

"However, I have Change Form Immortal Gu, a core essence of transformation path. Thus, using Change Form Immortal Gu as the core alongside mortal supplementary Gu, I can form sword dragon transformation."

As a wisdom path grandmaster, Fang Yuan not only deduced sword dragon transformation, but improved it to be faster and nimbler.

Activating the Gu refinement formation, he began refining this desolate beast sword dragon.

Some days later.

Fang Yuan took a deep breath, thoughts surging as Gu worms activated one after another.

In a single breath, piercing silver radiance erupted from his entire body.

As the silver light dissipated, an elegant, razor-sharp silver sword dragon appeared.

The sword dragon's white eyes flashed with intelligence.

It was Fang Yuan!

"Immortal killer move sword dragon transformation is refined. Next..."

Fang Yuan tested his new form, flexing claws and fangs and flying through the sky.

Once thoroughly accustomed to this form, Fang Yuan began testing the killer move's might.

Maintaining the sword dragon transformation consumed little green grape immortal essence, as it only involved rank six Change Form Immortal Gu.

Fang Yuan moved toward the subterranean adamantite and clawed at it!

Though subterranean adamantite was among the hardest rank six immortal materials, clear claw marks several inches deep immediately appeared.

Knowing the power limit of his claws, Fang Yuan saw no need to test them on the nearby rank seven material.

# Chapter 1198: Dragon Breath

Stretching his dragon body, Fang Yuan flew to the rank seven immortal material.

This giant dark inkstone was an exceptionally firm rank seven immortal material.

His claws slashed at it, unable to leave any trace.

Fang Yuan turned and lashed out violently with his tail!

Pain shot through his tail, causing Fang Yuan to draw a sharp breath of cold air.

While on the dark inkstone's surface, a thin crack appeared.

Surpassing even its tail's power was the sword dragon's speed.

The sword dragon's burst speed from a standstill was impressive.

While unable to match Sword Escape, it was not inferior to Blood Torrent.

Moreover, its innate speed allowed Fang Yuan to maneuver far more nimbly.

And the sword dragon's strongest weapon was its dragon breath.

Fang Yuan tested his dragon breath.

Instantly, a flash of white light shot at the rank six subterranean adamantite.

While his claws only left shallow marks, the razor-sharp dragon breath sliced the giant subterranean adamantite clean in two!

Next, he continued to test.

He tested his dragon breath against the rank seven dark inkstone.

The dragon breath carved marks several inches deep into the dark inkstone.

Fang Yuan unleashed sixteen consecutive blasts before reaching his limit.

He calculated: "On my own strength, I can fire dragon breath sixteen consecutive times. After resting for five minutes, I can recover and fire again." But it is just barely possible, and after breathing out the seventeenth dragon breath, I will once again fall into the previous plight and will still need to rest for five minutes of time.""

"With only a rank six Immortal Gu core, sword dragon transformation possesses decent strength, but is still insufficient against rank seven Gu Immortals."

Normally, rank seven Gu Immortals possessed defensive methods stronger than dark inkstone.

Even dragon breath had only managed to gouge the dark inkstone.

In its current state, sword dragon transformation was insufficient for the martial competition.

Fang Yuan was well aware of this.

He naturally had follow-up methods.

Canceling his transformation, he flew from his cloud city and soon arrived before Lang Ya land spirit.

Fang Yuan stated his intent directly: "Greetings, First Supreme Elder, I am here to exchange for sect contribution points."

Lang Ya land spirit rejoiced, knowing Fang Yuan possessed immense treasures from his various inheritances.

"First, take a look at this." Fang Yuan produced an item.

"A Gu Immortal's soul?" Lang Ya land spirit frowned. Immortal souls served as immortal materials—especially soul path ones—and contained even greater value in their cultivation memories.

Accepting the soul, the land spirit found Fang Yuan had tampered with it; unable to be soul searched, it could only serve as immortal material.

"Like this, this soul is only worth a hundred contribution points," Lang Ya land spirit said with slight disappointment.

Fang Yuan smiled: "Placed on Dang Hun Mountain, Gu Immortal souls yield a massive harvest of guts Gu. With guts Gu production currently stalled, this soul will easily satisfy the rockman tribe's demands."

Realizing this, Lang Ya land spirit nodded: "That is indeed true."

Reassessing the value, he said: "This rank six Gu Immortal soul can be worth two hundred and ten sect contribution points, then."

# Chapter 1199: Huge Sale

Fang Yuan nodded in agreement.

This price was fair, boosted by the soul's utility for guts Gu.

Lang Ya land spirit said: "This soul will drastically increase our guts Gu production. Desolate beast and desolate plant souls might be far inferior to Gu Immortal souls, but we can offset it with quantity and the source is also stable. With you taking action, we should be able to develop even more quickly in Tai Qiu."

Fang Yuan replied: "Here is a second Gu Immortal soul for First Supreme Elder to appraise."

"A second?" Lang Ya land spirit raised his eyebrows, not surprised.

Immediately afterwards, he brought out a third Gu Immortal soul.

In another cloud city.

Twelfth Hair was in the midst of refining Gu.

Otherwise, these self will Gu would be destroyed, not only would it waste the effort I spent over these last few days to refine these Gu, I would also have to compensate for it with three times the refinement materials."

# Chapter 1200: Dragon Breath Immortal Gu

Thinking of Fang Yuan, he subconsciously glanced at the top of Lang Ya Sect's contribution list.

However, the next moment, Twelfth Hair's whole body suddenly stiffened.

"Over fifteen thousand sect contribution points?! How?!" Twelfth Hair felt like he was hallucinating.

Twenty thousand, thirty thousand... fifty thousand, eighty thousand...

"It surpassed... eighty thousand!" Twelfth Hair watched in stupefaction as the number showed no sign of stopping!

After reaching over ninety thousand, Fang Yuan's total contribution points suddenly plummeted by over seventy thousand!

"Over seventy thousand points vanished—don't tell me he took Beast Enslavement?!"

Rank seven Immortal Gu — Dragon Breath!

Dragon breath!

Fang Yuan opened his mouth and breathed out.

The cloud city shook violently as numerous Gu forming the room died instantly.

"I controlled my strength, and the inkstone bore most of the breath—only a fraction leaked out." Joy flashed in the ancient sword dragon's eyes.

Green grape immortal essence drained continuously to maintain the ancient sword dragon form.

"I cannot practice here, but leaving will draw more attention from heaven's will."

"It seems I must place my sovereign immortal aperture to properly test this ancient sword dragon transformation."

"How powerful will it be when combining this rank seven dragon breath with my sword path killer moves?"

Fang Yuan was feeling anticipation.

Acting decisively, he flew out of cloud city and teleported outside through the super Gu formation.

Sixth Hair watched Fang Yuan vanish through the super Gu formation, wondering why he exchanged for Dragon Breath.

Learning of the change in sect contribution points, Sixth Hair grew deeply uneasy.

"Fang Yuan wouldn't exchange for a useless Immortal Gu. I must report this to Lord Ying Wu Xie."

# Chapter 1201: Ye Lui Qun Xing

Golden Dawn Hall floated majestically in the air, remaining lofty and unmoved despite the turbulence outside.

In contrast, Chu Du's Gu Immortals stood upon clouds with grim, worried expressions.

Chu Du was expressionless, but his gaze was extremely heavy.

"Immortal Wang is going to lose." Chu Du sighed internally.

At center stage, Immortal Wang battled righteous path Gu Immortal Ye Lui Qun Xing!

Immortal Wang had transformed into a heaven swallowing hound, rampaging with astonishing might.

Immortal Wang was only rank seven and lacked a rank eight Immortal Gu, capping his immemorial hound transformation at rank seven battle strength.

His opponent, Ye Lui Qun Xing, was tall and thin as a bamboo pole, with a three-strand beard and sallow skin. Far from the hound, he was encircled by hundreds of brilliant star fragments dyeing the sky blue.

Immortal Wang attacked with all his strength.

However, countless star fragments, big and small, tightly surrounded him.

The star fragments ranged from lantern- to elephant-sized. A small portion encircled Immortal Wang at dizzying speeds, while the majority orbited Ye Lui Qun Xing in slow, mysterious trajectories.

With a muffled thump, a star fragment slammed into Immortal Wang.

The heaven swallowing hound slowed, exposing a flaw while dodging.

Seizing the opening, three star fragments crashed fiercely into Immortal Wang.

The heaven swallowing hound growled low, coughing blood and staggering, nearly collapsing to the ground.

He declared clearly: "It is futile, Immortal Wang. Modeled on Dong Fang Chang Fan's myriad star fireflies, my killer move's trajectories are inscrutable. Six star fragments obstructed you earlier; now thirty-six surround you. How will you break through?"

Heavily injured, dizzy, and hemorrhaging immortal essence under relentless star fragment strikes, Immortal Wang could not even retort.

Chu Du's immortals looked increasingly grim.

"If Immortal Wang loses, he will be the fourth person Ye Lui Qun Xing has defeated from our side!"

"His killer move is too formidable. Fifteen fragments working together increased the difficulty countless times, but with a hundred, he has achieved complete dominance."

Inside Golden Dawn Hall, the righteous path immortals smiled.

The righteous path alliance and the Chu-Bai Zu alliance had already fought over ten battles.

Initially, Chu Du astutely sent the young Xue Wu Hen, who won three consecutive battles to widespread awe.

Gong Wan Ting countered with Nian Er Ping Zhi, who slew renowned demonic expert Granny Yin with sword heart clarity.

Gong Wan Ting then negotiated a temporary ceasefire with Chu Du, setting rules for exchanging corpses.

When battles resumed, righteous immortals from Yuan, Meng, and other tribes clashed with Chu Du's side, which fielded Hao Zhen, Chou Lao Wu, and Bai Zu tribe immortals.

As veteran Gu Immortals, both sides traded wins and losses with varying injuries, but suffered no deaths.

Seeing the stalemate, Gong Wan Ting pondered briefly before sending Ye Lui Qun Xing.

Finally, Chu Du spoke: "Alright, this battle is our loss."

Immortal Wang retreated with a shameful expression.

Ye Lui Qun Xing did not pursue the kill; Immortal Wang still possessed defensive capability, allowing Chu Du time to intervene.

Reverting to human form, Immortal Wang approached Chu Du, saying heavily: "Ye Lui Qun Xing's killer move is extremely ingenious. Its essence cost is minimal, and the star fragments generate strong magnetic attraction; discerning its mysteries would be difficult for anyone except a star path Gu Immortal."

"The fragments are swift, creating invisible forces that skewed my movements and made me lose control repeatedly. He was weakest in his first fight, but now a hundred star fragments form a battle array. Later challengers will lose advantages and find it very difficult against this array."

Chu Du patted Immortal Wang's shoulder: "Say no more, it is enough that you returned safely."

This simple gesture moved Immortal Wang almost to tears.

"Who will fight next!" Ye Lui Qun Xing called out.

"He refuses to retreat and seeks a fifth battle!" Chu Du's expression shifted, killing intent flashing in his eyes.

Chu Du found himself in the awkward position of having no experts to deploy.

While Golden Dawn Hall brimmed with righteous experts, Chu Du's side—a newly formed alliance of Bai Zu tribe and his sect—was severely undermanned.

---

# Chapter 1202: Arrogance Concealed Under Beauty

"What, no one wants to fight? Are you out of people already?" Ye Lui Qun Xing seized the chance to mock them.

Just then, his eyes brightened as an information path Gu arrived via treasure yellow heaven.

"Wonderful! Elder Liu Guan Yi's timing is perfect." Chu Du scanned the information, his brows relaxing immediately.

"Be patient. Chu Sect's second supreme elder is arriving. Why rush, Ye Lui Qun Xing? Enjoy your victory a little longer," Chu Du chuckled plainly.

"Chu Sect's second supreme elder?"

"He has arrived." Chu Du suddenly spoke.

The immortals turned to look where Chu Du indicated.

A multicolored cloud sped forward, bearing a youthful Gu Immortal standing proudly at the front.

He wore a white robe, its wide sleeves fluttering in the wind.

With long black hair, snow-white skin, sharp brows, and bright eyes, he smiled faintly in an unfettered manner, striking in his extraordinary handsomeness.

"Elder Liu, you have finally come," Chu Du smiled brightly, welcoming him.

"This Gu worm records earlier battles; look at it quickly." Chu Du flew before Fang Yuan and secretly passed him an information path mortal Gu.

Fang Yuan silently accepted it.

"That is Ye Lui Qun Xing, a star path cultivator who has defeated four of our members. Show your might and defeat him," Chu Du whispered, pointing toward Ye Lui Qun Xing standing proudly in the air.

Fang Yuan thought: "He is why I came. A star path blessed land suits my annexation. Annexing his rank seven aperture will immediately boost my cultivation to rank seven and produce red date immortal essence."

Fang Yuan, however, internally was shaking his head.

Fang Yuan estimated low odds of killing him. Though ancient sword dragon form matched Unfettered Scholar's power, his stamina was limited—green grape immortal essence could not compare to red date immortal essence.

Powering rank seven Immortal Gu took at least a hundred and thirty green grape beads to match the effect of a single red date bead.

As he pondered this, Fang Yuan spoke: "I won't fight."

The immortals were stunned.

"Why won't you fight—are you afraid?" Immortal Wang sneered from behind.

Chu Du looked at Fang Yuan silently, his gaze asking why he refused to fight.

Fang Yuan sneered at Ye Lui Qun Xing: "He is too weak—I can kill him with spit. Why use an ox-cleaver for a chicken? Fighting him insults my status."

A young Gu Immortal immediately shouted: "You dare not fight, yet talk big! How can you gauge Lord Qun Xing's might? You aren't being proud—you're just terrified!"

# Chapter 1203: Shameless

"This weakling?"

Fang Yuan laughed: "Rest as much as you want—take two or three days, or two or three years!"

"Hehe, an hour is enough." Ye Lui Qun Xing smiled with clenched teeth.

Finally, Ye Lui Qun Xing recovered and walked to the stage, standing opposite Fang Yuan.

"Liu Guan Yi, I..." Before Ye Lui Qun Xing could speak, Fang Yuan's body erupted in dazzling silver light.

The next instant, a silver ancient sword dragon shot out from the light.

It bore a sharp horn, its gaping maw densely lined with sharp fangs.

"So despicable!"

The righteous path's immortals scolded at once.

The ancient sword dragon had already neared Ye Lui Qun Xing.

# Chapter 1204: How Could It Be Seen Through?!

Ye Lui Qun Xing had a great fright as he quickly retreated!

"This shameless guy!" he cursed inwardly. Every time he thought Fang Yuan was shameless, Fang Yuan's next move completely redefined it.

The distance between Fang Yuan and Ye Lui Qun Xing was rapidly shrinking.

Retreating, Ye Lui Qun Xing shouted and pushed toward the charging ancient sword dragon.

Brilliant blue light erupted from his hand as a star fragment shot out like a meteor toward Fang Yuan.

Fang Yuan roared and arced gracefully through the air, nimbly dodging past the incoming star fragment with inches to spare.

With a sharp crack, Fang Yuan's tail swung and smashed the bypassed star fragment.

The ancient sword dragon's tail was even deadlier than its claws, capable of smashing dark inkstone, let alone this star fragment.

Seeing Fang Yuan respond so astutely, Ye Lui Qun Xing grew disappointed and accelerated his retreat.

Clapping repeatedly, blue light coated his hands as star fragments shot out one after another.

Starting thumb-sized, they regained their original size midair and accelerated, kicking up powerful gusts of wind.

Fang Yuan used his horn, claws, body, and tail to shatter every star fragment.

He did not give Ye Lui Qun Xing any opportunity to accumulate power.

Fang Yuan wisely targeted the weakness of Ye Lui Qun Xing's immortal killer move by smashing star fragments, but this reduced his speed.

Ye Lui Qun Xing had already stabilized himself.

Snorting, he struck out rapidly, scattering star fragments in all directions rather than directly at Fang Yuan.

Hesitating, the ancient sword dragon's offensive slowed.

Though brief, Fang Yuan's hesitation cost him the opportunity as dozens of star fragments filled the battlefield.

Ye Lui Qun Xing's advantage had started to accumulate.

Encircled by star fragments, Fang Yuan attacked frantically regardless of injury, yet failed to break through the layers of encirclement.

Ye Lui Qun Xing relaxed as more star fragments multiplied, surrounding Fang Yuan and orbiting steadily around himself.

"Liu Guan Yi, your arrogant boasting was just to make me retract my star fragments and deploy them again."

"A deep scheme, nearly convincing everyone of your arrogance. Unfortunately, I am not the same person I was years ago."

"Years ago, I patched this weakness in my killer move. Your methods cannot restrain me."

"Now, what are you going to use to resolve this situation?"

Stroking his beard with a brightening smile, Ye Lui Hui Hong reminded Ye Lui Qun Xing: "Be careful of his dragon breath. It is the ancient sword dragon's strongest weapon, yet he hasn't breathed out once."

Looking at his orbiting star fragments, Ye Lui Qun Xing thought: "A hundred star fragments protect me. Even Chu Du could only hold me briefly, let alone this Liu Guan Yi. Dong Fang Chang Fan, you might have passed away, but let me sustain the reputation of myriad star fireflies for you. After all, my immortal killer move had received your guidance."

Just as most Gu Immortals felt the battle was decided, a sudden change occurred!

Sword escape Immortal Gu!

Suddenly, Fang Yuan activated rank seven sword escape Immortal Gu.

In ancient sword dragon form, his transformation dao marks converted to sword path, reaching ten thousand when combined with sword eyebrows Immortal Gu.

Sword dragons lacked strong ranged attacks, but their burst of speed from a stationary state was astonishing.

Combining the ancient sword dragon, sword escape Immortal Gu, and ten thousand sword path dao marks, Fang Yuan vanished instantly.

Before anyone could react, he crossed the entire battlefield and appeared before Ye Lui Qun Xing!

Ye Lui Qun Xing's victorious smile froze as his pupils shrank to pinpricks, staring in terror at the gigantic sword dragon head filling his vision!

"Impossible! My star fragments' trajectories derive from myriad star fireflies, how could he see through them?!"

This was Ye Lui Qun Xing's final thought in life.

# Chapter 1205: Be Careful of Liu Guan Yi

The ancient sword dragon smashed through all obstructing star fragments in its path and reached Ye Lui Qun Xing.

He opened his mouth and breathed out.

While Ye Lui Qun Xing remained confident in his defenses, his head was instantly sliced off.

Fang Yuan smoothly grabbed his body.

Part of Ye Lui Qun Xing's soul was severed, and Fang Yuan stored it in his immortal aperture before it could escape the body.

Even after finishing these four actions, Fang Yuan's dragon body charged several li beyond the battlefield.

"Fortunately, I succeeded and killed Ye Lui Qun Xing. My luck is pretty good!"

"First, I need to find a place to annex this immortal aperture before doing anything else."

Fang Yuan did not return, directly flying away from Blood Plain.

Gu Immortals from both sides watched dazedly until he disappeared into the horizon.

Staring at the messy battlefield of star debris and drifting fragments, the immortals finally came to a sudden realization!

Inside Golden Dawn Hall, Nu Er Gu broke the long silence with a grave expression: "Stay alert. This Liu Guan Yi is extremely crafty; be vigilant if you encounter him in the future."

Reflecting on his performance, they all recognized how insidious and sly Fang Yuan was.

"Lady Gong Wan Ting," Ye Lui Hui Hong bowed deeply toward the main seat. "Ye Lui Qun Xing was of pure Huang Jin bloodline; dying here makes him a hero of our people. But now, his corpse is still in his killer's hands, his soul also might still be alive. I sincerely request to come forward and recover Qun Xing's corpse and his soul."

"Of course." Gong Wan Ting softly agreed, her attitude was straightforward and clear.

Surprised by Fang Yuan's sudden departure, Chu Du had already sent an inquiry—with Fang Yuan's strength, Chu Du still needed to rely on him.

Just as Gong Wan Ting asked, Chu Du coincidentally received Fang Yuan's reply in his immortal aperture:

"I have great use for Ye Lui Qun Xing's corpse! Brother Chu, if you have no choice, just expel me from Chu Sect."

These were two simple sentences, but they expressed Fang Yuan's firm and unrelenting attitude.

Chu Du spoke calmly to Gong Wan Ting: "Rest assured, Fairy, the corpse will be guarded properly. But to exchange for it, your side must pay a price."

"Everything can be discussed." Ye Lui Hui Hong immediately agreed, his stance was clear.

# Chapter 1206: Becoming Rank Seven!

Fang Yuan had already put the blood battle martial competition out of his mind.

He would never surrender Ye Lui Qun Xing's immortal aperture; even if he could not annex it now, he could do so in the future.

Regarding the righteous path's demand for Ye Lui Qun Xing's corpse and soul, Fang Yuan considered it and was willing to return only the body.

His focus was the immortal aperture, and the soul could be searched for Ye Lui tribe's secrets before yielding Lang Ya Sect contribution points.

"The priority now is to test whether I can annex this immortal aperture."

Using teleportation formations to leave Blood Plain far behind, Fang Yuan arrived over an ordinary grassland. After inspecting and not finding anything wrong, Fang Yuan took out Ye Lui Qun Xing's corpse.

The pitiful fellow's head had already been sliced off entirely.

Fang Yuan treated the headless corpse with temporary measures, ensuring the immortal aperture was preserved.

Fang Yuan had already extracted and properly sealed Ye Lui Qun Xing's soul.

Releasing his seal, Fang Yuan threw the corpse onto the grassland.

Several breaths later, there was turbulence in heaven and earth qi.

The immortal aperture began to land on the ground, causing a huge commotion.

Unsurprisingly, the immortal aperture's entrance opened before Fang Yuan.

The ground protruded upward as a basin-sized star core floated before Fang Yuan.

Resembling a dark blue crystal ball, this azure star core was the blessed land's land spirit.

Amidst soundless communication, Fang Yuan learned about this blessed land's ownership condition.

To ordinary Gu Immortals, this condition was quite difficult.

The land spirit required seeing the true, complete version of the immortal killer move, myriad star fireflies.

"My luck is unstoppable, hahaha." Fang Yuan immediately presented the complete contents of myriad star fireflies to the land spirit.

After a while, Fang Yuan became this blessed land's master.

"Now is the most crucial moment. Let's see if I can annex this blessed land."

Fang Yuan rested for a while before beginning.

Based on predecessor experiences, annexing an immortal aperture required fulfilling three main conditions.

First, annexing an immortal aperture required specific attainment level.

Second, a smaller immortal aperture could not engulf a bigger one.

Third, dead apertures could not be annexed.

Fang Yuan satisfied two conditions to annex Qun Xing blessed land, but one remained somewhat ambiguous.

A smaller immortal aperture could not engulf a bigger one—the question was, what defined small and big?

If judged by cultivation level, where rank six was small and rank seven big, Fang Yuan could not annex Qun Xing blessed land.

If based on aperture foundation, Fang Yuan's sovereign immortal aperture far surpassed Qun Xing blessed land and could devour it.

Fang Yuan had already wanted to test this and verify it.

Bold and skilled, Fang Yuan began testing, annexing Qun Xing blessed land with the land spirit's help.

The process was smooth beyond expectations.

Annexing Qun Xing blessed land added an enormous star fragment plain and bypassed numerous calamities and tribulations, officially advancing Fang Yuan from rank six to rank seven.

Rank seven Gu Immortal!

"From this moment on, I am a rank seven Gu Immortal. I have finally become a rank seven..."

Fang Yuan was filled with emotions.

Across five hundred years in his first life, he had only reached rank six second heavenly tribulation—now knowing heaven's will had deliberately suppressed his cultivation.

Through countless fortuitous encounters, effort, and perseverance, Fang Yuan had finally broken through heaven's will's restrictions to reach rank seven.

At this moment, the sovereign immortal aperture began to produce red date immortal essence.

He could also merge his accumulated green grape immortal essence into red date immortal essence.

"Using green grape immortal essence for rank seven Immortal Gu adds at least thirty percent extra cost. Merging them into red date immortal essence avoids that wasteful loss."

"With reserves of red date immortal essence, I will no longer fear battles of attrition. The crisis when Heavenly Lord Bai Zu attacked Hei Fan grotto-heaven will be completely behind me!"

# Chapter 1207: Doing Something Bad

"This is your strongest attack? Hmm, you have singed some of my hair—a bit stronger than before." This Murong tribe Gu Immortal spoke calmly without frustration.

"You!" Hao Zhen's eyes blazed with fury, but he could not retort.

His strongest killer move had no effect on this opponent.

It was this burly man who seemed to be forged from steel — Murong Gang!

Admitting defeat, a pale-faced Hao Zhen returned: "I am ashamed, I could not live up to your expectations."

"Supreme Elder, you are our strongest expert, but you cannot easily take the stage. I think you need to call back Elder Liu," Immortal Wang suggested.

His suggestion was immediately approved by many Gu Immortals.

Murong Gang called out: "Domination Immortal, stop sending minor characters. Bring out Liu Guan Yi; I would like to experience his dragon breath."

Chu Du naturally also hoped Fang Yuan would take the stage again.

But Fang Yuan had not given any reply.

Chu Du could only smile bitterly at this, and could do nothing about it.

Their relationship was built on mutual benefit and equal status.

Lang Ya blessed land, inside a secret room in a cloud city.

Fang Yuan was sitting cross-legged on a prayer mat, his divine sense entering his immortal aperture.

He was merging green grape immortal essence into red date immortal essence.

"Chu Du sent another letter about Murong Gang... this is already the sixth." Fang Yuan's attention shifted slightly.

He tossed the information path mortal Gu aside, disinterested in even replying.

What blood battle martial competition, I don't give a f*ck!

Screw off.

Fang Yuan's agreement with Chu Sect was extremely loose; he faced no backlash if he abandoned a task or departed voluntarily.

"The blood battle martial competition does not match my interests."

"With the sovereign immortal aperture, I can annex apertures to skip tribulations and raise my cultivation. A bloody shortcut, but... I like it."

"I want chaos, the more chaos, the better!"

"But the five regions chaotic war is still over four hundred years away! I can't wait that long."

"I must find a way to make them fight. The blood battle martial competition is too gentle—without deaths, there won't be blessed lands."

"There is also Lang Ya Sect and the four races alliance—how would Northern Plains react if they knew? Regretfully, alliance agreements still bind me."

Fang Yuan only worried the world was not chaotic enough; sinister, dangerous thoughts surged in his mind.

Fang Yuan had first thought of going to Southern Border.

Lately, he had adjusted his cultivation plan, spending nearly all his time and energy refining dream path mortal Gu.

It was all preparation for Southern Border's giant dream realm.

Yet on second thought, the opportunity presented by the blood battle martial competition was simply too rare.

Furthermore, Southern Border's righteous path had tightly defended the giant dream realm with a super Gu formation, leaving no opening currently.

After converting his green grape immortal essence into red date immortal essence, Fang Yuan quietly departed for Liu tribe's territory.

He was going to do something bad.

# Chapter 1208: With the Murder Weapon in Hand, Killing Intent Surges

Northern Plains, Bone Burial Field.

Gu Immortal Liu Yong was paying close attention.

Possessing the Huang Jin bloodline, he was a rank six enslavement path Gu Immortal of Liu tribe.

"Hmm? An information Gu from the tribe?" His brows rose and his eyes gleamed, sensing something interesting was coming.

His consciousness quickly entered his immortal aperture to inspect the information path Gu worm.

The message detailed Fang Yuan's strength and ancient sword dragon transformation, emphasizing how shameless, devious, and scheming he was.

Fang Yuan's 'Liu Guan Yi' persona had gained immense notoriety; throughout Northern Plains, even Prince Feng Xian and Heavenly Lord Bai Zu knew of him, and word had reached other regions like Central Continent.

Liu Yong was pondering this when a huge explosion suddenly erupted.

"What is going on?!" The tremors knocked the giant skull beneath Liu Yong off its skeleton's neck.

Liu Yong quickly floated into the air, staring in bewilderment: "The defensive Gu formation is under attack? Someone dares attack Liu tribe's territory!"

An ancient sword dragon!

It had pale white eyes, a sky-piercing horn, gleaming scales, and chilling fangs that made Liu Yong shudder.

"Oh? A Liu tribe member is here? My luck is pretty good." The ancient sword dragon spoke in human tongue, its eyes radiating intense killing intent.

"Liu, Liu Guan Yi?!" Liu Yong was stunned.

Though his name signified 'courage,' Liu Yong was utterly gutless now, stammering with a trembling tongue: "Liu, Lord Liu, why are you at my Liu tribe..."

"Of course it is to..." Fang Yuan purposely dragged his words out.

"Is, is to what?" Liu Yong asked.

Fang Yuan replied not with words, but with dragon breath.

Powered by dragon breath Immortal Gu, the ancient sword dragon's breath shot out like white light!

Liu Yong's upper body blew up.

The two halves of his corpse landed on the ground, his pre-death expression still frozen with wide-open eyes.

"Useless fellow. But the Huang Jin tribes have been in power for too long; internal rot is unavoidable, just like the ten great ancient sects," Fang Yuan analyzed.

An hour later, six unconscious bone armor hounds lay inside Fang Yuan's sovereign immortal aperture.

These desolate beast hounds came at a good time, as Fang Yuan needed their faeces to feed dog shit luck Immortal Gu.

Finally, Fang Yuan temporarily sealed the immortal aperture still hidden within Liu Yong's corpse.

This enslavement path immortal aperture was suited for Fang Yuan to annex.

And also, Liu Yong's soul.

Though severely weakened by the dragon breath and at Fang Yuan's mercy, it was still alive.

Fang Yuan quickly realized: "Liu Yong was an enslavement path Gu Immortal; since enslavement relates to soul path, manipulating desolate beasts requires a strong soul foundation."

Fang Yuan quickly left the scene of the crime.

"The next location, Liu tribe's jade light pit."

Fang Yuan licked his lips, showing excitement in his eyes.

Having just committed murder, he had no intention of retreating—he was off to strike again!

As the saying goes — With the murder weapon in hand, killing intent surges.

With soaring battle strength from the ancient sword dragon transformation, Fang Yuan grew increasingly unrestrained.

# Chapter 1209: Looting Another Place

"What if Liu Guan Yi returns and harms my sister? If anything happens to her, I will take it out on you both!" Liu Chang shouted.

"Brother is the best." Liu Luo was joyous.

The two Liu tribe Gu Immortals looked at each other with bitter expressions.

# Chapter 1212: Burning Soul Bursting Luck!

First, there was luck!

Ying Wu Xie's immortal killer move — Burning Soul Bursting Luck.

Before Bai Ning Bing left, Ying Wu Xie had used Connect Luck to link their fortunes.

To help Bai Ning Bing subdue the rank nine flame, Ying Wu Xie could only bolster their connected fortunes!

On the other hand, near the giant dream realm.

Two Gu Immortals appeared beneath his tree.

"Brother Luo, thank you for this." A Gu Immortal said.

"I can bring you in, but if you are discovered, it has nothing to do with me," the other replied.

# Chapter 1214: Situation of Southern Border

Beyond his expectations, this dream realm "immortal opportunity business" was thriving on a scale far grander than anticipated.

Judging by the bustling Gu House and Lady White Rabbit's words, any demonic or lone cultivator willing to pay could enter the righteous path's formation and explore the dream realm.

First, he required extended, repeated access to explore the giant dream realm.

Second, he needed a cover identity that allowed him to remain stationed there even if anomalies arose.

Trapped inside the formation, he would be fish on the chopping block—especially since he lacked heavenly crystals to feed the upper extreme heavenly eagle.

Fang Yuan said, handing Fairy White Rabbit a rank six immortal material.

"Use this," Fairy White Rabbit replied, handing him an information path mortal Gu.

The Legends of Ren Zu, chapter four, section twenty-six —

Ren Zu's daughter, Boundless Forest Samsara, was trapped inside Ordinary Abyss.

Boundless Forest Samsara was shocked: "Oh strength Gu, why are you here?"

Boundless Forest Samsara thought and asked: "Strength Gu, can you give us advice like wisdom Gu?"

Boundless Forest Samsara thought about it and nodded: "You are right, strength Gu, I will rely on you."

Boundless Forest Samsara watched in shock; the miniman was truly at the abyss's edge, ready to escape.

Boundless Forest Samsara shouted: "Oh miniman, do you not feel cold?"

The miniman replied: "Of course, but I must build my ladder and climb out."

Boundless Forest Samsara shouted again: "Oh miniman, do you not feel lonely?"

The miniman replied: "Of course, but I must build my ladder and climb out."

Boundless Forest Samsara shouted again: "Oh miniman, do you not feel afraid?"

The miniman replied: "Of course, but I must build my ladder and climb out."

# Chapter 1315: Convincing Old Monster

Southern Border.

Light rain was drizzling on a range of verdant mountains.

Robed in blue, Fang Yuan stood atop a rock gazing across the grand landscape before fixing his eyes on a particular mountain.

This was Mount Snail.

An immemorial desolate beast, it was a colossal river snail with a towering spiral shell drenched in green moss.

There were seven known Mount Snails in Southern Border. Super forces had long agreed that any wild, uncontrolled Mount Snail belonged to whichever clan's territory it inhabited.

Living within Wu clan's territory, this Mount Snail naturally belonged to them.

Now migrating, the Mount Snail was departing Wu clan's territory for other lands.

Mount Snail was heading toward an area without other righteous path super forces.

This meant the Mount Snail would become wild once more.

Unwilling to let this happen and lacking manpower, Wu Yong had no choice but to assign this task to his brother, Wu Yi Hai.

"Wu Yi Hai? I am Qin Jin Sheng, I am also called Mountain Moving Old Monster." A Gu Immortal flew over from another mountain peak.

Clad in rocky grey armor, the slovenly old immortal had messy straw-like hair of mixed black and white, with frayed, shredded robes.

Yet his rank seven aura was majestic and forceful, his eyes shining with sharp light as he sized up Fang Yuan like a junior.

Hearing Mountain Moving Old Monster introduce himself, Fang Yuan bowed slightly with righteous path etiquette: "Wu Yi Hai greets Senior Mountain Moving." Fang Yuan bowed slightly with righteous path etiquette.

"Hehehe, it was about time your Wu clan sent someone. Let's sit and talk." Mountain Moving Old Monster laughed, sitting on a rock.

Fang Yuan smiled and also sat down.

Seeing that Fang Yuan sat without objection or arrogance, Mountain Moving Old Monster's impression improved: "I almost forgot you were a lone cultivator. Though you joined Wu clan, you lack the hypocrisy of the righteous path."

Mountain Moving Old Monster laughed heartily: "I hear you chased away Xia clan's two Gu Immortals, yet plundered the resources of Frosty Peak."

He laughed loudly, then sighed deeply: "Righteous path Gu Immortals cannot understand you, but I do. How difficult is it for lone cultivators to become immortals? We must earn every cultivation resource ourselves. Without future guarantees, we must grasp present benefits with all our might. Who knows what tomorrow brings?"

Fang Yuan knew these words were not mere pleasantries, but an expression of resolve: as a lone cultivator, Mountain Moving Old Monster's present benefit was Mount Snail. His resolve was unshakable, as former lone cultivator Wu Yi Hai should understand.

"I understand senior's intention, but please have some understanding; I have my own difficulties coming here," Fang Yuan said.

Mountain Moving Old Monster snickered: "Everyone has their own difficulties."

Sometimes, silence was a useful tactic in verbal confrontations.

Sure enough, Mountain Moving Old Monster grew restless and handed an information path mortal Gu to Fang Yuan: "Take a look."

The contents listed in this mortal Gu had high value. If Fang Yuan obtained them, he could directly construct coiling thread caves!

"We will cooperate: I take Mount Snail and you get these, what do you think?" Mountain Moving Old Monster smiled.

"Senior wants to exchange these for an immemorial desolate beast?" Fang Yuan held the information path mortal Gu, smiling faintly.

"The resources inside are very valuable! Mount Snail is an immemorial desolate beast, but who can control it? As its owner, I will only take its resources. We can talk if you have conditions." Mountain Moving Old Monster's eyes brightened, his attitude warming.

"The contents of this list must be doubled at least." This was Fang Yuan's first condition.

"Mount Snail cannot be yours in name, it will still belong to Wu clan." This was Fang Yuan's second condition.

"In truth, senior will be its owner and take most benefits, but you must hand over a portion of resources to Wu clan annually." This was Fang Yuan's third condition.

Mountain Moving Old Monster sneered with a darkening expression: "Wu Yi Hai, are you playing with me?"

"Of course not." Fang Yuan stood up with a sober expression, meeting his gaze fearlessly: "Senior, may I ask three questions?"

Mountain Moving Old Monster barely restrained his anger: "Speak."

"First, senior is unaffiliated with any super force; how could Wu clan leave Mount Snail in your hands? Yielding to a super force is one thing, but letting a lone cultivator take benefits damages Wu clan's prestige."

"Second, even if you take Mount Snail now, how long can you defend it? Even if Wu clan does not interfere, what about other super forces?"

"Third, senior, do you think bribing me alone will make all of Wu clan simply watch from the sidelines?"

Mountain Moving Old Monster fell into silence.

After a long while, he sighed hoarsely: "Under your plan, wouldn't I become a mountain guard for Wu clan?"

Fang Yuan smiled faintly: "That is merely minor reputation. How could everything be perfect? These conditions are reasonable only because I was once a lone cultivator myself. Consider properly whether you want face or real benefits."

This silence lasted even longer; only as the drizzle ceased did he speak: "Alright, we will go according to your plan."

# Chapter 1316: Moon Festival

# Chapter 1318: Story of the Moon Festival

Fairy Tian Lu smoothed over the mood: "The moon is high, and we have shared tea; without poems, this festival would be incomplete."

Fang Yuan feigned confusion: "Are we really going to recite poems?"

He looked like he had heard it for the first time.

Competing in poetry?!

Hailing from Earth, Fang Yuan had a vast mental stockpile of famous poems and masterpieces; reciting just one would easily humiliate them both.

"Yes, poetry recitation has a story behind it," Qiao Si Liu answered him.

"Oh? Please explain." Fang Yuan continued to ask.

"This legend has been passed down in Southern Border as the origin of the moon festival," Qiao Si Liu explained eloquently.

Once upon a time, at a certain village in Southern Border.

"You are a mere mortal while my daughter is a Gu Master with a bright future—how could you be worthy of her? Get lost!"

As the youth begged, the old Gu Master sneered: "You daydream if you think I will let her marry you! A mortal who cannot even brew tea—what use do you have?"

The youth retorted: "Is brewing tea so difficult? If I brew it, will you marry your daughter to me?"

"If you brew a cup of tea meeting my expectations, I will give you a chance."

Overjoyed, the youth agreed at once: "Sir, I will definitely make it."

The youth replied: "Do not worry. Who says mortals cannot brew tea? Let me explain three principles."

"First principle: the law of the jungle—big fish eat small fish, and small fish eat shrimp."

With that, he caught a big fish from a stream, cut it open to retrieve a small fish inside, then sliced the small fish to take out a shrimp.

"The second principle: humans must eat and defecate."

The youth then ate the shrimp and excreted a pile of feces.

"The third principle: faeces can nourish vegetation to grow better."

The youth buried his feces under the soil, and sure enough, plants and flowers began to flourish.

Plucking a flower from among them, he steeped it in the stream, turning the entire stream into tea.

Taking a sip, the old Gu Master was left speechless for a long time.

His daughter said, "Father, you are not thinking of reneging on your promise, right?"

Only then did the old Gu Master nod reluctantly: "Boy, you passed the first test. But you are still an uncultured mortal who cannot recite poems; you cannot marry my daughter."

The youth scratched his head apprehensively: "Although I haven't recited poems before, I can try."

"Try then, so you cannot say I gave no chance. If you fail, leave and never see my daughter again."

Looking grim, Fairy Tong Hua nodded: "I am repaying most of it first; the rest will follow later."

"What is it? If you wish to lend more immortal essence stones, forgive me, but I will decline," Fairy Tong Hua said coldly with a slight frown.

After a brief silence, Fairy Tong Hua asked: "Which wood path great expert?"

Ren Xiu Ping smiled: "Wood path Gu Immortal Kui Wu Zi, have you heard of him?"

Ren Xiu Ping shook his head confidently: "Not so, Fairy. Kui Wu Zi's dazzling battle strength merely overshadowed his aperture management. In truth, he was quite skilled. Without an immortal aperture foundation, battle strength is hollow. Furthermore, as a rank eight wood path Gu Immortal, his legacy is undeniably useful to you."

Hesitating slightly, Tong Hua asked Ren Xiu Ping: "What is the price for Kui Wu Zi's true inheritance?"

After negotiating, Fairy Tong Hua bought the inheritance and departed the island.

"Tong Hua was blinded by Kui Wu Zi's fame; his true inheritance won't help her much, especially after I removed the crucial parts."

Northern Plains, Lang Ya blessed land.

Fang Yuan's divine sense entered his sovereign immortal aperture.

Fang Yuan activated his immortal killer move, creating a burst of orange-yellow light.

The orange glow washed over the green light shine fungi, rapidly transforming their color from green to pure white.

Unlike before, the transformed fungi radiated bright light instead of wilting.

"Excellent, the modification succeeded; I can begin large-scale cultivation now."

With the light of wisdom and immense foundations, Fang Yuan easily surpassed her attempts.

Using Perseverance, Self Love, Wood Sprout, and Snack, the move adapted the fungi to sky environments.

Wood Sprout was borrowed from Lang Ya Sect, while Snack proved immediately useful.

Mini White Heaven contained a field of multicolored overlord flowers.

While Years Flow Like Water fed easily, Attitude Gu and Wisdom Sword required difficult food.

"Furthermore, light shine fungi reproduce independently; expanding their scale will create another business for me in the future."

Fang Yuan planned to nurture both varieties: keeping green fungi in Mini Eastern Sea while focusing mainly on the white fungi. After meeting his own needs, he would sell the surplus.

"Next, I will release the restraints and restore the sovereign immortal aperture's rate of time!"

"Spring and Summer are rank eight Immortal Gu requiring rank eight immortal essence. As a rank seven Gu Immortal, I cannot even refine them without special methods."

"Then, I can use not only Spring and Summer, but also wisdom sword Immortal Gu."

Advancing from rank seven to rank eight required passing three increasingly powerful grand tribulations.

Fang Yuan was currently very close to the third and final grand tribulation.

Even if heaven's will strengthened it to the limit, Fang Yuan held the initiative with exposing heavenly secret.

Fang Yuan feared not the grand tribulation itself, but a potential human calamity.

Undergoing the grand tribulation required placing his aperture and absorbing heaven and earth qi from the outside world.

This would expose his location to heaven's will and make defending against deductions far more difficult.

Heavenly Court would certainly seize this chance, having likely estimated his cultivation level.

Undergoing tribulation in Southern Border would invite their Gu Immortals to kill him despite the captives!

"The key to destroying fate Gu lies in Red Lotus' true inheritance," Fang Yuan deduced.

"To claim Red Lotus' inheritance in the River of Time, I must pass this third grand tribulation."

"At rank eight, I can wield Spring, Summer, and wisdom sword, soaring in battle strength."

"If I fail, timing is lost; falling behind by one step means Heavenly Court will never let me recover."

In the following days, alongside soul cultivation and aperture management, Fang Yuan explored dream realms and practiced killer moves.

# Chapter 1618: Do You Believe In Fate?

Fang Yuan entered the dream realm.

"Do you believe in fate?"

Fang Yuan was a rockman Gu Immortal in this dream realm, though he could not control it.

The rockman Gu Immortal spoke in a muffled voice: "I, Tu Ji, cultivate rule path and believe in fate. Fairy Ruo Li, since first seeing you, I knew we were fated!"

Fairy Ruo Li smiled slightly, her brow furrowing as she looked at the rockman beside her: "You are right, we are fated to be an immortal couple."

He mumbled: "Twelve years have passed, yet it still feels like a dream! Ruo Li, my wife, I swear to love and protect you. Name any wish, and I will fulfill it."

"Is that so?" Ruo Li asked softly.

"Of course!" Tu Ji replied without any hesitation.

Ruo Li hesitated for a long while before saying with difficulty: "Then kill someone for me."

"Who? Even if a rank eight, I will stake my life to kill them," Tu Ji agreed.

"A newborn infant." Ruo Li gave a bitter smile.

Tu Ji was stunned: "An infant?"

Ruo Li took a deep breath: "Do you believe in fate?"

"I cultivate rule path, so I believe in worldly rules. All things have an ordained path—that is fate," Tu Ji replied.

Ruo Li continued: "This baby will become a Gu Venerable named Reckless Savage. And in the future, I will die at his hands."

"What?!" Tu Ji was shocked: "Ruo Li, how many times have you checked this prophecy?"

Ruo Li gave a bitter smile: "Wisdom path prophecies are accurate because fate is fixed. Dying at Reckless Savage's hands is my fate."

Surging killing intent erupted as Tu Ji stood up: "Then I shall kill him! Fate or not, I refuse to believe that I, the grand Tu Ji, a rank eight Gu Immortal, cannot kill an infant!!"

Fang Yuan's soul foundation fell as the third scene began.

Tu Ji appeared before Fairy Ruo Li heavily injured, his trembling expression filled with shame and shock: "I…"

Fairy Ruo Li smiled: "I know—you ran into your fated enemy on the way, and he happened to make a breakthrough."

Ruo Li shook her head: "This is fate's arrangement. Had I not told you, you wouldn't have encountered your old enemy. Anyone attempting to change fate faces its punishment—these injuries are yours. Had I gone to help, another obstruction would have appeared."

Ruo Li smiled bitterly: "You understand fate's power now? Don't try anymore—just accompany me in my final moments."

"No!" Tu Ji trembled, speaking resolutely: "Never! I will not watch this happen, nor let you die. I promised to love and protect you with my life."

"Yet my death is ordained by fate. Tu Ji, my husband, you said yourself that you believe in fate," Ruo Li said meaningfully.

"Then… I will stop believing in it!" After struggling in hesitation, Tu Ji roared, his anger soaring to the skies.

No matter how they pursued the infant, mishaps and strange coincidences always allowed the child to escape.

That infant was gradually growing up, becoming a Gu Immortal.

Events unfolded strictly along fate's path, finally nearing the day of Fairy Ruo Li's death.

Tu Ji blocked the fatal attack with his body and counterattacked, forcing back their great enemy.

On the verge of death, Tu Ji collapsed into Fairy Ruo Li's arms, saying joyfully: "We… won against fate. Ruo Li… my wife… I did it, I really did it, cough cough cough…"

Grasping Fairy Ruo Li's hand with deep love, he whispered: "After I die, you must continue living on… live well…"

Embracing him tightly, she whispered in his ear: "Though I cultivate wisdom path, I never believed in fate. I deduced what fate arranged for me, but who wants to die? So I sought you out; our marriage was never part of fate's arrangements. I did not love you—I only wanted to use you."

Tu Ji smiled, whispering weakly: "I knew, but so what? I love you… I am fully willing to be used by you. Thank you for letting me be of use… I once believed in fate, but no longer. Look, you are alive—fate has changed, this is wonderful…"

Tu Ji's heavy eyelids closed, unable to open again as he ceased responding.

Fairy Ruo Li wept, losing her composure for the first time: "I never used to believe in fate, but now I do!"

Pure-white light radiated from her body, slowly entering the rockman Gu Immortal Tu Ji.

Tu Ji's weakened aura gradually revived, while Fairy Ruo Li's body became increasingly frail and illusory.

Opening his eyes, Tu Ji shouted in shock and panic: "No, stop! I don't want to be healed—you will die, you will die!!"

Now nearly illusory, Fairy Ruo Li smiled with warmth and a trace of craftiness: "You know my killer move cannot be stopped once activated."

"I want to tell you one last thing—what you wanted to hear most."

"You silly rock… I…"

"I love you."

With those words, Fairy Ruo Li faded like an illusion, vanishing from the world.

"No! No——!" Tu Ji roared like a wounded beast, racked with rage, sorrow, and helplessness.

# Chapter 1619: I Do Not Believe!

"Master, look! I refined dream pillow Gu." Holding the rank five Gu, Feng Jin Huang ran up to Duke Long.

Feng Jin Huang pouted slightly: "How is it merely 'not bad'? Master, you don't know how many times I failed before succeeding! With this dream pillow Gu, mortal Gu Masters can enter dream realms simply by sleeping on it."

Duke Long showed no surprise: "Such accomplishments are only natural for you, Huang Er. You are the future Great Dream Immortal Venerable…"

Feng Jin Huang interrupted with discontent: "Alright, you're saying this again. Did I achieve all this solely because I am the future Great Dream Immortal Venerable?"

Duke Long chuckled, abruptly changing the subject: "Huang Er, do you believe in fate?"

Feng Jin Huang's brows furrowed: "Master, do you mean fate Gu?"

Duke Long nodded: "Indeed—both the fate Gu recorded in The Legends of Ren Zu, and the one Heavenly Court is about to restore completely."

The Legends of Ren Zu stated that Ren Zu sacrificed both hands to finally refine wealth Gu.

He brought his son, Blazing Glory Lightning Brilliance, and daughter, Myriad Gold Wondrous Essence, to the feathermen's residence.

Yet strangely, all the feathermen had vanished without a trace.

"What's going on?" Ren Zu was puzzled.

"Because I arrived here. Fearing me, those feathermen all fled." A black and white spider strolled leisurely toward Ren Zu.

"Who are you?" Ren Zu asked.

The spider smiled: "Human, you walked the road I created in the Door of Life and Death, yet still don't recognize me? I am fate Gu."

Myriad Gold Wondrous Essence added: "Fate Gu, you aren't even palm-sized, why would the feathermen fear you?"

Fate Gu chuckled: "Because they pursue freedom, but I, Fate, bind and restrict them."

Blazing Glory Lightning Brilliance grumbled: "So you wanted the same thing. You failed to capture even one featherman, while hindering us as well."

Fate Gu laughed: "Who says I failed? The feathermen pursue freedom, but their escape was arranged by me. You are no different; look at yourselves."

Ren Zu, Blazing Glory Lightning Brilliance, and Myriad Gold Wondrous Essence looked at their bodies.

White spider silk had already bound their limbs and bodies unnoticed.

"This is the all-encompassing web I have woven. Everything in the world is bound and arranged by me, Fate," Fate Gu said.

Chilled to the heart, Ren Zu and his children began struggling fiercely.

Fate Gu smiled: "It is useless, you cannot escape. Fate cannot be altered."

Ren Zu glared furiously at Fate: "Why do you toy with us? So all the hardships and misfortunes I faced were your doing, and the loss of my children was caused by you!"

Fate Gu said calmly: "Human, you wish to save your eldest son Verdant Great Sun, but he is dead. Death is humanity's inevitable fate; you cannot save him. Nor can wealth Gu save your daughter Boundless Forest Samsara."

At Fate's will, a thread of spider silk ensnared Ren Zu's wealth Gu and dragged it before fate Gu.

Fate Gu laughed: "Life and death are decreed by fate. Human, you are fated to die in madness. Though you refined wealth Gu, you lack the fate to enjoy it. If fated to be poor, even unearthing gold turns it to copper; if fated to be rich, picking up paper turns it to silk. All these things are under my control."

Fate Gu suddenly moved its spider silk, flinging Blazing Glory Lightning Brilliance and Myriad Gold Wondrous Essence far beyond Ren Zu's sight.

"My children!" Ren Zu howled.

Fate Gu said coldly: "Loneliness is everyone's fate. Even your children must leave you; separation is normality."

Just then, self Gu's voice spoke from deep within Ren Zu's heart: "Human, believe in your own strength rather than blaming fate!"

Ren Zu stopped crying, suddenly realizing: "Right, though I lack strength Gu, self Gu bit it, giving me my own strength. Self Gu, I must rely on you."

Self Gu erupted with dazzling light, attempting to break the spider silk.

Some spider silk tore, but even more bound Ren Zu.

"My own strength is not enough?" Anxious, Ren Zu said: "Right, self Gu, you also bit love Gu. If strength fails, let us rely on love instead."

Fate Gu said: "Human, love is merely a type of fate. Their love and deaths were all orchestrated by me."

Ren Zu lost the strength to cry, mumbling powerlessly: "I understand now why feathermen pursue freedom."

Fate Gu smiled: "Human, you also want to pursue freedom?"

Ren Zu nodded: "Yes. With freedom, I will no longer be bound by you."

Fate Gu said: "Yet despite pursuing freedom, aren't those feathermen still under my control?"

Ren Zu shook his head: "My freedom is different. I will pursue absolute freedom."

Fate Gu laughed loudly: "Absolute freedom is insanity. Human, in seeking freedom you are moving toward madness. As I said, you will lose your mind—that is the path I arranged for you. You cannot escape my control."

"No! I will use my own strength and wisdom to obtain freedom," Ren Zu retorted. "I don't believe you; I will escape your control!"

Fate Gu laughed: "Did you forget? Your self Gu bit strength and love, but not wisdom. When you think you are intelligent, that will be the sign you are going crazy."

"Hahaha!" Ren Zu laughed in turn. "I don't believe you, Fate Gu! I don't believe fate exists in this world!"

Fate Gu was silent briefly before replying: "Even if you don't believe, I still exist."

Ren Zu rebuked: "No! When I stop believing in you, you cease to exist. I refuse to believe in fate—fate does not exist! Hahaha!"

Fate Gu shook its head, sighing: "Truly pitiful human, you have fallen into madness."

… Time flew by as a scene from the past surfaced in Duke Long's mind.

A million years ago.

"Do you believe in fate?" Duke Long asked, looking warmly at his disciple.

His disciple was a handsome youth with bright eyes and waist-length black hair, bearing a lifelike red lotus birthmark on his forehead.

Duke Long continued: "Red Lotus, as the future Immortal Venerable, you will lead humanity to supreme prosperity and glory. You will join Heavenly Court, lead humanity, and bless all beings, your glory shining throughout time and space."

Young Red Lotus blinked and smiled with dazzling teeth: "There's nothing bad about that. I believe in fate!"

He looked solemnly at Feng Jin Huang: "Huang Er, understand that you are the future Great Dream Immortal Venerable who will surpass all past venerables! You will create dream path and reign invincible. Your glory will endure for ages as humanity's eternal pillar. Do not fear or hesitate; press forward indomitably until you reach the world's supreme peak!"

Feng Jin Huang said: "If all this is predestined, then… I do not believe in fate!"

"What?" Duke Long's smile froze on his face.

# Chapter 1655: Collecting Black Oil

# Chapter 1656: Fang Yuan Was Saved

Fang Yuan inhaled deeply, the gills on his face taking in oxygen to breathe underwater.

Calming down, he carefully approached and stopped several meters before the black oil, stretching out his arms.

Having exhausted his primeval essence, an impact current from behind shoved Fang Yuan into the black oil.

This had occurred during the five hundred years of his previous life.

Fang Yuan's gaze became clear, he returned from his recollection.

By now, he had led the village Gu Masters back to the island.

The rescued mermaid girl lay unconscious, color slowly returning to her pale face.

Looking closely, she did not resemble Xie Han Mo from his memories; their appearances were completely different, despite both being equally beautiful.

Xie Han Mo was a white-scaled mermaid, saintess of the mermen tribe, whereas this girl bore the blue scales common among mermen.

"Master Chu." The old village head and the middle-aged Gu Master arrived at the door.

Glancing at the mermaid girl, Fang Yuan walked out: "When she wakes up, have her leave. Though this is human territory and her actions amount to stealing, she has a hard life. Give me face and let her off."

"Indeed, many mermen have taken black oil over the years; sharing some is fine," the village head chuckled.

In the outside world, merfolk had lower status than humans, leading to frequent conflict. But here, both lived peacefully, interacting often and even intermarrying.

"It seems this grotto-heaven is a paradise for humans and merfolk alike."

# Chapter 1657: Clues of Regret Gu

# Chapter 1658: Sea Market Gambling Den

# Chapter 1665: The Story of the Sea God and Mermaid

# Chapter 1666: Intercept

# Chapter 1667: White Moonlight

…

# Chapter 1668: Too Naive

# Chapter 1669: Rejection

He struggled at the border of death, he had to worry about one or two primeval stones. He had groveled before the strong in destitution, yet had also held high status, sipping tea while subordinates reported to him.

Between his life on Earth and his journey in this world, his vision, experience, and knowledge far surpassed ordinary men.

Frustrated, Frost Tide's leader replied: "Then you know the risks! This is our mermen's political battle—why is a weak human Gu Master meddling? Do you like Xie Han Mo? I guarantee that once this ends, I'll gift you even more beautiful mermaids! Don't doubt my sincerity—I can swear an oath to the Sea God!"

"A merman's oath to the Sea God is indeed sincere. But…" Fang Yuan continued, "accepting these truths doesn't mean I like them. You think I like Xie Han Mo? No, I merely want to help her. Why take such risks? Because I have my own principles: favors repaid, grudges settled."

"I've lived far longer than you imagine. I once yearned for longevity, but life has grown boring. The destination often matters less than the journey itself and how one feels along the way."

The Frost Tide leader stared, struggling to comprehend Fang Yuan's mindset: "You mean the saintess position doesn't matter, only helping Xie Han Mo in this contest?"

"Correct, but more than that. The dark side of politics and promises of mermaid beauties mean nothing to me. To put it simply: I've lived long enough to grow sick of wearing a mask. Death doesn't frighten me at all. Now, I only wish to live by my truest feelings, pursuing my goals in my own way. Only then do I feel the thrill and desire of living!"

Dumbstruck, the Frost Tide leader finally understood and yelled: "You're a lunatic! All this talk just means you've lived long enough and have a death wish! Maybe if you were a Gu Immortal, but a mere rank three Gu Master living on his own terms? You're dreaming!"

Fang Yuan smiled: "You think being a Gu Immortal lets one live freely? Wherever people gather, there is conflict. How you live depends not on cultivation, but your heart."

Fang Yuan added: "Without a mask, facing reality's hardships and overcoming them makes life all the more wonderful."

The Frost Tide leader stood dumbfounded, mouth agape and unable to speak!

Looking across the crowd at Fang Yuan's faint smile, a chill gripped his heart: *This man's deviant thoughts defy all logic—he has an inclination towards self-destruction. He has truly turned demonic!*

The final song.

Xie Han Mo and Fang Yuan walked to the stage together.

Fang Yuan played accompaniment as Xie Han Mo's song echoed around them.

… The blue sea is laughing, the tidal waves are surging.

Drifting with the waves, only caring about today.

Heaven laughs, at this hectic mortal world.

Who will win, who will lose, only heaven knows.

… Human life ebbs and flows like waves. Why fret constantly over victory or defeat?

The natural romanticism intoxicated the crowd.

… The rivers and mountains laugh, the misty rain is far away.

How many great men and heroes, have the tides washed away?

Smiling at the breeze wind, lost in quiet solitude.

Heroic feelings remain, reflected in the cold night.

… Bold and unrestrained, all aspirations are washed away by the tides, and even life must end. But what does it matter?

The true self is unyielding and lonely; even like a setting sun, it shines with its own splendor.

The Frost Tide leader paled, shivering as he realized his defeat was certain!

Common people laugh, there is no more loneliness.

Yet the unyielding spirit in me is still laughing crazily.

… I struggled to survive in this mortal realm, living by my own feelings. Though tossed by the waves to the brink of death, I will never grieve, fear, or lament; I will savor every flavor and laugh wildly to the very end.

I am true to my nature.

I am a true person!

On stage, Fang Yuan closed his eyes and activated his Gu, filling the area with zither music.

The Frost Tide leader stared blankly, murmuring: "This… this demon…"

Xie Han Mo sang in a trance, eyes shining brightly as she looked at Fang Yuan: "Such a free, unrestrained life—isn't this what I yearn for? To create such a song, he truly possesses an immortal's demeanor!"

… Back to the present.

Xia Lin went on stage for the third song.

The blue sea laughs, tidal waves surge. Drifting with the waves, caring only for today.

Heaven laughs at the hectic mortal world. Who wins and who loses, only heaven knows…

The entire venue was stunned and Su Yi paled—the outcome was settled.

Xia Lin was already entranced in singing.

The familiar melody echoed in Fang Yuan's ears, intertwining with his memories.

He had once stood on stage as accompanist, eyes closed with a faint smile.

Now he stood offstage as a spectator, dark light hidden in his eyes.

Across several hundred years, time had changed him, yet changed nothing at all.

He had always been Gu Yue Fang Yuan.

# Chapter 1674: Sudden Change, Regret Gu

Fang Yuan could only enter Demon Suppression Regret Crying Sea through such a task.

Without hesitation, Fang Yuan accepted the task and was teleported back to Sacred City.

Several days later.

Saintess Xia Lin stood atop a giant tortoise slowly advancing toward Demon Suppression Regret Crying Sea.

Behind her stood Fang Yuan.

The tranquil journey was suddenly interrupted by a gale carrying mournful wails: "I regret it so much! Why did I ever provoke Paradise Earth Immortal Venerable!"

Xia Lin jolted, quickly looking at Fang Yuan: "Master Chu…."

"No worries." Fang Yuan smiled, secretly using wisdom path methods to soothe Xia Lin and the tortoise.

… The mournful cries paled Xia Lin's face, but Fang Yuan grew excited upon sensing the vast immortal formation ahead.

Yet for Fang Yuan, it was a crucial Gu worm he was determined to risk taking.

Focusing his mind, he activated investigative methods with full power, gradually clarifying the demon suppression regret crying formation in his mind.

This time, it was Fang Yuan who became pale.

"What a vast formation! Even with my attainment, deducing its profundities would take decades!"

Simultaneously, a boundless force emerged and bore down upon Fang Yuan.

# Chapter 1675: Birth of Red Lotus

Dark clouds covered the sky and heavy rain was pouring down.

Suddenly, Duke Mei shuddered and coughed up a mouthful of blood.

Hong Zhu forced himself to calm down and bowed: "I, Hong Zhu, pay respects to lord immortal. What brings lord immortal to the mortal realm?"

Duke Long smiled: "Hong Zhu, your son is a blessed genius born once in a million years. If nurtured well, he will achieve greatness beyond measure. Yet without proper guidance, he could bring immense chaos to the world. Seeing his rare talent and for humanity's sake, I have come to take him as my disciple. I will raise and guide him into a righteous path leader who seeks prosperity for all humanity."

Sensing Hong Zhu's thoughts, Duke Long consoled him: "Rest assured, I will not take him yet. I shall only return to teach him when he turns ten."

Overwhelmed with excitement, Hong Zhu repeatedly expressed his gratitude.

The door opened as the City Lord's wife emerged with the newborn and three midwives, kneeling to pay respects to Duke Long.

Drawn to the baby, Duke Long laughed joyfully and stepped directly before the City Lord's wife.

The hovering red lotus descended, shrinking until it settled on the baby's forehead as a nine-petaled red lotus birthmark.

A trace of shock flashed in Duke Long's eyes: "Destined luck imprinting as a birthmark is unprecedented among past venerables. My disciple will surely be unique!"

The lightweight infant suddenly felt as heavy as a mountain to Duke Long, filling him with a profound sense of responsibility.

"No need to kneel, please rise." After inspecting the child a moment longer, Duke Long solemnly returned him to the mother.

Duke Long said: "Parents and master play distinct roles. Love each other deeply and shower him with care so he feels warmth in this world; it will greatly aid his growth. Ten years later, I will come again."

Duke Long slowly rose into the sky amid surging air currents and incessant dragon roars.

# Chapter 1676: What is Fate?

# Chapter 1734: Chen Yi Removes Formation

# Chapter 1738: Primordial Origin Heavenly Court!

Primordial Origin said solemnly: "Without early precautions, all our hard-fought achievements and sacrifices will crumble once I die."

"Once I die, who among you can take on leadership when the variant humans retaliate?" Primordial Origin Immortal Venerable asked.
