"Establishing sects to discover and nurture geniuses without prejudice or regard for cost is our only hope of surpassing the variant humans!"

A Gu Immortal asked: "Will a sect system truly foster sincere cooperation and meritocracy without internal conflict or suppression?"

"Of course not," Primordial Origin shook his head. "Any organization run by people will harbor selfishness and conflict. A clan relies on bloodlines and marriage, whereas a sect decides based on ability and talent. Sects are far more open, directing limited cultivation resources to the most suitable people for the greater good!"

Primordial Origin Immortal Venerable continued in an earnest voice: "I know that the sect system will not truly be accepted at first. We painstakingly seek the way of Gu Immortal cultivation, we paid an immeasurable price to obtain success, it is okay if we leave it to our own descendants, but a sect means that we need to give them to outsiders."

"Establishing sects does not mean casually imparting cultivation. You will choose geniuses who possess great talent, upright moral virtues, and loyalty to their sect."

"While my reach cannot extend to the other four regions, Central Continent must abandon clans and establish sects. For humanity's sake, every Central Continent Gu Immortal—now and in the future—must create or join a sect and never establish a clan. Anyone who breaks this rule will face judgment from me personally and the collective force of all Gu Immortals!"

Primordial Origin Immortal Venerable continued: "As your leader, I shall set the example! I hereby take an oath that I will create sects and not clans. I will take in disciples and impart my life's learnings to them without holding back anything."

"Upon my death, my immortal aperture will also be contributed as the sect's foundation rather than left to my descendants."

"What kind of sect will you create, and where should we build ours? What rules and key factors govern a sect?"

Primordial Origin Immortal Venerable took a deep breath: "I have long envisioned this comprehensive system. For instance, my sect shall be named Heavenly Court…"

Looking at the immortals, he added: "The rest depends on you. By establishing sects, humanity will prosper long after I am gone, while unchanging variant humans will surely perish!"

Three million eight hundred and seventeen thousand six hundred and eighty-seven years later.

# Chapter 1841: Renowned in the World, Promising a Future

Though covered in injuries, Song Tao Zi's powerful aura firmly suppressed Wu Shuai.

"Failing to stop my killer move was your greatest mistake, Wu Shuai—now lose!" Song Tao Zi shouted.

Watching alone from a corner with tear-filled eyes, Tai Qin muttered worriedly: "Darling Wu..."

"You finally used it, Song Tao Zi—I have waited long for this!" Wu Shuai laughed.

Suddenly, a huge castle appeared—Dragon Court!

Dragon Court approached as Wu Shuai's voice resounded: "Song Tao Zi, kneel down and beg for mercy, I will spare your life."

Pale with rage, Song Tao Zi spat: "Don't even think about it! A mere dragonman dares humiliate me?!"

Within Dragon Court, Wu Shuai laughed coldly and drove the castle straight at him.

"Ah—!" Unable to dodge in time, Song Tao Zi screamed pitifully as Dragon Court crushed him to death!

From hovering Dragon Court, Wu Shuai shouted: "This was a public life-and-death duel. If anyone has objections, step forward!"

"Congratulations, brother! After this, no one will contest South Flower Island," Huang Wei toasted in excitement.

Wu Shuai declared aloud: "Our duel was attested by all. Song Tao Zi died in combat—I assume Wind Cloud Manor has no objections?"

Flushing, the Wind Cloud Manor envoy stood: "Since this was agreed upon, we will not contest it!"

Calligraphy Pavilion Lady arrived with her daughter, Shu Jiu Ling.

"Congratulations on your victory, son-in-law." Calligraphy Pavilion Lady smiled, shifting everyone's expressions.

Rank eight Green Ant Ascetic also arrived, approvingly visiting his disciple Wu Shuai.

After the banquet, Calligraphy Pavilion Lady left her daughter Shu Jiu Ling behind.

"You have been separated long; you should stay together," she said with deep meaning.

That night, Wu Shuai left her alone: "Rest first, I have work to settle."

Shu Jiu Ling paused before nodding obediently: "Go tend to your work, husband."

Wu Shuai was not busy at all; he was meeting Tai Qin.

"Junior sister, I have come."

"Brother Shuai, I thought you were not coming today."

"You know your importance to me; that woman cannot compare to a single strand of your hair."

Delighted, Tai Qin asked worriedly: "Brother Shuai, you killed Wind Cloud Manor's signature expert—will they let this go?"

"Of course not, but so what?" Wu Shuai sneered. Gazing at the moon, he sighed: "I realized the truth."

"In this world, strength is everything. The rank eights attended only because I own the Immortal Gu House Dragon Court. Even though I have rank seven cultivation level, I can use this house to fight rank eight, this is my foundation, I am now qualified to talk to them."

"When I reach rank eight and elevate Dragon Court, let us see who dares look down on me!"

Wu Shuai caressed her hair gently: "Junior sister, I will give you happiness. Calligraphy Pavilion Lady is still a threat, but when I become rank eight, I will give you a proper status."

"I want to have children with you and enjoy watching our descendants grow up together."

# Chapter 1842: Uprising Plan, Stealing Fate

Over the next few decades, conflicts between dragonmen and humans intensified as they clashed more fiercely.

Duke Long learned of this and summoned Wu Shuai.

Duke Long ordered him to confess his crimes, step down as lord of South Flower Island, and rename Dragon Court to Dragon Palace.

Gu Liang came to visit.

"Wu Shuai, I heard about South Flower Island. Why admit to those crimes? Is there any way I can help?"

Wu Shuai sighed deeply: "Gu Liang, this was ordered by Ancestor Duke Long. I have no choice but to obey."

Wu Shuai said: "Truthfully, when I killed Song Tao Zi, I thought our race would rise. But decades later, I am trapped in quicksand, facing pressure from all directions with little progress."

Gu Liang said: "I have a method to solve your problem."

"It is simple. You worry about dragonman morale since South Flower Island is our banner. But what if you advance to rank eight now?"

"Advance to rank eight? Of course I want to! But even with Dragon Court, the final tribulation..." Wu Shuai hesitated.

"Hahaha, years of leadership have made you fearful. Worrying over your importance to the race has stripped away your courage. I will help you pass the final tribulation and become a true rank eight Gu Immortal!" Gu Liang said, his aura transforming from rank seven to rank eight.

Gu Liang raised a hand to stop Wu Shuai: "Let us speak as friends. Truly, I approached you with my own motives—Central Continent is too dominant, while the other four regions are weak. As an Eastern Sea Gu Immortal, I welcome internal conflict in Central Continent. Yet beyond that, I truly appreciate and admire you. In truth, we are quite alike."

With Gu Liang's extraordinary strength, Wu Shuai passed the tribulation safely.

Gu Liang shared deep secrets: "Heavenly Court's foundation is fate Gu. Two Demon Venerables attacked Heavenly Court but failed because Star Constellation's assimilation preserved its foundation."

"However, while Star Constellation's assimilation preserved Heavenly Court's reign, it infuriated the Heavenly Dao. The way of heaven is balance, yet humanity is flourishing without restraint. This defies true heaven's will!"

Gu Liang told him: "For the dragonmen to rise, you must target the source of everything!"

"The source? Fate Gu?" Wu Shuai smiled bitterly. "Fate Gu is strictly guarded by Heavenly Court; it is too difficult."

Wu Shuai was moved: "You are referring to that person... Red Lotus?"

"That's right. Heavenly Court wanted to nurture Red Lotus into an Immortal Venerable, but he chose to defy them. Your ancestor Duke Long is so troubled over this that he has relaxed control over the dragonman race. You should thank Red Lotus for reducing the pressure on you," Gu Liang said.

Gu Liang laughed: "To revive his family and lover, Red Lotus must defy the Heavenly Dao and fate. This irreconcilable conflict made him turn against his teacher, and Duke Long cannot sway him back. Red Lotus will definitely attack Heavenly Court to destroy fate Gu. When he attacks, that will be our opportunity to act."

Wu Shuai realized: "I understand. We must infiltrate Heavenly Court to gather intelligence. When Red Lotus attacks, we'll seize the chance to steal fate Gu!"

# Chapter 1843: Making Sacrifices

Wu Shuai displayed a repentant attitude, winning favor from the ten great ancient sects while seeking every opportunity to approach Heavenly Court.

A century later, despite some success, Wu Shuai still could not gain Heavenly Court's trust.

"What should I do?" an anxious Wu Shuai asked Gu Liang.

Gu Liang said: "Heavenly Court is deeply wary of variant humans and looks down on them. Our only hope is Duke Long—we must target him."

"How do I gain Duke Long's trust? His impression of me is..." Wu Shuai smiled bitterly as he shook his head.

Gu Liang looked at Wu Shuai solemnly: "It depends on whether you can make sacrifices."

Wu Shuai answered without hesitation: "I've planned for the dragonman race all along. What if I must make sacrifices?"

Gu Liang presented his plan, but Wu Shuai hesitated—Gu Liang was asking him to deliberately sacrifice Huang Wei!

Huang Wei had followed Wu Shuai since youth, laboring loyally to develop South Flower Island and never wavering in devotion.

Gu Liang urged: "If you publicly sacrifice your closest general to defend human interests, Duke Long will finally believe your loyalty!"

"You want me to kill my greatest general, the person who trusts and idolizes me most..." Wu Shuai gritted his teeth in hesitation and reluctance.

"If Huang Wei knew the purpose of his sacrifice, he would surely agree. Am I right?" Gu Liang's words eased much of Wu Shuai's hesitation.

Wu Shuai sighed deeply, eyes reddening: "I know Huang Wei. If he knew the plan, he would definitely sacrifice himself."

"No!" Gu Liang interjected. "This plan is too crucial—only the two of us can know. Even the dead can be investigated for evidence; Huang Wei cannot know our plan."

"This..." Wu Shuai closed his eyes and shook his head. "Let me think, let me think..."

He hesitated for half a year before finally making up his mind.

Wu Shuai and Gu Liang secretly plotted, killing human Gu Immortals and gathering evidence to frame Huang Wei.

Huang Wei cried out his innocence: "I didn't do this, brother! You know me, I would never do that!"

Wu Shuai initially defended Huang Wei, but as more evidence surfaced, he had to 'uphold justice' and execute him.

The ten great ancient sects praised Wu Shuai greatly. Even Duke Long nodded in approval upon hearing this: "He has matured greatly over the years; I am pleased."

Before the execution, Huang Wei's last words were etched into Wu Shuai's heart, unforgettable in this lifetime—

"Brother, I never regretted following you! Whatever your reason to execute me, I accept it! But I did not do this. You must be careful—those human Gu Immortals are deceiving you. These years, they haven't moved against you directly; instead, they framed me to eliminate me and gradually clip your wings."

"Brother, I won't live to see the future of the dragonman race. Though I die, carry on this dream—the dragonman race cannot succeed without you!"

Wu Shuai snorted coldly: "Huang Wei, you committed murder yet refuse to confess. I trusted you in vain—you have disappointed and hurt me deeply."

"Brother!" Kneeling on the cold prison floor, Huang Wei watched Wu Shuai leave and shouted: "Let me call you that one last time! Don't forget the grand aspiration of our dragonman race!"

Thereafter, Wu Shuai began entering and leaving Heavenly Court regularly.

Once, Heavenly Court decided to build Central Heaven Gate.

Duke Long's reaction was within Wu Shuai's expectations: "Wu Shuai, I appreciate your willingness. But Central Heaven Gate is an information path Immortal Gu House, while Dragon Palace is enslavement path; it is inappropriate. Furthermore, with Heavenly Court's foundation, we do not need your personal wealth."

Wu Shuai petitioned to assist with the project. Duke Long laughed: "Alright, you and your father will oversee Central Heaven Gate's construction."

As building Central Heaven Gate required vast resources, Gu Liang offered his assistance.

He told Wu Shuai: "This is our chance to install a backdoor into Central Heaven Gate while probing Heavenly Court's secrets."

Just as his hard work was yielding results, an accident occurred.

His father returned gravely injured from Heavenly Court and summoned Wu Shuai before dying.

"I contacted fate Gu, my son! I received its revelation—we dragonmen will reign supreme, dragonmen will reign supreme!!" Wu Shuai's father gripped his hand tightly in immense excitement.

"What?!" A stunned Wu Shuai asked, tongue-tied: "Father, what happened?"

His father gasped: "When discovered, I deliberately sabotaged the construction, using the backlash as an excuse to escape Heavenly Court and reach you."

"Dragonmen reign supreme! Our race is destined to hold heavenly fate and replace humanity! This is fate Gu's revelation—it is absolute truth!" Wu Shuai's father's eyes shone. "Do you realize what this means? Heal me quickly and spread the news! The dragonman Gu Immortals will be thrilled!"

"Father, rest and recuperate; I will handle this." Wu Shuai was equally thrilled. After settling his father, he left.

Through their close collaboration, Wu Shuai had learned Gu Liang's true identity—he was not human, but a variant human Gu Immortal!

After a moment of silence, Wu Shuai told him the truth.

"Wu Shuai, you did well not to announce this to the dragonmen. If Heavenly Court learns this secret, they will eradicate our entire race!"

"Your father's actions were too abnormal; they may discover he contacted fate Gu. Heavenly Court's investigators will certainly come probing."

Gu Liang hesitated before speaking: "You already know the only way, don't you? Only by sacrificing your father and claiming he died of his injuries can we escape total extinction!"

Paling, Wu Shuai stumbled backward and shook his head repeatedly: "You want me to kill my father?! No, I will never do that!"

"If Heavenly Court finds out, our race is doomed," Gu Liang sighed. "I finally understand Duke Long's suspicion—Heavenly Court already knows fate Gu's revelation."

# Chapter 1844: Killing Father, Dream Revelations

Wu Shuai frowned bitterly: "I suspect this is a plot against my father and me to harm our race. 'Dragonmen reign supreme' might be a lie concocted to find an excuse to exterminate us."

Gu Liang dismissed the doubt: "Unlikely. Your father contacted fate Gu through coincidences he chose himself rather than Heavenly Court's design."

"How did humanity receive fate Gu's revelation back then? Isn't your father in the same situation now?" Gu Liang's words left Wu Shuai speechless.

Just then, a voice echoed from the sky—Heavenly Court's Gu Immortals had arrived to investigate Wu Shuai's father's injuries.

"They're here already!" Gu Liang's expression shifted. "Wu Shuai, decide now! Any delay and our efforts are ruined—your entire race will be exterminated!"

That day, Wu Shuai's father died from the construction backlash of Central Heaven Gate, his soul entirely erased.

Finding no evidence to act against a rank eight immortal, the investigators departed.

Tai Qin consoled Wu Shuai as he wept in her arms.

Tai Qin said gently: "The dead cannot return, Senior Brother; you must move on. Uncle died constructing Central Heaven Gate, so Heavenly Court will surely compensate you."

He could only reply: "Junior Sister, after I killed Song Tao Zi back then, I often had the same recurring dream."

Tai Qin was equally sorrowful; over all these years, she had failed to bear Wu Shuai a child.

Though dragonmen were fertile among themselves, crossbreeding with humans rarely produced offspring.

Gu Liang urged him: "Do not let visible grief arouse suspicion, or your father will have died in vain."

Struck as if by lightning, Wu Shuai wiped the cold sweat from his brow and cupped his fists: "Thank you for the reminder, or I would have made a grave mistake."

Gu Liang smiled and nodded: "Grief has stalled your work on Central Heaven Gate. It is time to resume."

"Can we truly trust fate Gu's revelation that dragonmen will reign supreme?" Wu Shuai still could not let it go.

Gu Liang nodded: "If dragonmen are destined to reign supreme, heaven's will will surely favor your race. Following its guidance, he stole fate Gu and delivered it to Primordial Origin before he became an Immortal Venerable."

Gu Liang explained: "I have a theory. Star Constellation Immortal Venerable assimilated with heaven's will, and her will has interfered with it ever since. That is likely why your father met disaster. Yet by delivering the secret that dragonmen will reign supreme, he died for a noble cause."

Wu Shuai suppressed his sorrow and returned to work. He continued constructing Central Heaven Gate to reassure Heavenly Court.

On this day, Wu Shuai dreamed of his father again.

His father told him: "Keep working hard; I understand you. This sacrifice will lead to great achievements! The dragonman race needs your leadership, my child."

He also dreamed of finally having a child with Tai Qin using a nameless weed found deep in an Eastern Sea Earth Trench.

Wu Shuai awoke with a start: was this a heavenly revelation?

Wu Shuai immediately acted, using Gu Liang's strength to retrieve the unnamed seaweed from Eastern Sea's Earth Trench.

Following the dream's instructions, Wu Shuai and Tai Qin consumed the seaweed. Months later, Tai Qin was pregnant with his child!

Beyond gaining an heir, his suspicion was confirmed: heavenly revelations had been arriving all along, yet he had failed to recognize them.

As his dreams evolved, more revelations flowed to Wu Shuai.

He not only constructed Central Heaven Gate, but successfully installed a backdoor that went undetected during Heavenly Court's inspections.

Guided by dream revelations and aided by Gu Liang, his cultivation rose as he passed tribulation after tribulation.

The dreams shifted again, revealing how to build the rank eight Immortal Gu House, Dragon Palace!

"The core of Dragon Palace is the rank eight Dream Token!" Thrilled, Wu Shuai immediately roamed the five regions and two heavens gathering dream path materials.

Following the revelations, Wu Shuai gradually gathered and refined the materials.

---

# Chapter 1845: A Life of Tragedy!

During this period, Wu Shuai returned to South Flower Island.

Tai Qin finally gave birth!

"We finally have an heir to our bloodline! Tai Qin, you've suffered." Wu Shuai cradled the newborn, spinning in joy.

"What shall we name our child?" Tai Qin asked with a maternal smile.

"This child has such lively, spirited eyes—let's call him Long Ling," Wu Shuai said.

Tai Qin nodded: "Long Ling... it is a good name."

Driven by his responsibilities, Wu Shuai rested briefly on South Flower Island before traveling the five regions and two heavens again to gather dream path materials.

As materials were refined one by one, Dream Token reached the final step of completion.

"This?!" Wu Shuai was immensely shocked.

The dream's final revelation required Tai Qin to willingly sacrifice her life to complete the refinement of Dream Token.

"No, I cannot do that!" Shaken and pale, Wu Shuai refused to accept this revelation.

Wu Shuai halted the refinement of Dream Token, hoping for further dream revelations.

The next night, he received a new revelation in his dream.

This revelation was shocking: "Ancestor Duke Long has an immortal killer move that can exterminate the dragonman race?! And he has wanted to use it repeatedly?"

Guided by dream revelations, Wu Shuai gathered clues proving the dreams true, even learning the killer move's name—Dragonman Extermination!

The dream told Wu Shuai that countering dragonman extermination required refining Dream Token first.

Wu Shuai had to tell Tai Qin the truth.

Tai Qin accepted it readily, caressing Wu Shuai's face with a gentle smile: "So that is why, Brother Shuai. I love you and would sacrifice everything for you, even my life. This is nothing, but beyond you, my only concern in this life is our child."

"After I die, you must care for and nurture our child well. Promise me, alright?"

"I promise you on my life, dignity, and all that I have!" Wu Shuai wept profusely in anguish.

Dream Token was refined.

Next, rank eight Dragon Palace was also constructed.

His child with Tai Qin grew up and would sometimes ask: "Father, where is mother? Why is she not back yet?"

Wu Shuai felt deeply exhausted, but he could not stop; dragonman extermination had not been resolved yet.

Through repeated dream revelations, he realized settling dragonman extermination required using rank eight Dragon Palace to experiment on dragonman bodies.

With Dragon Palace's power, he could completely reverse-deduce the dragonman extermination killer move.

Unable to do this alone, Wu Shuai gathered all the dragonman Gu Immortals, revealed the truth, and begged for their help.

Though stunned, the dragonman immortals were convinced by Wu Shuai's undeniable evidence and Gu Liang's testimony.

"The experiments require vast numbers of dragonmen. Nearly all will die, and survivors will wish for death. Yet I cannot stop this plan. If anyone objects, speak up now."

"I object!" Immediately, someone jumped out.

Everyone turned to look—it was Wu Shuai's cousin, the seventh young master whom Duke Long doted on most.

Pointing at Wu Shuai on his throne, the seventh young master scolded: "You scoundrel, you are insane!!!"

"To gain Heavenly Court's trust, you killed your most loyal sworn brother!"

"To conceal the secret of dragonmen reigning supreme, you caused your own father's death!"

"To refine dream token Immortal Gu, you used your beloved wife as Gu material!"

"Now, to counter the dragonman extermination killer move, you want to experiment on and sacrifice innocent dragonmen?"

"Hahaha!" Seventh young master laughed bitterly to tears. "You strove so hard to make our race rise, yet led us straight to extinction!"

"You are a real tragedy! Your whole life is a tragedy!!"

The entire hall was silent.

Wu Shuai sat on his dragon throne, expressionless...

At this point, the dream realm finally faded away.

The dragonman clone strode out of Dragon Palace.

"It has... already been a million years."

"I am back." The dragonman clone's voice echoed in the hall like the cry of a lingering spirit.

"But I... am no longer myself." The dragonman clone smiled bitterly.

A will that had endured a million years, waiting until today!

"Dragon Spirit greets master!" Dragon Spirit appeared reverently, joy in its eyes. "Dragon Court finally has a new master!"

The dragonman clone gazed intently at Dragon Spirit, his eyes reddening rapidly.

He dearly wished Dragon Spirit would call him—Father!

But it was impossible now.

"Tai Qin, I failed you after all. I couldn't even fulfill your final request." Raising his head, Wu Shuai sighed deeply, filled with boundless guilt and sorrow.

---

# Chapter 1846: Obtaining Primordial Origin's True Inheritance

After much effort, Duke Long finally reached an agreement with Fang Yuan.

Besides compensating Fang Yuan with vast qi path resources, Duke Long even gave Qi Sea Ancestor a Primordial Origin true inheritance!

Disguised as Qi Sea Ancestor, Fang Yuan agreed to a truce and coexistence with Heavenly Court, which would deliver the resources and Primordial Origin's true inheritance in installments.

With negotiations concluded, Fang Yuan did not leave; instead, he led the way.

"Fang Yuan is trying to seize Dragon Palace now, Duke Long. Perhaps Heavenly Court can resolve your enmity today," Fang Yuan smiled.

Diving into the deep sea where Dragon Palace was hidden, the group found it had already vanished.

"It seems Dragon Palace really flew away," Duke Long sighed.

Fang Yuan smiled: "What a pity. If Fang Yuan took Dragon Palace, Heavenly Court would have lost to him once again."

Duke Long knew Dragon Palace well—back then, his descendant had designed it so only a dragonman could become its lord.

"I cannot let Dragon Palace fall into Fang Yuan's hands. Retrieving it and handling him are one problem; saving Fang Zheng, who counters Fang Yuan, comes first."

Thinking so, Duke Long approached Shen Cong Sheng.

Gu Yue Fang Zheng was currently in Shen Cong Sheng's hands.

Shen Cong Sheng was naturally willing to trade Gu Yue Fang Zheng to Duke Long for substantial benefits.

Watching from the side, Fang Yuan was also tempted, but competing directly against Duke Long was unwise.

Refusing to give up, Fang Yuan secretly sent Shen Cong Sheng an inquiry.

Shen Cong Sheng quickly replied to Qi Sea: "Having soul-searched Fang Zheng, I know he indeed counters Fang Yuan and negatively affects his luck."

Eyes gleaming, Fang Yuan secretly probed Shen Cong Sheng: "Though Fang Yuan is merely rank seven and I have met him only once, he left a deep impression on me. Since Fang Zheng counters him, keep him to negotiate with Fang Yuan, who holds multiple venerable true inheritances. Would Heavenly Court ever trade you a venerable inheritance?"

Not daring to delay, Shen Cong Sheng quickly smiled and replied: "Ancestor is right, that is a great suggestion!"

Turning to Duke Long, he demanded: "If Heavenly Court wants Fang Zheng back, give me a venerable true inheritance."

"Hahaha!" Duke Long laughed coldly. "Shen Cong Sheng, you are too greedy. Qi Sea earned a venerable true inheritance through peerless strength and my acknowledgement. If trading a captive yielded a venerable inheritance, wouldn't that make a mockery of Qi Sea?"

Shen Cong Sheng smiled fearlessly: "Duke Long, you can defeat me, but you cannot kill me here. Furthermore, Fang Zheng is in my hands, I can kill him with a single thought."

"If not a venerable true inheritance, what will you offer? Show me Heavenly Court's sincerity."

Having made up his mind, Shen Cong Sheng replied: "Senior Qi Sea, I prefer dealing with Heavenly Court. As a righteous path force, they must uphold their reputation and need Fang Zheng alive. But Fang Yuan only wants a dead Fang Zheng, he might not negotiate with me peacefully. Secondly, in terms of wealth and foundation, who in this world can match Heavenly Court?"

At this moment, Fairy Zi Wei sent Duke Long information.

Duke Long's eyes brightened at the crucial bargaining chip, and he quickly transmitted it to Shen Cong Sheng.

Shen Cong Sheng's expression changed, he cried out: "Really?"

"Of course." Duke Long nodded. "How about the earlier resources plus this intel?"

Shen Cong Sheng agreed without hesitation.

Shen Cong Sheng handed Gu Yue Fang Zheng to Duke Long on the spot.

Holding the unconscious Fang Zheng, Duke Long bid farewell to Fang Yuan.

After flying a distance, he stopped at a cloud.

From within the cloud, an Immortal Gu House appeared, the dragonman clone walked out.

Fang Yuan and his clone smiled at each other.

Despite numerous hurdles, his Eastern Sea expedition to claim Dragon Palace concluded safely, yielding far greater gains than expected!

---

# Chapter 1847: Dream Token

"This is dream token Immortal Gu." Fang Yuan inspected Dragon Palace.

Dream Token resembled a dragonfly with pink ruby eyes and four pairs of transparent wings shimmering in a rainbow halo.

He had long anticipated dream path Immortal Gu; despite possessing numerous dream path killer moves, he had lacked a single dream path Immortal Gu until now.

"Exploring that dream realm was truly perilous; I almost lost myself in it." Beside him, the dragonman clone sighed with lingering fear: "Had I not sensed danger and secretly prepared unravel dream to activate upon exiting, I would have betrayed the main body already."

Fang Yuan had always applied unravel dream to dream realms, but this time, he targeted himself.

Dragon Palace selected its lord through dream power; by targeting himself with unravel dream, the clone countered the assimilation directly.

Unravel dream alone could not overcome the rank eight Dream Token; in that regard, he owed thanks to the four Eastern Sea Gu Immortals, including Granny Rong and Zhang Yin.

Fang Yuan nodded: "This was truly the most difficult dream realm I have explored. Yet my luck inspection did not lie—the azure-purple qi indicated you could become Dragon Palace Lord without losing yourself."

As for Wu Shuai's will, it did not exist.

No will could live in the dream realms for over a million years.

The clone had believed he was Wu Shuai due to Dream Token twisting his will, making him think he was the revived Wu Shuai.

Wu Shuai's meticulous arrangements and foresight were truly praiseworthy.

Learning of his clone's encounters, Fang Yuan's main body praised: "He was truly a formidable person!"

It was a pity that Wu Shuai failed.

Regrettably, his foes were too formidable. Even without Heavenly Court, Duke Long alone could exterminate the dragonmen—and behind Duke Long stood Star Constellation.

The decree that dragonmen would reign supreme came from the Heavenly Dao. Yet Star Constellation Immortal Venerable was terrifying enough to assimilate into heaven's will and twist the Heavenly Dao itself.

Thus, subsequent Demon Venerables failed to destroy Heavenly Court; only Red Lotus managed to damage fate Gu despite not being an otherworldly demon.

Through Wu Shuai's life, Fang Yuan witnessed Heavenly Court's terrifying might!

Fang Yuan wanted to overturn this current trend!

"Only by destroying fate Gu can I hope for eternal life."

Storing Dragon Palace and his clone in his immortal aperture, Fang Yuan summoned Xue Er, Shi Shi Cheng, and Mo Tan Sang.

Fang Yuan used Omni-directional Travel with them, rapidly leaving Eastern Sea.

---

# Chapter 1848: Collating His Gains

Inside the sovereign immortal aperture.

A grand purple-gold palace floated in the air.

Immortal killer move — Dreamy Light Smoke!

The dragonman clone operated the Immortal Gu House, unleashing thick clouds of smoke.

Testing it on an immemorial year beast, the creature growled helplessly as the dense smoke overwhelmed and engulfed it.

"Gather," the clone willed, and the dream path smoke retreated into Dragon Palace.

Upon testing it personally, Fang Yuan realized dreamy light smoke was not an offensive dream path move, but one designed to capture enemies.

With just this move, Dragon Palace had captured and easily suppressed a rank eight battle strength immemorial year beast.

Dragon Palace remained an enslavement path Immortal Gu House at its core, despite incorporating the rank eight dream path Dream Token.

Dragon Palace also possessed two other dream path killer moves.

Dream revelation carried wisdom path effects, allowing Gu Immortals to dream in their sleep and gain revelations.

The other was dream within dream, which constructed nested dream realms, just as Wu Shuai had done in the past.

The dream realm that previously shrouded Dragon Palace derived directly from Dream Token itself.

Fang Yuan considered this; at his current stage, dreamy light smoke was the most practical.

But the most important thing was dream token Immortal Gu!

Fang Yuan had already learned the exact usage of rank eight Dream Token from Dragon Spirit.

When Duke Long unleashed dragonman extermination, Wu Shuai was not spared, but through painstaking experimentation, he found a way to delay his death.

Thus, Dream Token's activation cost was immense—Wu Shuai had died not from dragonman extermination, but from using Dream Token.

Fang Yuan assessed: "A peak rank eight enslavement path Gu Immortal sacrificed himself to activate Dream Token and create this dream realm."

Used alone, Dream Token was fatal, consuming the Gu Immortal's entire foundation to manifest a dream realm.

"Does activating dream token Immortal Gu expend a rank eight Gu Immortal each time?" Such a steep price discouraged Fang Yuan from attempting it.

"In the future, with higher dream path attainment, I can create killer moves around Dream Token to prevent it from draining the user completely while forming restricted dream realms."

Integrated into Dragon Palace, these dream path killer moves could be unleashed conveniently at will without extensive practice.

Beyond dream path, he made major gains elsewhere as well.

Most prominent were the Four Dragon Generals, including Zhang Yin and Granny Rong—granting Fang Yuan four new rank eight battle strength experts!

The accumulated wealth of Wu Shuai and the dragonman race preserved inside Dragon Palace now belonged entirely to Fang Yuan.

While mostly enslavement path inheritances, the most valuable concerned Qian Kun Crystal Wall, Censure Peak, and army ant.

Army ant, the true inheritance of Green Ant Ascetic, had been Wu Shuai's primary offensive method. In sufficient numbers, its terrifying might allowed a solitary cultivator to battle a group of rank eight Gu Immortals.

And finally there was Dragon Palace itself, the Dragon Spirit, and enslavement path attainment level.

Clearing the dream realm raised the dragonman clone's enslavement path attainment straight to quasi-supreme grandmaster.

These immense gains meant Fang Yuan had essentially inherited the entire dragonman race's legacy!

Fang Yuan would not cultivate army ants for now, as raising an ant army from scratch demanded immense resources.

Qian Kun Crystal Wall and Censure Peak provided the information path foundation Fang Yuan lacked.

To Fang Yuan's regret, Dragon Palace lacked dream path defenses, which in this era would surpass even reverse flow protection seal.

Yet recalling his previous life, Fang Yuan accepted this; had Dragon Palace possessed dream path defenses, Duke Long could never have invaded it.

---

# Chapter 1849: Ancestor of the New Dragonman

Inside the sovereign immortal aperture.

As large amounts of white litchi immortal essence poured in, the Long Hair refinement path formation roared, igniting a towering flame.

Within the raging flames, the dragonman clone sat cross-legged with closed eyes, expressionless as if asleep.

Though agonizing, the dragonman clone's soul had already left the body, now standing beside Lang Ya land spirit.

Fang Yuan personally controlled the formation while Lang Ya land spirit and Sixth Hair assisted.

Mobilizing nearly all his refinement path manpower, Fang Yuan gave it his all.

Under the flames, the dragonman clone's skin and flesh swelled and blistered into disfigured, bubbling colloids on the verge of popping.

"Be careful and steady. I'll leave this to you, Lang Ya land spirit," Fang Yuan instructed while presiding over the refinement.

Lang Ya land spirit nodded.

Fang Yuan did not completely scorch and melt the clone, as doing so would kill him.

Next, Fang Yuan activated the refinement path formation, gathering traces of lightning.

These pitch-black lightning sparks were thick as chopsticks and crackled continuously.

The lightning sparks entered the raging flames effortlessly, completely unaffected by the fire.

Under Fang Yuan's control, the lightning stabbed into the clone's body, piercing flesh and blood to attach to the soft skeleton.

Fixing the skeleton in place, the pitch-black lightning slowly drew out one of the clone's arm bones.

The arm bone was not heat-resistant and began melting, but the prepared Sixth Hair activated the formation to release waves of bubbles.

Fang Yuan quickly tossed the arm bone into the bubbles.

# Chapter 1858: Omniscience and Omnipotence

Fang Yuan placed great importance on this premonition.

This time, the feeling arose while facing Divine Bean Palace.

"Lastly, wood path attainment. Becoming a wood path grandmaster filled the missing piece, condensing the vague premonition into concrete form."

High attainment across all paths could produce premonitions about all things—a state virtually identical to omniscience.

"Omniscience, omnipotence..." Fang Yuan muttered, his heart shaking and gaze turning sharp. "If I reach this realm, I will surely perceive the path to eternal life!"

"Though how to achieve eternal life remains unknown, omniscience and omnipotence are the foundation. First, fate Gu must be destroyed to make eternal life possible. Then, I will strive toward omniscience and omnipotence!"

"To achieve omniscience, I must explore dream realms and raise my attainment in every path."

"To achieve omnipotence, I will cultivate every path with the sovereign immortal body and master all methods."

Even venerables cultivated only two or three paths and could not achieve omniscience. Their strength was unimaginable, but without the sovereign immortal body, omnipotence remained impossible.

"Wait, the Prophecy of Three Venerables stated that Great Dream Immortal Venerable would be the strongest venerable. Could it be because she attains omniscience?"

Fang Yuan's heart jolted; he had gained a deeper understanding of the Prophecy of Three Venerables and the future!

"Such struggle and effort will make my life truly vibrant."

Several days later.

Lang Ya blessed land.

The formation halted; a brand-new wood path Immortal Gu was refined.

Lang Ya land spirit praised admiringly: "All thanks to Master's Gu recipe!"

As a refinement path quasi-supreme grandmaster and wood path grandmaster, Fang Yuan modified wood path Immortal Gu recipes of extraordinary caliber.

Coupled with Lang Ya land spirit's peak refinement path attainment, their efforts yielded exceptional efficiency and a very high success rate.

Due to the sovereign immortal aperture's rapid time flow, Fang Yuan obtained several wood path Immortal Gu in mere days.

Although Southern Border had many wood path Gu Immortals and wood path Immortal Gu, Fang Yuan did not demand them.

If Fang Yuan extorted wood path Immortal Gu from Southern Border's righteous path, Heavenly Court would surely discover it.

Fairy Zi Wei would grow suspicious: "Fang Yuan is gathering wood path immortal materials to advance in wood path and refine Immortal Gu? What is he plotting?"

# Chapter 1859: Suan Bu Jin, Please Rest In Peace

Time passed. The outside five regions appeared tranquil while undercurrents surged secretly, but within the sovereign immortal aperture, rapid time flow brought noticeable daily changes.

Meanwhile, Fang Yuan's main body worked diligently on cultivating karma divine tree.

After recent improvements, though still lacking the core Immortal Gu Cause and Effect, karma divine tree had mature bamboo Immortal Gu replaced by far more suitable wood path Immortal Gu.

Sensing Fang Yuan's thoughts, Fang Di Chang smiled: "Fret not, brother. We will control the Immortal Gu House together, not leave you alone. Once finished, Fang clan will richly reward your contributions."

"Seeing Fang clan's situation, you know there is no other choice. Please die for the sake of Fang clan's future." Fang Di Chang bowed deeply to Fang Yuan.

# Chapter 1860: You Know Too Much

Hiding near Divine Bean Palace, Fang Gong felt anxious.

Although Suan Bu Jin is no demon Fang Yuan, caution is essential. Moreover, second supreme elder himself asked me to arrange this inspection."

Silence.

"How is this possible? I oversaw the entire process; you only offered a few suggestions!" Fang Di Chang felt a sudden chill: "Could it be..."

Fang Di Chang glared at Fang Yuan: "Who are you? Accomplishing this requires extremely high formation path attainment, plus a method to influence Divine Bean Palace!"

Fang Yuan smiled. Though his wisdom path lagged behind Fang Di Chang's, he was still a grandmaster, and his formation path matched it—granting dual grandmaster attainment.

Immortal killer move — Karma Divine Tree!

Green smoke rose above Fang Yuan's head and shoulders, forming a vast, lush divine tree with several fruits scattered among its leaves.

Divine Bean Palace began to shake.

Fang Di Chang's eyes widened with shock and anger, pointing at Fang Yuan: "You sided with Heavenly Court! Despicable bastard!"

Seeing Fang Di Chang's misunderstanding, Fang Yuan ignored it, focusing entirely on karma divine tree.

Using this move openly for the first time, Fang Yuan saw Divine Bean Palace respond, gradually lowering its resistance to accept him as the killer move's owner.

Soon, Fang Di Chang was unable to even budge.

The temporary Immortal Gu House was designed to imprison Gu Immortals. Though Fang Di Chang planned to trap Suan Bu Jin, Fang Yuan's greater control and Divine Bean Palace's suppression turned Fang Di Chang into the captive.

"Good, very good, Suan Bu Jin! I admit defeat—kill me." Fang Di Chang sneered fearlessly.

Fang Yuan sneered: "You want your death to alter your life tablet Gu and alert Fang Gong outside? Praiseworthy resolve, but I will not take the bait. I will extract your soul and possess you with my split soul. With your body alive and soul intact, your life tablet Gu will show no change."

"My Fang Di Chang clone will replace you to infiltrate Fang clan. I will thoroughly search your soul, plundering all your experiences, memories, and knowledge."

"Hmph! Impossible! Forget it." Fang Di Chang snorted coldly. "You think a split soul escapes inspection? Fang clan records my soul's details; any discrepancy will expose you."

"Moreover, your time is short. I set a deadline with first supreme elder; if I fail to appear, they will immediately storm in to reinforce me!"

"Even with Heavenly Court's reinforcements, how long could you hold out? A furious first elder Fang Gong will surely smash you into meat paste!"

Fang Yuan smiled, gazing deeply at Fang Di Chang.

"You turned my own scheme against me with such confidence. To accomplish this, you need immense formation and wisdom path attainment, plus extraordinary soul path methods!"

"No, you are not sent by Heavenly Court!"

"You! You are Fang Yuan!!"

Fang Di Chang's face turned deathly pale.

Fang Yuan clapped: "Truly worthy of a wisdom path great grandmaster."

Fang Di Chang gulped nervously: "Fang Yuan, we can cooperate. There is no need for conflict—please believe in Fang clan's strength and sincerity... urgh!"

Fang Di Chang's eyes opened wide all of a sudden.

While conversing, Fang Yuan had relentlessly influenced Divine Bean Palace, finally triggering a qualitative breakthrough!

"Fang... Fang Yuan, everything... can... be discussed..."

Fang Yuan shook his head with a smile: "It is truly a pity for a wisdom path great grandmaster to die here. But you... know too much."

"Ahh." Fang Di Chang's eyes rolled back and his mouth foamed; his body twitched a few times before he died.

As the sounds persisted, dao marks of each path congregated into unified colors, appearing far clearer and grander.

Not long later, his face was filled with astonishment.

Within the new dao mark, he 'saw' blades and swords, 'smelled' axes and halberds, 'felt' hammers and spears, and 'heard' darts and arrows...

Fang Yuan continued moving forward.

Another patch of dao marks carpeted the ground; though uniform, interweaving lights on its surface formed mountains, rivers, birds, and beasts.

When other dao marks flooded past, this patch drifted like leaves to lightly adhere to their surface, neither disrupting them nor crumbling apart. It was truly mystical.

Fang Yuan's heart shook at the sight: "If I am not mistaken, these are painting path dao marks!"

"However, similar dao marks only congregate while demonic sounds are active."

"Let alone Thieves Den—lacking the sovereign immortal body, it would shatter from conflicting forces the moment it was brought out!"

Fang Yuan sighed and set the thought aside for now, continuing forward.

Whatever dao marks lay ahead, they were harmless as a light breeze to him.

Fang Yuan probed cautiously, finding that dream path dao marks were equally harmless to him.

These were merely dao marks, not dream realms; to the sovereign immortal body, they were just moving immortal materials.

One path was dark and horrifying, killing intent filled it.

One path was humble and plain, giving a virtuous aura.

Fang Yuan's eyes gleamed with understanding: "These three paths must be traces of past venerables. Filled with luck path, soul path, and earth path dao marks, they belong to Giant Sun Immortal Venerable, Spectral Soul Demon Venerable, and Paradise Earth Immortal Venerable respectively!"

Yet the dao marks in these three paths remained solid, standing firm against the crashing dao mark currents.

"And why do the paths left by these three venerables only appear near the eighth layer's entrance?"

The momentary darkness vanished, and Fang Yuan landed on solid ground.

"How could this be?" Fang Yuan was dumbstruck.

The eighth layer showed a scene far beyond his expectations, bearing no resemblance to the seventh layer.

# Chapter 1866: Eighth Layer, Heaven Path

# Chapter 1870: I Will Take Responsibility

# Chapter 1878: World Savior Little Du

Outwardly, Little Du frowned and slammed his fist down: "Damn it! Do we just wait for reinforcements? Where are we, and why is there an altar?"

Little Du gasped: "Wait, Uncle, isn't it strange? The crocodiles surround this area, yet avoid approaching this ancient altar."

Kneeling down, Little Du prayed: "First generation Combat Beast King, please help us! Beasts outside are slaughtering our people! I beg you, if you can hear me in heaven, please do something!"

White light burst from the altar, enveloping Little Du.

The white light fused into Little Du as the indestructible altar shattered.

Little Du turned joyfully: "Uncle, you were right! I inherited the first generation Combat Beast King's power!"

"A miracle! This is a miracle!" Eagle Warrior looked to the sky in sheer ecstasy.

"What?" Little Du was dumbfounded.

"You can claim all the inheritances! You are the world's savior!" Eagle Warrior shouted.
