# Chapter 1887: Banquet Ends, Desire to Enter Dragon Whale

Inconspicuous in the vast Eastern Sea, this uninhabited island concealed four Gu Immortals.

All four were injured; one lay motionless, life uncertain, while the other three sat healing their wounds.

Moments later, someone coughed, spitting mouthfuls of blood.

"Lord!" The other two conscious immortals halted their healing and hurried over.

The person coughing blood was Miao Ming Shen.

Ambitious and charismatic, Miao Ming Shen led an alliance of three fellow lone immortals: Immortal Hua Die, Feng Jiang, and Gui Qi Ye.

Now, Gui Qi Ye lay unconscious and dyed a venomous purple, in critical peril.

Wiping blood from his pale face, Miao Ming Shen gasped: "My injuries... cough, cough... are fine! Gui Qi Ye's condition is more severe."

"Gui Qi Ye was struck by the ice poison starfish, and we have no way to heal him," Immortal Hua Die said worriedly.

Feng Jiang said coldly: "The starfish's poison is troublesome, but I've heard Su Chen and Fairy Jiu Yue can heal it."

Miao Ming Shen sighed: "Fairy Jiu Yue is connected to Ren Xiu Ping, while Su Chen is attending the qi sea banquet. We cannot risk exposing our identities and secrets, so we must heal him ourselves. I intend to exchange the extreme time pole for underworld yellow water to cleanse the poison."

Miao Ming Shen immediately connected to treasure yellow heaven and traded the extreme time pole for underworld yellow water.

Purged of the poison, Gui Qi Ye slowly woke and thanked Miao Ming Shen.

Gui Qi Ye pondered: "Ren Xiu Ping targeted us because Lord has the method to enter the blue dragon whale. We must use this secret to invite allies and explore Paradise Earth's true inheritance before Ren Xiu Ping does. If we delay and Ren Xiu Ping spreads the news, we will lose our initiative and become the target of all Eastern Sea Gu Immortals!"

As in the previous life, their discussion finalized the participating members, including Chu Ying.

When Fang Yuan received the invitation, he was still hosting the qi sea banquet.

"The time is right; the qi sea banquet ends now," Fang Yuan announced.

Fang Yuan smiled warmly: "Transactions are endless. Everyone has important matters to attend to, and our goal of gathering Eastern Sea's friends has been achieved."

The immortals quickly stood and bid Fang Yuan farewell.

---

# Chapter 1888: Changes Midway

Several days later, on a nameless island in Eastern Sea.

Eight Gu Immortals finally gathered.

Miao Ming Shen led the group, joined by Gui Qi Ye, Feng Jiang, Immortal Hua Die, Zeng Luo Zi, Tu Tou Tuo, Tong Hua, and Fang Yuan.

"Even after my rebirth, the influence hasn't reached Miao Ming Shen," Fang Yuan observed impassively, disguised as Chu Ying.

As in his previous life, Fang Yuan planned to obtain regret Gu and advance the bulk of his Immortal Gu.

"In the previous life, lacking Red Lotus' true inheritance and pressed for time, I couldn't explore the blue dragon whale's immortal aperture with peace of mind."

"This time, beyond regret Gu, I will try to claim the Merit Obelisk, Paradise Earth's true inheritance, and the blue dragon whale itself!"

Miao Ming Shen looked around solemnly: "The risks of this expedition are unknown and potentially fatal. If anyone wishes to back out, you may leave now. I will not stop you, and I completely understand."

Nobody backed out.

As in the previous life, Zeng Luo Zi established the alliance agreement before they set off.

The immortals then entered the sea, using a method to track each other's locations.

Miao Ming Shen led them through the undercurrents, with Fang Yuan following amidst the group.

Though Fang Yuan had made arrangements where the blue dragon whale appeared in the previous life, he received no news of its arrival.

If not for Miao Ming Shen, he indeed might not find the blue dragon whale.

Suddenly, he slowed down as he showed an excited expression: "We are getting close!"

Fang Yuan's investigative methods still failed to deduce how Miao Ming Shen located the blue dragon whale.

Moreover, their current location differed completely from the previous life.

The waters grew turbulent as desolate beasts multiplied, forcing the group to slaughter them and carve a path forward.

"It seems Paradise Earth Immortal Venerable's test started in the sea. If I 'die' now, will I be transported into the blue dragon whale's immortal aperture?"

"Who is it?!" Zeng Luo Zi shouted, unleashing a killer move toward his rear left.

Though lacking offensive power, the killer move immediately revealed several figures.

"Wonderful investigative method, Zeng Luo Zi," the leading Gu Immortal praised with a smile, his surging rank eight aura dispelling the technique.

Seeing him, Fang Yuan was slightly dazed: "Why is Shen Cong Sheng here as well?"

The person who casually broke Zeng Luo Zi's investigative killer move was Shen clan's first supreme elder, Shen Cong Sheng.

Shen Cong Sheng had brought along Shen clan immortals and lone experts like Ren Xiu Ping.

Fang Yuan feigned shock; with his main body present, he had no reason to fear Shen Cong Sheng.

---

# Chapter 1889: Entering the Aperture

"There is a traitor among us! Split up!" Miao Ming Shen shouted with an ashen expression, eyeing his companions with suspicion.

"Since you noticed me, none of you will escape," Shen Cong Sheng laughed, flicking his finger to send surging sound waves toward the group.

Surrounded by these sound waves, Miao Ming Shen's group slowed drastically.

Immortal Hua Die gasped as sound waves bound her, and Shen Cong Sheng dragged her away immediately.

"Hua Die!" Feng Jiang rushed to help, but Shen Cong Sheng easily captured him as well.

He snorted coldly: "Attack."

Ren Xiu Ping and the surrounding Shen clan Gu Immortals found their targets and attacked.

Only Shen clan's Shen Tan, an ordinary water path Gu Immortal, attacked Fang Yuan.

He shot a vat-sized water ring flying toward Fang Yuan's head.

Unwilling to fight, Fang Yuan transformed into a seahorse and darted away.

Fang Yuan pretended to be trapped while patiently observing his allies.

Moving alongside Miao Ming Shen, Gui Qi Ye shouted as two Shen clan Gu Immortals closed in: "Lord, go quickly! I will stop them."

"Old Gui, take care!" Knowing the gravity of the situation, Miao Ming Shen flew upward with tearful eyes.

Suppressing Feng Jiang and Immortal Hua Die completely, Shen Cong Sheng sneered: "Where are you going?"

Saying this, countless sound waves chased after Miao Ming Shen.

Miao Ming Shen grunted, activating a space path killer move.

He vanished instantly, reappearing a hundred steps away before blinking another hundred steps further from the group.

Flickering repeatedly, Miao Ming Shen escaped and charged out of the sea.

With Miao Ming Shen as his prime target, Shen Cong Sheng tossed the two captives to his subordinates and gave chase.

Right at this moment, there was a shrill cry resounding.

An immemorial thunder phoenix flew over and attacked Shen Cong Sheng.

The immemorial thunder phoenix attacked fiercely, forcing Shen Cong Sheng to abandon chasing Miao Ming Shen and face the beast.

With a deafening crash, the immemorial thunder phoenix blasted Shen Cong Sheng back into the sea, churning up massive waves.

While Shen Tan caught the two captives tossed to him, Fang Yuan used the distraction to destroy the water rings and aid the others.

Tong Hua, Zeng Luo Zi, and Fang Yuan escaped the sea, flying into the sky.

"All of you, scram!" An intense sound wave suddenly erupted from the ocean depths.

Shen Cong Sheng shot from the sea into the sky, unleashing two translucent sound blades across the battlefield.

Immortal killer move — Aerial Sound Blades!

The sound blades sliced through lightning and eagles, forcing even the immemorial thunder phoenix back.

One sound blade curved around Tong Hua and swiftly slit Zeng Luo Zi's throat.

Zeng Luo Zi's eyes widened as his severed head fell.

A sound blade went after Fang Yuan.

Fang Yuan sighed inwardly, bursting with speed to charge straight toward the immemorial thunder phoenix.

Charred by lightning in the next instant, he died on the spot.

Fang Yuan opened his eyes as he woke up.

"I arrived here after all." He stood up and looked around.

The sea was blue with white waves, the sandy beach golden, and the surroundings warm and serene.

"Hmm?" Fang Yuan saw Zeng Luo Zi here as well.

Though beheaded by Shen Cong Sheng's sound path killer move, Zeng Luo Zi lay unconscious on the beach with normal breathing and his head intact.

"As expected," Fang Yuan thought calmly. "The illusion started long ago; deaths within it are not real."

Thus, Fang Yuan hadn't acted earlier. Killing Shen Cong Sheng wouldn't have been fatal, only transporting him here sooner while needlessly exposing Fang Yuan's identity.

Fang Yuan waved his hand as a qi blade flew towards Zeng Luo Zi.

Though Zeng Luo Zi was defenseless, the qi blade vanished right before striking him.

Fang Yuan snorted coldly, turning around and leaving.

Shen Cong Sheng awoke with blurry vision to a joyful cry beside him: "First supreme elder, you finally woke up!"

As his vision cleared, he saw his Shen clan subordinates and Miao Ming Shen's group locked in a tense standoff.

"What happened? Didn't I die!" Shen Cong Sheng was inwardly shocked, feeling it was unreal.

"First supreme elder, this is Paradise Earth's arrangement, similar to the Reincarnation Battlefield," Shen Tan said.

Shen Cong Sheng calmed down and nodded: "This is indeed Paradise Earth Immortal Venerable's style."

His eyes flashed as he glared at Miao Ming Shen's group, asking directly: "How long have you been awake?"

---

# Chapter 1890: Where is Chu Ying?

"Where are we? Tell me everything you know!" Shen Cong Sheng demanded, attacking Miao Ming Shen again.

However, his killer move vanished upon activation, and Shen Cong Sheng grunted as blood trickled from his nose from the backlash.

"First supreme elder, this place forbids combat—all offensive moves fail, though healing is unobstructed," Shen Tan warned.

"Even rank eight Gu Immortals cannot defy Paradise Earth Immortal Venerable's arrangements," Miao Ming Shen exhaled, calming down completely after seeing Shen Cong Sheng's failure.

Shen Cong Sheng's eyes flashed: "It seems we are inside the blue dragon whale's immortal aperture world."

Gui Qi Ye glared furiously at Tong Hua: "Tong Hua! You betrayed us!"

Tong Hua lowered her head and did not speak, looking ashamed.

Miao Ming Shen sighed, stopping Immortal Hua Die: "Fairy Tong Hua likely had her difficulties. Let it be; everyone has their own goals."

Ren Xiu Ping smiled arrogantly: "Miao Ming Shen, recognize the stronger side! If you surrender and hand over all your information, we might spare you."

Ren Xiu Ping sneered coldly: "Sharp-tongued girl, do you think Paradise Earth Immortal Venerable's methods can protect you for a lifetime? Once we return to Eastern Sea, can any of you resist Lord Shen Cong Sheng? Even here, do you think Paradise Earth Immortal Venerable's arrangements lack a single loophole?"

"The outcome is yet undecided. Let's go!" Unwilling to waste time arguing, Miao Ming Shen turned and left the beach.

"He has the method to find the blue dragon whale and knows more than us. Follow him!" Shen Cong Sheng quickly ordered.

Leaving the beach, they soon arrived in a dense forest.

"This forest is strange; the leaves have hollow heart-shaped centers," Immortal Hua Die said in confusion.

"Hmm, these seem like ordinary trees," Feng Jiang said, touching a trunk.

With a soft sound, the tree collapsed into a pile of wood dust.

"What is going on?" Sensing a commotion, the immortals quickly gathered.

Shen Cong Sheng said: "You only know part of the details regarding cloud ladder trees. Cloud ladder trees are a rank seven immortal material, but ten-thousand-year-old trees form the rank eight immortal material, cloud ladder leaf heart. Once all the cloud ladder leaf hearts are taken, the tree collapses into wood dust, becoming ordinary material."

Walking quickly, he struck several trunks; each cloud ladder tree turned to wood dust upon contact.

Shen Cong Sheng commanded his subordinates: "The leaf hearts have all been taken. Quickly search for any remaining materials!"

Zeng Luo Zi also sensed something amiss, calling out: "An entire field of clear wind grass stems must have grown here; I recognize this aroma. These fist-sized holes with smooth, round walls are the effect of clear wind grass stem roots."

Miao Ming Shen was stunned: "Clear wind grass stem is a rank seven immortal material—was this whole area once an entire field of them?"

Shen Cong Sheng frowned at Miao Ming Shen, asking: "Why is someone missing from your side?"

Miao Ming Shen started; the reminder made him realize what had felt off—someone was indeed missing.

"Chu Ying is not around!" Feng Jiang said grimly.

"Where did he go?"

"Did he awaken earlier and take away all the immortal materials here?"

Shen Cong Sheng stopped following Miao Ming Shen and surged ahead.

The immortals quickly arrived in front of a huge pit.

The pit stretched tens of li wide and hundreds of feet deep, with only fragments remaining inside.

Inspecting the fragments, Tu Tou Tuo shouted: "Heavens! This is rank seven rooster iron. Which bastard plundered everything and left only these fragments?"

"Such a vast deposit of rooster iron would have resonated in the wind, producing rank eight heavenly white snow iron!" Shen Cong Sheng said coldly: "We must find Chu Ying as quickly as possible."

They found no trace of Fang Yuan—only empty pits, dried rivers, and fields stripped of all resources.

---

# Chapter 1891: Who Else Could It Be But Me?

The island was small; finding nothing from their exploration, the immortals quickly gathered at its center.

A huge golden obelisk radiated with a mild crystalline light.

Rank eight Immortal Gu House — Merit Obelisk!

Inscriptions on Merit Obelisk's surface detailed the island's background and the Paradise Earth true inheritance.

To obtain the true inheritance, one had to complete missions on the Merit Obelisk, earning merits to exchange for rewards.

Those who refused could only wait on the island, unable to leave for other parts of the grotto-heaven.

Paradise Earth had provided the island's immortal materials for explorers to share, preventing anyone from leaving empty-handed.

Three hundred days later, everyone would be transported away.

"There really were immortal materials on this island—those cloud ladder leaf hearts, clear wind grass stems, and rooster iron weren't fake."

"Someone took them all! Damn it, he left us absolutely nothing."

"It must be that Chu Ying."

"I found Chu Ying!" Immortal Hua Die suddenly shouted.

The immortals gathered and looked where Immortal Hua Die pointed, seeing words appear on another face of the Merit Obelisk.

Merit Board Ranking — Chu Ying, eighty-two merit points.

Right then, Chu Ying's merit points jumped from eighty-two to ninety-three.

Next, the Merit Obelisk flashed.

The light faded as Fang Yuan appeared.

"Chu Ying!" Feng Jiang cried out.

"Oh, you are awake." Fang Yuan nodded at them, speaking plainly.

Shen Cong Sheng stepped forward, demanding coldly and overbearingly: "Tell me, did you take all the immortal materials on this island?"

"Who else could it be?" Fang Yuan retorted indifferently, moving to the other side of the Merit Obelisk to browse missions.

Ren Xiu Ping said grimly: "Paradise Earth arranged those immortal materials for all of us. Chu Ying, taking everything for yourself is too much!"

Without even looking at him, Fang Yuan pressed his palm to the obelisk and accepted another mission.

White light flashed, he vanished again.

"Investigate him after we leave." Shen Cong Sheng calmed down and walked to the Merit Obelisk, mimicking Fang Yuan.

"Chu Ying acts fearlessly only because combat is forbidden here," Shen Cong Sheng thought. "He is merely rank seven; our priority is this Merit Obelisk."

There were many missions on this Merit Obelisk.

Help South Coast City's merfolk excavate golden lotuses on silver lake.

Round fish island was drying up and needed wells built.

A large amount of immortal materials and Immortal Gu could be exchanged with merits!

There were also peculiar items like titles or mortal Gu.

Shen Cong Sheng immediately noticed a rank five mortal Gu called good deeds Gu, a worm he had never seen before.

Exchanging for a good deeds Gu cost fifty merit points, making it the most expensive mortal Gu.

Realizing they had to participate, Shen Cong Sheng stepped forward first to accept a mission.

Shen Cong Sheng's mission was: Round fish island was drying up, requiring wells to be built.

Light flickered, and he appeared in a desert the next moment.

Despite his dense rank eight dao marks, a grand, mystical power transported him instantly and unhindered.

Arriving in the desert village, he easily built the required wells. While completing it, Shen Cong Sheng tested various methods, thoroughly probing the paradise's foundation.

For instance, he could not leave the area, restricted solely to this desert.

Communication was restricted; he could not even message treasure yellow heaven or his clan members.

He could not attack the villagers either; any offensive method failed and caused backlash.

He could open his immortal aperture to retrieve items, but could not store anything from round fish island into it.

In short, Dragon Whale Paradise granted inhabitants great freedom while heavily restricting Gu Immortals on missions.

---

# Chapter 1892: Analyzing Chu Ying Together

After completing the mission, Shen Cong Sheng thought "return" and was transported back to the starting island.

Checking the board, he saw his name on the merit list: Shen Cong Sheng, nine merit points.

"Did Chu Ying already complete ten missions?" Shen Cong Sheng frowned deeply.

The Immortal Gu and materials he wanted required over ten thousand merit points!

"Moreover, Immortal Gu are unique—if others get them first, I lose my chance."

Shen Cong Sheng, Shen Tan, Shen Qi, Shen Xiao, Shen Nai He, Ren Xiu Ping, and Tong Hua were the first group, while Miao Ming Shen, Feng Jiang, Immortal Hua Die, Gui Qi Ye, Tu Tou Tuo, and Zeng Luo Zi were the second group.

Evidently, Shen Cong Sheng's group was far stronger. Yet within the paradise's special environment, they could not act against Miao Ming Shen's side, forced to watch their enemies band together.

"Heaven always leaves a way out! Everyone, this is a great opportunity. If we seize it, we'll have a chance to deal with Shen Cong Sheng later. We must work hard and unite for hope. Otherwise, working alone, we won't survive," Miao Ming Shen encouraged his group.

"Our mission rewards were at most nine points, never exceeding ten. It seems each mission awards between one and ten merits."

Zeng Luo Zi asked: "Brother Miao, since you sensed the whale's location, is this place truly entirely new to you?"

Miao Ming Shen smiled bitterly: "Brother Zeng, Brother Tu, if I said I don't know why I can sense the blue dragon whale's location, would you believe me? Several years ago, information about the blue dragon whale began to appear inexplicably in my mind, but at first it was very vague. These bits and pieces of information had only gotten clearer recently, I finally realized that it was the blue dragon whale calling to me."

"If I knew shortcuts, I would have used them. Had I known the outside attack was an illusion, I would have died immediately."

Gui Qi Ye noted: "When attacked by a sound blade earlier, Chu Ying deliberately crashed into the immemorial thunder phoenix to perish under its lightning."

"Actively seeking death is strange; Chu Ying surely knows something about this place." Tu Tou Tuo's eyes shone brightly.

"Miao Ming Shen." Shen Tan stepped forward from his group to approach Miao Ming Shen's party.

"No need to be nervous," Shen Tan smiled. "We aren't here to cause trouble, but to seek cooperation."

Shen Cong Sheng nodded slightly and said indifferently: "This was my decision. I did attack you earlier, but put yourselves in my shoes—if you were me, would you have spared me?"

"I swear on Shen clan's reputation that after leaving Dragon Whale Paradise, we will not harm you and will let you all depart."

"In exchange, you must share all the information you have regarding this place."

"The reputation of Shen clan..." Miao Ming Shen pondered, while the surrounding immortals looked visibly moved by the proposal.

Miao Ming Shen smiled and nodded: "I accept your offer. I'll cooperate and share everything I know."

Shen Cong Sheng smiled too: "Good, a wise man submits to circumstances. I'll spare you—speak."

He repeated what he had told Tu Tou Tuo and Zeng Luo Zi earlier.

Observing Miao Ming Shen's reactions, Shen Cong Sheng judged that he was indeed telling the truth.

Gui Qi Ye interjected: "Our earlier analysis showed Chu Ying is very suspicious. He may indeed possess inside information!"

Ren Xiu Ping sneered: "He sought death intentionally, looted the island's materials first, and already amassed over a hundred merit points."

At this moment, white light flashed as Fang Yuan appeared again.

His mission was completed, his merit points went past a hundred, reaching one hundred and two.

Shen Tan smiled and stepped forward to approach Fang Yuan: "Brother Chu Ying."

"Scram." Fang Yuan glanced at Shen Tan, turned, and walked away.

Shen Tan's smile froze in rising anger, but Shen Cong Sheng stepped forward and patted his shoulder.

"Little brother." Shen Cong Sheng chuckled: "We can coope..."

"Scram," Fang Yuan said calmly, interrupting Shen Cong Sheng without hesitation.

Having spoken, Fang Yuan immediately vanished, taking another mission and leaving once more.

Shen Cong Sheng chuckled, breaking the silence: "This Chu Ying is very courageous. I look forward to seeing his courage once we leave."

He smiled, but furious sparks flashed in his eyes as killing intent surfaced.

"Miao Ming Shen, who is this Chu Ying and what is his background?" Shen Tan turned and shouted aggressively.

Miao Ming Shen sighed and shrugged: "If I said I don't know his origins, would you believe me?"

"I trusted Chu Ying because of Ren Xiu Ping. Brother Ren, explain—is there any need to hide it now?"

After questioning everyone present about Chu Ying, they failed to uncover anything useful. "This Chu Ying is not simple," Shen Cong Sheng sensed, yet remained confident. "He's merely a rank seven transformation path Gu Immortal, no match for me."

# Chapter 1893: Saving Xia Lin Again

As light flickered and faded, Fang Yuan appeared on a small sea island.

He accepted the mission to collect Earth Trench black oil in the nearby sea.

Having taken this mission first in his previous life, he was most familiar with it.

"Dragon Whale Paradise has undergone many changes compared to my previous life."

"Not only did the blue dragon whale change locations, but more Gu Immortals entered, and missions have increased."

"This black oil mission only appeared after completing roughly ten missions."

In his previous life, he used this mission to rescue Xia Lin, making her Merman City's saintess to reach regret sea and obtain regret Gu.

Once regret Gu flew to him, the venerable's method triggered, sending him to the stone lotus island in the River of Time to bypass Heavenly Court's assault and claim a Red Lotus true inheritance.

This time, Fang Yuan intended to take Dragon Whale Paradise; regret Gu was only part of a greater plan.

Rather than entering the fishing village immediately, Fang Yuan dove into the sea first.

Black oil was an immortal material dangerous to Gu Masters; contact with it carved food path dao marks into their bodies.

Amidst sea beast corpses and various ores within the black oil, the blue-scaled mermaid Xia Lin lay unconscious.

He breathed out lightly as a bubble surrounded Xia Lin.

Upon awakening, she found herself lying in a waterhole.

"Wasn't I engulfed while collecting black oil?" Memories resurfaced. "Right, I was rescued—I saw a vague white figure on the dark ocean floor."

"This must be my savior's doing," Xia Lin thought with warmth in her heart. The pool was not seawater, but water perfectly suited for a weakened merman.

"You are awake." Right then, tree leaves parted as Fang Yuan walked in.

"Did you save me?" Xia Lin stared at the white-clad Fang Yuan, sensing a hint of familiarity.

"You were very lucky I happened across you," Fang Yuan smiled faintly.

"You are still too weak. Eat something." Fang Yuan extended his hand, sending a wisp of green wind to pluck a coconut-like fruit from the treetop.

Flushing red, she stammered: "May I know benefactor's name? I will definitely repay you for saving my life."

Fang Yuan chuckled: "No repayment is needed. Stay away from black oil in the future—it's dangerous, and you were fortunate this time."

Deep in debt from her grandfather's funeral, she had risked harvesting black oil to repay it, only to fail and nearly lose her life in the process.

"Even if I survived, the black oil's corrosion will kill me soon. How can I repay my debts and this benefactor?" Kind-natured, Xia Lin fretted over this.

Fang Yuan's gentle voice reached her ears: "Right, you suffered black oil corrosion earlier, but I have already healed you without any lingering aftereffects."

Fang Yuan nodded: "Eat, and once you regain strength, come with me—I have business here."

With her grandfather, her only kin, dead, Xia Lin was all alone. Her heart was hollow, her sole remaining purpose being to complete his water burial.

Standing outside the forest gazing at the sea, Fang Yuan knew her state well, yet stayed outside to give the girl time to compose herself.

In this life, he had a grand plan for Dragon Whale Paradise.

"Since I accepted the mission and found Xia Lin, I can make use of her again."

"This pawn is valuable; by replicating my past success, I can indirectly control Merman Sacred City."

"Controlling this force will be quite helpful to my plans ahead."

"Benefactor, I've kept you waiting." Xia Lin soon floated out of the forest, having regained some strength to avoid delaying Fang Yuan.

"Don't call me benefactor—I am Chu Ying, known as Master Chu," Fang Yuan smiled.

"Let's go." Fang Yuan led Xia Lin toward the fishing village.

# Chapter 1894: Going Down, Going Up

Fang Yuan brought Xia Lin to the fishing village to meet its head.

Upon meeting him, Fang Yuan soul-searched him openly. The entire village fell into a brief trance before recovering without suspicion.

As before, he assumed the identity of a traveling Gu Master to interact with these mortals.

After easily defeating the village's Gu Masters, he gave them the recipe and taught them how to refine water shell Gu.

Fang Yuan then led them to the seabed to practice using water shell Gu, also teaching healing methods to alleviate black oil corrosion.

Unlike in his previous life, he nurtured her properly, using wisdom path methods to transmit knowledge directly into her mind while correcting her mistakes.

Fang Yuan did not stay long, leaving as the entire village fell to their knees in reverence.

Xia Lin wanted to follow him, but Fang Yuan stopped her, saying meaningfully: "Our connection does not end here; we will meet again."

Helpless, Xia Lin watched tearfully as Fang Yuan vanished in a flicker of light.

Fang Yuan returned to the Merit Obelisk once again.

His merit points had risen by ten.

By collecting black oil and teaching the villagers to sustain a livelihood, Fang Yuan completed the task perfectly.

Shen Cong Sheng and the others had all been teleported to their missions; only one person remained at the Merit Obelisk.

It was Miao Ming Shen.

He felt a faint, mysterious connection with the Merit Obelisk, though the peculiar feeling was extremely subtle and weak.

Yet he had no idea how to grasp this opportunity.

Fang Yuan slowly approached the Merit Obelisk.

His footsteps interrupted Miao Ming Shen, who turned around, pupils shrinking: "It's Chu Ying!"

Fang Yuan smiled: "Brother Miao, your connection with the Merit Obelisk is too weak. It merely led you here and won't help you much further. I advise you to actively complete missions and accumulate merits."

Fang Yuan's polite attitude surprised Miao Ming Shen.

Shocked, he focused on Fang Yuan's words: "He actually knows about my connection to the Merit Obelisk! I've never told anyone. How did he know? Unless he can also sense the blue dragon whale's location? Or does he have some other connection instead?"

Walking past, Fang Yuan pointed at a line on the obelisk: "This mission suits you. Accumulating merits isn't just about superficial good deeds—it's better to teach a man to fish than to fish for him."

Miao Ming Shen was shaken internally. Gulping, he said: "Thank you."

"You're welcome." Fang Yuan smiled.

On one hand, it sowed discord for his convenience; on the other, it laid arrangements to influence Eastern Sea.

Miao Ming Shen was popular among Eastern Sea's lone immortals; if Shen Cong Sheng cornered him, Qi Sea Ancestor or Wu Shuai could easily recruit him.

Rather than taking a mission, Fang Yuan went to the obelisk's other side and exchanged for a title.

Instantly, his merit points plunged from over a hundred to single digits, dropping him from first place to last.

Seeing the merit board update, Miao Ming Shen's eyes sparkled with suspicion: "Chu Ying spent a hundred merit points—what exactly did he exchange for?"

Fang Yuan took his mission and vanished again.

Miao Ming Shen immediately went to the other side of the Merit Obelisk to check the exchange list.

With a flash of white light, Fang Yuan was transported to the seabed.

Amidst murky seawater and churning sand, a giant salamander was wreaking havoc.

This was a desolate beast, tiger king salamander!

Fang Yuan's mission was to suppress it.

He found no reason for the tiger king salamander's rampage; its body and mind seemed normal, yet it acted maniacally, destroying its surroundings.

Testing the tiger king salamander, Fang Yuan discovered its battle strength had reached the level of an ancient desolate beast.

Left with no choice, Fang Yuan killed it.

He stored the salamander's corpse in his immortal aperture as extra profit from the mission.

Ren Xiu Ping returned to the starting island again.

Upon his arrival, Shen clan Gu Immortal Shen Xiao said: "Congratulations, Brother Ren, you're now at the top of the merit board."

He was truly ranked first, with Shen Cong Sheng in second.

Shen Cong Sheng had also returned, standing before the obelisk with a dark expression.

Shen Cong Sheng nodded: "Ren Xiu Ping, what do you think Chu Ying exchanged for that dropped his rank to last?"

Ren Xiu Ping frowned: "For Chu Ying to surrender his lead, the exchanged item must be immensely useful."

With a flash of white light, Fang Yuan reappeared before everyone.

Simultaneously, his ranking on the merit board skyrocketed back to the top.

Chu Ying, ninety-eight merit points!

At once, the immortals became tongue-tied.

# Chapter 1895: Mid-sized Missions

Small missions awarded one to ten merit points, while mid-sized missions gave eleven to a hundred.

Fang Yuan's 'good person' title allowed him to accept mid-sized missions.

Mid-sized missions were Gu Immortal level; this tiger king salamander was a rank six desolate beast whose battle strength had reached rank seven.

"So that's why I earned over ninety merit points..." Fang Yuan realized. "I didn't get a hundred because I took the salamander's corpse; leaving it behind would have let its dao marks enrich the surrounding environment."

He brought the corpse along, planning to research it later.

In his previous life, Miao Ming Shen's group encountered this repeatedly and failed to find the cause; this time, Fang Yuan wanted to investigate it himself.

Shen Cong Sheng looked over at Shen Xiao.

"Brother Chu," he cupped his fists, speaking earnestly and politely: "Name your price; as long as I can afford it, I will satisfy you."

Fang Yuan smiled lightly: "You want to know how I obtained so many merit points?"

"Indeed." Shen Xiao cupped his fists again: "Please teach us, brother. Shen clan will not disappoint you, and you will gain our clan's friendship!"

Fang Yuan laughed: "Sure, exchange one of Shen clan's true inheritances for it."

Shen Cong Sheng's eyes brightened. Surprised that Fang Yuan agreed, he asked: "What true inheritance do you want?"

"Up to you. If not an inheritance, Immortal Gu work too," Fang Yuan said nonchalantly.

Shen Cong Sheng's lips twitched. An Immortal Gu? Dream on!

Catching the information path mortal Gu, Shen Cong Sheng said grimly: "Chu Ying, you've checked so many—how much content do you expect to see?"

Fang Yuan smiled: "Give me a portion of constant wave sound, and I'll explain how I gained so many merit points."

# Chapter 1954: Pursue — Freedom!

Bathed in blood and heavily injured, Fang Yuan snorted coldly and rose, gazing at Embroidered Tower before him.

The Legends of Ren Zu, chapter four states —

Fate Gu's manipulation had separated him from his children and cost him wealth Gu, driving Ren Zu mad.

One morning, a group of birds ran past Ren Zu.

Wingless, these birds sprinted across the ground on six alternating legs, kicking up clouds of dust.

The birds growled: "You are human, not a bird. Leave us alone—we are pursuing freedom Gu to reclaim our freedom."

Ren Zu asked: "Why are you all searching for freedom Gu?"

The birds replied: "Without freedom Gu, we are wingless and unable to fly. Once we regain freedom, we can soar again."

Ren Zu realized: "I understand, humans need freedom too. Without it, we are like birds that have lost their wings."

"Right!" Ren Zu clapped and laughed madly. "I must seek freedom to escape fate's shackles and be with my loved ones forever."

One afternoon, a leap of blue leopards passed by him.

The leopards shoved him away: "You are human, not a leopard. Leave us alone! We are pursuing freedom Gu."

Ren Zu asked: "Why are you searching for freedom Gu?"

The blue leopards sighed: "Without freedom Gu, we are toothless and unable to hunt. Once we regain freedom, we can feast again."

Ren Zu realized: "I see, humans need freedom too. Without it, they are like toothless beasts."

"Right!" Ren Zu laughed madly. "I must seek freedom to escape fate's shackles and enjoy boundless wealth!"

One evening, a school of fish swam past him.

The fish shoved Ren Zu away: "You are human, not a fish. Leave us alone! We are pursuing freedom Gu."

Ren Zu asked: "Why are you searching for freedom Gu?"

The fish sighed: "Without freedom Gu, we are gill-less and unable to breathe. Once we regain freedom, we can swim again."

Ren Zu realized: "I understand, humans need freedom too. Without it, they are like gill-less fish unable to breathe."

"Right!" Ren Zu clapped and laughed madly. "I must seek freedom to cast off fate's shackles, breathe freely, and live forever—I want eternal life!"

One day, freedom Gu flew towards Ren Zu on its own accord.

Ren Zu was joyous as he grabbed it.

"I have finally obtained freedom!" Ren Zu asked freedom Gu: "The wingless birds, beasts, and fish pursue you, yet you flew to me. Why?"

Freedom Gu replied: "I did not fly to you, human. I despise you! I only came because I was drawn to your cognition Gu."

Cognition Gu floated from Ren Zu's body, explaining with a smile: "Ren Zu, in your madness, you think delirious thoughts constantly. A mortal desiring eternal companionship, yearning for a carefree life, and pursuing eternal life—what else could that be but a lunatic?"

Freedom Gu sighed: "Cognitive freedom empowers me. Ren Zu, though you caught me, I will never serve you. Release me!"

Ren Zu shook his head and grasped even tighter: "Freedom Gu, I will not let you go."

Freedom Gu sneered: "Then prepare yourself, don't collapse from the pressure."

The moment it finished speaking, responsibility Gu flew over, pressing on Ren Zu's shoulder.

"Heavy, so heavy!" Ren Zu almost bent over from the pressure.

Cognition Gu sighed: "Freedom and responsibility coexist, Ren Zu. To gain freedom, you must bear responsibility—at least, responsibility for yourself."

Fate Gu's spider silk wrapped around his body, trapping him beneath responsibility's crushing weight.

Fate Gu's spider silk constricted tightly, opening bloody wounds across Ren Zu's body.

Cognition Gu explained: "Human, the more freedom you experience, the more restricted you will feel."

# Chapter 1967: New Otherworldly Demon

"Wake up! Hey, wake up kid."

Peng Da opened his eyes with difficulty. Through blurred vision, he saw the face of a bearded, middle-aged man with clear triangular eyes and a white headscarf covering his head.

"Where am I?!" He was shocked to find himself in a desert under a cloudless sky, scorched by the blazing sun.

"Kid, this place is called Wolf Desert. When we found you, desert wolves had already eaten your dead companions; after chasing them away, we found you still alive."

"My name is Mo Li, leader of this caravan. I saved you and healed your wounds. You are quite lucky to have met us—do you remember anything now?" the bearded middle-aged man explained.

"I transmigrated!"

With several burly men staring at him, Peng Da forced himself to stay calm, holding and shaking his head: "I... I only remember my name is Peng Da. As for the rest... damn it, why don't I remember anything?"

The bearded man looked deeply at Peng Da, light flashing in his eyes: "If you don't remember, forget it. I hope you regain your memories one day. What are your plans now? Do you want to travel with my caravan?"

Peng Da quickly nodded, not daring to travel the desert alone: "Uncle Mo Li, I will definitely repay you for saving my life. Wherever you are going, please take me along; I have nowhere else to go."

"Then follow us." Mo Li nodded, instructing someone beside him: "Provide a camel for kid Peng Da."

Left alone, he was shocked to discover this was not his original body, but one from this world—with tanned brown skin, thick limbs, and bulging joints.

"So only my soul crossed over, entering the body of an inhabitant of this world."

By nightfall, they prepared dinner. A Gu Master planted seeds in the desert that grew into fruit-bearing trees within moments.

"Kid, it seems you really have amnesia! We are Gu Masters! These are Gu Master methods." Mo Li looked at Peng Da with a strange gaze.

"Gu Master?" This was the first time Peng Da heard this phrase.

With an even stranger expression, Mo Li pointed at Peng Da: "Kid, you are also a Gu Master—in fact, a rank two Gu Master."

Extremely excited, he nevertheless succumbed to fatigue by nightfall and fell fast asleep.

"Memory loss or not, he is still a rank two Gu Master and useful to us. There was no loss in saving him," Mo Li said.

As they spoke, Mo Li suddenly frowned, his expression turning grim: "Listen, do you hear something?"

The Gu Masters rushed out of the tent, only to freeze in shock.

A boundless qi tide surged from all directions like a grand tsunami overwhelming heaven and earth, sweeping up sand with unstoppable might.

"Escape!" Gritting his teeth, Mo Li retreated with all his strength before even finishing his sentence.

Amid the chaos, Peng Da remained sound asleep, oblivious to the mortal danger upon him.

# Chapter 1968: Spectral Soul Hunts

In the quiet surroundings of black heaven, three Gu Immortals moved stealthily.

They were Old Man Zheng Yuan, Fairy Zi Wei, and Spectral Soul Demon Venerable!

Fairy Zi Wei analyzed: "The heaven and earth qi varies across the five regions. When Gu Immortals enter other regions, absorbing foreign qi causes problems in their immortal apertures. Now that the regional walls are gone, the five regions' heaven and earth qi is converging into one, giving birth to these qi tides."

Spectral Soul snorted coldly, his voice hoarse and icy: "This qi tide is a hindrance to us! Soul beasts cannot resist it; even if they survive, their soul cores are damaged."

Spectral Soul snorted coldly: "What use is staying by my side? I alone am sufficient, and I have tasks for you two."

Old Man Zheng Yuan and Fairy Zi Wei looked at each other: "Please give us your instructions, Master."

Spectral Soul squinted, saying eerily: "Back then, I expended my assets to refine sovereign immortal fetus Gu for Fang Yuan to create a complete otherworldly demon. Now that Fate Gu is destroyed and the plan succeeded, it is time to retrieve sovereign immortal fetus Gu. I want you two to capture Fang Yuan alive; I will refine him back into sovereign immortal fetus Gu."

Old Man Zheng Yuan frowned, recalling: "Master wants to deal with Fang Yuan? After destroying Fate Gu, that demon left Heavenly Court immediately and did not participate in the subsequent battle. He acted very strangely, and no one knows where he went."

Spectral Soul smiled coldly: "Because of the heaven path dao marks, Fang Yuan could barely save himself and had to make that choice. Since he discerned the arrangement Giant Sun Immortal Venerable placed on wisdom Gu and used it unhesitatingly in the refinement, he can naturally infer my arrangements in sovereign immortal fetus Gu as well."

"But how do we locate Fang Yuan now?" Fairy Zi Wei felt a headache.

Eventually, Spectral Soul ordered: "We temporarily can't find Fang Yuan, we have to force him to show up."

"How? Fang Yuan is a solitary demon with no attachments. Even if he had friends or family, his cruel nature means threats won't make him appear," Old Man Zheng Yuan said, troubled.

Spectral Soul snorted coldly: "During the battle, everyone witnessed Fang Yuan destroying Fate Gu through the killer move everybody's vision. Spread the secret of the sovereign immortal aperture: tell the world Fang Yuan reached rank eight and destroyed Fate because his aperture can annex others to skip tribulations and rapidly raise his cultivation level."

"Periodically, Fang Yuan must annex immortal apertures to sustain his life. Whoever kills him will gain countless venerable inheritances and the sovereign immortal aperture, qualifying them to become an invincible venerable!"

Pausing, Spectral Soul continued: "That will make Fang Yuan the enemy of everyone. We must also reveal his current weakness—that heaven path dao marks have stripped his battle strength, which is why he fled immediately after refining the Gu."

"With the entire world searching for him, where can Fang Yuan hide? Even if he hides for a while, he cannot hide forever. Afterward, both of you will find my hidden secret treasuries. The cultivation resources surplus from refining sovereign immortal fetus Gu are kept there, and their value is substantial. Using these resources, you can rebuild Shadow Sect and help me recruit more members."

"Fang Yuan's subordinates like Bai Ning Bing and Hei Lou Lan are outside—finding them may yield clues to Fang Yuan."

Spectral Soul looked down, his gaze piercing through the darkness toward the five regions: "The five regions have fused into one; converging heaven and earth qi has spawned qi tides spreading across the world. Thus, colliding qi causes tremors in their immortal apertures, forcing the five regions' Gu Immortals to recuperate. The stronger the aperture's foundation, the longer the recovery."

"Fang Yuan will be forced to lie low for a long time. But as former Heavenly Court members with phantom apertures, you two are unaffected. Make use of this time and work hard!"

Spectral Soul waved his sleeves: "Then why are you still here?"

"Master, please take care! We will take our leave." Fairy Zi Wei and Old Man Zheng Yuan left quickly.

# Chapter 1969: Black Heaven's Gu Immortals

After parting with his subordinates, Spectral Soul had been hunting soul beasts in black heaven.

Drawing closer, he found a high-quality soul beast army numbering over three million, delighting him.

This discovery was quite surprising: "Why are there soul path Gu Immortals?"

There were three Gu Immortals controlling the soul beast army.

At the center leading them was a plain-looking female with grey eyes, naturally radiating a rank eight aura.

"Black heaven Gu Immortals." Discerning their aura, Spectral Soul snickered and abandoned his plan to charge in, stealthily mixing into the soul beast army instead.

The female immortal sighed: "Besides me, you two are the most likely in our clan to advance. Now that Fate Gu is destroyed, we control our own fate. The great era has arrived; the peaceful life of the past is long gone. You must strive hard, or Soul Pacifying grotto-heaven will eventually be drowned by the tides of the era!"

The female immortal sighed: "The five regions have fused, spawning qi tides across the world—even black and white heaven are not exempt. Wherever the qi tide reaches, heaven and earth shake, exposing concealed grotto-heavens. We black heaven grotto-heaven Gu Immortals are meeting to discuss how to face this situation. At that time, you will be representing both yourselves and our Soul Pacifying grotto-heaven—do not forget this."

"So that's it," Spectral Soul realized. "With the convergence of heaven and earth qi, grotto-heavens concealed in the two heavens are affected too, for the same reason the five regions' Gu Immortals must recuperate. But while the five regions' Gu Immortals are more affected, the two heavens are less troubled, allowing their immortals to move about with difficulty."

Sensing a perfect opportunity, Spectral Soul remained hidden and followed the three immortals.

After half a day controlling the soul beast army, the three immortals finally arrived at their destination.

"So our friends from Soul Pacifying grotto-heaven have arrived." Seeing them, a Gu Immortal flew out from a pack of night heavenly wolves.

"Night Heavenly Wolf Lord, you arrived early." The rank eight female immortal from Soul Pacifying grotto-heaven replied while smiling.

"Actually, we were late, Lady Cold Ash." Night Heavenly Wolf Lord smiled bitterly, pointing at the grotto-heaven entrance: "Those variant human Gu Immortals have entered already. I waited for you to enter together, otherwise, as lone rank eight Gu Immortals, we will be pushed aside."

Lady Cold Ash nodded grimly: "We gathered today at Ice Crystal Immortal Monarch's request. As a snowman Gu Immortal hosting in his Ice Crystal grotto-heaven, this will definitely be dominated by variant human Gu Immortals. Let's go in and see first."

Unknown to her, Spectral Soul had already possessed one of her immemorial soul beasts, he followed after them.

After observing for a while, Spectral Soul saw through the icy palace's foundation, swiftly finding a loophole to enter the hall.

Sitting in the main seat with a squarish face and dignified demeanor was the snowman Gu Immortal Ice Crystal Immortal Monarch.

Beside him were three other rank eight variant humans: a rockman, a hairy man, and an eggman.

"The five regions have merged and qi tides rampage through the heavens. Our grotto-heavens will be exposed; I propose we unite to resist the five regions' enemies together!"

"Do not worry, everyone. Though we are humans, our Soul Pacifying Ancestor was forced into black heaven; we have already severed all ties with the five regions."

"To be straightforward, my Night Wolf grotto-heaven does not wish to be exposed—we share an immense enmity with Northern Plains' Longevity Heaven!"

"Friends," Ice Crystal Immortal Monarch spoke. "Do you only wish to defend rather than advance? With fate Gu destroyed, humanity's reign is disrupted. As the five regions' Gu Immortals recuperate, this is our best chance to act!"

Ice Crystal Immortal Monarch sighed with a grim expression: "The five regions are vast and richly resourced; even combined, our grotto-heavens cannot compare to them. The world will plunge into chaos. If we do not strengthen ourselves, the five regions will eliminate us once they settle down. Only by taking the lead can we hope to survive."

# Chapter 1970: Heavenly Court's Dilemma

Soul Pacifying grotto-heaven's name and members revealed its soul path foundation, surely rich in cultivation resources Spectral Soul desperately needed.

"Qi tides rampage across the five regions and two heavens, and the black and white heaven grotto-heavens will not stay idle. Hehe, I can exploit this to strike other venerable forces and accelerate my growth!"

Night Heavenly Wolf Lord said: "Ice Crystal Immortal Monarch wants us to form an alliance resisting the five regions. This is quite difficult."

Gu Immortal Ye Zhi nodded: "Indeed. With fate Gu destroyed, the five regions merged, and heaven and earth qi fusing into rampant qi tides, no grotto-heaven can conceal itself. The five regions are obviously stronger than the two heavens, so why can we not join them instead?"

Night Heavenly Wolf Lord sighed: "That is why I agreed with Lady Cold Ash to unite our human grotto-heavens. We should secretly contact Central Continent's Heavenly Court first."

Central Great Hall was finally repaired, with Qin Ding Ling currently in charge.

With Duke Long dead and Fairy Zi Wei turned traitor, Heavenly Court chose Qin Ding Ling as their new leader.

"Oh?" Holding an information path mortal Gu, her expression shifted slightly: "Night Wolf grotto-heaven?"

"Hmph, those of other races have such motives! Once fate Gu got destroyed, these variant humans jumped out immediately." Qin Ding Ling snorted, deep killing intense rose in her heart.

Heavenly Court was at an unprecedented level of weakness.

Recognizing the severity of the situation after brief reflection, Qin Ding Ling decided to discuss it with Zhou Xiong Xin and the others.

Zhou Xiong Xin suggested: "This is crucial, yet the situation remains unclear. Night Heavenly Wolf Lord and the others are merely the rank eights in Central Continent's black heaven. What of the other four regions' black heaven? We know neither how many grotto-heavens exist nor how many rank eight Gu Immortals they hold. I am willing to investigate the two heavens myself!"

Agreeing with his suggestion, Qin Ding Ling chose to maintain contact with Night Wolf grotto-heaven while investigating the situation.

Jun Shen Guang produced an information path mortal Gu: "The candidates have been selected—talented Gu Immortal seeds loyal to Heavenly Court and the ten great ancient sects. However, there is one person requiring everyone's discussion."

The list held many names: Immortal Crane Sect recommended Sun Yuan Hua, Spirit Butterfly Valley put forth Xiao Qi Xing, Ancient Soul Sect offered Gu Ting, Heaven's Envy Manor nominated Wei Wu Shang... but Spirit Affinity House's section was blank.

She knew Spirit Affinity House's intended nominee had to be Feng Jin Huang.

"We will talk about this again next time."

# Chapter 1971: Struggle Between Feng and Zhao

After Feng Jiu Ge betrayed Heavenly Court and vanished, his wife and Feng Jin Huang's mother, Fairy Bai Qing, requested a transfer to Quiet Rain Valley to collect quiet rain, vowing never to leave.

Enchanted by the beautiful music, Feng Jin Huang ventured deeper into the valley and met her mother.

Fairy Bai Qing sat in a bamboo pavilion as two sound path mortal Gu—zither Gu and flute Gu—circled her like white jade pearls.

Already aware of Feng Jin Huang's arrival, Fairy Bai Qing turned slowly: "This demonic immortal unification song was composed by your father when we fell in love; it is the symbol of our relationship. Your father treasured this profound song and kept it hidden, yet he played it during the fate war."

Fairy Bai Qing's tone shifted as she looked fixedly at Feng Jin Huang: "The list of names has already been announced."

Feng Jin Huang nodded: "I know. Heavenly Court gave no reply when the sect recommended me previously. This time, they submitted Sun Yao's name, which Heavenly Court quickly approved."

Fairy Bai Qing said plainly: "The sect originally wanted to recommend you, but Li Jun Ying and Xu Hao interfered, promoting Sun Yao instead. How do you feel about this outcome, my daughter?"

"Hehe." Feng Jin Huang smiled slightly, radiant as a flower, momentarily brightening the bamboo pavilion.

"Mother, why test me? Ever since father turned against Heavenly Court, I have been prepared. The situation is not bad—my dream path Immortal Gu was not taken," Feng Jin Huang said.

Fairy Bai Qing smiled slightly: "Forceful seizures occur in the righteous path as well, merely cloaked in righteousness and morality. It is good that you have reached this level of understanding. Do not worry too much, however. Your father created destiny song upon leaving Heavenly Court; with his peerless strength evident to the world, neither Heavenly Court nor Spirit Affinity House dare touch you."

Feng Jin Huang showed displeasure: "Mother, do not make excuses for him. Turning on Heavenly Court without telling us beforehand was abandoning his wife and daughter! One day, I will settle the score with him."

"Believe me, if I showed the slightest inclination to leave Spirit Affinity House, he would take the initiative to take me away. He understands me well and knows I do not want to become a demonic path member. Therefore, he gave us both the freedom to choose our side, not wanting his ideals to become our burden."

Feng Jin Huang snorted coldly: "Father chose to help the great demon Fang Yuan rather than my master. Master was stubborn and nagged about fate, but he was kind to us and had my best interests at heart. Father was simply too cold and heartless."

"Mother, since you are fine now, I'll be leaving."

Leaving Quiet Rain Valley, Feng Jin Huang encountered two female Gu Masters.

"Senior sister, sorry, I... I did not mean to steal your opportunity..." Sun Yao said anxiously, her cute round face full of worry.

Feng Jin Huang laughed and tapped Sun Yao's forehead: "You did well, so why apologize? The nomination quota is a minor matter—would I be unable to become immortal without this funding? Becoming a Gu Immortal is no obstacle for me; I only have to consider what kind of Gu Immortal I want to become. But for you, this is a rare opportunity, so seize it well."

Feng Jin Huang then turned to Qin Juan: "You have always been diligent and persevering, so why did you faint while fusing with the dao marks? Otherwise, the nomination would have been yours."

"So that was it." Feng Jin Huang nodded with regret: "It is indeed a great loss. Fang Yuan refined destroyed fate Gu into countless heaven path dao marks that dispersed across the world. Ultimately, your achievements in life will depend on your own talents and efforts."

At the same time, on another mountain, Affection Peak.

Spirit Affinity House's Li Jun Ying and Xu Hao visited Zhao Lian Yun.

Having become a Gu Immortal, Zhao Lian Yun was recently appointed Affection Peak Lord by Spirit Affinity House.

"Seniors, you want me to use my status as current generation fairy against Feng Jin Huang and Fairy Bai Qing?"

"Indeed, now is our best chance! Feng Jiu Ge's betrayal caused Heavenly Court's defeat and Fate's destruction. Targeting them now guarantees our victory," Xu Hao urged fiercely.

"This..." Zhao Lian Yun hesitated: "Feng Jiu Ge betrayed Heavenly Court, and I know you hold grudges against him, but why implicate his family?"

"Lian Yun, one cannot be overly kindhearted. Think back to your competition with Feng Jin Huang for the fairy position," Li Jun Ying urged. "If we miss this chance, we will regret it. You need not worry; our sect's original nominee was Feng Jin Huang, but she has already been removed from the list."

Xu Hao dismissed her words: "Back then, did the demon Feng Jiu Ge spare us?"

Zhao Lian Yun sighed and adjusted her argument: "Consider the situation carefully. Heavenly Court has not stripped Feng Jin Huang's status, showing their stance toward her remains ambiguous."

"Precisely because they are uncertain, we must deliver a decisive blow to finalize their stance! Power struggles never cease until a true victor emerges," Li Jun Ying remarked with deep meaning.

Zhao Lian Yun sighed again, forced to accept their request.

Uninterested in any reward, Zhao Lian Yun resumed her closed cultivation after the two departed.

Fate's destruction was great news to Zhao Lian Yun, as reviving Ma Hong Yun would now be far easier.

Yet Ma Hong Yun's soul remained in Fang Yuan's hands.

Thus, Zhao Lian Yun had to cultivate and grow stronger, preparing to rescue her beloved.

Inside the secret room, Zhao Lian Yun calmed down and examined her immortal aperture.

After absorbing the heaven path dao marks, Lian Yun blessed land began undergoing manifold changes.

Watching her immortal aperture's entire transformation unfold, Zhao Lian Yun was dazed and deeply shaken.

"With heaven path dao marks, the immortal aperture transforms closer to a truly balanced environment. Despite temporary losses, its future potential and prospects multiply greatly."

Possessing Divine Concealment from Thieving Heaven's true inheritance, Zhao Lian Yun faced no calamities or tribulations. While advantageous, this had hindered her aperture's development—a problem now greatly alleviated by the heaven path dao marks.

"Sigh, what a pity that I only obtained six and a half heaven path dao marks—all fragmented, without a single complete mark."

"How many heaven path dao marks did Fang Yuan obtain? As the one refining the Gu, he stood closest to them."

Unable to fathom the answer, she knew only that the gap between her and Fang Yuan had widened once more.

# Chapter 1972: Fang Yuan's Disaster Relief

Peng Da groaned and barely opened his eyes to see a bearded uncle slapping his face with a rough palm.

"Uncle Mo Li." He called out: "Wasn't I sleeping on the camel?"

Surrounded by endless sand, the caravan was nowhere to be seen—only he and Mo Li remained, both utterly disheveled.

Uncle Mo Li looked at Peng Da and sighed: "You lucky kid! Many Gu Masters fled desperately and died, yet you survived sound asleep. Still, had I not noticed your faint breath and dug you out, you would have been buried alive."

"Look at me," Mo Li pointed to his chest. "I worked hard most of my life for this caravan, and now it's gone! We must look on the bright side to survive until tomorrow. If only I could become an immortal!"

"Of course!" Mo Li said emphatically. "Making a living in the desert isn't easy; lethal sandstorms are frequent visitors. There are also flying blade hurricanes whose gusts condense into massive wind blades cutting everything in their path. Besides natural disasters, vicious beasts roam—in this wolf desert, desert wolves are most plentiful."

As Mo Li spoke, a pack of desert wolves suddenly emerged from beneath the sand.

Paling, Mo Li cursed aloud: "Damn it! Why weren't these desert wolves wiped out by the disaster?"

Desert wolves emerged from all around, but despite spotting Peng Da and Mo Li, they did not attack, instead gathering to howl and stare at the desert ground.

With shifting sand sounds, millstone-sized golden scorpions crawled out from the ground; Peng Da watched with chills in his heart.

The golden scorpions and desert wolves clashed in a brutal fight.

"We must break out!" Mo Li gritted his teeth firmly.

"Do you want to wait to be eaten?" Mo Li said, about to move: "Kid, can you fight?"

"Huh? I, I can't, I have amnesia."

"The wolves and scorpions don't care about your amnesia. Stay close and do your best—there is at least hope of breaking out." Mo Li laughed, "If we fail, you'll fill their bellies. But don't worry, you won't die alone with me around."

As Mo Li began breaking out, Peng Da yelled: "Uncle, wait for me!"

Almost simultaneously, several golden scorpions and desert wolves lunged from the left and right.

Mo Li grunted and activated his mortal Gu, but only repelled two beasts before the packs encircled them.

"The breakout failed!" Mo Li sighed and gave up the fight.

Inside the sovereign immortal aperture.

Chaos raged across both the mini five regions and mini nine heavens, throwing the entire aperture into turmoil.

Mini Southern Border's mountains collapsed, Mini Central Continent's diverted rivers caused floods, and Mini Western Desert's sandstorms devoured oases.

Mini Northern Plains.

Amid a fierce snowstorm, a pure white flame fluttered in the blizzard, clinging wherever it burned.

"We cannot let this frost ice flame spread!" Snowman Gu Immortal Xue Er took charge, trying to salvage the situation.

Tasked by Fang Yuan to manage Triple Sacred Mountain, she controlled the snow crystal formation to oversee the snowman tribe's expansion.

But at this moment, a figure suddenly appeared.

"Fang Yuan!" Xue Er was stunned before joy filled her face.

Fang Yuan reached into the empty air, drawing away all the frost ice flames within the formation.

Fang Yuan suddenly grunted as his body shook, pale white traces abruptly appearing around him.

From these pale white traces, Xue Er sensed a vast power surging throughout heaven and earth!

"These are... heaven path dao marks! Heavens, so many—he must have at least a thousand!" Xue Er covered her mouth in shock.

"I will leave the rest to you." Smiling at Xue Er, Fang Yuan took the frost ice flame and vanished.

Having helped Xue Er resolve the snowman crisis in Mini Northern Plains, Fang Yuan immediately returned to his secret room to resume closed cultivation.

Holding the prime position while refining fate Gu, Fang Yuan had absorbed over three thousand heaven path dao marks into his body—all complete and intact!

Because the sovereign immortal body had non-conflicting dao marks, Sovereign grotto-heaven had suddenly gained three thousand heaven path dao marks.

"The way of heaven takes away surpluses while replenishing deficits, balancing living beings to limit each other. Even in an extreme environment like the snow crystal formation, the Heavenly Dao could create fire path dao marks within ice and snow path dao marks; once the frost ice flame spreads destruction, Mini Northern Plains will be altered beyond recognition."

"Of course, if ignored, Sovereign grotto-heaven would benefit, creating a balanced, complete ecosystem with great future prospects."

"However, this consumes too much foundation—exactly what Red Lotus Demon Venerable wants to see!"

With fate Gu destroyed and his plan successful, Red Lotus Demon Venerable no longer valued Fang Yuan. Thus, he schemed to restrict Fang Yuan with heaven path dao marks, limiting his growth speed.

Though Fang Yuan saw through this, he had to take the bait. Having noticed that Spectral Soul had tampered with sovereign immortal fetus Gu, he needed the heaven path dao marks to counter Spectral Soul's arrangements.

"Time is about right." A while later, Fang Yuan moved again.

Storing the sovereign immortal aperture, his main body emerged into the five regions.

Standing in Western Desert, he gazed at a tree before him.

Now, he retrieved the immortal formation and took the thousand wish tree, sending both into the sovereign immortal aperture.

Unconcerned, Fang Yuan transformed into a flash of light and soared into the sky.

Surrounded by desert wolves after failing to break out, Peng Da and Mo Li were on the brink of death when air currents arrived.

The desert wolf pack fell into chaos, scattering in flight.

Peng Da jolted: "Another disaster!"

Mo Li's eyes widened before he laughed: "Haha, we are saved! This is no disaster, merely a normal hurricane. Let's go!"

# Chapter 1973: Going After Fang Yuan

With the qi tide gone, sparse clouds drifted across a refreshing sky.

A yellow cloud drifted high in the sky, sprinkling fine sand in its wake.

A corpulent female immortal with a bulging belly sat atop the yellow cloud—a member of Western Desert's Mo clan known as Plump Lady.

Her eyes shone as Plump Lady realized a Gu Immortal had secretly stolen an ancient desolate plant from this spot.

Plump Lady snorted coldly in rising anger. Though she did not know what the plant was, Wolf Desert was Mo clan territory; stealing it was an affront to Mo clan.

Flying onward, she saw a vast oasis with a stone city at its center. Enclosed by low but sprawling walls, Sand Wolf City housed a massive mortal population.

Plump Lady openly descended from the sky directly into the City Lord Manor.

Plump Lady waved her hand, uninterested: "Prepare a secret room for my closed cultivation. Also, how is the gathering of loyal Gu Masters with good aptitude going?"

"Very well. I will collect them in three days. You may return to your duties."

As the secret room's door closed, Plump Lady waved her hand to activate the formation.

Looking exhausted, she probed her immortal aperture with divine sense and let out a deep sigh at the scene within.

Her immortal aperture had once been flat yellow sand, with over six thousand acres of sand farms meticulously cultivated at its heart.

After absorbing five heaven path dao marks during the fate war, however, her immortal aperture shifted, turning uneven as numerous sand dunes formed. Furthermore, a trench cleaved through the center of the desert like a knife, splitting the land and destroying thousands of acres of sand farms.

With the five regional walls gone, the five regions' heaven and earth qi fused unobstructed. Western Desert's changing qi caused the foundations of local Gu Immortals' immortal apertures to diverge from the outside environment.

Absorbing this foreign heaven and earth qi destabilized their immortal apertures, causing tremors.

The best solution was to adapt to the changes by continuously absorbing and expelling heaven and earth qi. If one remained in closed cultivation while heaven and earth qi drastically shifted, opening the immortal aperture to absorb qi later would cause massive tremors and severe damage.

With the five regions unified, peace was at an end. Lone cultivators and super forces alike prepared for the massive battles ahead.

Plump Lady had been tasked to go to Sand Wolf City to bring back Gu Immortal seeds for Mo clan to nurture.

Now, preparing for war, every force was mobilizing these resources.

Thus, factions prioritized nurturing Gu Immortals over hoarding resources. The prevailing consensus was that if they failed to cultivate enough Gu Immortals, their enemies would seize those hoarded resources upon wiping them out in the future.

Plump Lady activated her Gu worms, connecting to treasure yellow heaven.

Other than that, there was Fang Yuan's arrest warrant!

A mysterious force detailed Fang Yuan's circumstances, offering a huge reward for his latest information.

It revealed that Fang Yuan possessed the sovereign immortal aperture with non-conflicting dao marks, but was now burdened by heaven path dao marks, causing his strength to plummet.

The secrets of sovereign immortal fetus Gu were fully exposed, issued not by Heavenly Court, but by Fairy Zi Wei and Old Man Zheng Yuan under Spectral Soul's orders.

Unbeknownst to her, she had once fought Fang Yuan—and the ancient desolate plant stolen earlier had been taken by him.

As Plump Lady entered closed cultivation, two battered figures supported each other toward Sand Wolf City.

"There's an entry fee?" Peng Da, one of the downcast Gu Masters, stared with wide eyes.

The middle-aged Gu Master he supported was Mo Li.

Saved by the air currents from Fang Yuan retrieving the thousand wish tree, they had painstakingly reached Sand Wolf City.

"I have it." Prepared, Mo Li handed two primeval stones to the guard.

Mo Li patted his shoulder: "Let's go, kid. I can still afford this fee. Stay with me for now—you have no money or memories of this city, so how could you survive alone?"

Mo Li's residence was a large house with a blooming garden in central Sand Wolf City.

"I'm back!" Mo Li knocked, and his wife opened the door.

"You're finally back!" Mo Li's wife, a rank two Gu Master, greeted him with surprised delight. "When the qi tide struck, I feared the worst..."

"I survived by luck, but the caravan is ruined and only the two of us made it," Mo Li sighed.

After dinner, Mo Li told his wife, "We still have savings left. Even with the caravan gone, as long as I live, I can rebuild!"

"What is it?" Mo Li was curious as he asked.

"After you left, the city lord announced that loyal Gu Masters with A grade aptitude would be selected. It is an order from the higher-ups to nurture new Gu Immortals."

"Oh? The city lord posted a notice?" Mo Li asked. "I passed the gates too quickly to notice."

Mo Li's wife continued, "Our son heard and wants to sign up."

Mo Li chuckled: "I admire his ambition, but he only has B grade aptitude."

His wife laughed: "Aptitude matters less than loyalty to Mo clan. If we show sufficient loyalty, he might be selected."

Mo Li realized at once, asking:" How much?"

When Mo Li's wife named the sum, Peng Da's jaw dropped.

Mo Li's wife looked troubled: "Even all our savings won't be enough. Husband, the decision is yours."

Mo Li hesitated before steeling his resolve: "I will borrow! It is rare that our son wants to improve himself. I'll shamelessly borrow until we have enough funds."

# Chapter 1974: Creating An Opening

Beneath Soul Pacifying grotto-heaven's purple sky and thick grey clouds, the layout was impressive enough to draw praise even from Spectral Soul.

As a soul path grotto-heaven with abundant resources, it had once produced two rank eight soul path immortals simultaneously.

Soul Pacifying grotto-heaven's greatest trait was an immortal killer move influencing all its lifeforms, pacifying soul beasts and soothing Gu Immortals' souls to greatly aid soul cultivation.

Already raising soul beasts, Soul Pacifying grotto-heaven's Gu Immortals ventured outside to hunt and stockpile even more to prepare for war in the unified five regions.

Deeming this insufficient, the leadership led by Lady Cold Ash dispatched even more Gu Immortals to hunt soul beasts.

After resting only a few days in the grotto-heaven, An Xun was ordered back out to hunt soul beasts.

Before his departure, Lady Cold Ash summoned him: "You will command three thousand soul beasts guarded by an immemorial soul beast. Do your best."

Leading the soul beast army, An Xun departed Soul Pacifying grotto-heaven to hunt in black heaven.

Finding few soul beasts along the way but gathering abundant qi path immortal materials, An Xun did not know whether to laugh or cry.

# Chapter 1993: Fang Yuan Within The Mist

Sovereign immortal aperture, Mini Southern Border.

In a valley, Shi Shi Cheng leaned over to examine the stone mushrooms.

Healthy stone mushrooms stood five feet tall, but these were stunted like felled tree stumps. Instead of a healthy gray, their bodies showed a distorted multicolored hue.

"These stone mushrooms are ruined!" Shi Shi Cheng's expression turned grim upon confirming his inspection.

Light flashed as Fang Yuan's will manifested mid-air.

Fang Yuan's will waved a hand: "The destruction of the stone mushrooms was a natural disaster. Return for now; materials will arrive shortly to rebuild the valley."

Shi Shi Cheng nodded: "Lord is perceptive. Can these stone mushrooms be recycled somehow? It would be a pity to discard them."

Fang Yuan shook his head: "Don't worry about the details. If I can resolve it, you have no need to worry; if I cannot, knowing is useless. None of these stone mushrooms are usable; using them as Gu refinement materials would only cause harm. You may leave."

Shi Shi Cheng left, only Fang Yuan's will remained in this valley.

Fang Yuan's expression was grim.

The mushrooms' earth path dao marks had been replaced by a chaotic mix of wind, lightning, poison, dark, and fire dao marks.

"Heaven's will!" Fang Yuan's will sneered, discovering heaven's will lurking in the valley.

With a roar, he transformed into a mist blanketing the valley to hunt down heaven's will.

Fang Yuan triumphed and eradicated the lurking heaven's will, though at no small cost.

This victory treated only the symptoms, not the root cause—new troubles would inevitably arise!

Heaven's will had been manifesting across the sovereign immortal aperture, ruining numerous resource points.

By personally refining Gu to destroy fate Gu permanently, Fang Yuan's main body had gained over three thousand heaven path dao marks.

These unrefined dao marks spontaneously transformed the sovereign immortal aperture's environments, making them increasingly balanced and stable.

This greatly enhanced long-term potential, but inflicted heavy near-term losses on Fang Yuan.

Because all his assets resided within the aperture, heavy losses directly undermined his battle strength. Refusing to succumb to Red Lotus's trap, Fang Yuan commanded his subordinates to combat the incessant natural disasters. Simultaneously, he retrieved the thousand wish tree and incomplete Human Sea, using human path to restrain heaven path's effects.

This strategy improved conditions, yet the heaven path dao marks began spawning heaven's will over time.

Unlike the impartial Heavenly Dao, adaptable heaven's will deliberately sabotaged resource points across the sovereign immortal aperture.

"Though I have heaven's will dissipation, the vast aperture constantly generates new heaven's will anywhere, making clearing it inefficient."

The fundamental solution was directly refining these heaven path dao marks so they truly belonged to him.

No one had ever cultivated heaven path before; the only known method was using human path to suppress it.

"Emperor City has become a human path sacred land; seizing it would greatly restrain the Heavenly Dao."

The second way was in Crazed Demon Cave.

"Limitless Demon Venerable's Crazed Demon Cave houses Heavenly Dao derivations in its eighth layer, where demonic sounds corrupt materials through disrupted dao marks. This mirrors my corrupted resources; unlocking Crazed Demon Cave's secrets should resolve this predicament."

Targeting Emperor City would trigger battle with Heavenly Court, and Fang Yuan feared the hidden schemes of Genesis Lotus and Red Lotus.

Genesis Lotus had schemed away Fang Di Chang; recent luck inspections revealed no trace of him, making death probable.

Red Lotus had also plotted against him with these heaven path dao marks, while simultaneously scheming against Spectral Soul. These dao marks were both a danger and a blessing, preventing Spectral Soul from activating hidden methods.

The Three Crazed Demon Eccentrics had failed to appear in the fate war and vanished without a trace.

Fang Yuan suspected Giant Sun Immortal Venerable had plotted wisdom Gu's consumption, proving the venerable still held hidden trump cards.

With fate Gu destroyed, venerables could revive, and entering Crazed Demon Cave would force Fang Yuan to confront their methods.

Another concern weighing on Fang Yuan was the ongoing turbulence within the River of Time.

Since fate Gu's destruction, the River of Time had grown so turbulent that even Myriad Year Flying Warship could not explore for long.

Consequently, Spring Autumn Cicada was temporarily unusable.

In current violent rapids, activating Spring Autumn Cicada would smash it to pieces without a specialized killer move.

"Turbulent water is manageable, but my true concern remains what other arrangements Red Lotus left in the River of Time."

With fate Gu finally destroyed, Fang Yuan had escaped the Sword of Damocles hanging over his head.

Yet the path ahead was shrouded in mist, like walking through a perilous valley where safe terrain and fatal cliffs lay indistinguishable.

Was his lifelong pursuit of eternal life hidden within that mist?

If it existed, where would it be?

# Chapter 1994: Ice Crystal Immortal Monarch Fights Fang Zheng

# Chapter 1995: Extreme Ice Crystal Light Immortal Suppression Coffin

Around him, countless traces of frost energy gathered, whipping up a storm.

Qi Sea Ancestor and Wu Shuai clashed repeatedly across the two heavens and Eastern Sea.

Though Wu Shuai and Qi Sea Ancestor fought frequently, casualties remained low, as both sides prioritized resolving the qi harvest fruit crisis over destroying each other.

"Demon Immortal Qi Jue likely understands the qi harvest fruit best, but my strength is constrained," Fang Yuan sighed.

Though he had resolved the threat of heaven's will, he still had no clue how to refine the heaven path dao marks.

Demon Immortal Qi Jue, whom Fang Yuan was pondering, had just arrived in Western Desert.

Failing to borrow Gu from Qi Sea Ancestor, he used qi path investigative methods to search for other qi path Immortal Gu.

"I deduced a qi path Immortal Gu is nearby." As Demon Immortal Qi Jue muttered, a Gu Immortal suddenly entered his investigative range.

Rank eight Gu Immortal, Red Heart Traveler!

# Chapter 2014: Qi Jue Takes Blood Qi

Seeing the handsome, green-robed Gu Immortal in a headband standing tall and imposing, Demon Immortal Qi Jue was startled: "Could that qi path Immortal Gu I deduced be on him?"

The moment this thought emerged, Demon Immortal Qi Jue attacked!

With a loud sound, a giant white qi hand moved to catch Red Heart Traveler.

Unrecognized by Qi Jue, Red Heart Traveler already possessed Heavenly Court's intelligence on him.
