The next moment, blood-red light flared behind Red Heart Traveler's head, sharply boosting his speed and allowing him to dodge the qi hand.

Unwilling to let Red Heart Traveler escape so easily, Demon Immortal Qi Jue gave chase.

After pursuing for a while, Demon Immortal Qi Jue shouted: "Where do you think you're running?"

Surrounding qi currents instantly engulfed Red Heart Traveler, severely hindering his speed.

Disadvantaged in direct combat, Red Heart Traveler shielded himself with radiant blood-red flowers that exuded righteous warmth.

Suddenly, a beast roared as an immemorial desolate beast burst from the sands, launching a surprise attack on Demon Immortal Qi Jue from behind.

Just before the giant hand struck, the beast shone brilliantly and transformed into an immemorial swallow, shooting at Demon Immortal Qi Jue like a black arrow.

"A transformation path Gu Immortal! Haha, interesting," Demon Immortal Qi Jue praised in mild surprise while engaging the new foe.

The aid was from Nine Spiritual Fairy.

"We can't drag this out! This old demon is terrifying, and we are no match for him. We are only holding on because he is unfamiliar with our methods," Red Heart Traveler hurriedly transmitted.

"I have a plan, follow me!" Nine Spiritual Fairy transmitted, retreating while fighting.

Demon Immortal Qi Jue pursued the two immortals deep into the desert.

Nine Spiritual Fairy transformed into an immemorial desolate beast, took Red Heart Traveler into her mouth, and plunged into the sands.

With a clap of his hands, heaven and earth shook. Milky-white qi currents slammed down like a tsunami, depressing the surrounding hundred li of desert over ten feet deep!

Just as Demon Immortal Qi Jue moved to dive down and give chase, a beast roared and a massive immemorial soul beast erupted from the desert.

Furious and bizarrely shaped, the immemorial soul beast possessed a tortoise shell, four tiger paws, a dragon tail, a snake neck, and a disheveled human head with eyes radiating ominous fury.

"You found Qing Chou!" Seeing Demon Immortal Qi Jue tangled with the beast, Red Heart Traveler exclaimed in shock.

Nine Spiritual Fairy had located Qing Chou recently, but lacked the strength to subdue it alone. When Red Heart Traveler encountered Demon Immortal Qi Jue, she devised a plan to pit Qi Jue against the beast.

Contrary to their expectations, Demon Immortal Qi Jue sensed something amiss and exhaled vast qi currents that filled the sky.

He entered them and quickly disappeared.

Lacking an opponent, Qing Chou also fled beyond the horizon.

Deep underground, the two Heavenly Court immortals exchanged looks. Red Heart Traveler blurted out: "Damn it! The Blood Sea true inheritance is going to be taken!"

Nine Spiritual Fairy froze before asking: "You truly found that blood path true inheritance?"

Red Heart Traveler sighed: "A qi tide exposed the Blood Sea true inheritance, but I arrived only to encounter Qi Jue."

Meanwhile, Demon Immortal Qi Jue returned to the original spot.

"It really is here!" After inspecting the area, he found the target unmoved.

With further effort, he successfully claimed this Blood Sea true inheritance.

"And this blood qi Immortal Gu suits me perfectly. Hahaha."

Acquiring a qi path Immortal Gu boosted his strength far beyond immortal material consumption.

Though still short of his historical peak, he was already far stronger than when he fought Fang Yuan.

# Chapter 2015: Sand Wolf City's Huge Change

Western Desert.

Amid howling winds and flying sand, a camel caravan trudged with difficulty through the barren desert.

"Heavens, we're finally back at Sand Wolf City," an exhausted Peng Da exclaimed from within the caravan.

Riding a camel beside him, Gu Master Mo Li chuckled: "Kid, you're singing a different tune from when we first set out."

Mo Li smiled, thinking of his wife and reformed son, who was being cultivated as a seed.

These simple blessings gave Mo Li fresh hope and drive. Caravan life was arduous, but he found his own joy in it.

Finally, they arrived in front of Sand Wolf City's gate.

Sand Wolf City lay in smoking ruins, corpses and rubble littering the burning streets.

Mo Li muttered dazedly before bolting toward the inner city.

Reaching the ruined house, Peng Da found Mo Li kneeling in silence before his wife's excavated corpse.

Looking at the statue-still Mo Li, Peng Da hesitated before urging: "Uncle, pull yourself together. Don't forget you still have a son."

These words jolted Mo Li, reigniting a glimmer of hope in his eyes.

"My son is in the inner city being nurtured as a Gu Immortal seed—let's find him!"

Carrying his wife's corpse, Mo Li rushed toward the inner city with Peng Da.

The whole inner city area had turned into a huge crater.

Peng Da gasped, realizing the massive crater was a beast's footprint. For a footprint to be this immense, the beast had to be colossal!

"Did the giant beast not leave?" Peng Da looked up and saw two figures floating in the sky.

"Gu Immortals!" The other Gu Masters shouted.

"Disaster befell this place as well." The Gu Immortals spoke openly, their voices echoing below.

"This damned beast caused my Mo clan disastrous losses. Once I capture it, I will pull out its tendons and flay its skin!" another Gu Immortal fumed.

"Let's go, we will catch up soon." The two Gu Immortals quickly flew off.

"I want to follow them and look," Mo Li said resolutely.

Mo Li was firm: "I cannot avenge my family, but I will stake everything to see the culprit die with my own eyes!"

"Uncle, I also want to follow you." Peng Da said.

"Stay behind, kid." Mo Li's expression softened as he looked at Peng Da.

Peng Da smiled bitterly: "You saved me repeatedly and are closest to me. I won't leave you now—let me come!"

Mo Li stared at Peng Da for a long while before nodding hoarsely: "Then follow me, rascal."

Following the beast's trail across the desert, Mo Li struggled forward alone; climbing a sand dune, he took a sharp breath at what he saw.

Far away in the horizon, dark fog covered everywhere.

The fog was the dark qi current from earlier. Within it, Mo Li vaguely saw a mountain-sized beast and occasional flashes of lightning.

Mo Li took a deep breath and was about to advance when someone suddenly hugged him from behind.

"Uncle, do you want to die? Don't go any further, you'll lose your life!" Peng Da shouted.

"Brat, why haven't you left yet?" Mo Li was furious.

Peng Da urged: "Uncle, you are my benefactor—how could I watch you die? Live on, don't throw your life away!"

"I don't need saving! Even if I die, I'll stake my life for revenge. If even an insignificant attack lands on that damned beast, I will be satisfied!"

Boom——!

As they bickered, a hurricane swept in from the battle on the horizon.

Resembling a pillar connecting heaven and earth, the hurricane rushed toward them.

"Damn it!" Unable to dodge in time, Peng Da and Mo Li were swept away by the hurricane.

The two insignificant figures instantly vanished into the violent hurricane.

# Chapter 2016: Dazzling Smile

Western Desert.

Dark clouds covered the sky and thunder rumbled as the Mo clan Gu Immortals battled the mysterious giant beast.

"You want to kill me?" The mysterious giant beast suddenly spoke in human words.

Simultaneously, the giant beast opened its mouth and shot out its long purple-red tongue.

The tongue pierced a Mo clan Gu Immortal at astonishing speed. Almost instantly, the potent poison corroded the immortal into nothingness.

"A legendary immemorial beast?!" The surviving Mo clan Gu Immortal retreated in horrified panic.

The beast was Qing Chou; dense ghost qi surged around it, forming figures that slaughtered the remaining immortal.

"Pursue me?" Anger flashed across Qing Chou's face: "You two idiots don't even know you're being used. Die!"

With the monster driven off, Qing Chou's ghost qi intensified. Looking toward the sky, it sneered: "Two despicable worms, are you still not coming out?"

Heavenly Court's Nine Spiritual Fairy and Red Heart Traveler slowly showed themselves, floating side by side as they looked down at Qing Chou.

With their ambush exposed, the two Heavenly Court immortals attacked.

However, before long, a qi tide began to appear.

The dead Mo clan immortals' apertures had opened, absorbing heaven and earth qi to stabilize.

The difference in heaven and earth qi between the apertures and the outside world, combined with the clashes against Qing Chou, generated a massive qi tide.

The qi tide heavily suppressed Qing Chou, while the Heavenly Court immortals with phantom apertures remained unaffected.

Qing Chou roared and struggled in vain.

It realized Heavenly Court's deeper scheme: they had not only used the Western Desert immortals, but even factored their immortal apertures into the plan!

While Qing Chou fought bitterly, Peng Da shook his head and opened his eyes.

"Where am I?" After a dazed moment, he found Mo Li carrying him across a huge sand dune.

Mo Li sighed: "The hurricane swept us over ten thousand li away. We are heading back now."

Having lived in the desert for years, Mo Li easily navigated the directions.

Peng Da grew worried: "Uncle, you still want to return? You want to go back and die?!"

Mo Li fell silent before replying with deep resolve: "I know it's risky, but if I don't even see the killer of my wife and son, I will never rest easy!"

As they argued, the sand beneath Mo Li shifted into a huge whirlpool, sucking them both inside.

Peng Da tried to no avail, his face pale: "Is this quicksand? We are going to be sucked in!"

Mo Li sighed deeply: "I implicated you, Peng Da."

But soon, Peng Da's attention was caught by another thing.

He found that Uncle Mo Li, usually so strong-willed, was actually weeping.

Mo Li sobbed: "I am dying without avenging them! I am too weak—the gap between immortals and mortals is too vast. I am only an ant!"

Hot sand poured into Peng Da's mouth as he quickly closed it. Completely buried, his vision filled with darkness.

Suddenly, in his dark vision, there were specks of starlight.

"Huh? I didn't die?" Peng Da sat up, looking around in disbelief.

He was at the bottom of a dry well. The quicksand whirlpool continued rotating at the entrance, yet strangely, no sand fell down.

A mysterious force held back the quicksand whirlpool, allowing only Peng Da and Mo Li to enter.

"Uncle, uncle?" Peng Da spotted Mo Li, calling twice before getting a response.

"Kid, you're awake? We've struck gold!" Mo Li turned around, saying in shock and excitement: "This is likely a Gu Immortal's inheritance!"

Right then, the starlight moved like tidal waves, bypassing Mo Li and entering Peng Da's body.

Peng Da stood dazed like a statue, his eyes wide open.

Mo Li rushed over: "Peng Da, are you alright?"

Only then did Peng Da react: "Un... uncle, you were right, this is Thieving Heaven Demon Venerable's true inheritance!"

"Thieving Heaven Demon Venerable?!" Mo Li was shaken. In these changing times, knowledge of venerables and the Gu Immortal world was no longer secret among mortals.

Mo Li murmured: "An otherworldly demon? No wonder the inheritance did not respond to me."

Mo Li waved his hand: "So what if you're an otherworldly demon? You're still the Peng Da I know, aren't you?"

Mo Li added: "You really struck it big this time. Since you inherited the Demon Venerable's inheritance, find the method to leave quickly. Ordinary methods are useless here."

Peng Da felt ashamed: "Uncle, though I have many Gu worms, I've never seen them before and need practice. According to the inheritance, I must use a killer move to leave here."

"Then practise it quickly, ask anything you don't understand, uncle will guide you!"

Over the next few days, Peng Da practiced relentlessly. As a mortal, the Gu worms he practiced with were all mortal Gu.

Mo Li guided his study, demonstrating how to activate the Gu worms.

Finally, Peng Da barely mastered several Gu worms and found a way to activate a killer move.

"Go on, Peng Da, try to succeed in one attempt!" Mo Li encouraged him.

"Watch this, uncle." Peng Da unleashed the killer move, but it failed.

Backlash from the failed killer move struck him; coughing blood, he collapsed to the ground.

"Peng Da, are you okay?" Mo Li quickly inspected him.

Peng Da wheezed: "I have disappointed you, uncle. But rest assured, I will definitely... ah!"

Mo Li's hand pierced his chest, destroying his heart in a sneak attack!

"Un... uncle..." Even more blood poured from Peng Da's mouth.

Mo Li raised his head slowly, eyes tearful and expression twisted, filling Peng Da with dread and alienation.

Mo Li rasped: "I want revenge! But the inheritance chose you, and you couldn't even master a killer move. Uncle cannot wait any longer; I cannot depend on you."

Mo Li then took out his hand.

Peng Da fell powerlessly to the ground, his eyes gazing helplessly at the well's entrance.

He was dead.

Without pausing, Mo Li activated his Gu worms and captured Peng Da's soul.

"The Thieving Heaven true inheritance is mine now." Mo Li laughed, a dazzling smile spreading across his blood-spattered face.

# Chapter 2085: Four Conditions to Become Venerable

Across three million years of history in this Gu world, only ten Gu cultivators stood at the apex, looking down upon all living beings.

In his pursuit of eternal life, rank nine venerable cultivation was merely a stepping stone for Fang Yuan.

His plan to become a venerable was set the moment he was reborn!

But how could he become a venerable?

"First, the Gu Immortal's immortal aperture origin core must produce white litchi immortal essence."

"Fourth, after meeting the first three conditions, the Gu Immortal must break through the Heavenly Dao blockade, triggering a qualitative change in their origin core to produce rank nine yellow apricot immortal essence."

Lu Wei Yin explained: "The way of heaven takes away surpluses while replenishing deficits, balancing all things through mutual restriction. A tall tree is the first to face destruction; soil closest to the water is the first swept away by currents. The way of humans is the exact opposite: it reduces deficits and builds surpluses, devouring the weak and learning continuously to grow even stronger."

"The Heavenly Dao restricts Gu Immortals through calamities and tribulations. Before one becomes a venerable, it unleashes a tribulation far surpassing any myriad tribulation!"

"Then there is lifespan Gu, binding even invincible venerables, whose natural production continuously drops while a venerable is alive."

Fang Yuan pondered: "Of the three Heavenly Dao blockades, Fate Gu is destroyed and lifespan Gu is no immediate concern, leaving the tribulation blockade as my greatest hurdle."

"Is there a way to overcome the Heavenly Dao blockade? How did historical venerables bypass it?" Fang Yuan asked.

Lu Wei Yin answered: "Historical venerables' immense innate luck stemmed from two shortcuts: heaven's will and human path adoration."

"Three million years ago, when variant humans disrupted the balance, the Heavenly Dao countered them by favoring Primordial Origin with heaven's will, allowing him to become an Immortal Venerable."

"For human path adoration, tribulation struck at Red Lotus Demon Venerable's birth, forcing Heavenly Court's Three Dukes to shield him."

Lu Wei Yin nodded: "Indeed. All venerables drew inspiration from The Legends of Ren Zu to create top-tier human path methods."

After analyzing, he realized only two obstacles restricted him from becoming a venerable: attainment level and the Heavenly Dao blockade.

The blockade could be handled through Cooking Luck Pot and further-developed human path methods.
